reviews.author: Ace Mastev
reviews.text: a wonderful place for you and your friends... here they offer a large number of cocktails with perfect flavors, whiskey and good fun... this should be seen and felt and tried

reviews.author: Aysenaz Coskunkan
reviews.text: Amazing cocktails and great atmosphere. The service was really good for that many people at the bar. Very friendly staff. I would recommend it and go again next time i’m in town ☺️

reviews.author: Marina Jovanova Masteva
reviews.text: perfect peaceful place….. delicious cocktails and perfect service…. highly recommended.  😉

reviews.author: Bálint Kondor
reviews.text:
Great bar, awesome, high quality cocktails for a fair price, and a really fun atmosphere:)
The Barkeeper is a great guy too, I can definitely reccomend this place to anyone.

reviews.author: Jordan
reviews.text: Landed in Berlin and decided to come to this bar the first night and it was the best experience i possibly could have on the first night. Shoutout to the bartender mladen he opened me with open arms, made really good drinks and gave me recommendations! If you are in Berlin this a must spot!

reviews.author: Shannon Maguire
reviews.text: Happy with the drinks, food, and service! The server was great, he told us when to be ready to take photos of certain drinks when they came to the table. Before ordering he gave great suggestions based on our preferences. Server was very attentive throughout the meal. Food and drinks came out fairly quick. The drinks were picture-worthy and delicious. The food was also great, and costs were reasonable. Great experience overall!

reviews.author: Joseph Abou Chedid
reviews.text:
Didn’t get the chance to try the cocktails unfortunately, but we had a good food experience overall.

Both burgers were tasty, cooked well and came with nice sides. The pretzel could’ve been better if it wasn’t so salty, same goes for the steak — way too much salt.

On the other hand, the chicken, calamari, and shrimp were all really good. Everything was fresh and well-prepared.

The prices are decent too — most mains are around €10, which is nice for this kind of place.

Would come back to try the drinks next time!

reviews.author: Shreyas Gore
reviews.text:
The Alchemist near Potsdamer Platz definitely lives up to its promise of serving up theatre in a glass! If you're looking for more than just a standard cocktail, this is the place to be. Its prime location, a stone's throw from the S-Bahn, makes it incredibly easy to reach, and the ambience inside sets a cool, slightly mysterious tone. While they do offer food, it's clear the real star of the show here is the drinks menu.
We dove straight into the theatrical offerings and were not disappointed. The Light Bulb Moment arrived in a, you guessed it, a light bulb, complete with a smoking flourish that was as intriguing as the drink itself. The Pipe Dream was equally captivating, served in a way that played on its name with a playful presentation. Even "the legal one" and the Lavend Air weren't just poured; they each had their own unique glass and a little bit of extra flair that made them feel special.
It's clear that a lot of thought and creativity goes into crafting not just the cocktails themselves, but the entire experience of receiving them. Each drink felt like a mini-performance, making it a fun and engaging way to enjoy an evening out.
If you're someone who appreciates a bit of spectacle with your sip and enjoys drinks that are as visually interesting as they are (hopefully!) delicious, then The Alchemist Potsdamer Platz is a must-visit. Be prepared for a bit of novelty and a departure from your usual bar experience. It's definitely a spot to check out for a memorable night out focused on the art of the cocktail.

reviews.author: Giselle Q
reviews.text: Im currently visiting Berlin, Germany for the first time and I came across this wonderful restaurant that specializes in theatre drinks. It was just an incredibly unique experience that made my night. From edible cup drinks, to drinks that change colors, oyster drinks, and many other options that I had the pleasure of tasting. Also, the food was reasonably priced, yummy, and they have many options that will satisfy anyone who visits. To capture the moment there’s a Photo Booth. Lastly, my server Ivan completely made my night and went the extra mile to put a smile on my face. I will definitely recommend this as a MUST visit when you come to Berlin and if you’re lucky enough, you will encounter Ivan as I did. Thank you Alchemist for everything!!!! My new favorite restaurant restaurant in Berlin

reviews.author: ecem kara
reviews.text: We were here for celebrating for our friends new relationship. The place was so joyful and cozy, really enjoyed it. The drinks were amazing!!!! Everything has a lots of taste inside and the presentation was super cool!!!! I really recommend this bar, you can feel luxury. Thank you so much for your services!!!

reviews.author: Anthony Alkosseifi
reviews.text:
Vault Bar Berlin is an absolute gem! The venue is cozy, with a warm ambiance and an original interior design concept that makes it stand out. The atmosphere is perfect for a relaxed yet sophisticated night out.

We ordered the Sesame Street and Purple Cloud cocktails, and both were incredibly tasty—expertly crafted with unique flavors. The only downside was that the service was a bit slow, but given that it was a busy Saturday night and the place was packed, it was understandable.

Overall, a fantastic experience, and I’d definitely return! Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Jens Jacobeit
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
A true hidden gem in Berlin!
Vault Bar impresses with its stylish, intimate atmosphere, incredibly comfortable seating, and top-tier signature cocktails. Each drink is a work of art – both in taste and presentation. One highlight: cocktails are prepared right at your table, with flair and attention to detail.
The staff is plentiful, professional, and knowledgeable – offering excellent recommendations and lightning-fast service.
If you love cocktails and a relaxed yet elegant vibe, this place is a must. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Neeraj Mittal
reviews.text:
The Vault Bar is a true hidden gem in Berlin.
This speakeasy-style bar offers a cozy, intimate vibe and some of the best cocktails we’ve ever had. The team is incredibly friendly and passionate about their craft.

Special thanks to Ferhat, who made us two incredible drinks – the Botanical Woman and Lemongrass Gimlet – after asking about our flavor preferences. His attention to detail and creativity truly made the experience unforgettable.

Highly recommend this place for anyone looking to enjoy a unique and elevated cocktail night. Can’t wait to visit again!

reviews.author: İrem Arslan
reviews.text: The most glamorous bar in the city, you can easily find unique, delicious and signature cocktails. I definitely recommend it. Also: the service and atmosphere were great. I will definitely come back soon :)

reviews.author: Inbal Shacked
reviews.text:
Very good Cocktail bar. Friendly staff, we were seated although didn't reserve in advance and were a group of 6.
The signature Cocktails are special and I'd definitely come back.

reviews.author: Melissa Frederique
reviews.text:
Great views!
The place overall is pleasant but the music is so loud it takes away from the lounge aspect. The servers and very energetic which makes it a little hectic.
Drinks are nice! And also pricey, average 15€. The views are beautiful and really make up for it.

reviews.author: Elli Stylianou
reviews.text:
The view from Monkey Bar is amazing. The place has a great vibe and looks really cool. I loved the atmosphere!

But the cocktails are pretty expensive, and you definitely need a reservation. If not, you’ll probably have to wait in line for about an hour. Still, once you’re inside, it’s a really nice experience.

reviews.author: Seckin Doganli
reviews.text: One of the best rooftop bars I have visited. It has an amazing view over Tiergarten and city landmarks. Music is good, variety of cocktails are great. I recommend Missionary’s Downfall for a good sweet cocktail. It gets really busy through the night so be there before 20:00 to get a seat with a nice view.

reviews.author: Dez
reviews.text: Great drinks. Great view. Great atmosphere. Great music. Vibes. The jungle 25 was delicious. Perfectly tart and velvety with mild rum funk.

reviews.author: TH3 TR/\V1R
reviews.text: The best thing about this bar is its high altitude and view over the apes section of the Berlin zoo. Cocktails were just ok, staff was friendly but service on weekend evenings was super slow, 2 people serving the tables and 1 bartender are just way too few people for the capacity of around 150 guests. Prices are upmarket.

reviews.author: Henrik Holmberg
reviews.text: I travel all around the world and I love cocktails. Chris designs some of the best original and drink variations I've ever had. Sure, it's a bit on the expensive side, but worth every penny. The atmosphere is great as well. Do yourself a favor and visit this place if you're in Berlin.

reviews.author: Serkan Iravul
reviews.text: I had a great experience at Le Jardin. The staff were very attentive and went out of their way to help us choose the right cocktails. Their signature cocktails were not only unique but also incredibly tasty. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Elena Kuzminova
reviews.text:
Absolutely Wonderful Experience!

I had an amazing time at this French restaurant! Everything was perfect — from the elegant atmosphere to the exceptional service. The food was absolutely delicious, beautifully presented, and full of authentic French flavors. Every dish felt like a work of art. The staff were attentive, friendly, and made us feel truly welcome. I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend this place to anyone who loves great food and a classy dining experience!

reviews.author: Huseyin Muhammed Çoban
reviews.text:
service, atmosphere and drinks were great. entrance part is smoking free, so be careful about that if you don't like that sort of places. however if you could mention it you can also find a seat in the back where is smoking is not allowed.

on overall, was a great experience, absolutely worth a visit!

reviews.author: Spotlight Videos
reviews.text: A perfect host (Jonas) at a beautiful bar. Very good service and drinks.

reviews.author: Giorgos Tsigourakos
reviews.text: A great speak easy place a bit outside of the center of the city. We tasted 4 cocktails and each one was unique. The decoration is also very nice and aligns with the bar's title. The service was great and they were very welcoming. A definite suggestion for anyone that wants to drink an excellent cocktail and chill.

reviews.author: Despina Anastasova
reviews.text: Great speakeasy bar. Love the vibe and the fantasy theme. Unique cocktails. The waiter was very nice and explained all the cocktails and helped us out with choosing the right one for our taste.

reviews.author: Rina Feast (That’s How We Feast)
reviews.text: This bar offers one of the best experience in Berlin. The atmosphere is very cool and all the little details made such a special evening. The menu is also fun. Service is friendly👍🏻 and the drinks were delicious. They also offer some alcohol free options!

reviews.author: Laura Loisel
reviews.text:
What a find! The decoration is amazing, the service perfect and even the drinks menu is totally unique. It’s a little pricier than average but it’s completely worth it
Little plus: in the women’s toilets there are sanitary towels and other hygiene products just in case - nice and thoughtful!

reviews.author: Aleksei Minkov
reviews.text:
Honestly? They’re trying way too hard to be a speakeasy. Like yeah, the door's shut and they make you wait outside like it's some big secret—but it’s all for show. Once you're in, the vibe kinda falls apart.

The waiter rushed us to order like two minutes after we sat down. Dude, you hand me a cool deck-of-cards-style menu with fancy drink names and artsy pics, then tell me to "just ask, I’m faster than Google"? Chill. I came here to relax, not feel like I’m on a game show.

The place was packed with parents with their teenagers, which honestly killed any kind of "secret bar" mood they were going for. Cheap drinks sold overpriced.

Cool concept, bad execution. It's not worth the hype and price.

reviews.author: Tal Belilty
reviews.text: If you're into jazz, an underground atmosphere, and live jamming, Madam Claude is a must-visit! It's a really nice bar with a cool vibe. Just a heads-up: get there early if you want to participate in the jamming – it gets popular!

reviews.author: Diego S.
reviews.text:
Great bar with Friendly service, ambience and prices. Large selections of beer starting from €3.50. The bar has tablefoosball set and an arcade machine to the left when going in. The main room is on the right.
The whole room is turned upside down which is beautiful, totally recommend

reviews.author: Mohammad Ebrahim
reviews.text:
A very very interesting Pub/club.

The place used to be a brothel before being a pub.

The decor is very interesting and it was one the main reasons I wanted to visit, where everything is set upside down (literally).

Smoking is allowed inside which can be annoying to non smokers.

Many rooms to chill.

There's live music everyday there. However it is very hot in the music room, specially when it gets packed. It needs more ventilation and air conditioning.

reviews.author: Mario G.H.
reviews.text:
A real hidden Gem. The place has a unique concept and a versatile cultural and event offering.
What I like the most is the upside-down furniture glued to the roof, simply is so full of details.
Can only recommend it to have a cozy and wholesome night with friends.

reviews.author: Volky
reviews.text: An incredible bar with live DJ performances every night! The bar staff are exceptionally friendly, and the seating options are super cozy. I’m genuinely surprised to have had such an amazing and spontaneous evening in Kreuzberg, completely stress-free.

reviews.author: illy loulou
reviews.text:
Great staff, heads up to Junior! Delicious drinks, between 12 to 18 euros for cocktails,big dark place and nice light probe projections. Music was just right. The ceiling designs are nice! If they would offer a bit more just, it would be perfect.
Very close to the M8 tram stop, in a nice bustling round about.
Our first bar in Berlin, will be coming back!

reviews.author: Thulio Philipe (thulioph)
reviews.text: Great selection of drinks and very good staff. They also offer some free snacks. I’d definitely recommend it.

reviews.author: Aaron Sarkissian
reviews.text: Nice bar. It's pretty good and calm. The music is techno but not too loud. The service is little bit slow but overall it's a good place. The price depends on what you want to drink, they have from cheap brands to the most expensive ones. Their cocktails and mixes are great, the price range for the cocktails are from 8-12€.

reviews.author: Nina Evardone
reviews.text: The name of the bar is not as appealing as it may sound but they serve nice drinks - the cocktails are tasty but nothing really extraordinary. The ambiance is comfy and the music is not too loud which is a perfect ambiance to just chill.

reviews.author: Diana A
reviews.text:
Slow service, drinks were not as we expected. Weird aftertaste and we ordered our „usuals“. Expensive for the service and products. Would not recommend.
Edit: We ordered cocktails on drink basis that we usually like, reason for which we were a bit surprised we did not enjoy them. ☺️ Anyway, maybe other clients will find them good, so that’s ok. However, service could be improved.

reviews.author: Morteza Shirkhorshidi (Muri)
reviews.text: Very good drinks, delicious food, nice and friendly staff, very good atmosphere, clean WC ... And cheap! Recommended !

reviews.author: Diego Salvador
reviews.text:
I was there for the first time yesterday. Great bar to come with a group of friends for drinks. The music is nice, not too loud so people can talk. The place looks cool.

And the guy who works there, Mermet, is the best! Super friendly and fun.

I'll be coming many more times, for sure!

reviews.author: Victor Lecomte
reviews.text: Super friendly staff/waiter/cook. Good place to watch football. If they had the volume turned up it would be great. The food is alright for a pub like this. In my opinion it's above average. The cheerful staff stands out and turns this place into a great experience.

reviews.author: Simon Evald
reviews.text: Very relaxing pub with amazing service. Lovely in-keeper. A bit expensive in comparison to surrounding pubs, however it is definitely worth it, taking it all into consideration.

reviews.author: Jacob Heinrichs
reviews.text: The ideal neighborhood bar, run by a genius

reviews.author: Debbie Foster
reviews.text:
It was our first night in Berlin and the hotel reception recommended that we try this restaurant.
I wasn’t disappointed. I had grilled sausage and I was able to choose to have just one sausage (or 2, or 3) which came with sauerkraut and potato. It was yum and the price was good. Hubby had liver which had a delicious gravy (mine did too) and mashed potatoes. It was good.

reviews.author: Marifer Fragoso
reviews.text: It was so delicious!! The space is great, fun environment. Our bartender Frank/Philip was so helpful and he gave us amazing recommendations!! You HAVE to come here!! 100% recommend it!!!

reviews.author: aleksei milov
reviews.text:
Stopped here for a true taste of Berlin classics - we shared the pork knuckle, tried the authentic currywurst, and added a Caesar salad for good measure. Everything was delicious, hearty, and perfectly cooked. Portions were generous too.

A special mention to our lovely waitress — warm, attentive, and her recommendation of the Apfelschorle was spot on !)

Highly recommend this spot for anyone who appreciates quality meat dishes and genuine Berlin hospitality.

reviews.author: Xin Ru Toh
reviews.text: Omni pub with vegan options. So happy I finally got to try a Vegan Currywurst, a German staple! Chubby, juicy, and tender 'sausage' that didn't have a strong mock meat aftertaste and left me pleasantly surprised. Served with tomato-based curry sauce and French fries. The non-vegans sitting at the table near me were amused and impressed when my dish was served hahaha. The Vegan Meatloaf went well with the caramelised onions and sweet mustard dip, and was also served with chunky potato salad, pickled caperberries, and spicy beetroot horseradish. Flavour-packed and fancier than I expected. Overall impressed with the great vegan options and friendly service! Located near Friedrichstraße Station, overlooking River Spree.

reviews.author: Uri Michon
reviews.text:
Very nice place located close to the river.
Place is a sprts bar heaving tables and dar seats as well.
Veey big place, around 150 people, so more than a little noosy.
Traditional barbarian kitchen.
Tried 3 sausages with cabbage and potatoes. Besides the potatoes that were cooked in water and had no taste, the sausages were great, and so was the cabbage
Potato salad plate, regular, no more.
Purple cabbage was interesting being cooked in red wine and sugar.  Too much sugar.
Prefared apple strudel over sweet rise and happy i did so. The cake is served warm over vanilla sauce with vanilla ice cream and cream. Sweetness was in the right amount, so it was great.
Service was not so friendly and without patience, could improve.

reviews.author: Lucas Kühn
reviews.text:
Only in Berlin.

This is why we come to this city. To experience something like this. Sitting on hospital beds, in an ambience of a toxic hazard chemical lab, surrounded by bizarre humor, flasks, bottles and skeletons, while drinking highly experimental yet boozy cocktails, thats what Zyankali Bar is.

You get served by the owner, who himself is an attraction on his own, with an attitude that fits right in.

The prices are not cheap, but more than justified. If its not your first drink of the night, one could say, one is enough, but only one is also enough to get curious what could be next, so be careful and wise in your choices.

reviews.author: Benjamin Föckersperger
reviews.text:
Drinks are cool, the overall theme as well. They even offer high percentage oxygen treatments while you enjoy the drinks.

The music is not music. And they know it as it seems, since there is a "music wish" in the online order system for 50 and 100 euros. So more a joke... ;)

The online order system is cool. You choose and see all drinks, pay and then they bring them over quite fast. Prices are on the higher end but OK. 6euro for a beer. 6.50 for a non alc cocktail. Around 12 for alcoholic Cocktail.

The lights are bright, because they have plants and it is bright LEDs. So I would say: worth an experience

reviews.author: ariel steinfeld
reviews.text: It was a really cool environment, all the cocktails we tried were very good and interesting. Nice experience overall.

reviews.author: Morten TS
reviews.text: The place is great. The menu is really unique, personally I went with the buzzworthy which indeed got me very buzzed with 30% alcohol for €12.50. The decor is amazing and the ordering is all by phone. There is a free limoncello shot for 5 star reviews, but it truly does deserve those reviews. There is also a dungeon playground with darts, pinball and a dance floor. We also got a free bottle of tap water without asking for it, which was very appreciated. I can only recommend checking out this place

reviews.author: Phottos Photos
reviews.text: Offers shot for 5* review. Horrible beer €7 per person. Not the one at all

reviews.author: Sabrina Jahnke
reviews.text: Lovely view 😍! One of the best in berlin for sure! The staff is a bit inattentive and was lots of empty glasses outside on multiple tables... still friendly and the drinks are good too. I would recommend this place and will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Ulrike Herold
reviews.text: The rooftop terrasse (great view of Gedächtniskirche) and decor are great. The cocktails were a bit weak and the service so lala.

reviews.author: Nolusindiso Hleko
reviews.text: Beautiful place with a beautiful atmosphere, staff is friendly and overall loved it here but it did take forever to get attention to order drinks and even longer to get our drinks served. So, maybe work on that

reviews.author: Oana Beje
reviews.text:
Stylish place with great cocktails. We actually wanted to visit the Monkey Bar nearby but it was too crowded so we went to Motel One Bar. The view is really fascinating. Cocktails are strong and the menu is varied.

I was very disssapoinyed by the staff. They were very slow and didn't pay attention, although there weren't that many customers.

reviews.author: Tamara Matvieieva
reviews.text: The bar is located on the 10th floor. Very beautiful cozy interior. The terrace has a great view of Berlin. The only disadvantage is long wait for waiter and order. But for the sake of this view I will come again))

reviews.author: Angana Barua
reviews.text: we went during the happy hour and its a super cool bar restaurant with a good seating area outside playing really good music, the waitress was really sweet. the washroom is also really clean and well kept :) will come back again for sure

reviews.author: berlintastemap
reviews.text: This is a great cocktail place on the coolest street of the city. You can meet your friends and enjoy the nice weather with cocktails and tapas. They also have happy hours between 16:00-19:00. Espresso martini and Pornstar martini were the hightlights for me.

reviews.author: Andrea Hasznos
reviews.text: Very nice cocktailbar on the Spree (bank). There is a large terrace you can enjoy in good weather, but there is also an indoor part - this has a very cosy atmosphere in the evening, with great lights. The floor is sand inside as well as outside.

reviews.author: J oe
reviews.text:
Cool spot that seems to be One of the only places that is open late in this area. The prices are a little on the high end, but you pay for the space, the service, and the general atmosphere of the place. It feels upmarket.

You get a bit of a shock when you walk in there because of the flooring- But you’ll have to go to find out what it is.

Decent Wi-Fi so if you are working late it’s perfect. The music is not too loud before 11.

reviews.author: Arash Salamati
reviews.text: Really chill place. Feels like you at the beach funky breakfast menu and staff are really accommodating

reviews.author: Soraya Ali
reviews.text: Food not that good, great atmosphere  entry staff friendly and efficient. Oasis at the top of a parking lot. Great bands and vibes  plus view of the city. A surprisingly organic rustic relaxing or groovy place to be in the middle of a concrete jungle.

reviews.author: Peter THORN
reviews.text: This is an amazing roof-top bar and nightclub overlooking all of Berlin. The music is varied... at least 3 DJs are going at the same time. The bars are fast and very professional. The sunset is a daily highlight.

reviews.author: S Hassan
reviews.text: Nice rooftop beer garden and bar, with a nice view of Berlin. perfect for those summer days or sunsets. the bar also hosts live gigs sometimes and there is DJ playing music on weekends. really nice spot to kick off your evening and soak up the views.

reviews.author: Coco M
reviews.text:
Nice rooftop terrace bar. Paid 8 Euros entry fee and the drinks were not cheap either for the quality/quantity you got. 9Euros for a Campari Spritz.
The view is great, with lots of seating and dancing space and lots of "klunker" to discover. Dj's were ok. Worth a visit.

reviews.author: Mariah Johnson
reviews.text: You must take the elevator to P5, and then walk up to P6. Great afternoon activity with the best views. Be careful of the honey bees!

name: LOST MY VOICE Bar - Breakfast, Barsnacks, Wine and Drinks
address: Barfood, Wine and Drinks, Rosenthaler Str. 1, 10119 Berlin, Germany

reviews.author: Steph Roth
reviews.text:
Possibly the most unique cocktails I’ve ever had, and I’m a huge cocktail drinker and maker!  Who could possibly come up with a “clarified Bloody Mary” that uses tequila and clarified tomato juice? Genius! Ditto the clarified Piña Colada. Our server didn’t bat an eyelash when we asked him if a Naked and Famous was possible and even gave a Last Word a shot with a green chartreuse substitute (it can be tough to get your hands on). This was a great drinking experience for our group of four.

The only drawback is the hotel lobby vibe (the bar is located in the Circus Hotel), despite the plush decor.  It does offer some good people watching, though.

reviews.author: Berin Adsan
reviews.text:
If you’d like to sip your cocktail in a relaxed and pleasant ambiance, I highly recommend this place.
The cocktails are carefully prepared, and the service is excellent!
You’re also thoroughly informed about the cocktails.

reviews.author: Onur
reviews.text: Fantastic cocktails and a very friendly service. Great interior design. We spent an absolutely wonderful time here! Espresso Martini was really good.

reviews.author: Michel Schauenberg
reviews.text: Very cool bar with friendly staff. We went for drinks before our dinner date @ another restaurant. Very warm welcome. They have a great selection of drinks and cocktails, but they also know to mix you the drink you feel like :-) Also a nice selection of non alcoholic drinks Thank you for taking good care of us.

reviews.author: Dasha Gritsuk
reviews.text: The cocktails were extremely good, we loved everything. It was nice that they offer non-alcoholic versions of almost all menu items. Also the location was great, inside garden was calm and silent, exactly what you need to escape the loud streets. We loved the stay and we’d like to come back again

reviews.author: Charlotte Gaughan
reviews.text: Gorgeous speakeasy style bar! Amazing cocktails including non alcoholic versions that tasted amazing. The food is light but delicious and the chocolate duck desert was a total winner. Bonus points for a very fun bathroom!

reviews.author: Truly Excellent Hotels & More
reviews.text:
Bellboy Bar in Berlin is not just a bar—it's an experience. Inspired by its Tel Aviv origins, the concept revolves around creating a surreal and theatrical atmosphere where every detail, from the decor to the drinks, is designed to transport guests to another world. The interior is opulent and mysterious, with dim lighting, plush seating, and quirky elements like vintage furniture and unexpected design touches that evoke a sense of playful escapism.

The drinks at Bellboy Bar are nothing short of extraordinary. Each cocktail is a masterpiece, served in unconventional vessels such as miniature bathtubs, ceramic heads, or even seashells. The creativity extends beyond presentation, with flavors that are bold, balanced, and unforgettable. Whether you're sipping on a classic Old Fashioned or indulging in one of their signature creations, the craftsmanship is evident in every sip.

I had the pleasure of attending a very special event at Bellboy Bar, and the experience was truly memorable. The service was impeccable—attentive, friendly, and professional—and the atmosphere was unlike anything I've encountered before. The combination of exceptional drinks, unique ambiance, and outstanding service made for an unforgettable evening.

Bellboy Bar is a must-visit for anyone looking to escape the ordinary and immerse themselves in a world of creativity and indulgence. A true gem in Berlin's vibrant nightlife scene.

reviews.author: Tugce Uslu
reviews.text: A great place for date and meetings with friends! I only had the chance to try the cocktails this time, but I'm looking forward to trying the food next time. The ambiance is great and the staff was incredibly kind. I'll definitely be back.

reviews.author: Luca Motterle
reviews.text: The cocktails are very extravagant, yet impressively crafted and enjoyable. Service is impeccable, attentive and professional throughout. Some dishes, like the ceviche, stand out while others like the tartar feel slightly unbalanced. Still, the overall experience is positive and definitely recommended

reviews.author: Annabelle
reviews.text:
Celebrated my partner's birthday here and it was a great experience. Our waiter was super lovely and made us feel very welcomed without being too much (sorry I didn't ask for your name, you were awesome💚)
The atmosphere here is everything, so along with the food being a 10, this place is a 20/10. Thank you for having us, we'll surely be back. 🌹

reviews.author: Yves Benimana
reviews.text:
Overall, it is a good experience as a visitor from the other side of the Atlantic.
Cool bouncers,  cool customers who offered me free drinks and cigarettes.
Only negative is one waitress who tried to give me an attitude as they had thrown my drinks away while at restrooms; but they replaced the drinks. To me, fair enough despite the incident.

reviews.author: Nageshnagi08@gmail.com Nagi
reviews.text:
I don't know about people complaining about bouncers being rude and not being friendly guys I feel the problem was with the attitude you had when you were entering. I am from India and I went all by myself and the bouncer was so polite and he asked if I'm here for the first time

- He told me they accepted only cash and he guided me to get to ATM and I came after an hour when the place was full but he did not deny my entry and he was so helpful. I don't remember the name but he a (Bald guy who stands at the entrance) sorry about my language but "owner" you really have to know that he is fantastic

I am coming to your place again today
My previous experience with you guys was fantastic

reviews.author: Nathalie Gil de Rubio
reviews.text: When visiting Berlin, this club is centrally located. Their mixed drinks are good and strong. Everyone there was having fun. Lot’s of English songs in the mix, was a nice plus. Songs that bring you way back.

reviews.author: Hindi Entertainment
reviews.text: Im from india and just Right now 27july 2025 want to visit the Hafenbar Club but Main entrance bouncer was very rude(Abuse me) to me and he say you can‘t go inside. I asked him why?? He say because i(he) Said…. I feel Little embressd and to be very honest that‘s why he is just bouncer….. well im Educated and im Not insulting anyone and don’t want to Diskussion ! some people insulting himself😂😂, i just Laugh

reviews.author: Cam E Ron
reviews.text: A great wee bar in Berlin. Had a really great time here back in October and will certainly be back next time I am in the city. Got really drunk but not super drunk and didn’t spend a lot of money because the other patrons were really cool and took pity on me as a foreigner. The staff were unbelievably helpful and courteous and were one the highlights of my time in Berlin. When I got up on one of the tables and started belting out Eternal Flame I only got one complaint and only had to be asked once to get out - that’s what I call friendly. The banger I brought in with me was very great too and I regret leaving it in the middle cubicle, will definitely be looking for this on my next visit. All in all, 5 stars ⭐️

reviews.author: Francisco Jardim Rios
reviews.text:
Great drinks, great service. Only downside: it misses a bottle of Cynar! I read about it on the Internet and finally came here to check it out. I recommend 100%

EDIT: they bought a Cynar bottle. So, nothing else to complain. Best cocktail bar ever!

reviews.author: Eyal Peleg Harris
reviews.text:
Great bar, chill atmosphere, amazing drinks.
Drinks cost between 11 and 17 euros but are made on custom order, they come to your table and make specific drinks by choice. Every drink we got was amazing and unique. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Olivia Victor
reviews.text: Usually busy on weekends, if u find a spot … its a very nice bar. Cocktails are Amazing. They can recommend drinks for you.

reviews.author: Laetitia Illea
reviews.text: What a great place, FINALLY a grown up, quality bar (in the middle of Friedrichshain of all places). Don’t be fooled by the name ‘Booze Bar’, the service is impeccable, clientele is mature and relaxed, seating and interiors is cosy and well thought out. We were sent there from their sister bar since they were fully booked, but since having been to both we actually prefer Booze Bar. The cocktail makers are pros and the managers are welcoming and friendly. Reminds me of the type of bar you’d find in London, NYC or Singapore, classy but unpretentious.

reviews.author: Stuart Mcbeath
reviews.text:
Important to know this is a "concept" cocktail bar.   The concept being, there is no menu and you tell the barman the sort of drink you would like and they make you a cocktail to suit .   And to be fair they make good cocktails However.....there is no menu and more importantly no prices!  Ours averaged out at €13 per drink.
Maybe we missed something but not knowing the price seems a bit  like they feel they need to hide this.

But drinks are good. And certainly better than most places.

reviews.author: Laura Sellars
reviews.text:
Amazing!! We got this for €13 each on the berlin welcome card and were pleasantly surprised with the value for money. 3 included drinks. Cocktails, whiskey and coke, vodka lemonades, beers... soft drinks. I had vodka and bitter lemon, they did not measure the alcohol- lovely and strong!!
Then went into the next room- a video room of the exhibition, put on loaned coats and gloves and to the beautiful ice room. -10! Perfect for the 30° outside. Stunning sculptures and photo ops, with a choice of beer, shots or soft drinks (2 included) I chose sambuka shot and a coconut vodka one
Spent a good half hour in there until we were too cold, then back into the bar area. Lovely atmosphere. Magical memories.

reviews.author: Josh L
reviews.text:
Had a great and boozy time at the Berlin ICE Bar!

My wife and I got lucky and were slotted to move into the ice bar by ourselves. The staff were lovely and very attentive. Even offered some great suggestions on cocktails to try.

Would recommend as a start to a boozy night. Also, don't forget to throw your glasses in the ICE bar.

reviews.author: Lisa Greinert
reviews.text: This is a very cool experience! We didn’t eat, just enjoyed the adventure that came with a few drinks. If you are in Berlin, I’d suggest trying it, where else can you drink from a glass made of ice and smash it when you’re done?! Great concept!

reviews.author: nic o
reviews.text: Had a fantastic time celebrating a hen party. The staff were so welcoming and engaging. Highly recommend for a group of friends looking for fun

reviews.author: LIZETTEDRUSILA FLORESDELGADO
reviews.text:
We went to the Ice Bar Berlin and had a great time! The weather was super hot so it was a nice break from our sightseeing.
They gave us three drinks, two inside the ice bar (the Nutella shot is DELICIOUS!! I wish they sold that vodka here in Mexico!!) and one outside. You can hace the outside drink before or after getting into the ice bar, and I suggest taking it after, so that you enjoy it calmly.

They give you gloves and a jacket so you are comfortable inside the ice bar, but I do recommend not wearing shorts or skirts as it can get cold and you might have problems sitting down.

It was a great experience!

reviews.author: Jake Pessall
reviews.text: First time visiting. Met some great people and enjoyed fantastic music. Bar staff were very efficient. Such a large variety of drinks. Busy on our evening (weekday) from around 9:30pm. Would definitely recommend and visit again time after time and no doubt see different musicians. Fantastic idea.

reviews.author: Johary Mustapha
reviews.text: We stumbled upon the place when walking around after the conference. They have indoor and outdoor sitting area, and a pleasant show from the jazz band performing from inside. Waitress were very kind and provides a good service, should try out their recommended cocktails.

reviews.author: Ariel Moniz
reviews.text: The bar opens on weekends at 7 pm, but the jazz doesn’t start until 9 pm. That being said, I would get there early because there is limited seating and it gets very crowded. There are only bar stools, no real chairs, so that might be something to keep in mind. Also, there is smoking allowed inside 🤢 So if you’re sensitive to smoke like I am, be aware! Entry is free but you are required to buy at least one drink or they will charge you 20 euro! They do thankfully have soft drinks and mocktails, so you don’t have to be a drinker to get something there, which is a plus. So it’s not a place to go if you just want to pop in for some jazz. But if you want to stay and have a drink, don’t mind thick smoke, and listen to jazz, I think you’ll like this place.

reviews.author: Seema Timmawagol
reviews.text: One of the overrated place for Jazz in my opinion. The music is something we need to sit back with drink and enjoy and this place is just the opposite of that . There no much room for people and we need to be early and order drinks . Despite ordering multiple cocktails after a point they asked us to make room for new people and get out of our seats . (Not sure of it was just a racist thing because I did not see him ask anyone else to move when they ordered lower value drinks than we did ) .  To add to the uneasiness the free smoke area isn’t making the ambience enjoyable. The cocktails were mediocre at best not worth the pain to go through all this . But one thing I liked is the crowd is very friendly and nice .  Oh also there is no food which means if you need to stay longer we need to spend at least 50 - 60 euros on cocktails just stay and listen to the very okayish Jazz which otherwise the magnet will ask you to move .

reviews.author: Gabriela Perez Corrales
reviews.text: Amazing cocktails and music! It’s a really good vibe, you can chill or dance! Less serious than other jazz clubs in Berlin. The only thing I don’t love is that people are allowed to smoke.

reviews.author: Paul Kujawa
reviews.text: Has been our first time. We preferred sitting at the bar over having a table. The bartenders were friendly, and the drinks so good, they have very unique signature cocktails, must try! Atmosphere and crowd was good too. Will come again.

reviews.author: Gideon Tirosh
reviews.text: The basic drinks were nice, the others were mediocre. There were smokers inside at some point which ruined the possibility of smelling anything other than the cigarettes, obviously not the drinks. The waiter was professional but did the minimum.

reviews.author: Patrick McKiernan
reviews.text: Sensational classic cocktail bar with very friendly vibe, approachable and knowledgeable staff, and drinks for those who love the good stuff. You know it’s a good cocktail bar when they pour you a glass of water as soon as you sit down. If you’re up for veering out of classic territory and into their signature drinks, try the duchess garden, a fabulous gin drink with edible gold flakes. If I lived nearby I’d be here every week.

reviews.author: F RE
reviews.text:
super nice experience! the staff is very friendly, their signature and classic cocktails are very well executed. The mixologer makes a nice show when prepping drinks. The staff look like they really know what they are doing, and they even accommodate making cocktails which are not part of their menu.

10 points for hospitality experience. They are well aware about how long should it take to order and get a drinks. If you’re waiting time is above average, they pay attention to it with small nice attentions, either a small snack or a courtesy shot. Tasty tasty 💯.

Price-wise, the average drink, is around 12-14eur. For the quality served, it’s a fair price. It wont break the bank unless you are super thirsty and plan to spend the whole night there…but in such case, you are probably very aware that you will be treating yourself very well.

The bar from outside is very unpretentious. You have to pay attention to few signs like the small one that says this bar is among the 50 best in Germany.
From inside, the bar is dark, yet cozy. Nice ambience and play of textures with the rugs and decoration. I’ll definitely come back with more friends and taste more of the making.
Try it put if you have a good appreciation for good nice drinks, without the urge of getting smashed 😉

reviews.author: Elif Duruk
reviews.text: Great ambiance, great cocktails, everything is fresh made. We discovered it in heavy rain by chance and really liked it

reviews.author: Nastya
reviews.text:
One of the best places I’ve ever been to.
Everything — from the presentation of the dishes to the interaction with the staff — was absolutely top-notch. The waiter didn’t just serve us, but passionately introduced the menu, gave thoughtful recommendations, and did so fluently in both German and English.

The service was impeccable, and the atmosphere warm and attentive to every detail. My friends and I were genuinely impressed!

The food and drinks were delicious, refined, and prepared with great attention to detail.
I wholeheartedly recommend this place to everyone — it’s a true gastronomic delight

reviews.author: Pauls
reviews.text: Was here on my last day in Berlin. Delicious cocktails; Super friendly staff. They explained the info about cocktails, oysters and assisted at choosing a good cigar and a drink to pair it with; and a nice atmosphere. Just a perfect end to my trip.

reviews.author: Tyler
reviews.text: Imaginative drinks served in unique glassware combined with an elegant environment and outstanding service made this a special memory I will have for a very long time. This is more than just a bar — it is an experience. I look forward to returning in the near future!

reviews.author: Neeraj Mittal
reviews.text:
The Gibson Berlin is not just a bar – it’s an experience. If you’re in Berlin and looking for a place that serves amazing cocktails in a beautifully curated setting, this is the spot.

The bar was recently started by Marian, and he is doing a fantastic job bringing a fresh vibe to the city’s nightlife. The setup is stylish and thoughtfully designed, creating the perfect ambiance for a night out. The staff are incredibly well-trained, friendly, and attentive – which makes a big difference.

What really stood out to us was the attention to detail. The presentation of both the food and the cocktails was absolutely top-notch. We also appreciated how well we were taken care of — special shoutout to Rekar (apologies if I got the spelling wrong!), who kept us hydrated with some refreshing rose-infused drinking water throughout the evening. It’s those little touches that make all the difference.

We woke up the next day feeling surprisingly fresh – a testament to the quality of ingredients and care that goes into everything served here.

A huge shoutout to the entire team at The Gibson Berlin. Wishing you all the success and growth ahead – you truly deserve it!

reviews.author: Matias Gimenez
reviews.text:
Happy hour of oysters was great.
The grilled oyster were also to die for.
Great bartender and awesome staff.
Had 30 oysters from happy hour, 6 grilled oysters and two cocktails for €110.

reviews.author: Hannah
reviews.text: We had a really great evening here! High quality cocktails and great service. We got tap water without asking- which I like. And Samuel did a great job overall!

reviews.author: Vincent
reviews.text: Great place. The bartenders have a very creative mind and the menu is lovely. I also love their rule. Flash and you get a free shots. Trust me, it works!

reviews.author: James
reviews.text:
Wooow very cool place!
I always struggle to pick a cocktail but there they have a map that will guide you to different tastes. The cocktails are super nice (a bit pricey yeah) the taste, representation. The place itself is very nice. I really liked atmosphere inside

Update: it was fancy in the past, but became somewhat usual. The glasses, the appearance of the cocktails look usual, the taste is not impressive and they don't give snacks anymore. But the prices stay the same (13.5-15€ for a cocktail) and I think they updated the menu

reviews.author: Kirill Milkus
reviews.text: Great bar with a very nice atmosphere — cozy, with dim lighting and friendly staff. A great spot to unwind in the evening. Tasty and unique cocktails. I would recommend Charlie Chaplin.

reviews.author: mo schaef
reviews.text: Awesome variety of classic cocktails as well as newly inspired ones. Incredibly balanced cocktails. Home-Feeling atmosphere, very friendly personal and always up to share ideas and thoughts on their drinks. Is it a minus if you have to book a table? It's always full, for a reason!

reviews.author: Sterling Reyes
reviews.text: I’ve been here a few times with friends and it’s such a great atmosphere. The bartender is so accommodating and provides great service. The place was so clean and the music was great but not too loud. If it’s your first time coming to Berlin I would recommend coming here for a great bar experience.

reviews.author: PheNom603
reviews.text: Very nice bar! The bar is in an old train car which is really nice and they have some outside seating and a patio in the back! Everyone was friendly, the menu is great, the drinks are fantastic and the prices are super cheap! Cards only accepted if you spend more than 20 Euros. Most cocktails are around 8 Euros, highly recommend and we really enjoyed the night out there!

reviews.author: Lisa T
reviews.text: Lovely bar friendly service fantastic cocktails great value for money best price in Berlin, sadly we went after a big meal and struggled to finish our drinks worth the visit though!

reviews.author: Ксения Рябоконь
reviews.text: Lovely atmosphere, great staff, wonderful cocktail selection and a delightful evening, will definitely be back again!

reviews.author: Martin Janse van Rensburg
reviews.text:
Really great atmosphere, but unfortunately the drinks are of extremely poor quality and had made my wife and a friend of ours very sick. My wife wrote a review about this, but they sent lawyers after her to delete it.

I can provide evidence of this.

reviews.author: Tim Chan
reviews.text:
Great vibes, good DJ, and a friendly crowd.

Mein Haus am See was highly recommended by local friends and online sources also said it was one of the "top bars to go to"

It’s not a fancy or over the top venue by any means, but that’s exactly the charm. If you’re looking to soak in some authentic Berlin atmosphere in a laid back setting, whether to start your night or finishing here, this spot is definitely worth a visit.

There is a lower floor that we couldn't check out due to it being closed for a private event. But I'm sure it's great.

reviews.author: Liya Staneva
reviews.text:
I've been here last year. Feels like a place to calm down and think beautiful, obscure, bizzare happy thoughts. And the bartender was so nice.
It'd be great if they worked with BEVUP, so I could treat my friends to drinks here

reviews.author: Lucy Butcher
reviews.text: came on a Thursday and just very quiet strange atmosphere, you walk in and there’s just a wall of people staring at you, we went downstairs as there wasn’t any seating upstairs and it felt like an empty club, maybe we came when there wasn’t an event on but had this as a recommendation and felt let down. Ordered a raspberry beer but it was actually just a normal beer with raspberry syrup in which didn’t taste good at all. The service was very slow and the staff were quite rude.

reviews.author: Ava von Niebelschuetz
reviews.text: Love the atmosphere! Very cozy, and interesting! Drinks were kinda expensive 16€ for a Moscow mule and 2 water, but it was still worth it, in my opinion. Nice music and fun to watch videos being projected onto the walls. Very creative.

reviews.author: Ali Akob
reviews.text: It seems like an acceptable experience, but the nice thing is their food and fast food. I wish them continued happiness.

reviews.author: Lily Van der Burgh
reviews.text: Their service is great and the shisha is great too. Staff is nice and generous. Will definitely visit again and recommend.

reviews.author: Mahboob M
reviews.text: Really nice spot! Shisha was great, service was super quick, and the staff were friendly and polite. Bathrooms were clean too. Definitely worth checking out.

reviews.author: Ashwin Aggarwal
reviews.text: Very nice hookah bar with reasonably priced cocktails. Service is that fast though, and this place gets very busy during weekends. The waiter forgot our order and never returned with hookah, and eventually we cancelled it after 45 minutes. Drinks were pretty good though!

reviews.author: Shravya Rastogi
reviews.text: It is a beautiful shisha place with great drinks! But they never picked up phone for reservations. We took a gamble and luckily found a table. The hookah was good too, but slow service. The drinks were amazing. We had what the waitress recommended with berries and Prosecco and it was delicious!

reviews.author: Alberto Barbieri
reviews.text:
This place is wonderful! The ambiance is great, the staff is friendly and attentive, and the cocktails are well-crafted with a perfect blend of flavors. The hookah is excellent, offering smooth and enjoyable sessions. Highly recommended for a relaxing and enjoyable evening!

Only negative side, look like they are not accepting payment by card and considering we spended more then 100 euro was a strange

reviews.author: Neelesh Bhalla
reviews.text: Cozy bar with super friendly vibes. Staff is super amazing. On live music nights, they charge you 1 Euro extra (on drinks) for contribution to the playing artist - fun concept! Good place to wind down your day, when in Berlin.

reviews.author: Ella
reviews.text: I’ve always appreciated the vibe at Minimal, but my experience on Saturday night was really disappointing. It didn’t feel as inclusive or safe as it used to — the crowd and energy were completely different. Sadly, I no longer feel comfortable coming back, which is a shame for a place that used to feel safe for all.

reviews.author: Iulia I
reviews.text:
I got there because of the good reveiws on google, but I couldn t stay there more than a few minutes. The vibe was very bad, smelly and sticky , like any club from a tourstic place, I think the name ‘minimal’ is just a trap for people to come because they think is cool and maybe underground.
The place is like any other bad club in a touristic area. Also they play music inside but the vibes are very bad and very lame.

reviews.author: Max P
reviews.text:
I have been here several times because the tankbier is good, but no longer. The owner has Google take down every lower than 3 star review by claiming "defamation."  You'll notice over time that low ratings will disappear leaving only high ones to artificially boost the score. 1700 reviews total and only 5 are under 4 stars? This is impossible for any institution. You have to fight Google's system and upload proof that you were there (eg receipt) if you want a chance of your review to stay up.

Sadly common for bars and restaurants in Germany who exploit this. The owners and companies who do this are pathetic.

reviews.author: Ali Nezamolmaleki
reviews.text: Pretty cozy Fhain bar with live (DJ) music and ping pong table. When it's crowded, it's hard to get a place, and it's better to go early evening or later at night on the weekend; otherwise, there is a low chance to get in. During the week, it's a chill and nice place to enjoy your drink, listen, or dance to music. I wish they go no smoking sometimes soon (even in that smoking room).

reviews.author: Ольга V
reviews.text: Great rooftop bar in the heart of Berlin! The atmosphere is fantastic, with amazing city views and a stylish vibe. The cocktail menu is impressive, offering a wide variety of creative and classic drinks. There’s even a separate gin menu for true gin lovers! We’re enjoying delicious cocktails and a great evening. Highly recommend for a night out in Berlin!

reviews.author: Anastassia Koppel
reviews.text: Great rooftop bar in Berlin. Evening was pretty busy and we had to wait in line untill we got the table. Beer is pretty cheap around 5€ and coctails 12-13€. View of the city is really nice. Service was kind and fast!

reviews.author: Shalini Nautiyal
reviews.text: The Bar is Beautiful but small and they don’t take reservations so you gotta wait but its worth it :) We were 3 of us and reached at 8:30 but it was already full. Took us 30-40 min to get a place. Cocktails were really good! Snacks are hardly available so just go post dinner.

reviews.author: Mohamed Firas HACHICHA
reviews.text:
Great place to chill out in
Wide variety of drinks and cocktails, especially gins
Small choice of salty snacks
Service was fair. We didn't have any good advice about the salty snacks but we managed to have fun.
Lovely and cosy atmosphere with a breathtaking view.
Worth visiting

reviews.author: Nathália Santi
reviews.text: The bar has a wonderful atmosphere, polite waiters, and drinks that are perfect paired with a stunning view. It's great for socializing with friends or enjoying a romantic evening. I will definitely return.

reviews.author: Paulo Eduardo Apgáua Baumgratz
reviews.text: Came all the way from Brazil to know this bar, perfect vibe, good service and the best drinks!!!

reviews.author: Infojet
reviews.text: one of the best nights we spent in berlin in this place very nice service and very nice drink amazing shisha nice atmosphere best place in berlin

reviews.author: liz ann
reviews.text:
Immediately, the ambiance was exactly what we were looking for on a sunday night in berlin. Beautiful neon lights, strong drinks, and classic hip hop/r&b music! Jack was very welcoming and helpful. I would recommend this spot to anyone looking for dope, chill vibe

Follow @soulsearching_travels

reviews.author: Persian GameR (MA1)
reviews.text: The interior looks good but the personnel was not acting really friendly. The hookah (shisha) was good.

reviews.author: Usman Shahid
reviews.text: The worst shisha I had during my stay in Berlin. Appreciation for Chinese waiter for the best service but the bartender needs to learn how to deal with customers.

reviews.author: Yan Ni Tan
reviews.text: Lovely bar with innovative tarot themed cocktails 🍹 we enjoyed our drinks and the great service :) also very much loved that they have a separate smoking and non smoking area, which was great for non smokers like us

reviews.author: Laura Mayo
reviews.text: A great choice for cocktails lovers and those who (like us) are non smoking. You get the option to sit in the nonsmoking section of the bar on entry. Highly recommend a stagger lee beer old fashioned, we will definitely be visiting again.

reviews.author: piangpim c.
reviews.text: the drinks are STRONG, the vibes are immaculate (a bit hot in the summer though), and the service is super nice!! i would definitely come back here :)

reviews.author: Gemma Catterall
reviews.text: A hidden gem of a bar with a chilled, cosy atmosphere. Friendly staff & incredible cocktails! We enjoyed the drinks so much that we visited for a second night during our short stay in Berlin. 🙂

reviews.author: Mircea-Bogdan Tănăsescu
reviews.text: Nice atmosphere. Good service, proffesional bartender. Interesting cocktails. Normal prices accordingly. A very friendly area, you should enjoy the walk around.

reviews.author: Lukas O
reviews.text:
We visited The Curtain Club at the Ritz-Carlton on Potsdamer Platz on a Saturday evening without a reservation and were lucky to get seats at the bar. Not long after, the bar filled up quickly—so it’s best to reserve in advance.

The bar is beautifully and classically designed. The mixologists are highly skilled and prepare cocktails to a very high standard. We were served small crackers, olives, and a glass of water alongside the drinks.

The atmosphere is definitely upscale, which is also reflected in the prices—but they are justified. There was live piano music with a singer, and when you combine that with a great drink, what more could you ask for?

The cocktail menu offers 4–5 choices for every taste, including champagne cocktails and their own gin creations. I had the El Camino with mezcal—perfectly balanced and highly recommended. A great way to start a Saturday night.

reviews.author: I P
reviews.text:
Delicious food and drinks, paired with good service. Atmosphere with suitable live music.
This bar is definitely to recommend and to come back.

reviews.author: Dudu Nguyen
reviews.text:
Service: amazing 10/10⭐️
Bartender: 10/10 🍹
Drinks and even Non Alcoholic drinks are amazing.

We just love the vibe here and even other guests are very calm.
My Fiancé and i always have a great time here.

Definitely a place we always come back to whenever we’re in Berlin.
I’d say this is my favorite Bar in Berlin.

reviews.author: Mi Mai
reviews.text: Normally I don‘t write reviews, but wow I had a wonderful time there with delicious food and drinks! Thanks to the very obliging bartender. Look out for Leo Albrecht! You will be in wonderful service.

reviews.author: Stephen Worgan
reviews.text: Stylish, elegant cocktail bar in a sophisticated hotel with classy, friendly service serving modern cocktails and the classics. Recommended.

reviews.author: Michelle Lo
reviews.text:
Hands down one of the coolest spots in Berlin! The Wash Bar is already a vibe on its own — great atmosphere, friendly staff, and delicious cocktails — but the real magic happens when you get invited into their hidden speakeasy, The Storage.

It’s an intimate, private experience (just for a party of two in our case), and it felt like stepping into another world. The drinks were next-level — each cocktail inspired by an element and presented with such creativity. We were treated to a full-on sensory experience, complete with surprise shows and incredible attention to detail.

It’s rare to find a place that nails both the quality and the experience like this. Highly recommend if you’re looking for something special in Berlin!

reviews.author: Chloe Maguire
reviews.text: Super cute and chill cocktail bar with amazing staff! Guillermo was so friendly and welcoming and made the most delicious sour I’ve ever had. Already can’t wait to come back and try their speakeasy experience 🤩

reviews.author: Kamil
reviews.text: It was my first time at this place, and I must say it had that great Berlin vibe! The service was exceptional, and the cocktails were not only super tasty but also beautifully presented. I would definitely come back

reviews.author: Suhas Thakral
reviews.text: A great place for cocktails if you like some classics with twists! I can recommend the mezcal espresso martini 🍸 and was impressed how it tasted so good! The service is polite and really fast ! Next time coming for their hidden speakeasy

reviews.author: Anny Pham
reviews.text: My 2nd time at this bar and still as amazing as I remembered! Went out for a casual drink on a Wednesday night, and it was super cozy and chill there. Got the traditional bottle of water and a snack right as we sat down, and the service was great too! Very friendly and so kind, the drinks all had a different taste like just the perfect touch to each one we had ! Would recommend this bar anytime ! xx

reviews.author: Sofie Magnusson
reviews.text: Highly recommend! Calm but still alive atmosphere. Nice live music from the piano.

reviews.author: Fred Wang
reviews.text: I went to the bar today, because this was the first place she invited me to come half a year a ago, and I couldn’t make it at that time. I feel so regretful about it. Now today I came here, but she probably will never talk to me anymore, we had a heartbreak one month ago and I can still feel the pain. I miss her and still love her 🥺

reviews.author: Postcards from Stewy
reviews.text: We enjoyed a stop here for a couple of drinks and a snack style pizza. Loved the atmosphere and of course the live piano music. The musician played a lot of Elton John songs and other pop songs. This is a really nice place to relax and unwind. They offer indoor and outdoor seating. We recommend stopping here for a drink or two when in the area.

reviews.author: Prathiba Kodappully Bhasi
reviews.text:
I really liked the atmosphere here, filled with both senior and young crowd. ✨

The music was not loud that I could talk to my friend without being too loud.😅

I enjoyed the drink as well, it was decent! 🥂

Would definitely go there 🙌🏻

reviews.author: Mehmet KASAP (SMMM / CPA)
reviews.text: It was a coincidence that it was located at the entrance of the hotel I stayed at, but it turned out to be an absolutely delightful discovery. I definitely recommend it.

reviews.author: Bull Dogg
reviews.text:
The food rating refers to the cocktails. This is a nice Helmut Newton-themed bar which has been around for at least 20 years in Gendarmenmarkt, and we keep coming back. The cocktails are great, the ambience very nice, and the staff is nice, albeit somewhat quirky (but this is Berlin).
The beer selection isn’t great but we don’t come here for the beers.

reviews.author: Barada Craig
reviews.text:
Great cocktails, service is good,
But, no peanuts or bar snacks of any kind (or it would be a five star)

reviews.author: Cari Oleskewicz
reviews.text: Coolest bar in Berlin, an easy walk from the Brandenburg Gate and just outside the cathedral. Gorgeous cocktails, gorgeous people, very accommodating and friendly staff. Cheers.

reviews.author: Herlock
reviews.text:
An absolute catastrophic of a place.
Service is zero. The waiters act like Gestapo telling you how to sit. They are very rude and lack the very basic training. The atmosphere is absolute hell.

Never ever again.

reviews.author: Kane Evans
reviews.text:
Good beer on tap, but this is predominantly a cocktail bar. I was a bit confused by whether or not its bar service or table service, as we seemed to have both going on around the venue.

Dress code was also unclear. We saw individuals is casual tracksuits, as well as groups of people in their Sunday best suits and dresses. Whilst it’s nice to be so inclusive and not be a stuffy pretentious place, it doesn’t give a cohesive aesthetic to the venue itself, which is decorated nicely in a contemporary upmarket style.

Nice place to stop if passing, but given Berlin’s sprawling nightlife, I’d not go out of my way for a trip here again as there was nothing particularly special.

reviews.author: William Beach
reviews.text: We sat at the bar on a rainy Sunday evening. Greeted with enthusiasm, we placed an order of something classic and something different. The gin martini was excellent, but the banana bread espresso martini wasn't as...banana-y as I was expecting. It was a lovely atmosphere. International crowd.

reviews.author: Gideon Tirosh
reviews.text: The service was perfect. Kind and professional. The drinks were spot on. The atmosphere was good, nice music with the right volume to allow a comfy chat.

reviews.author: Liam Duke
reviews.text: Very average place despite it being on all the top 10 lists of Berlin. Spirits selection is amazing, but this is not a focus. Cocktails are stirred and diluted to death, losing most of the benefits of good ingredients, while anything with sour ingredients like verjous or lemon is going too far in that direction.  Sorry, but despite the reputations, there much more deserving bars in town.

reviews.author: Ege Kockesen
reviews.text: We tried 3 different cocktails on our visit, which were Certainly Marigold, Coffee & Cigarettes and Voltaire. The flavor profile of Coffee & Cigarettes was really interesting and unique, and the marigold was a delicious fruity cocktail. Voltaire also had a complex but balanced flavor profile. A reservation might be useful, even though we could get in without a problem. The service was slow for the first cocktail round, but was better by the end. This is a great cocktail place I would recommend to everyone.

reviews.author: Josip Kuman
reviews.text: We went there on a chill Sunday night and had a great time. Beautiful atmosphere and creative cocktails. Outstanding service throughout the whole visit.  Would definitely recommend to anyone interested in quality drinks and places with soul. We will be back!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Kolgan
reviews.text: Loveliest place with beautiful Berlin views and most delicious cocktails. Parma negroni - worth to try and get little happy buzz on. Gorgeous beautiful host - most lovely lady you can encounter and she will make your time on river Spree bank very enjoyable and memorable. Pass my best to her. Coming back for barman’s craftsmanship who makes you happy buzzing on your Sunday afternoon. Many many thanks

reviews.author: S. Ossino
reviews.text: Very cozy bar with live piano music. Large selection of drinks, super friendly staff and guests. Just the right thing to relax.

reviews.author: Cecilia Aburto
reviews.text: If you are expecting a piano we have not experienced that but the place is quite cool for those like me who like this old Jazz place atmosphere and have a delicious drink. Warning about cigarette inside for those that do not like that. Went twice, is quiet and with nice music to have two people hang out night.

reviews.author: Parisa Khosravi
reviews.text: I didn't know fries could taste this delicious :)) Nice drinks, great atmosphere, and super friendly staff.

reviews.author: Klárka Supíková
reviews.text: Perfect vintage place! Fine evening with live music of very talented pianinst. Love the atmoshere of this place!

reviews.author: Oleg Chermoshniuk
reviews.text:
Great restaurant with high quality gourmet food! The service is outstanding as well. We took the 3 courses menu and there was a lot of fantastic food, including caviar.
The prices are not cheap, but the experience is worth every penny. The view is also very beautiful and it adds to an overall atmosphere. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Maitri Mehta
reviews.text:
This was one of the best experiences I have had in Berlin so far. The food was amazing, atmosphere was amazing and the service was also top notch. ' Mr. Loris ' who was serving us was the coolest guy,  we ordered the chef's special menu where I wanted vegetarian and my partner wanted the normal with meat.  Mr. Loris made this happen for us and every course had atleast 5 different items and every item was a bust of flavors in the mouth. This was the best vegetarian food I've had in Germany till now, that too with all these varieties. The cherry on top was that the whole staff came singing happy birthday for my partner with the cutest most delicious cake ever and the whole restaurant sang along , this was a very special moment for my partner.  Thanks a lot to the Solar team for making my partner's birthday so beautiful.
P.s. we went at 8:30 pm in the summer, this way we were able to see the view in sunset and in the dark.  This view of Berlin is the prettiest.

reviews.author: Camilo Blanco Vargas
reviews.text:
Loved the place!

The service was amazing. The chill-out music and overall atmosphere made the food taste like heaven! The traditional suckling pork knuckle, cordon bleu, and tartlets were all fantastic, but the mashed potatoes with raclette cheese were truly out of this world.

Add a note on your reservation to request a table by the window - it's a great way to enhance your Berlin experience!

reviews.author: Penelope Bergeron-Dufour
reviews.text: The food was amazing! We had wonderful service from Marie, Jan & Björn. The staff is extremely nice. Amazing cocktails from Juan. Get the Jess in Wonderland, it’s the best :)! Thanks so much!

reviews.author: Grendys Garcia
reviews.text: The food at Solar was exceptional — every dish was bursting with flavour and beautifully presented. The chef is truly talented, and the staff went above and beyond to make our evening special.

reviews.author: Jack DeSchlong
reviews.text: We went here, because of a photo of a delicious espresso martini on Google. The small, almost shot-sized espresso martinis we were served were among the worst espresso martinis I’ve had, but also the most expensive. The ambience is not noteworthy. The chairs are uncomfortable. But the staff was friendly.

reviews.author: Jaime Curtis
reviews.text: I did the aperitivo menu with a friend and it was delicious. The cocktails were very special. A really nice evening.

reviews.author: Robert Norris
reviews.text:
Under new management? New service personnel?

We have been here several times in the past and  had great cocktails and wonderful service. We were there the other night to celebrate with friends and the service was awful.

On our arrival we told the service personnel that our group would likely exceed the size we had reserved for. We were repeatedly told that this was a problem. Eventually we were nine instead of six. At that point we were told that we could stay if each person ordered a minimum of three cocktails during the two hour period that our reservation was valid for.

A reservation is an estimate of group size and any establishment I know of is aware of that and deals with any changes in a service minded fashion. This was far from polite. We were not welcome from the moment we stepped in the door!

We left after one drink only and are not coming back.

reviews.author: benjamin braun
reviews.text:
A beauty within an area with some nice cocktail bars.
But here you get phantastic cocktails AND amazing food!

Be sure to do a reservation - that will make a lot of things much easier ;)

Friendly staff
Beautiful atmosphere
Delicious foods & cocktails

A MUST when you are in the area

Say hello from me
5/5

reviews.author: Stilyana Podmolova
reviews.text: Very cozy atmosphere, good variety of cocktails and the food on offer is very delicious and creatively presented (asparagus highly recommended). Some of the cocktails were a bit too sweet for my liking but when asked for a cocktail to suit your taste, the staff are super helpful.

reviews.author: Zeynep Çakıroğlu
reviews.text:
It was a Saturday night. First of all, the atmosphere is cool. The DJ is playing and people can dance or sit if they want. There is enough room to dance and sit. The unique interior design was nice, the toilet is not clean...  The problem is that they smoke inside. In fact, there is no oxygen inside, there is cigarette smoke…….
The ventilation is very poor.

reviews.author: Eylül Akar
reviews.text: Great atmosphere with good music. I visited in a very cold and rainy tuesday evening so it was almost empty. Will definitely visi during a weekend as well. Coctails are a bit overpriced, even though they’re average.

reviews.author: Erjon Gorani
reviews.text:
15.11.2024 22:55

- The waiter is too "pushy" sale sale sale...
- They have no bigger bier only small bier (5.50 euro)
- Location is very nice
- Dj was amazing !!

reviews.author: Marc A
reviews.text: A very nice, fancy looking bar with rather expensive drinks (14 euros Moscow mule) but you are paying for one of the nicest bars in the area (which is also a very nice area). The drinks are however very good and hence you could justify the price tag. There is usually a dj inside (techno / house). Be careful with the bouncer he can be a bit dificult and not let your entire group in (especially later on). Also important to remember to put your jacket in the coat room, they will be very strict.

reviews.author: Lars M. Heitmüller
reviews.text: Good bar with a tough party crowd. After Berlin Mitte became quite lame concerning parties within the last years, on many days probably the best location to party in Mitte.

reviews.author: Emmanuel Bernhard
reviews.text: We were a group of five on a stag — not rowdy, not drunk, just looking to enjoy a quiet beer. But the moment we spoke English, we were told to go "watch football somewhere else." None of us are football fans — we just wanted a seat and a drink. Treated like an unwanted stereotype from the moment we opened our mouths. Avoid if you're expecting hospitality over hostility.

reviews.author: Amir Zolfaghari
reviews.text:
I stumbled upon this bar while searching for a place that serves great Guinness, and I'm thrilled to share my positive experience. From the moment I stepped into this establishment, I was pleasantly surprised by its cool and laid-back atmosphere. My initial visit turned into a routine, as I found myself returning every night for the past three weeks. Not only did I enjoy the fantastic Guinness, but I also discovered a welcoming community that has become a source of newfound friendships.

What truly sets this bar apart is the attentive and caring staff. They go above and beyond to make every customer feel valued and ensure a memorable experience. It's evident that customer satisfaction is a top priority for them. Without a doubt, I wholeheartedly recommend this bar to others seeking a relaxed and friendly environment, making it deserving of a 5-star rating.

Cheers to a great place and even greater memories!

reviews.author: Dougie Bell
reviews.text: Great wee bar with great barmen with the added bonus of Angry Hour (usually happy hour 😁). Short visit to Berlin with mates from Scotland... lucky to find this place (even had a Scottish barmen ) well worth a visit if you're passing

reviews.author: TVD
reviews.text: Great bar! Good prices on beer and general beverages. Nice modern interior. Have a playable NES!! Friendly atmosphere. Smoking is permitted in this bar JUST A WARNING.

reviews.author: Vincent Rist
reviews.text:
I really like this bar. It plays good rock music. Super nice bartenders. Beer for 3 €, and most importantly memes on the toilet walls.
Plus the have TV were they’ll let you play Mario Kart sometimes.
But it gets really crowed the later it gets. It’s really Smokey and all your clothes will smell. And the seats in the back are quite uncomfortable.

reviews.author: Eden Minkin
reviews.text: Came here with my sister on my first and last night in Berlin, such an amazing place! The cocktail menu has many unique and delicious options, Tommy the bartender was so nice and attentive, not once did I need to try get his attention to order more drinks! I highly recommend coming for karaoke night, didn't think I'd sing but ended up singing 3 songs! Had such a great time here, if you want delicious cocktails and great vibes - here's the place to be.

reviews.author: Matthieu JAMES
reviews.text: Spectacular bar!! Amazing cocktails, balanced and constituent. Spectacular service, the owner is hands on, attentive, and just magically gets what cocktail would suit you best. A definite must see!

reviews.author: Matthew Tait
reviews.text: Gem bar is an actual Gem. Great patio and the interior is warm and cozy without a bad spot to sit. The cocktails are great as well, the best old fashioned I had in Berlin. Tommy is super welcoming and makes you feel right at home. Karaoke was a treat one of the nights we went too!

reviews.author: Jess T
reviews.text: 10/10 experience. Bartender is so personable and fun. The karaoke events are to die for, seriously - you won’t enjoy anything  more on Tuesdays and Sundays. As a local it’s unbeatable. The cocktails and beers are unbearable in quality and piece. Super friendly to women and heterosexual couples in cause people were worried! Sooo good, GEM Bar is one of the greats.

reviews.author: Miguel Andrés Yáñez-Barreto (Migue)
reviews.text:
Amongst a lot of loud overwhelming bars this gem shines in its cute decor, welcoming and comfortable aesthetic and great cocktails for those of us who are not that into beer.

Over pride weekend it was super busy and our drinks took a while but the owner who is also the bartender was super friendly and attentive anyway.

reviews.author: Tat Jarnova
reviews.text:
Bar Amélie is Berlin cocktail heaven with a funky soul!

From the moment you walk in, Bar Amélie grabs you with its bold, funky vibe and warm, welcoming energy. The space is effortlessly cool, but it’s the people and the drinks that truly make it unforgettable. The team is not only super friendly but absolutely masters of their craft—you can see (and taste!) their passion in every cocktail they shake or stir.

We tried a few drinks from the classics menu and they were outstanding. The Old Fashioned was smooth, deep, and perfectly balanced—pure cocktail perfection. The Ruby Sour with mezcal, Aperol, lime juice, and strawberry syrup was a knockout: smoky, citrusy, and just the right touch of sweetness. And the Manhattan was  elegant, and beautifully stirred. Easily one of the best we’ve had in Berlin.

This bar gets everything right—creative drinks, classic execution, amazing service, and a vibe that makes you want to stay all night. If you love a well-made drink and a good time, Bar Amélie is an absolute must.

reviews.author: Dyllan Algo
reviews.text: My first time at this place, discreet but quite pretty, nice to chill out and the bartender has been really nice , an interesting bar so I'kl definitely come back another time 👌

reviews.author: Loay
reviews.text:
Nice hidden bar with a lovely atmosphere. It is not very loud inside nor smokey, which is great. The gentleman at the entrance asked if we had a reservation, but we didn't. He mentioned that he will try to find us a place but we have to wait a bit which we didn't mind.
