They have a wide selection of cocktails depending on the taste you are after and they are decently priced. Some cocktails felt very weak to my taste and even if it's a really nice bar, there wasn't anything that stood out in my opinion.

reviews.author: Markus Riedel
reviews.text: Great bar. Excellent drinks & cocktails. Plus friendly service. Our drinks were perfect both visually and in terms of taste. The prices were absolutely fair. You can only get in with a reservation or if there's room, but it's definitely worth a visit. A clear recommendation and we'll be back ;)

reviews.author: shira matityahu
reviews.text:
We had a blast here!!
Drinks were exquisite, very fresh
Staff were very welcoming and sweet
And it’s a very atmospheric and pretty space.
Highly recommended for a lil drink w anyone really🥂

reviews.author: Jonathan Preuss
reviews.text:
Um… is there a 6th or 7th star?!!
If you like cocktails and respect yourself, this is a must not miss in Berlin. I HIGHLY recommend “Die vergessenen Werte des Westens”. But the 100 other choices might suit your palate more 😉

reviews.author: Ola Nesgovorov
reviews.text:
Wonderful cocktail bar
The service is quick and very nice
The selection is to the point and has something for everyone
The drinks are strong and very generous portions . There are also plenty 0% Alcohol drinks that look beautiful and this allows everyone to have a great time at the table

reviews.author: A. S.
reviews.text:
Fantastic Cocktailbar close to the beautiful Hufelandstrasse. This bar exists since twenty years already and offers a wide range of classic cocktails, but also newer creations. I especially enjoyed the different kind of Whiskys 🥃.
The Barkeeper ist very friendly and supportive. 🍹 🍸

reviews.author: Andrew McQuade
reviews.text: Bartender was excellent this evening. Cocktails were delicious. Will definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Rita Moreira da Silva
reviews.text: Loved the bar and the bartenders. Very relaxed and unpretentious atmosphere. My saphire Moscow mules (had 2) were very delicious.

reviews.author: Alex H
reviews.text: Could not recommend a better bar for punk and alternative. Always felt welcome and friendly. Great prices, haven't seen better prices anywhere else in Berlin. Seen people moaning about the staff but only ever had a great experience with them. A must go in Berlin if you're into the punk and alternative music scene.

reviews.author: Mads Buchwald
reviews.text: Seems like a nice place for some hard rock - got totally ruined by a bartender that obviously didn't get enough sleep and couldn't be bothered by customers. Charged us 24 euro for 3 double house G&Ts... Sign said 'no service'; didn't lie

reviews.author: Andrea Robles
reviews.text: Good music and smoking allowed inside. Very friendly person at the bar.

reviews.author: Ofelia
reviews.text: Went there just out of curiosity but had a really good time.

reviews.author: Karen Victoria
reviews.text: Good beer, drinks, and music. But the bar woman had a different treatment with us as she realized we were latins. It was a different treatment than german people. It's supposed to be a punk place and against racism  😒 not good from her. Anyway, it's place with good music and drinks.

reviews.author: Mousa Albarawwi
reviews.text: My friends and I always come here. The customer (from East Asia) greets us politely speaking English. We have never seen that treatment anywhere else. I loved dealing with them.

reviews.author: Yehya Alattar
reviews.text: We visit this place often and we trust the place's services and its wonderful customers. Shikha and Sita met us with a cheerful heart and great services. They really give us a positive atmosphere.

reviews.author: Anita I.
reviews.text: It is open 24 hours, exactly what I need. Coffee is good. Outdoor seating super comfortable!

reviews.author: saad Alian
reviews.text: The place is great, I loved it with its beautiful services, the waitress is shika , wonderful and provides her services kindly

reviews.author: Eugenia Faina
reviews.text:
The American Bar Girl, super nice and friendly. There are many bars but a barwomen  like that is only one, she give you a super vibe positive and she’s can really listen and be there for you!❤️
With love from a Moldovien girl!

reviews.author: Steve B
reviews.text:
Sat outside and had curryweirst with chips. The food was hot although the chips were a bit strange. Good selection of drinks, service wasn't bad I think they could have interacted a bit more with the customers.
We didn't get a good feeling when we didnt give a service tip.

Worth visiting but we wouldn't be back sorry.

reviews.author: Ole Andreas Gulliksen
reviews.text: So so good. My South African brother and I had 3 days in Berlin to hang out. Kilkenny served us the best beer and and meat of the whole time with the greatest service of the 3 days with rugby on the big screens.

reviews.author: John M
reviews.text: Didn’t have food but it looked great. Great atmosphere watching the rugby, staff were great and the Guinness excellent. Also, a great stopping point on the way to the airport with the train station right above the pub and a direct train there!

reviews.author: Mathias Kiekens
reviews.text: Great pub with agreat atmosphere. Constant live music and a nice selection of drinks. The decoration/look-and-feel does not disappoint. We spent several evenings here and are sure to return when we visit Berlin again!

reviews.author: Rajko Milić
reviews.text: Great place for beer lovers, very nice service and amazing food (I would recommend currywurst)

reviews.author: Sarah Blue
reviews.text: Afterwork with a few colleagues. We randomly stumbled upon this bar by coincidence, and what a great surprise! We had such a wonderful time. Special mention to the server, who was truly exceptional: very welcoming, passionate about his work, and took the time to explain every cocktail ingredient in detail. Outstanding service and a warm atmosphere. A fantastic discovery—I highly recommend it!

reviews.author: Renny Sibiglia
reviews.text: This bar was close to our hotel and we're so happy we stopped in for a drink. The bartender/owner made us delicious drinks and provided amazing service and friendly conversation. Not only did we order another round we got recommendations for great things to do and eat around Berlin. 100%recommend popping in for drinks. (Michel, you are welcome in my town anytime, thanks for a great evening!)

reviews.author: predatedcello59 pred58
reviews.text: I came with my girlfriend to this bar for only one drink (at least that's what we had expectations) I asked the bartender nicely in English for one beer and one drink. He replied that there were no ingredients for the drink, which I understood 100%, so I asked for something different. He totally poured me off. I waited an extra 20 minutes but he didn’t even look in our direction. After something like this, I feel totally unwanted in this bar and my foot will never get there again. It hurts me because indeed people who speak only German were treated with respect and for native Germans it must be a great place to sit, but as a tourist I advise against it.

reviews.author: Danii McLeod
reviews.text: Best cocktails! Amazing service and friendly staff. They have an extensive list of cocktails and are also very skilled at making/recommending cocktails of you're liking. Highly recommend - From Australia 🇦🇺

reviews.author: Sneha Chandra
reviews.text: Very good drinks, large variety, and affordable. Lively and loud music. Featured: Mexicana shot, pina colada, and swimming pool. Pancake shot was also good if you want a sweeter shot. It comes with an orange juice chaser.

reviews.author: K AZZAM
reviews.text: Absolutely loved this place! The cocktail bar has an incredible selection of unique, expertly crafted cocktails that truly stand out. The atmosphere is stylish and welcoming, and the service is simply top-notch. The team is friendly, attentive, and clearly passionate about what they do. A perfect spot for a great night out, highly recommended!

reviews.author: Debbie Anjos
reviews.text:
Lovely place, friendly staff. Their cheese sandwich was the highlight for me! I will definitely go back.

The only downside was that they weren’t accepting payment by card that day.

reviews.author: Jared Gheen
reviews.text:
Next level coziness. Wish I would have taken more photos, but this was a unique experience that became one of my highlights of my entire time in Berlin.
The setup is NOT your typical bar, and the service goes above and beyond. Our server provided recommendations, explained things on the menu, and really made sure we had everything we needed.
Aside from great drinks, the drinks are also paired with a small snack that makes it feel much more like an experience rather than a drink at a bar.
Cannot recommend this enough.

reviews.author: Paola Galluccio
reviews.text: I was in Küche Bar last Friday for birthday drinks with some friends. The place is cozy and pretty, and the drink selection is creative and interesting —most cocktails even come with little servings of different foods, to further enhance the flavour of the drink. We were served by Sophie, who gave great recommendations and checked in from time to time to make sure we were all happy with our drinks. We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Nick Broad
reviews.text:
Wow. Every cocktail was well thought out, balanced and imaginative. We had eleven cocktails and not one was too sweet or too bitter or at all bland. Can’t believe this place isn’t packed all the time. The espresso martini, the Kuche Thyme Julep, the espresso negroni…all amazing.

Hidden GEM.

reviews.author: Eren
reviews.text: Spacious bar with plenty of room inside and out, including a huge downstairs area with its own bar. Great for watching sports, grabbing a drink, or just unwinding after work. The staff are friendly and the atmosphere is always relaxed. Food could be better, so it’s not the go-to for quality dining, but for everything else, it’s a solid choice.

reviews.author: Amelia Short
reviews.text: Great staff and good vibes especially because its joined with a hostel so many people keen to talk. After 21:30 the garden/patio area is closed and cocktails aren’t served anymore so just to keep that in mind:)

reviews.author: Utkarsh Tripathi
reviews.text:
The place has different energy level altogether. Rooms are neat and well ventilated. Food at the restaurant is yummy. Had a nice time here and Bella from the Hostel Staff made a special welcome drink for us.
Location is also very nice, so a 10/10 from my end.

reviews.author: Edouard Ohleyer
reviews.text:
Terrible Experience – Not a Real Sports Bar

We booked seats and paid €20 each just to watch a game – but what a disaster. The TV wasn’t working, the streaming was absolutely awful, and we ended up watching the match on our phones… in a sports bar! Unbelievable.

Even worse, the staff didn’t care at all. No one tried to fix the issue or offer any kind of explanation or compensation. They simply ignored us.

And to top it off, the security guy at the entrance was already shouting at customers at 8 PM – completely unprofessional and aggressive for no reason.

Never again. If you call yourself a sports bar, at the very least make sure people can actually watch the game.

reviews.author: Mariia Pakhomova
reviews.text: Always a great experience here: the atmosphere is welcoming and the service is top-notch. Shout out to Bella for the amazing cocktails!! Highly recommend stopping by if you're in the area!

reviews.author: Darja Pixel
reviews.text: Such a vibe, wowzer! 😎🤌 Love it! Great cocktails, great atmosphere, great staff!!! Thank you for a wonderful evening. We will surely come back 🥹🤍🤍🤍

reviews.author: Neville King
reviews.text: Super cool little place. Awesome server, great cocktails in a space that feels a little like someones home.  Drinks lean toward asian flavours.  Really enjoyed our time here.

reviews.author: Lou
reviews.text: This place smells so nice and clean! even the bathroom smells nice. The employees are kind and bubbly, the drinks are so good we got the Pistachios Dream, Gin Basil Smash, something with Matcha, Gin and beer. Everything tasted good and very well made! I must say, this place has one of the best drinks menu and they deserve tips!

reviews.author: Charlotte Smith
reviews.text: Quite possibly the best cocktails I have ever had. Absolutely beautiful. Staff kind and friendly, so.welcoming. If we weren't heading home tomorrow we'd be going back!

reviews.author: Sara Fleming
reviews.text: Our neighborhood spot! We often retire here after touring the latest bookstore selection. And who needs peanuts when there’s salty popcorn! How often are you taking to a friend and can’t even hear them because the crunch of peanuts is too loud. Anyway, the bartenders are cool and the grapefruit goddess is worthy of worship.

name: Knutschfleck Berlin Variete Show Restaurant und Party Bar

reviews.author: 0d3LL
reviews.text: We booked the burlesque night via the getyourguide app and when we arrived they let us know it wasn't a burlesque show but a variety show which we didn't mind and the show was brilliant. The young guy on the door was really nice and towards the end of the evening came around to take photos of everyone. I believe we were one of a few non german groups but they were very accommodating and our waitress ISA was amazing she bought us the English menu and kept checking up on us throughout the night, nobody in our section waited long for help as she was always there. I believe our ticket was for 7 oclock and the show went on for quite some time it was very worth it and the food and drinks were nice. The price was expected for this type of establishment

reviews.author: Peter Schillizzi
reviews.text:
Never felt so uncomfortable while on toilet. You have to pee into something that resembles a mouth.

Brunch buffet ist mostly pork and cheese.

Music is deafening loud. If you expect to have a conversation, go somewhere else.

Staff is clearly untrained and unexperienced. They try to be nice though. The show is a steaming hot mess consisting of Ballermann and cruise ship vibes.

This might be for you. For me its a never again.

reviews.author: Sarah Pearce
reviews.text:
Kalina was a lovely and attentive host, we enjoyed the show and the evening.
Wasn't super keen on the food with the meal ticket we purchased but it was okay. Definitely recommend the evening for the show and hospitality.

reviews.author: Alice Hammarsten
reviews.text:
Definitely worth every cent! The show was beyond my expectations, showing dancers, acrobatic performers, musicians and singers. And in the time in between acts popular music was played with light effects to the beat.
Even dancing around the tables became more and more common.

One of the best evenings of my life! I was smiling and applauding the whole night. It is the perfect place for a girls night out, birthday celebration, wedding anniversary or graduation present.

reviews.author: Dan Pearce
reviews.text:
We visited Knutschfleck while in Berlin celebrating my wife’s birthday, and it was definitely a night to remember. The atmosphere was vibrant and full of energy, with great performances that kept us entertained throughout the evening. There’s a real sense of fun here, and it’s clear a lot of effort goes into creating that unique cabaret-style experience.

A special shoutout to our host, Kalina, who was warm, attentive, and made us feel genuinely welcome, she added a lovely personal touch to the evening.

If I had one small critique, it would be that the cocktails could’ve packed a bit more of a punch, but overall, Knutschfleck delivered a fun and memorable night out in Berlin. Worth checking out if you’re in the mood for something different!

reviews.author: C T
reviews.text: What an absolute hidden gem! The service was super quick. The music wasn't loud. The food was rustic and delicious.  Definitely worth a visit!

reviews.author: Erin Leitheiser
reviews.text: Amazing craft cocktails, served with (free) water and sometimes snacks. Really nice staff and cozy atmosphere. One of our best finds in the city!

reviews.author: Steve Chase
reviews.text:
We stopped in for a couple or more beers during our European train tour. Excellent service, great staff and some great beers. Would definitely drop in again when in Berlin, thoroughly recommended and hope to see you soon

Jacqui and Steve, Stourbridge, UK

reviews.author: Ayesha Mulvihill
reviews.text: I used to go to this bar a lot when I lived in Berlin, I’ve been moved out of the country for two months and every weekend I get a longing to return. I’ve always felt so welcomed by the gentlemen who work here. Sometimes I’d visit just for a chat. They always made any guests I brought feel also very special. The drinks are perfect standards. High level of mixology and they know how to make any drink to your liking. Really the best spot I can recommend to anyone I know if they visiting, and a great spot to make your regular if you are a local.

reviews.author: Kristina Waldt
reviews.text:
Super cosy and the drinks were amazing! (It actually took me by surprise because I'm so used to cocktails being a cheap mix of things, but here it was very flavourful and balanced.)
The bar felt very safe and comfortable, and the bartenders were experienced and friendly. I highly recommend it!

reviews.author: Elle Condon
reviews.text: I ended up in here late this evening with a few friends. The cocktails were amazing, super delicious! But the two lads behind the bar were amazing! Super friendly and cool, professional but also chatty and sound. I'm not in this part of town a lot but I'll totally come back just because the barmen were so lovely :)

reviews.author: Erika Gai
reviews.text: We are tourists here in Berlin and we wanted to have a good night. We rang the bell twice and nobody opened the door for us. The girl said the local was full but we saw from afar at least ten people leaving the bar and other two entered, so we tried another time but the girl still said that it was full. Idk if it’s because we are tourist or not but in any case the treated us very badly. I don’t recommend

reviews.author: Anita C
reviews.text: I am only visiting Berlin for one night, and for some reason a friend recommended Victoria Bar as a must visit. I walked here at 22:30, it’s already very crowded inside, but anyway the door man let in everyone in front of me. I asked him nicely if it’s possible to just have one drink at the bar, he was extremely rude to me (with a disgusted facial expression) first told me simply no chance tonight, and then before I could say anything, he asked me to step aside and wait, he doesn’t have time to discuss this, then turned around to talk to some girls. I just walked away, no drink or bar is good enough for me to take this kind of attitude and to ruin my good impression of Berlin.

reviews.author: Illusha de Bruijn
reviews.text: Something I personally haven't experienced before, the servers were all neatly dressed, they were nice and quite fast. You had to ring the bell to get in which I thought was funny. They had some art displayed which was very interesting aswell.

reviews.author: Robert Pohle
reviews.text: Wow—everything about this place is top-notch! The location, the atmosphere, the attention to detail, and of course, the amazing drinks. We came as a group of five, and even though I personally might not have perfectly fit the usual crowd, I never felt out of place. The vibe was welcoming, and the experience was genuinely enjoyable. I highly recommend checking it out—easily an 11/10!

reviews.author: Elizaveta Khorikova
reviews.text:
Great atmosphere in the bar, nice decorations with cute geckos. A little bit overpriced, you will pay 10€ for a cocktail.
And you can smoke inside.

reviews.author: Sunny Simantov
reviews.text: Great cocktails in a small and cozy place with fantastic music playing.

reviews.author: Raffael G
reviews.text:
May 2024 update.
Lovely spot to close a day. Friendly personnel and a long list of cocktails to choose from. Alabama Slammer was top. Reccomended.

reviews.author: Bruna Kremer
reviews.text:
It was one of the most rude places that me and my boyfriend went. We were having an absolutely amazing time at Berlin and we went on our last night to this bar. We enter and is a place that people can smoke inside ( which was fine) so we opted to go outside to have our drinks and enjoy the evening but when we asked the waiter said we couldn’t and we thought it was a joke but he was so rude and said we could have our drinks ourselves. We couldn’t believe how rude he was because they have a lot of tables outside with blankets for people to be on it. He came with the drinks with a Absolutely rude attitude and gave the check and he was not even looking at us. Made us feel embarrassed and mistreated with no reason!
I felt disgusted with the treatment because all the places we went people were really nice, that’s why tourists exist to connect and help economy as well.

reviews.author: Chase Evans
reviews.text:
Awesome little bar open till the early hours of the morning, they have great music and a good atmosphere.
Just know where ever you go and to see the lizzard your in the right place.

name: Hildegard Bar
address: Hildegard Cocktail Bar, Marburger Str. 3, 10789 Berlin, Germany

reviews.author: Amanda Lowe
reviews.text: A great cocktail bar in Berlin with standout seasonal drinks—like the Watermelon Man, served from May to August. The atmosphere is cool and relaxed, with just the right energy. Staff are welcoming, knowledgeable, and happy to help you find the perfect drink. Definitely worth a visit if you’re in the city.

reviews.author: Luke Mckend
reviews.text: So good we went twice. The vibe is awesome although be warned that smoking is allowed inside! In a way it adds to the vibe of the place, however depending on your pov that may be a major detractor. The drinks were excellent.

reviews.author: Josh R
reviews.text:
I was surprised.  I just wanted a really good cocktail one evening and wandered in here.  Wow. The bartender took his job very seriously though wasn’t a jerk about it.  I had a gin sour on the suggestion of a bar server.   She was great.  And the drink blew me away.  The flavors played so well.  And this was after my own decision which was a more approachable black margarita.  Also good.    Place was easy and excellent.   Service great too.

Music tasteful too, again, without pretension.

reviews.author: Jana Christoviciute
reviews.text: Stopped by for a quick drink before the movies and ended up really loving the place. We sat outside on a charming little street, which added to the relaxed vibe. The menu is creative and well thought out, especially enjoyed their twist on the classics, like the black margarita. Great cocktails, fair prices, and a lovely atmosphere. Will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Darren Wilson
reviews.text: Great little place with amazing cocktails and excellent staff who were friendly and very attentive.

reviews.author: John Eagle
reviews.text: Nice place but space limited, cocktails were very varied with a good choice but expensive, we only went for a beer and it came in a very small glass. Staff were friendly but service was slow

reviews.author: Manelisi Billy
reviews.text:
Amazing places with 2  different lounge areas and 3rd seating area around the bar.

Amazing staff, especially one the managers Melita. Cocktails and complimentary snacks like popcorn.

They have a terrace viewing the lovely spree.

It's a perfect spot for exploring a decent night life in Berlin, located close to the core attraction destinations of the city.  A perfect time to visit is summer and winter.

reviews.author: Cemil Altunay
reviews.text: I visited this bar recently and while the atmosphere and music were great, I was very disappointed with the service. One of the staff members spilled my cocktail over the chair and partially on me. They gave the chair a quick wipe but didn’t even clean the glass, which left my hands sticky and uncomfortable. On top of that, their attitude felt careless and borderline mocking. It’s a shame, because the place has a lot of potential, but the staff’s behavior really ruined the experience. I hope management takes this seriously and improves their customer service.

reviews.author: Pekka Lehtinen
reviews.text:
Bad review due to 40 minute wait time for cocktails at a bar that is far from busy. The idea of a quick drink on the way home is not suited to such a location.

Cocktails are okay, But nothing amazing. Worst experience I had in Berlin and not even a Sorry for the god awful service.

I would never ever come back here.

reviews.author: Olena Saraniuk
reviews.text: Great bar with nice cocktails. I usually go for the classics but their signature cocktails are also very nice. The staff is amazing - especially Anastasia. She made my evening ❤️

reviews.author: Egor Markovsky
reviews.text: It’s a fantastic place! You’ll have a unique experience with toilet seats, lifting tables, immersive sound, and unusual drinks—like vodka with worms or beer served in urine bottles. You don't have a lot of food choices, but the hot dog was good.  Everything is well-designed, and I’m sure you’ll love it!

reviews.author: Kwang Sujinno
reviews.text: Fun place to enjoy drinks! This place keeps you entertained every 15 minutes. It’s a must-visit when you are in Berlin!

reviews.author: Steven A. Culbreath (Immigration Law Tampa Bay)
reviews.text: This is probably one of the bizzarest themed bars in Berlin!  It's definitely worth stopping in.  Beware of the DJ in his booth, when you walk in (you won't be able to avoid him). He will ridicule you and hurl comedic jabs at you and those with you all evening long. You're the subject of his ongoing "roasting", so take it all in with a grain of salt, laugh it off, and don't get your feelings hurt!  The entire bar has "toilet" at the theme, hence the name "Klo" (German for toilet).

reviews.author: Victor Dembovsky
reviews.text:
Food is simple and good - 3 options only, just to get it with your drinks. Atmosphere is great, music, life DJ, service good and fast. Place itself decorated very cool, with tons of toilets elements.
Recommended.

reviews.author: Mikael Nylander
reviews.text:
Quirky and interestingly styled bar. Staff was excellent and they spoke perfect English with me (my German is not good at all)
Beer was great, the venue was full of gags and surprises.

reviews.author: chris carpenter
reviews.text: They dont do food as far as I know. Fantastic little bar with another on in Cuba too! I look forward to visiting there. Dennis was our host for the evening, and what a fantastic guy. Extremely knowledgeable, especially when it cam to rum! The humidors were small, but they had some very nice cigars in them. Great vibe, great people, I highly recommend. And if you are a rum drinker and have the luxury of Dennis' company, ask him for the Rum with Butter speciality drink that he makes. Looks like a milkshake but certainly doesnt behave like one!

reviews.author: Anatoly Shabalin
reviews.text: Good cocktails and nice menu. But we were waiting for the service for too long. Also waiter refused to split the bill in half between two guests and was rude. Had more pleasant experience in the Hat bar next door.

reviews.author: Pavlina Jung
reviews.text: Such a nice bar under the S-bahn railway. Great coctails, possibility of a Champagne by glass and selection of wines, plus complimentary water. Amazing friendly staff is working here. When we are in Berlin, we always stop by to have a drink here.

reviews.author: Codin Moldovanu
reviews.text:
Great cocktails, great atmosphere, great people.
Our third round was a bit delayed but it was hectic so - understandable, the people serving made up for it!
Highly recommend the place, even for non-Berliner crowds.

reviews.author: Alfredo Marcus
reviews.text:
Small and cozy bar. Smoky dark music great bartender doing absolutely amazing job crafting the cocktails. Very pleasant see them prepare a Pisco sour where are they shake the entire royal egg in the shell then draw a hole small hole and take that away up leaving the Joakin side untouched
I’ll be back we more friends have more cocktails and have more laughs it’s open till late so it’s perfect for the last call

reviews.author: Krister Brolin
reviews.text:
If you are a hard core punk fan or looking for cheap beer, this might be the place for you. It is a bit tricky to find. It has a stage so I assume there is live music some days of the week. There is also a small and cosy biergarten.

We were there late in the afternoon, so It is hard to rate the atmosphere. I guess evening would have been better.

One odd thing was a couple who clearly had a LOT of amphetamine in their systems. The guy was running around like a ball in a pinball machine. His irratic behavior made people feel uneasy, but the barkeeper seemed to know him so he was left alone. It was not really threatening, but we could see a lot of other customers feeling uneasy.

I have no pictures from inside, because It was not allowed.

Anyway, if you love punk rock and don't mind a bit of odd behavior, this might be the place for you.

reviews.author: Xyrn
reviews.text: The place looks so underground, just how I would imagine a pub in Berlin. I love the music playing inside, the people and the bartenders are really friendly, the beers are fairly priced and they're the best ones I had in Berlin. You can also play pool, foosball and pinball inside, it's a really good addition to the atmosphere

reviews.author: Bruce Renwick
reviews.text:
Great bar, hidden away off the main street. Punky vibe, no photos allowed inside, don't really understand why.
Decent beer selection, outside terrace as well as a cavernous interior. Worth hunting out.

reviews.author: Ofelia
reviews.text: Loved the place. It's huge compared to other bars I've been to. Affordable drinks and friendly bartenders.

reviews.author: Dusan Ristic
reviews.text: If you want to experience real Berlin bars, you should visit Clash. It’s an authentic and unique place with Berlin vibes. There are nice and still cheap beers, table tennis and good music.

reviews.author: Ezgi Y.
reviews.text:
-Stepping into Rein Gold feels like traveling back to the roaring twenties — glamorous, cozy, and full of charm. I had the Gin Basil Smash and it was absolutely perfect: fresh, aromatic, and beautifully balanced. The attention to detail, from the presentation to the ambiance, made the whole experience unforgettable. Can’t wait to come back!
Danke Ray du der beste in Berlin 👌🏻👌🏻👌🏻

reviews.author: Bas Hink
reviews.text:
Last weekend, I visited Reingold Bar for the first time, and it was an unforgettable experience. This classic cocktail bar maintains high standards, offering an atmosphere that instantly transports you back in time.

From the moment you step inside, you are immersed in an elegant and nostalgic ambiance. The bar team, dressed in classic attire, perfectly complements the vintage aesthetic of the venue. Their professionalism and passion for mixology are evident in every drink they craft.

One of the highlights of Reingold Bar is its hidden speakeasy, where exclusive cocktails are served in an intimate setting. This secret gem adds an extra layer of mystery and excitement to the experience.

Overall, Reingold Bar delivers top-notch cocktails, impeccable service, and a truly unique atmosphere. Thank you for an amazing evening—I’ll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Manelisi Billy
reviews.text:
The most amazing Cocktail Bar you can find in Berlin. Very welcoming, friendly and sophisticated in a nice way.

Best for every occasion, especially for a great evening out with friends, special guests, VIPs and hospitality experts😊😍

Ray, Pia, Bas are your best go to staff members😊😍😎💯🔥🍹📸

reviews.author: Fabio Mon
reviews.text: A true hidden gem! This cocktail bar offers a truly unique experience: a refined atmosphere, incredibly knowledgeable staff, and an impressively wide selection of high-quality drinks. Each cocktail is crafted with care, using premium ingredients and creative flavor combinations. A must-visit spot for anyone who appreciates exceptional mixology and loves discovering something new with every visit.

reviews.author: Mitch Wilson
reviews.text: Reingold has recently had new ownership under Ray Peters, and he has really brought back the spirit and vitality of this bar. Beautiful drinks, welcoming and friendly service, and one of the most iconic bars in Berlin. A must visit. Make sure you check out the secret speakeasy out the back as well!

reviews.author: Максим Лазаренко
reviews.text: Great place , for everyone, any time of the year. My friends with their dog came often, they had a great time. We went here with the kids, there is a kids menu and ice cream, which made the kids happy in the heat. Beer is good and they change the draft beer list often. The taps are looked after and the glasses are clean (which is important, especially in hot weather). Even when I was tired and had a hard time after the heat, I was greeted by smiling people who work here. It's a positive establishment and there are always smiles here. I have been going here for about 2 years now and will continue to go and recommend this place. I am glad to know BrewDog on Mitte. In fact : Clean, Fresh, Cozy, Friendly..... The beer is great! Thanks.

reviews.author: Sena ÜRKÜT
reviews.text: i loved the atmosphere. the design is so cool and it was really big. there were so many beer options we tried some with pizza. pizza was tasty and it was a really good experience with all that beer options.

reviews.author: Corey Chapman
reviews.text: BrewDog has over 25 beers on tap ranging from IPAs, Ambers, Helles, and more. The staff are very friendly and give you plenty of samples. The pastrami pizza was delicious and paired well with the Helles Lager. The interior is modern and outdoor seating is available as well.

reviews.author: Dimitar M
reviews.text: I’ve been to a lot of BrewDog pubs, but this has to be one of the best. Great interior, wonderful selection of beers and excellent service. Thank you!

reviews.author: Polina Abramova
reviews.text: We loved the place and the atmosphere! All waiters were very polite and pleasant. They offered us to try different beers before our order! What's a magic? Definitely recommend and will get back there!

reviews.author: Clontarf ConsultingPL
reviews.text: Great Irish pub right near the River Spree (see photo). Good Guinness & friendly barman & bar ladies. Plenty of outdoor space as well. Highly recommended. Love Berlin!

reviews.author: Nur Sökmen
reviews.text: Our friend had previously enjoyed the pancakes and beer, so we brought them, but they didn't have any. This time, we decided to try a cocktail, but it was truly awful. We wanted less sugar and more alcohol, so we ordered the Long Island iced tea. The menu listed Long Island iced tea (€15), but it was filled with cola, and it was practically cola, with very little alcohol and way too much sugar. The Lynchburg lemonade (€11) was so overly sweet we couldn't drink it. We ended up with everything. Clearly, our choices were wrong. If you're looking for a beer and a good time, you can have it, but this isn't a cocktail place.

reviews.author: Kate
reviews.text:
Amazing food, great drinks, and very rude woman at the cashier. Come on, you can’t be barking that much at people visiting the restaurant.

Otherwise it’s a very nice pub which  I visited twice already.

reviews.author: Maha Nasser
reviews.text: Great place to meet new friends. The songs and vibes are exceptional. When you go, ask for Irvin, he’s the best.

reviews.author: Debbie Foster
reviews.text:
We had a great Sunday night at this pub. The Irish stew was delicious and the atmosphere was as you’d expect of a good pub.
The singer, Ellie (?) made it even better. Great value and friendly staff made for a good time.

reviews.author: Max Blackwood
reviews.text: Love the concept of pouring your own beer, 4 taps per table. Splitting bills made simple for large groups with the easy to follow digital display above the taps. Cool location in the rail arch’s and decorated well inside. Food available was a great quality and the burgers were a highlight, generous portions. Went as family but very popular with stag and party venue which didn’t detract from the enjoyment.

reviews.author: Marcos F. Caetano
reviews.text:
The Pub has a great atmosphere — excellent music playing, a spacious setting, and very good service. I found the staff to be polite and helpful, and it's a plus that they speak English. The burger was excellent; I highly recommend the Hangover. The weissbier was also spot on.

The only downside was the touchscreen ordering system at the table. It didn’t work very well and ended up wasting a lot of time with misclicks and redoing the order. The screen is also positioned too high, which makes it uncomfortable to use.

Overall, I really enjoyed the place and definitely plan to return. I recommend it!

reviews.author: Michael Riis Allesøe
reviews.text:
Cool gimmick with you pouring your own beer. Only Berliner Weisse though, so not the most fancy beer.

Burger was ok. Fantastic for Germany, but burgers are not really their strength regardless.

Pretty expensive and having a 10% tip already included on top of the bill is not okay. Ever.

reviews.author: paul flynn
reviews.text:
Great spot for beer and food , very nice vibe.
Realy enjoyed it there. Pour your own beer, what's not to love.

reviews.author: Lyns Rudd
reviews.text: This is such a great wee place if your looking for something different. Staff were great, friendly and welcoming. Would definitely recommend a visit. Booking is required as it is always booked out!

reviews.author: Victoria Brito
reviews.text: I host a Run Club, and man, it is borderline impossible to find a place in Berlin where it is easy to make a reservation and you would actually want to spend time there. The castle is by far the best bar for large groups in Berlin! You can make reservations for 30, 60 even 90 people. I’ve had so many issues and other places. I would say this is the best reservation process in the city. The craft beer is also awesome.

reviews.author: Lucas Sekula
reviews.text:
I’ve noticed a shift here lately — and not necessarily for the better. The atmosphere is becoming increasingly self-assured, perhaps even bordering on cocky. It’s also a little exhausting for English speakers when you try in German and still receive no response. That in itself is worth a discussion.

Another point: staff conversations about clients — even if not overtly negative — are not exactly the most welcoming background noise. As a guest, you come here to relax and enjoy yourself, not to feel like part of someone’s side commentary.

And finally, attentiveness and kindness cost nothing. Simple gestures — a genuine greeting, eye contact, checking in — go a long way. A little more of that could transform the experience.

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.text: Top service, on a busy night they managed to sort out a table for us. Spacious, good setting for some board games and drinks. Decent coffee as well, better than what you'd generally expect at a bar.

reviews.author: N. D.
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 15/10 – A Second Home in Mitte!

This place is absolutely amazing! The staff is so kind and friendly, making everyone feel welcome. The music is great, and the atmosphere is wonderful—it’s like a second home to me. If Google had 10 stars, I’d give it 15! 😊

After picking up my daughter from Kita, I sometimes stop by to chill out, and it’s always a perfect escape. We’ve even brought friends along, and everyone loves it too. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Andressa Daniella
reviews.text: It's one of my favorite bars in Berlin. A lot of beer and cocktails options, with fair price and good service. The environment is very relaxed, I always have fun when I'm there 😄

reviews.author: Alexej
reviews.text:
It is a quite huge place, smells pretty much like an Irish Pub. Inside the shipping mall downstairs and not that easy to find at first instance.

Opens early on weekends to cure and cause hangovers))) We had a good time there. Thank you!

reviews.author: Iwona Swisulska
reviews.text: Great place for entertainment with live music and great choice of beers and spirits. Highly recommended 👌

reviews.author: Danny RiverA
reviews.text: I haven’t eaten here but the service is super fast even when packed wall to wall. Great music and great beer. They could use some work on the cocktails (i know that’s not what this bar is about but still)

reviews.author: Yugine Lama
reviews.text: Wanted to try the popular Irish pub. We just looked around and took seat at the bar. There was only 1 bartender and it took forever to place order. Later, there was 1 server and we went to her to place order. Since it took long time to place order, we didn’t want to order any food. Had beers and left. But the atmosphere seemed nice.

reviews.author: Christian Molle
reviews.text: Great beer menu, lots of options. The staff is also very accommodating and speaks English well. There was live music as well

reviews.author: Steve B.
reviews.text: The Lir is hands-down the best Irish Pub in Berlin! The cozy, authentic atmosphere makes it the perfect spot for a relaxed night out with friends. The friendly staff and great selection of drinks and food make every visit a delight. Highly recommend! 🫶

reviews.author: Guldeniz Torun
reviews.text: I and my 2 friends visited on a Saturday around 11:00 PM. The bartender seemed very tense, and the vibe was a little off. When we asked about sitting on the terrace, she responded with a very sharp "no," citing the neighbors, which was fine but a bit jarring. The same thing happened around midnight when she told us it was the last round multiple times. While I understand the rules, the delivery felt unfriendly. The Lir didn't have the typical bar culture I'm used to in Berlin. I might try it again with a different bartender.

reviews.author: Jasmin Arthur
reviews.text: One of the best pubs I’ve ever been to. Great environment. Our waitress Alex is absolutely brilliant - breath of fresh air. Highly highly recommend!

reviews.author: Team Tumas
reviews.text: Amazing! We have traveled all throughout the British Iles and Ireland, this is on par with the best we've ever had! We were soooo impressed. They also had great cider!! We will come here again before we leave. It's the best food we've had in Berlin!

reviews.author: Devin Fiachra Duffy Meade
reviews.text: Guinness, Spice Bags, Football, Great service. Can't ask for more.

reviews.author: S
reviews.text:
Good ambience to chill over weekends, Guinness beer is good here, lots of other alcohol varieties.
Great service & also pool table & some other gaming options available.
No food options are there, only light snacks & some nuts available.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Loebick
reviews.text: Very nice Irish pub. A lot of room. Great selection of beers and whiskey. The service was friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Michał Pawłowicz
reviews.text: An authentic, atmospheric place for fans of Irish - Scottish tastes of beer or whiskey 👌

reviews.author: Henrique R (happiMonster)
reviews.text: Good atmosphere! They have some darts, a pool table and a foosball table.. you can tell by how much fun were having 😁

reviews.author: Tamás Fülöp
reviews.text:
Great selection of Whiskey for a decent price. The atmosphere is also amazing, the nice folk music really sets the mood for drinking a proper whiskey. Highly recommended place!

PS: the staff is very friendly and nice.

reviews.author: Varun Mandalaparthy
reviews.text:
We were in Berlin for a band get together and wanted to find a bar with karaoke. Unfortunately, the bartenders informed us that they had no karaoke any more, they just hadn't updated the description on Google.
But we asked and they were exceptionally kind, allowing us to perform live music and relive our musical pasts. Amazing servers, really made our evening!

reviews.author: Annette
reviews.text: This is a lovely pub and the staff are very friendly. I just happened to be there on a quiz night and happily joined in on the fun. If I get a chance to visit Berlin again I would definitely pop in here, well worth checking out!

reviews.author: Celine Burke
reviews.text:
I’m not one for going on holiday from Ireland and heading straight to an Irish bar but stumbled upon this little gem. Not your typical cheesy  ‘Irish bar abroad’, it is full of real Irish charm and cracking atmosphere. Situated in a lovely part of Berlin with outdoor sitting so you can watch the world go by.
If you’re craving Guinness and tayto on your city break, this place is the place to be! ☘️

reviews.author: Ciaran Burke
reviews.text: Great atmosphere and very friendly staff. Best pint of Guinness in Berlin, without doubt. Plenty of Sport options and excellent music

reviews.author: REDTT59
reviews.text:
We booked a table to watch the football.
And what a good choice,
Brilliant pub super atmosphere.
Brilliant people working there really looked after us .
Most definitely our first choice next time  we're in Berlin.

reviews.author: Dennis Beyer
reviews.text:
KASCHK is hands down one of the coziest and friendliest neighborhood bars I’ve ever been to. Thank god I live next door.
From the moment you step in, you’re greeted with warm lighting, inviting wooden interiors, and a vibe that makes you feel right at home.

The beer selection here is incredible! Whether you’re a craft beer connoisseur or just looking to try something new, there’s always something exciting on tap.

Josh, our great bartender, knows his beer inside out and can recommend the perfect one based on your taste. His friendly and approachable attitude adds an extra layer of charm to the whole experience.
By the way they also have a great red wine, you would not expect in a beer bar.

If you’re looking for a spot to relax, catch up with friends, or explore a world of beer flavors, KASCHK is the place to be. Highly recommended!

Oh, they have Shuffle Board in the basement too! 🤯🤩

reviews.author: Nikita Nymeros
reviews.text:
Looovely place to have a lecker bierchen! They have a vast amount of different tap beers to choose from. Pale Ale, German IPA, Helles, Dunkelbier, even ciders and other cocktails. Sitting places can be limited during the weekend but the atmosphere was pretty nice!

I would love to come back any time soon.

reviews.author: Bobby Saco
reviews.text: This is a busy place located right at Rosa-Luxemburg-Square. It is a (day)bar and you can have different kinds of beer and drinks. Selfservice. Since the location is next to a busy street it is quite noisy. More a place to go with your friends or after work rather than for a date.

reviews.author: Alex McRae
reviews.text:
Drank in here a couple of times during the day on a recent trip to Berlin, some decent choices on tap and also bottles available.
Both times the bar staff very friendly & overall nice vibe in the place for a couple of craft style beers

reviews.author: Sarah S
reviews.text:
Great variety of beers to choose from, this location specifically has a "Juicy and I know wit" beer that has citrus mango taste-so unique. I plan to return to this location specifically for this beer.
Atmosphere is relaxed, sitting options inside and out. Approachable staff.

reviews.author: Yashaswini gowda
reviews.text: It is a really nice bar tucked away on Augustastrasse to hangout with friends. It costed us around 50€ for 3 people for 3 rounds of beer and soft drinks. Seems a bit expensive, but given the location the prices are okay.

reviews.author: VC Kristi
reviews.text: Music and athmosphere first class! What a charming place with very friendly owner, outdoor area and incredibly designed interior area! You have a feeling like you enter different time and space zone, literally you are going back to times between 50’s and 2000. Everything the best you remember about those times, it’s in this pub. I’m definitely coming back here 😁

reviews.author: Andreas CALISKAN
reviews.text:
Bar that I liked to go, but the beers are getting super expensive.
I also had a bad experience with the bar man and the boss because instead of 7€ for 2 shots I only had 6.80 and they insulted me for proposing the deal, saying : here it’s mitte and not the bazar.
They were very disrespectful in their ways of talking and at the end forgot to give me my shot saying that they gave it to me

reviews.author: Marius Mostert
reviews.text: Really friendly and welcoming staff. Best pub I’ve been to in Berlin! Also had quite a few screens with sports on. Top quality.

reviews.author: Jan Laird of Glencoe
reviews.text: A lovely arranged furnished pub in the heart of the City! Centrally located between synagogue, the former Tacheles and the Friedrichstadt Palace. There are 6 Draft beers #Guinness #Kilkenny #BerlinerPilsner #Heinecken  #TegernseeHelles and #wheatbeer and also a well-stocked bar. Noble Whiskys and Whiskeys, Gins, Cognacs and various other alcoholic beverages await the guest. An absolutely friendly environment as well as customer-oriented staff. I am pleased that BVB has found its home here. The back part of the Pub is decorated in the Club colors of BVB in black and yellow. You feel like you are sitting in the "Temple". Seat reservations for the matches are not accepted. It is recommended to take your seat at least 90 minutes (for top events at least 240 minutes) before kick-off.

reviews.author: Peder North
reviews.text:
Simply the Best whisky bar in Berlin.
Wide selection, you can spend days just browsing the shelves. They have Guinness and Murphy’s on draft!

reviews.author: Phil Thomas
reviews.text: Incredible selection of whisky and some wonderful, friendly German hospitality. What's not to like? Ask for recommendations, they have so many whiskies off the beaten path it's worth exploring.

reviews.author: Tony Holland
reviews.text:
A whisky drinkers haven in Berlin. Service was great and prices were not bad at all. Bare in mind that some whiskies are ferociously expensive.

Oh and they also sell gin for those who don't like whisky.

reviews.author: Alan Bainbridge
reviews.text: Brilliant whisky pub.  The lady who was serving gave us some great recommendations.  Definitely a place to make a special trip to visit

reviews.author: Brad Coulson
reviews.text: We stumbled across this place by accident and it's like going back in a time warp to a classic English pub, loved it. They have a fantastic selection of Whisky and bourbon. The service was excellent too. If you're in the area, definitley worth calling in!

reviews.author: David Alan Roden
reviews.text: Was a great experience - Guiness was nice - barman and barlady who served us were very pleasant and easy to talk to - very attentive. We speak no German unfortunately - even so it was very easy to communicate with these lovely people. I read in other reviews that they don't take card payment - this was not true when we were there - card payment was accepted without issue. We spent several nights there and enjoyed the relaxed atmosphere very much indeed. I would venture to say that this a proper pub! Thanks Berlin Pub - wishing you all every success and we will visit again for sure next time we are in Berlin!

reviews.author: Madi Gale
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing bar, friendly service and lovely barman. Proper German pub and a great top shelf selection, could not expect more, 100% recommend.

reviews.author: Hesham Saleh
reviews.text: My recent visit to Berlin Pub was nothing short of a nightmare due to the appalling behavior of the barmaid. Her hostility and rudeness were absolutely unacceptable, leaving us feeling disrespected and unwelcome. The barmaid's consistent rudeness towards us and other patrons throughout the evening tarnished the entire experience. I strongly advise against visiting Berlin Pub if you value basic courtesy and a pleasant atmosphere.

reviews.author: Darren Wilson
reviews.text: The place was empty and the woman serving scowled at us as we left. It was also like she'd never poured a pint of Guinness in her life. Avoid.

reviews.author: Charlotte Lewis
reviews.text:
Stopped in for a pint after a long day trawling around the zoo, ended up staying for several hours enjoying delicious local beer at a decent price (€5ish), chatting to locals and having a laugh. Mario was great and taught us some German phrases and fed us Schnapps, along with some other regulars sat at the bar. We were made to feel very welcome and would definitely recommend.
This is a pub for smokers, and you can really tell - I will only partake after a few beers but it's definitely noticeable when you first go in, so beware if that's not your thing!

reviews.author: Arian Rassoul
reviews.text: didnt try the food. service was good. atmosphere as well, but the choice of beer was a bit lame. i mean cmon pilsner urquell on the card … thats so not special. but we had a good time.

reviews.author: Tez Boyes
reviews.text: Great modern beer choices and staff in a classic eckkneipen.

reviews.author: Felix
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing place! The oldest craft beer bar in Berlin. They change the beers quite often and have a wide range of local and special beers. The owner and staff are really nice and will give you great advice about the beers. Absolutely worth a visit

reviews.author: Bull Dogg
reviews.text: Excellent craft beer bar with a good selection of beers on tap. A wide variety of beer types and breweries are offered. The staff is professional and friendly. The interior is terrific, except for the restrooms which are Berlin-nasty. Nonetheless we keep coming back to this place for its great beer.

reviews.author: Gicu Hincu
reviews.text: It is a beer place and it should be treated accordingly. The atmosphere is simply awesome, the vibes are so cool and it just feels good here chatting over a beer. It is a disruptive place with good beer, nice staff and good people. They allowed us to bring our own food and I believe the combination of their beer and Burgermeister burgers has added to this experience being hard to forget. Highly recommended

name: Murphy's Irish Pub at Checkpoint Charlie

reviews.author: Thurso Lass
reviews.text: A real old fashioned bar in a city with loads of restaurant/bars. Found it by chance then planned our next day to end up in the vicinity of the bar at beer o'clock. Nice big bar, good few seats, table service. TV for sports even a projection of football onto a bare wall. Background music at a decent level. Can reserve tables. Drink a good price, one of the cheapest we seen, and no compromise on quality. Food cheap as chips, (you pay for what you get) you don't pay 4.90 for a burger and chips and expect to get a premium burger and chips. We had currywurst and chips, food for the price. Liquors are decent prices, shot of Moonshine only 3.90 and for 4cl. Overall a good bar, good easily while away a few hours without breaking the bank.

reviews.author: ciara sutton
reviews.text: As an Irish person I went to watch the rugby then enjoyed some live music the service was great too plenty of friendly staff would definitely visit again! The Guinness was also very good!

reviews.author: Sarah Robinson
reviews.text: When we first arrived, we tried to go in to order and got told we could not do it at the register and they would come outside to take our order. When the waiter came outside he said “what do you want” in a rude tone. The second waiter was friendlier. The waitress that brought out the food seemed not overly friendly either. Got the fish and chips. Portion size was small, however price was not too expensive I guess. Beer was not too bad. Meal took a little while to come, and it was hard to get the attention of the waiters when trying to order. Wouldn’t return and based on the owners replies to the comments on here, happy to not return.

reviews.author: Maryna Ryzhova
reviews.text:
Nothing special at all. The food was not freshly prepared and the schnitzel meat was full of veins. That's probably why almost everyone at the table had nothing but beer.
The only positive I noticed - the cafe is pet friendly.

reviews.author: P M
reviews.text:
A nice little Irish boozer right on Checkpoint Charlie. Service is excellent, the fish and chips were tasty and the Warsteiner was cold and refreshing.
It can get busy at peak times but we had no problem getting a seat and served a drink which is a testament to the efficiency of the staff.
It won’t give you anything you can’t get in any Irish Bar outside Ireland but it does it as well as any and better than most.
Its greatest asset (other than the beer, the atmosphere and the staff) is that it’s one of the few bars in this fair city that opens so you can get a beer before 5pm in evening!
All in all a good place that became our go to bar for the time we were here.

reviews.author: passed port (passedport)
reviews.text: Amazing. Came back twice during our trip. Delicious food, huge servings and awesome location and interior design- but above all, the kindest multilingual waiters and waitresses I’ve perhaps ever met. On the first night, we had a really lovely lady waitress, and the second, Tomas, both of whom were efficient and humorous despite the pace at which service needed to happen. Thanks for our lovely dinner!

reviews.author: Vasiliy Kulakov
reviews.text: Great riverside restaurant with nice chill vibe, brats, beer and great schnitzel. Wish we could have sat by the Spree but tables were not available for some reason, so we sat in the outdoor garden instead

reviews.author: Maryna
reviews.text:
The beer was decent, and the food was okay, but the service was truly disappointing. Everything was extremely slow, and when we asked to sit outside, they refused to wipe down the table after the rain. On top of that, they added a 4-euro service charge that wasn’t even shown on the bill. I’m almost certain this was just a forced tip that the staff keep for themselves.
Overall, I wouldn’t really recommend this place — you can find good beer in many other places across Germany without dealing with poor service like this.

reviews.author: Olena Davydiuk
reviews.text: Everything was perfect! The service was excellent, and the food was absolutely delicious. I especially loved the sausage, goulash, and salad – each dish was full of flavor and perfectly cooked. The beer was fantastic, and the dessert at the end was the perfect finishing touch. If you're in Berlin, this place is a must-visit!

reviews.author: Shuo Sue Hua
reviews.text: My local friends took me to this wonderful restaurant by the river, one with its distinct history, house culture and flavour. We enjoyed our lunch here very much. Thank you.

reviews.author: Kira Svane Kristensen
reviews.text:
Really great place with an amazing selection of beers on both tap and bottles. They have an especially wide selection of sours and lambic beers.
The service is great, and cool surroundings. Definitely one of the best craft Beer bars in Berlin!

reviews.author: Kenny Pollock
reviews.text: AMAZING BEERS holy shit, it brought me back to Belgium. Bottle selection insane. Lagers on draft equally insane. This place made me love Berlin so much more than I did. I already forgot the bartenders names but they were both incredibly nice and welcoming, which is rare in Berlin :p Will be back in the Summer!!!!!

reviews.author: Cam Olsen
reviews.text: Excellent spot for craft beer. The tap list was fantastic and in addition to a robust offering of drafts, they had plenty of canned and bottled offerings. They have some simple snacks that are tasty and affordable. The bartenders are knowledgeable and friendly with great recommendations and fantastic service. It also is a plus that they take credit card. Highly recommend if you’re in the area!

reviews.author: Dzmitry Yudo
reviews.text: Great selection! Over 20 taps and lots of bottles. The place is somewhat skewed towards geuze/lambic/saison/farm/stout styles.

reviews.author: Hanna Stelmakh
reviews.text: This place is a must-visit for beer lovers! They offer a wide variety of beers, so there’s something for everyone. Everything I tried was absolutely delicious, and I really enjoyed the experience. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Filip M
reviews.text:
Have you met my friend "good service" because they have it here.

One of the coziest pub I have been to.
The kindest friendliest girl worked here on wensday night.

Had chilli burger and fries for dinner, was great.

Guinnes and Kilkeny red ale for me and for the lady it was Pina colada. Everything was great.

Interior was very cool if you are How I met your mother fan, and if you are not its also very cozy. The atmosphere is great.

Will come back for sure 🙂‍↔️

reviews.author: apolin 656
reviews.text: Extremely good atmosphere. You really feel like one of the characters from himym. Not so pricey for a themed pub. Also you can buy souvenirs from the show, read Barney’s books and enjoy yourself

reviews.author: Ha Pham
reviews.text: I came here as a big fan of HIMYM. The decoration is really authentic and remind me a lot about the series. We had mocktail and they‘re very tasty. Schwarley and Schmosby. The menu is also named after the characters which is pretty cool.

reviews.author: Filippo Ghirardini
reviews.text: Must go if you're a HIMYM fan. A lot of niche Easter eggs and props. Not expensive (in line with other bars).

reviews.author: Lior “Lucy” Amado
reviews.text:
If you are a fan of "How I met your mother", this destination is a must!
Every way you look you see another item from the tv show.
Good service, Decent prices.
I recommend the "Snake bite" beer.
:)

reviews.author: Muhammed Erdogan
reviews.text:
As the last notes drift through the air and the laughter softens,
we pause to thank The Harp Irish Club
for a night full of music, joy, and memories we won’t soon forget.

Our tour group came in with curiosity and left with stories,
smiles, and maybe a few new dance moves.
Led by our fearless and fantastic guide, Diar—
who kept us together, kept us laughing, and made sure the fun never stopped.

So here's to good company, great music, and the road ahead.
May it always lead us back to places like this.

Sláinte, and see you next time!

reviews.author: Rachel Reynolds
reviews.text:
An Irish Bar anywhere in the world is usually a safe bet for good drinks and a bit of fun.
The harp is unique because while it does all the things you expect from an Irish bar:
Ceol agus Craic and a warm welcome,  it’s head and shoulders above the run of the mill Irish bar when it comes to food. It’s does the staples but it has no business doing them this well.  Have a pint and eat some food - thank me later

reviews.author: Michael Ruggieri
reviews.text: Fantastic bar, best bartender I’ve seen pour a Guinness!

reviews.author: Greg Carleton
reviews.text: Only bar in Berlin that correctly poured a Guinness. Didn’t come here for it but stayed here for it.

reviews.author: nicolas borda
reviews.text: Amazing place and so beautiful people. We spend really good moment with people from different country’s

reviews.author: Jaume Estapé
reviews.text: Fish & Chips was up mark. Unfortunately, we didn't enjoy the dessert. Service need to improve as waitress was too distracted.

reviews.author: Nick “Mizunonick” Brunyard
reviews.text: What an AMAZING place. Full of atmosphere, great food, all served with a welcoming smile and hospitality from the super attentive staff. The owner is obviously so well liked, as is his staff. Always full(which is a great sign) The pies are amazing as is the special daily soups. If you like Guinness, here is the pub to enjoy it. Please call in, you will not regret it. Highly recommend. Wish I lived in Berlin.

reviews.author: Chris Cohoe
reviews.text: I love this pub. It's a great place to play darts and have a few pints. It's always lively and has a great atmosphere. The staff are awesome and the service is great. Prices are very reasonable for both the food and drinks. It's a place I always visit when I'm in town and makes for a great night out.

reviews.author: Peter Gronerth
reviews.text:
Oh beloved Pub around the corner, please accept this ode to your humble greatness: Not only do you serve this most delicious of beers Guinness (that one can crave after a long day of exploring the city) no you also have never disappointed in the food category!

If, dear reader, you are like me and love a good stew, search no further than Finnegan's. It feels just like your grandma's kitchen and both the staff and also the other people that come here promise to make your visit one to remember, celebrate and hold dear (every.single.time)

Thanks for all of you working here, making this one of the greatest spots in all of Steglitz, if Not Berlin!

reviews.author: Alice Oluwole
reviews.text: Beautiful decor with a 90's vibe. Soft light and excellent choice of 90's music. They've got a jukebox but I didn't find out if it works. Also perfect for a group. I went with 6 other friends and it was enough room for us all. Oh yeah they are actually the cheapest beer I've gotten in Berlin at €2.80. Great staff too. The lady at the counter was super sweet.

reviews.author: craig patrick
reviews.text: An unassuming bar located within the train station. Met a nice guy called Frank and we discussed his greyhounds.

reviews.author: C B
reviews.text: Excellent Berlin Kindl premium Bier. Nice and cold. Well kept. Quaint cosy place with very friendly lady who I think owns it. Busy area with lots going on.

reviews.author: Luke Clarke
reviews.text: We use this bar as our farewell to Berlin just before we board the train to the airport. It’s a cute little place with indoor and outdoor seating. It’s a little basic but that’s all part of its authenticity. The lady behind the bar is nice once you get talking. They are happy speaking in broken German, to match your own broken skills. They do take both cash and card, although it would be handy for them if you paid in cash.

reviews.author: Margery M
reviews.text: horrible aggressive barmaid. slammed the drinks down on the table because she got the order wrong. we tried to be polite to her but her service was atrocious and i suspect she does not like english speaking tourists.

reviews.author: Leonardo da Cunha
reviews.text:
Nice little bar with good location, the server was very nice.
The only issue I had was I was served a Pilsner when asked for s Helles, which was advertised outside.

reviews.author: Pasi Lehto
reviews.text: I love this place and the personnel are great. Thank you for the good service again. See you soon again.

reviews.author: Sriparna Tah
reviews.text: This is such a cozy place with the most welcoming host ever. Tried different kinds of beer and liked them all. An absolute visit for beer lovers. Loved the vibe of this place . A perfect evening visit.

reviews.author: Ludwig Semper
reviews.text: They had Guiness so I was happy

reviews.author: Buck
reviews.text: Welcoming bar, great prices, lovely service and a new lovely beer introduced to me by the sweet lady in charge ....definitely recommend

reviews.author: Nur Kullukçu
reviews.text: We had guinness very friendşy service

reviews.author: Z O L U
reviews.text:
Perfect local experience, both for tourists and for local, particularly in the summer!

Located in the heart of Berlin, right on the river bank with a superb view over “museum island”, the location is hard to beat.

Great food and great local beer served by friendly waiters (somewhat overloaded). Unexpectedly, we had one of the best burgers and French fries in town!

reviews.author: Laura Woodside
reviews.text:
Came here on the recommendation of a friend. It was a beautiful spring day in Berlin when I went, opting for the outside riverside seating.
Nice German menu, so many good options. I chose the Zwei grobe Bratwürste, 2 bratwurst, fried potatoes (the best!), sauerkraut and mustard. So yummy and filling. Washed it down with a few cold Gaffel kolsch. Friendly staff, attentive but not overbearing. Quick service.
Lovely respite from a day of walking around.

reviews.author: elllen k
reviews.text:
Great place to crush after a busy day exploring Berlin. Seatings  are available inside or outside by the river.  Fast and friendly service. Good cold beer. I ordered  blood sausage and hands down it was the best blood sausage I've eaten all my life. Just  like a mousse.  My son got Schweinshaxe, it was very good, but be warned  - it's  for a serious carnivor person. It's a lot of meat.
I would recommend this place to a friend. Should I be back to Berlin  one day, I would definitely stop by here. For more blood sausage.

reviews.author: Özge Ergün
reviews.text: Really cool and nicely decorated German restaurant with indoor / outdoor sitting options, great selection of beers and food items (including quite some options for vegetarians and vegans). Even though we went as a big group, service was fast, the food was delicious and the staff was friendly.

reviews.author: Efim Kolodkin
reviews.text: One of the best german food in Berlin with a nice river side outdoor seating. Top notch flammenkuchen, great salads and curry wurst. And also Partick has a really personal and respectful approach to customers. Seriously recommended!

reviews.author: Karl Finke
reviews.text: Super good pizza, really friendly staff, great beers, wonderful garden - love this place!

reviews.author: Laura Burtonshaw
reviews.text: Very friendly staff with a nice selection of beers. We enjoyed the Parmesan pommes which I forgot to take a picture of!

reviews.author: Dzmitry Yudo
reviews.text:
The place has good pub vibes. Enjoyed the pizza-pie and a few craft IPAs and a pils. The tap selection is a bit limited (5 beers at the time of review). Can pay by card.

Update June 2024. They added some decent brunch options.

reviews.author: Krista Casey
reviews.text: We always have a really nice time at Two Fellas! The staff is very warm and welcoming and it’s family friendly. They have an excellent selection of unique and interesting beers and the pizza is delicious. We’re very lucky to have such a great spot in our neighborhood!

reviews.author: Nicole Marinho
reviews.text: Very good vibe. They have a good beer selection and other options as well. Service was also amazing. Amanda was very nice and friendly while serving us. Highly recommend Two fellas.

reviews.author: Dario Gasparroni
reviews.text: Top sport pub!!!! They are able to hire whatever you want to watch directly on your screen on your table! When I booked online the customer service took care to check if the event was possible to hire in advance exchanging many emails in advance and in real time... astonishing service! The food is better than average sport pubs, great beers, good prices, full of people watching sports...great vibe!!! AMAZING!!!

reviews.author: uffe hanghøj johansen
reviews.text: This excellent bar offers delicious food and a wide selection of beers. Many monitors are available for sports viewing; please ask the friendly staff if there's a particular game you'd like to watch.  Located within a hostel, it boasts a diverse and welcoming atmosphere.

reviews.author: Johannes
reviews.text:
Solid bar for groups. The TV‘s are located throughout the place so you can watch several games at once. They show a plethora of different sports.

The service wasn’t good on that evening, due too understaffing. Everybody was very nice and tried their best but having 4 people run the place on a Nations League evening is a disaster in the making.

The burgers were ok, nothing special, but chunky but cooked through.

3/5 stars due too understaffing and the food quality.

Btw they did not have Mayonnaise which I thought was kinda hilarious. Just Ketchup and mustard for the fries XD

reviews.author: wissanea lyndel
reviews.text: Great sports bar with a friendly atmosphere. Tasty pub food with a super efficient staff that will do anything for you. I never once had to wait long for a drink.  For major sporting events this is the place to be or it’s easy to pop in for a quiet drink. Very close to public transport. Go there, it won’t disappoint

reviews.author: mihir paghdal
reviews.text: I went for Champions league final match and the vibe was amazing. You need to go early if you want to get seat or else reserve in advance

reviews.author: Todd Colfelt
reviews.text: What an incredible place! Lena was amazing- engaging, kind and ran the bar effortlessly. Watched the final game of round of 16 of the Euros. Crowd was a bit older but still fantastic. They let me stay late and they were so gracious and welcoming. I wish that other places around the world could be so loving! Cheers! -Todd

reviews.author: Dalton
reviews.text:
Something different about this place. Imagine a sports bar where you can smoke inside but somehow it’s like your living room at home, it’s tastefully lit, it’s well decorated, it buzzes pleasantly but quietly. Birgit is an excellent host, she’ll check up on you regularly and even bring you a blanket or an extra table like your aunt might at Christmas.

I went in just because I saw the sky sports logo and had almost a surreal experience. My new favorite bar in Berlin. Will be back.

reviews.author: sam barnett
reviews.text: Met birgit this evening, lovely lady. Fantastic bar, can smoke inside, beer tastes beautiful and has an amazing atmosphere. Worth a visit

reviews.author: Jörg-Peter Rabanus
reviews.text: Well, I was looking for a place to watch an international soccer game between Germany and a different country. All the recommended "soccer bars" sucked. Birgit's Pub had the screens that are minimum for watching an important game, such as the one I watched. Bine, the bar tender was great, made sure that I had a full glass of beer, and gave me a welcome feeling at Birgit's Pub.

reviews.author: Josh Dunderdale
reviews.text: We arrived without a reservation for the opening match of the Euros and Birgit gave us two front row seats; the atmosphere was friendly and the host very accommodating. Would definitely go back if I'm around again!

reviews.author: James Cowling
reviews.text: Hot summer evening, sitting outside, good atmosphere and attentive service. Murphy's Red is good (no Kilkenny). The cottage pie was tasty, but a little sloppy, likewise the burger. Not on this occasion, but have enjoyed a pub quiz here, so good place to visit.

reviews.author: Alana U. Belcon
reviews.text: Had the Irish sausage with baked beans and mashed potatoes. The potatoes weren't as fluffy as I'm used to and needed a little salt but the sausage, beans and bacon were yummy and added that balance when eaten with the potatoes. The hot chocolate was divine. Wish there were more desserts than just muffins but all in all I really enjoyed my meal.

reviews.author: Ulf Schulte
reviews.text: Very nice Irish pub with a great mix of people! Big terrace, cosy inside!

reviews.author: cameron pollock
reviews.text: One of the best pubs for me as they had Strongbow on draft. 80% of Pubs only serve beer and im not a beer drinker. The full Breakfast was so good and they do deals on pitchers so check them out.

reviews.author: Tuong Vi
reviews.text:
It doesn’t look Irish outside and then you go inside and it is like Dublin in there. Loved the wall decoration. Food is not super Irish Pub style, everyone were looking for spare ribs! Burgers were super and my salmon sandwich more than expected. I had a bit trouble finishing it 🙈
Service super. Waiter was awesome.

reviews.author: Tom Shackle
reviews.text:
My wife and I had the immense pleasure of spending an evening at Offside for my birthday. From the moment we walked in, the quirky charm of the decor immediately drew us in - there was so much to look at and we could both tell everything had a story. The train set on the ceiling, the sleds, the Sesame Street characters, just so charming. And then… the whiskey collection. I have never seen so many different whiskeys in my life and if that wasn’t impressive enough, the meister himself attended our every whiskey need throughout the evening. He was unbelievably knowledgeable and lit up like a kid on Christmas at the opportunity to be able to share what he was so passionate about - a genuinely refreshing experience in a world of mass produced fast products and experiences. As if that wasn’t enough, a box of ‚happy birthday‘ chocolates was presented as a birthday gift - a gesture that really made my night - and an indication that kind gestures are not dead in the gastronomy environment in Berlin.

We thoroughly enjoyed the whole evening and the ability to slow down and enjoy the experience was such a nice change to the usual hum of some Berlin bars. In addition, the service was immaculate. The lady behind the bar was cheerful, positive, accommodating and attentive with a perfect balance of making us feel comfortable but not over-served (a difficult balance). The food was brilliantly functional and soaked up the whiskey nicely (it was honestly nice to only really have 1 choice to make menu-wise). 10/10 bringing as many people as I know here for a dram and the largest portion of cheese and olives I’ve ever seen.

We witness patrons who were popping in for a beer, all served wonderfully, and felt really grateful that should you seek it - a deeper experience awaits that you will not forget.

reviews.author: Neil Green
reviews.text: Great little bar in Berlin, upside down model Train set on ceiling is worth the visit alone. Staff are excellent. You get a tablet to pick one of the vast selections of scotch available. Also, it's good to hear good music as well.

reviews.author: Lui42
reviews.text:
A piece of UK in East Berlin.
Great pub with a good selection of beer and an impressive selection of whiskies.

reviews.author: Simon King
reviews.text:
This is an amazing and quirky "Irish Pub" style venue with the largest selection of whiskys and whiskeys I have ever seen, with over 1500 variations to choose from including some very unusual vintages. They also have plenty of spirits, beers and other drinks available.  The staff are very knowledgeable and are happy to make recommendations based on your preferences.

Likewise the food is excellent and ideally selected to compliment your drinks.

The decor has some very unique as well, such as a model railway inverted on the ceiling (sadly isn't one that will run 😂)

reviews.author: Carly Marcinkoski
reviews.text: My husband and I took a weekend trip to Berlin and happened to find this awesome bar. We love whisky and beer. This was our favorite bar we visited during our trip, such a warm and cozy vibe. Great people, relaxing atmosphere, and tons of whisky options to choose from! Our bartender Xander was awesome. He was so kind and welcoming as it was our first time visiting Berlin. All the bartenders there were great and friendly, and we will definitely be going back on our next visit to Berlin.

reviews.author: Ian Orti
reviews.text: Just a damn good local pub. Authentic and friendly. Perfect place to catch football or enjoy a low cost Guinness in one of the nicest hoods in Germany.

reviews.author: Ugam Kumar
reviews.text: Great Irish sports pub in the middle of Prenzlauer Berg. We went there on Friday evening and the place was jam packed. We enjoyed a couple of Guinness here. They have multiple TVs inside where they keep playing football games. There is outdoor seating for people who prefer quiet time.

reviews.author: Bora Uyar
