reviews.text: Great local pub to watch sports games with affordable prices for good beer

reviews.author: Corvus Cantans
reviews.text: As the Berliner barman explained, this pub has been around for ages: The Wall came down, people left what used to be a GDR workers', later indie artists' district, others came, mostly from Southern German regions, gentrification and bourgeois ambience grew and has been closing in on the small, cosy place - but they have stayed on, steady as a rock, and with Berlin's laid-back rough charm, patience and wit keep serving their guests, a crowd of old-school regulars and new fans. I'm one of the latter, enjoying a pint and friendly banter with people across the table.

reviews.author: Angélica Paiva
reviews.text: If you like a place just to whatch some soccer match, it's ok. They accepts only cash, and the options of beer and food it's few.

reviews.author: Yasunari Ishii
reviews.text: I had to sit at a counter when I got there but as a table became available and I asked her if I could sit there she quickly cleaned the table for me. She made a good recommendation on beer. And the pork knuckle was worth the wait. I've had it in a few different places including Munich and Warsaw. But it was really good. Enjoyed my evening.

reviews.author: Giusi
reviews.text: A very cosy pub in the city centre, a relaxed atmosphere, friendly staff and delicious food. From the gulasch to the schnitzel and the strudel, everything was fresh and tasted amazing. The price is appropriate to the quality/quantity, and the overall experience worth trying.

reviews.author: izzy fleming
reviews.text: Came here for drinks, didn’t disappoint. Very reasonably priced, had a couple beers. Divine. Friends had glasses of house white wine and enjoyed. Felt welcomed. Lovely staff. Would’ve loved to stay for hours. Didn’t have any food but saw some customers eating and looked nice. We just walked in but i recommend booking.

reviews.author: Reel to Reef
reviews.text: Highly recommended for good food and cheap beer. First time trying schnitzel and it was amazing. Outside seating and inside with bar. Great service too.

reviews.author: I P
reviews.text:
The drinks were ok.
The dish (lentil soup) I could not recommend, because the soup itself tasted warm water with spices.
The service behind the bar was friendly but insisted the new guests, to give old drinks and dishes from the tables of the guests before.

reviews.author: Tilman Benecke
reviews.text: An unexpected direct hit after warming up in the Destille pub:  suddenly there it was, like an oasis of green hop on the edge of the equally green Hasenheide. The alcohol level was already in the cozy upper floor, the mood somewhere between Sunday and after work. Inside: gleaming copper kettles, home-brewed happiness and service staff with patience. We sipped, chatted and philosophized. After all, beer makes you smart. Next to us were a couple of ladies who suspiciously often had to go to the loo, but well, everyone has their hobbies. Outside on the sidewalk, Neukölln's quiet shadow economy lurks within 50 meters of the dealer panorama. But inside, it's an ideal world of beer, malt, hops and water.

reviews.author: Mathias Fonseca
reviews.text: Very good schnitzels and beer! The waiter was super nice and spoke perfect Spanish to us, she made our visit so much better, we will definitely come back.

reviews.author: Alessandro Gouveia
reviews.text: Ive played there for the Fette de lá music and the Beer is awesome! The nachos were insane, the portions are generous and the crew is specially gentle and in a good mood, even through the place was crowded and they were eventually getting tired. Great place! I'd definitely get back there eventually

reviews.author: Ignacio Gonzalez
reviews.text: Very nice, good typical brewery house. I've been here in a company event and as a regular. I've had fun times! Beer is very good (very heavy tho). Food was good. Nice location next to the park. Totally recommended.

reviews.author: Disht Advani
reviews.text:
During my stay in Berlin, we visited this place for lunch and were seated in their delightful outdoor seating area. The food was quite good, featuring typical German dishes, and they served beer from their own brewery.

In our case, the service was friendly and excellent. The prices were reasonable and average for Berlin, making it an affordable option.

reviews.author: ES Hera Hwang
reviews.text:
You can taste many kinds of different beers. The vegetarian menu is also diverse and looks delicious. We ordered two kinds of chicken menu. The chicken was very moist, soft, and not salty, so it was delicious. However, the fried chicken did not have a crispy coating and the seasoning was very bland, so it was not delicious to eat with beer.
The overall interior atmosphere is nice and clean. If the weather is nice, the outside seating would be nice too. It's worth visiting again.

reviews.author: marco montella
reviews.text: Nice environment with good, relaxing, and friendly atmosphere with #1 waitstaff. Food could be better, but beers are really nice! I'll definitely come back to explore more of the menu options!

reviews.author: Fiona
reviews.text: Honestly I love this place so much- beer, food , atmosphere and staff are all incredible. But I find it absolutely ridiculous that I am spending 100’s and they can’t give me a glass of water for free. The beer is very strong, you need water. We live in Germany, you can drink tap water. I don’t want their filtered water at 2,50 per (very small) glass.

reviews.author: James Edward Richardson
reviews.text:
Exceedingly good staff, charming and knowledgeable. Beer is also excellent and in happy hour it is frankly incredible value.

The food is getting better not in terms of quality, which is impeccable, but in terms of offering the food a pub should offer. Maybe it's just me but at a pub, I just want a meal. BRLO being BRLO I naturally would expect to pay a premium and the quality to match that price. But most of the menu is simply too complicated. There is, slowly, more "proper meals", but only a couple.

I would come far more often to eat if I could order a plate of some classic pub grub but well done. Basically the gastropub concept which is what BRLO looks like it wants to be.

However that is my only gripe. Other than the menu, the place is fantastic - i am thankful it exists in my area.

Again, a shout out to the amazing staff, especially some of the wonderful beards from around the world on display.

reviews.author: Jose Hernandez
reviews.text:
Great beer and atmosphere. The IPA (West Coast IPA) and Blurry Vision (Hazy IPA) 🍺 are amongst my favourites from BRLO’s beer offerings.

The place has a very relaxed atmosphere and there’s plenty of comfortable seating, both inside and outside.

The only downside I could find was the music volume being a tad on the high side and leaving my ears ringing due to the bass reverberations.

reviews.author: Ankur Verma
reviews.text: Best place I been to in Berlin so far. We went with a group of friends. Ordered different type of brandy, beers, pizza, pommes. Nice music , nice staff, football game on the big screen. Overall a nice atmosphere. The best part was bring your cards/board game and play. Amazing washroom like a maze 😂

reviews.author: Luca L
reviews.text: Went with some of my mates, and it was really nice. They have a large variety of Alcoholic drinks. Recommend the Burgers also. They have a big outside seating area, and its quiet because it borders a cycling street.

reviews.author: Lorenz Seibl
reviews.text: A fun and charming place. In summer, much space to sit outside - in winter, cozy inside. You can find good food here, a wide range from tap (including Murphy's Stout and Red, plus cider, rarely found from tap) and on top an extraordinary warm welcome from the service.

reviews.author: Binarie
reviews.text:
We were there for St. Patrick’s day and the staff are so lovely, attentive and kind. They were even so kind enough to give out St. Patty’s hats - made my day!
Will definitely be visiting again ☺️

reviews.author: Axel Bagenal
reviews.text: The main barman here is exceptionally good at his job and very friendly! My favourite bar to visit when in Sprengelkiez - would recommend the Murphy’s red ale or the Newcastle Brown

name: Das Lemke - Biergarten, Brauerei, deutsche Küche

reviews.author: Eshaana S Sharma
reviews.text:
a lovely restaurant I’m Berlin for some delicious and authentic food!

We were brought here at the end of our food tour by our guide and it did not disappoint.

The ambience is lovely, and the is both indoor and shaded outdoor seating available. Great place for beer too! Many many varieties.

We ordered a beer flight and cherry spritz, as well as Cherry juicy for non -alcoholic preferences. Lovely drinks!

We ordered a popular dish called tarte flambe , would definitely recommend, it’s think and topped with cheese and meat.

The swarian cheese spatzle was amazing, so cheesy and indulgent.

To top it off, we got the “pork knuckle ”, I haven’t had this delicious meat in a while. The quantity is really large so perfect to share.

Overall a wonderful experience , would come again .

reviews.author: Steven Cheng
reviews.text:
We signed up for a brewery tour as one of the excursions which Viking cruise took us here!

When we arrived at 7:00 PM, it’s almost full house already. So do make reservations if you like to come!

The pork knuckles they served was one of the most tender one we had for my wife and I been in the Germany for over 10 days now!

We drink Pilsner beer and bocks beer, both are pretty good!

Then we have a brewery tour and beer testing which I am not too fond of their dark beer!

I it was a very interesting evening. If I come back to Berlin again I will definitely come here to have a few beer and a meal.

reviews.author: Deniss
reviews.text: Very nice brewery Das Lemke pub. Wide selection of beers on tap. German cuisine. Friendly staff. The terrace is nice.

reviews.author: Lujan Cordaro
reviews.text: We had a great time thanks to our super nice waiter, Ivan. He was super fast, got us food before the kitchen closed and advised us on beers. Food was good but overpriced.

reviews.author: P H (Quicksilver)
reviews.text: Wide range of beers to try - I would recommend the little tasting board, 6 different types of beer, with flavour notes and other info. Nice and chilled vibe

reviews.author: 랄랄라
reviews.text:
I had a great night at this restaurant! 😆 Every staff member was incredibly friendly and kind.

I loved all the drinks. Before we ordered, they explained everything very well, and their suggestions were spot on. Everything tasted amazing.

I highly recommend the "St Jaro, Tschechisches Schwarzbier" black beer for anyone who enjoys sweeter drinks.

The "Franziskaner Hefe Hell" beer was also fantastic—super smooth, almost like yogurt, with a lovely hint of banana smell.

We wanted to try more, but since we'd already had dinner, we decided to get just one dish, the "Konigsberger," which paired perfectly with the beer. 😋 I’m definitely coming back to try more dishes!

We couldn't drink any more after finishing two liters of beer and a lot of food, so we asked for a good shot recommendation.

They suggested the special shot, "Michelada." It was spicy but so delicious… 🥲 If you like spicy drinks, definitely give it a try! 😆

The prices were great, the service was excellent, and both the food and drinks were amazing. You have to visit this place!

reviews.author: Andreea Bodea
reviews.text: Great family run place! Food is super good and generous. The owner was incredibly kind. You feel like in their living room. Had the Schnitzel which was very tasty and a massive portion! Delicious.

reviews.author: Claire
reviews.text:
The best in Berlin!

The food is absolutely incredible, you can get gluten free dishes and the owners are adorable.

And they are Französisch freundlich…Imagine that!!! I told you: best Place in Berlin!

I’ll come again and again.

reviews.author: Rahul R
reviews.text:
Amazing restaurant to try German cuisine! Staff is so welcoming and helpful in recommending the dishes too
The price is pretty good for the quantity
I would love to visit again 😊

reviews.author: Karmo
reviews.text:
Super nice service and good foods. Cozy atmosphere. They introduced us the whole menu since they didn't have one in English.
Cash only.

reviews.author: Karen O.
reviews.text: I really like this place. The vibe is nice, pleasant, with this vintage and casual look. You can have coffee if you want, tea, beer, wine, cocktails, you name it! As for food, I once had a cake/pie and it was good. Service was also nice, I feel they are a bit understaffed sometimes (not a criticism, just an observation), nevertheless, everyone from the staff is nice and efficient. Perfect place to meet a friend, friends, date, or just have a date with yourself.  Google says it accepts cards, but it was cash only last time I was there.

reviews.author: Rose Mc1 Ron
reviews.text: The best place I Found like India home here in Germany. Rich culture through the food. Could've been a wee bit less expensive but for me it's worth evey byte

reviews.author: sskindeep illustration
reviews.text: The place has a nice vibe, staff are always friendly but overloaded, most of the times you have to wait for at least 15min for your drinks to come but sometimes the waiters do reward you with an extra luft shot 🥃

reviews.author: Youju (youju_j)
reviews.text:
Such a lovely cozy place!

I love that cocktails in the pictures with vanilla absolute. So five stars unconditionally!!Lol

(But there is actually a certain bartender in the picture makes really really good cocktails. So If you see the bartender, try a cocktail! You won’t regret. Definitely!:-D )

reviews.author: Amber Inman
reviews.text: Beautiful café&bar with a good range of drinks. We found the majority of staff to be extremely kind and helpful but I must agree with other comments that service is wonky. The atmosphere was great and I’d definitely return for a cocktail when I’m next in Berlin !

reviews.author: C N
reviews.text:
Nice Mikkeller bar as in many other cities in the world. No food though. Still
Good beer on tap. Some seats outside if you like it.

reviews.author: eloisebattey
reviews.text: Brilliant selection of beers (apricot sour was delicious) and a lovey cosy atmosphere inside. Staff were super friendly and welcoming.

reviews.author: Guillem
reviews.text: Very nice selection of beers, we really enjoyed our time there.

reviews.author: Sander Elias
reviews.text:
No food, as it's a beer-house. Good selection. Knowledgeable staff.
Not unimportant very good beer!

reviews.author: Leonardo da Cunha
reviews.text:
Can't go wrong with Mikkeller.
Nice bar in a nice and active area. Great selection of beer and a cozy vibe.
The servers were great each time.

reviews.author: Hel
reviews.text: The owner is the cutest. Absolutely lovely pub.

reviews.author: Jörn Schneider
reviews.text:
Nice, cozy pub.
Very friendly staff. Delicious beer!

reviews.author: Bernd Nowak
reviews.text: I felt very comfortable here. The beer was delicious and I was also able to charge my cell phone. The pub has its own charm. Nothing for yuppies. I received friendly service and would love to come back for a beer.

reviews.author: Andreas Haerer
reviews.text: Super nice pub. Small but cozy. Typical Berlin pub that rarely exists anymore. Not overcrowded like many other places. Very family atmosphere. Will come again. Thank you for the lovely evening.

reviews.author: Alessandro Rosa
reviews.text: We stumbled upon a pub frequented only by locals and builders... Low lights, clouds of smoke (it's a smoking place), and eccentric people... Worth noting is the owner's extremely kindness and the incredibly low beer prices! Stay away if you're into roll-ups and aperitifs after dinner.

reviews.author: Nag
reviews.text: The environment was so cool. I also liked the music. We came across two very cool men too, which was delightful. Suggested for a night out with friends.

reviews.author: Stephen Hardwick
reviews.text: Fully endorse other comments about the rude staff. I wonder if they're ex-border guards from the Berlin Wall?

reviews.author: Henrik Holmberg
reviews.text: A claustrophobic, smokey hellscape straight from the 90s with rude staff, limited selection and high prices. Do yourself a favor and avoid this place.

reviews.author: Louise Uttley
reviews.text: This could be a cracking pub, if it weren't for the unpleasant barmaid. She was just as offhand with my German friends, so at least it seems she dislikes all customers  equally... hospitality seems a strange career choice for her?!

reviews.author: Marie Langenbrinck
reviews.text: honestly one of the worst experiences I have had in a bar. I am German so it's not like we were tourists and the bartender kept yelling at us and talking badly about us because we did not order enough drinks 'in her opinion'. then she proceeded to tell us we would need to leave if we did not order more drinks. very rude and unwelcoming atmosphere, would not recommend going there!!

reviews.author: Josef Vak
reviews.text: Totally recommeded for visit, very friendly guy owns pub fo 37 years, nice beer, nice beer, only cash!

reviews.author: Lars Laser
reviews.text: Perfectly located near Subway Bülowstraße in a boiling neighborhood. I, strolling around by myself, felt very welcomed by locals and tourists alike. Easy to get in touch with folks and catch up some gossip. Most important: Bear and Korn (some kind of German Whisky), they call it "Herrengedeck", was excellent.

reviews.author: Bob Niemand
reviews.text:
Great little dive, friendly, cultured in a seventies kinda way, I’d live here if I could.
Smoking allowed. Hard rock posters , football on tv, cheap and very very cheerful.

reviews.author: Kira
reviews.text: Great place and relaxed atmosphere! The staff is very friendly!

reviews.author: Gottfried Kibelka
reviews.text: A dive but Berliner Kindel is fresh and nicely tapped and a helpful, friendly bar wench that does her best to keep you lubed. Music along the lines of AC/DC.

reviews.author: sbailie2002
reviews.text:
Eke the landlord is a gentleman
Great craic
Guinness is just beautiful
Great pub for watching football and especially Shamrock Rovers

reviews.author: Hans-Eric Usher
reviews.text: Absolute CU Next Tuesday behind the bar. Asked whether the service was like in Ireland (at the bar) or whether we should sit down and get served (like in Germany). Barman told me to f- off........ Nice........ Don't bother coming here. Good Guinness or no......

reviews.author: Nadim
reviews.text: Man working today was very rude! I Asked politely to use the washroom before I ordered and told me rudely “it was for guests only” I hadn’t decided what I wanted to order yet but it was obvious that I was going to order something. That was enough for him to lose my business. Bathrooms are a human right sir.

reviews.author: Mary Filardi
reviews.text:
This small pub is an absolute treasure! The Guinness here is exceptional—smooth and perfectly poured.
The owner is a nice guy, he always welcoming with us and making everyone feel right at home. His friendly demeanor adds a personal touch that you don’t often find.

reviews.author: Ruben Folger
reviews.text: Amazing owner who cares about his regulars and is lovely to talk to. Come early for big games

reviews.author: Erik Møldrup Præcius
reviews.text: Fantastic setting for a family outing. The brewery is located a short distance from the center of Berlin. We had a three-course menu that was beautifully presented. Tasty dishes in fantastic rooms. Friendly staff and the opportunity to do nice activities such as mini bowling. And if you love beer this is the right place to visit.

reviews.author: Deepak Srinivasan
reviews.text:
Very pleasant atmosphere with loads of gaming options. Beer was top notch
The veg burger was too soft and started falling apart.
A good experience on the whole

reviews.author: Arsyatria Rasaki Akbar
reviews.text:
Went here as part of our team event. I am surprised that there is this kind of interesting place in berlin although I have been living in berlin for a long time.

One thing you notice will be how enormous the place is. And you can see a very cool mural on the wall. There are also a lot of arcade games and you can see how children are really enjoying their time.

You will not come here specifically for the food, but the foods are surprisingly really good. The burger is just so perfect. I ordered a chicken burger, and it was fantastic. Crispy and fresh. I tried some of my colleagues' food and it was as amazing as I mine. I would suggest to take the patriot burger, it is just looks better.

You probably come to here for the drinks. ( As you should be ). the drinks are fantastic as well, I am not a drinker and normally can't enjoy alcohol, but I tried a couple of their recommendations, and it was really good.

I bet you would have the same experience as me.

reviews.author: Daniel
reviews.text:
My wife, some friends, and I went here for Wings Wednesday, and we had a fantastic time. Our waiter, Cristobal, was absolutely amazing; one of the best you could ask for. The wings were delicious, even if they weren’t the best in the world. Cristobal checked in on us several times to see if we wanted additional rounds, which we really appreciated. Every round, there have been less wings but still it was more then enough! The Korean wings were definitely the highlight!

As for the beer, we even got to taste a few options before deciding which one to go for, which was a great touch. Overall, it was a fantastic evening with excellent service and plenty of wings. I would definitely do it again someday!

reviews.author: Federico Forestiero
reviews.text:
Horrible experience
- we booked a table for 25 people and we had to wait 30 minutes
- Some of the drinks that we ordered never arrived even though they were marked on our order
- We couldn't pay separate. This means one person had to pay the whole amount with his card...
- atmosphere of a medium pub with all kind of tasteless food

Never ever again

reviews.author: Narmin Karimova
reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of visiting Bar Dell and I must say, it exceeded all of my expectations. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with a warm and inviting atmosphere. The staff was incredibly friendly and attentive, making sure that my friends and I had everything we needed throughout the night.

The drink selection at Bar Dell was impressive, with a wide variety of options to choose from. Whether you're a fan of classic cocktails or prefer something more unique, they have something for everyone. The bartenders were skilled and knowledgeable, able to recommend the perfect drink based on our preferences. Each drink was expertly crafted and beautifully presented, adding to the overall experience.

What truly stood out to me was the exceptional service we received throughout the night. The staff went above and beyond to ensure that we had a memorable experience. They were attentive, friendly, and always made sure that our glasses were never empty. It was clear that they genuinely cared about providing top-notch service to their customers.

Overall, my experience at Bar Dell was nothing short of amazing. From the quality of the drinks to the ambiance and service, everything was top-notch. I highly recommend Bar Dell to anyone looking for a great night out. You won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: kirillstrack
reviews.text: We were out in Berlin with friends and stumbled upon this bar by chance. It must be said that Bar Dell is a very nice place where you can satisfy all tastes. The bartenders are real pros, the cocktail menu is excellent, and everyone will find something they like.

reviews.author: Özge Per
reviews.text: I recommend the Cosmo 30 Style cocktail. I loved it, it's great 😍

reviews.author: Valera Vasylenko
reviews.text:
Nice bar!! came with a group of girls.
the bar bought our hearts with cocktails, and there were also interesting drink options for non-alcoholic friendsthe bartender is very nice! service

reviews.author: Igor Fedotov
reviews.text:
really good cocktails 10/10 ❤️❤️❤️
also the place is not crowded, so u can easily find a table even in the rush hour

reviews.author: Belinda Basson
reviews.text: Wonderful service from the two owners who have been running this place for 30 years!  They are welcoming and friendly with the most amazing cocktails, each one prepared fresh and presented with attention to detail.  We will be back!

reviews.author: Madame Caramel
reviews.text: The place is absolutely incredible, offering delightful cocktails, wines, and beers served by two extraordinary individuals who are brimming with enthusiasm and expertise. I had the pleasure of spending a few hours each day at this marvelous establishment. I sincerely appreciate the exceptional service and kindness you provided. Mwaah

reviews.author: Miryam H
reviews.text: Delicious cocktails made with fresh fruit and garnished with fresh berries and other natural ingredients. The bartenders share excellent recommendations and even suggest cocktails tailored to your specific preferences. The atmosphere is phenomenal with excellent, fun music, comfortable seating, and an overall open and welcoming atmosphere. It’s our new favorite spot! Pictured is a cocktail with rosé, gin, and berries… lecker!

reviews.author: Burcu Arslan
reviews.text: You can feel and taste the passion they are putting in their drinks! Everything we had were top notch!

reviews.author: Luis Guillermo Castro
reviews.text: Best place, thank you Girls, you are the best, BEST cocktails ever👌🏻👍🏻

reviews.author: Hakan Köse
reviews.text:
One of the interesting bars in Prenzlauer Berg. The entrance was kind of very unusual compared to other cocktail bars that I went to so far and it took me some time to find the bell. The atmosphere of the inside is typically dim but feels very extraordinary at the same time. Service is fast and friendly. The place is not so loud even though people are chatting here and there. So that makes it here a good candidate for a conversational date. The prices are fair enough for a cocktail bar. The only tiny piece of negative feedback I could put in is that they are missing details in their menu. I think the base alcohol of the cocktails at least should be written. Maybe they assume that a cocktail fan should know them already but that is not be the case most of time.

You should drop by here for sure.

reviews.author: Anthony Marohn
reviews.text: Drinks were interesting and unique. Bartender was very helpful and explained all the ingredients in the cocktails very thoroughly. Apparently this place says cash only but it’s not. The thing I didn’t like about this place was the vibe. I felt like I was in a smoking lounge. Music was weird too. If you like high end cocktails this would be the place for you but I don’t need to go back.

reviews.author: Susann Pyrek
reviews.text: Unique atmosphere. This place really takes you away. Drink are characteristic. Unfortunately some noise from the ventilation covers up the music and the smoke smell is still something you will take home.

reviews.author: Victor C
reviews.text: This place is awesome! The cocktails are all carefully crafted with ingredients sourced from highly specialized craftsmen.  Tell them what you like and let them make you something.  Ask them about the ingredients and they'll tell you an amazing story.  Quite an experience and highly recommended!!

reviews.author: Andrea Puiatti
reviews.text: BK mixes some of the best drinks in town. Pick one, or just ask for a suggestion based on your preference. And with the next one let them surprise you with something that we’ll connects wit the previous drink. I went for a Penicillin followed by a Muenster Maid. Great flavors and perfectly balanced. Don’t be surprised if prices are higher - quality deserves to be paid.

reviews.author: Himeko Urushima
reviews.text: I love the place. The people working there are kind and attentive. They care what the customers think about the food and the atmosphere is overall calm. I'm recommending it.

reviews.author: Erin Mason
reviews.text: Had lunch here with my partner, was a lovely place with even lovelier staff!! Definitely recommend going if you visit Berlin☺️

reviews.author: Anna Zbrożyna
reviews.text: The drinks were great, with a proper amount of alcohol. The waiter remembered our orders, and by the second day, we could just say 'the usual'—such a nice touch!

reviews.author: Craig Robinson
reviews.text: Need a cocktail?  Get yourself here!  A cocktail thicker than your wallet on payday, means there's something for everyone!  Within minutes, I was a cheeky couple of fizzes down, and, I learnt that 'StudentFood' is a bowl of mixed nuts!  Sweet times!!

reviews.author: Jasmijn Esmee
reviews.text: We ordered delicious mocktails (they call it cocktail without alcohol on the menu). We had 'Florida' (bright red one) which was filled with strong, sweet sirups and we had 'Coconut kiss' (pink one) which was less sweet and more buttery. It's not cheap but nonetheless worth it!

reviews.author: Manuel
reviews.text:
This was my second visit, and I have to say, the cocktails didn’t really impress me. They reminded me of my university days, when quantity was above quality (they do a 2-for-1 deal until 8 PM). The floor is completely covered in sand to give off a beach vibe, which mostly just means dirty shoes and not much concern for cleanliness.

On my first visit, we ended up leaving after waiting 20 minutes without anyone coming to take our order.

reviews.author: Shawn Behrendt
reviews.text: Had a great night until they did not take care of their drunk customers. We‘ve been disturbed by a drunk customer which spilled our drinks. Service did not throw the drunk customer out. After we‘ve asked, whats gonna happen to our drinks they said: „you shouldn’t be so stressful, stuff like that happens“. We are not going to come back.

reviews.author: Persian GameR (MA1)
reviews.text: What a nice bar the environment is really nice and has a beach vibe, for example, the floor is covered with sand and the personnel is friendly a quick tip: go in the Happy hours and you will get two for every drink you order.

reviews.author: Jen B.
reviews.text: Really really lovely staff, walking the extra mile for their customers. The waiter made burgers for us even though he was the only member of staff and the kitchen was not open yet. Nice burger and cocktails and lovely interiors

reviews.author: Fried chicken Hot cheetos
reviews.text:
Happy our is crazy good
I can only recommend
Nice old banger music and nice staff
Good vibes and sand on the floor so cute
Hehe love it
Nacho is also good
Cocktail is mid but i still like it cuz it’s so cheap

reviews.author: Selena Kemp
reviews.text:
This was one of my all-time favorite bar experiences, ever. The bartender Ruben was very knowledgeable and personable, and the drinks were crafted with such deftness and attention to detail, they truly elevate every ingredient into something far more magnificent than the sum of their parts. He was even kind enough to make half portions so my spouse and I could try many drinks without overdoing it.

The bar atmosphere is beautiful, especially when the sunset is shining through the glass bottles in the window. It feels intimate without being claustrophobic. Even the restrooms were lovely, with every amenity you could want.

I cannot recommend this place enough. This will be the very first place i come back to on my next trip to Berlin.

reviews.author: MCM
reviews.text: Great, innovative drinks with a weekly menu focusing on seasonal ingredients. Amazing staff, unexpected combinations and surprisingly innovative approach to alcohol pairings. Co a and warm atmosphere, highly recommend.

reviews.author: Keira Herr
reviews.text:
My oh my, this bar really stood out in my recent trip to Berlin. The menu is based on seasonal produce, and changes every couple of weeks. All the ingredients are infused in house and they deliberately made all the drinks a one note color such that you can really be surprised by the umami bomb when you taste it. My personal favorites were the tomato and shitake, so delicious, well balanced and tastes like no other cocktail I havr had before, fragrant and savory notes at play with one another.

Will definitely come back.

reviews.author: Chihana Schiffer
reviews.text: Highly recommend this cocktail bar if you’re into artisan cocktails. Host was very friendly and gave us great other bar recommendations.

reviews.author: Aran Hevia
reviews.text: For me the best cocktail bar in Berlin and too class worldwide too. Went there with friends from the industry and they were also impressed. Pause for a moment to admire the creativity behind a weekly seasonal locally sourced menu, the mastery of impeccable execution, and all with the nicest friendliest service. We had detailed questions and we got professional answers, tried their distilled bases, had a laugh. Adulting should always be this much fun!

reviews.author: Matei Stancu
reviews.text: Good atmosphere and a nice place to play some pool and unwind

reviews.author: Ricky “Ricardo Johnboy” Ali
reviews.text: Very nice customer service.

reviews.author: Hassan Abbasi
reviews.text: Nice and friendly staff, peaceful ambient, clean place and reasonable price :)

reviews.author: Alexandre Landrieu
reviews.text: Very good cocktails and very friendly staff

reviews.author: Alexandre Lever
reviews.text: had a great time, waiter is super nice :)

reviews.author: Egor Tsalkovich
reviews.text:
Stopped by here during a bar crawl with my friend. Cocktails are interesting in terms of ingredient combinations. The kimchi cocktails really stand out - unique experience that's not for everyone, but I'd recommend trying them.
They also make standard cocktails well - made an Aviation for my friend that was perfectly balanced and tasty.
Quiet, relaxed atmosphere when it's not crowded. Very private with dim lighting, which lets you focus on the cocktails and that's a good thing.
Will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Suhas Thakral
reviews.text: This is a one of a kind cocktail bar with a unique menu. It is a fusion of Asian flavours inside cocktails and they have really produced great results from it. However due to this it also becomes a bit of a novelty! Next time I know someone who likes Asian flavours I’m definitely getting them here! I can recommend the Ube sour!

reviews.author: Johannes E
reviews.text:
Cool cocktail bar with a experimental cocktail Menu.
Kimchi juice and sour dough Sirup are some of the fascinating ingredients to mix delicious cocktail.
Service is super friendly, no reservations - walk in only is highly appreciated but the taste did not convince us till five stars.
It sounds a bit better on the menu than the taste is.

reviews.author: Tom C
reviews.text: Really cool bar, nice ambience and friendly staff. Very unique and interesting cocktails, we went on a day when a new menu was introduced. Very much enjoyed the mallow.

reviews.author: Rogelio Vergara
reviews.text: Excellent bar. They have amazing drinks and definitely worth a stop. Tried almost every drink on their menu and didn't find a single one that I didn't like. The decor and general atmosphere of the place was also great. Can't wait to go back and have some more drinks.

reviews.author: J Kendrick
reviews.text: Visiting from the US, wanted a great cocktail bar and this place fits the bill. Came twice in a row and the drinks have been consistently good. Great place!

reviews.author: Uwe Hahn
reviews.text:
Very competent and friendly service in a bar with very nice interior (just redone) and a suitable bar menu - all usual suspects, some with a special Galander twist. They definitely know, what they are doing!
Before choosing You're welcomed with water and a small snack (popcorn this time).
Music is very nice as well delivered by good speakers set to the perfect volume (not disturbing).
Perfect place to hang out or wind down as two or a group.
Highly Recommended

reviews.author: Manling XUE
reviews.text: I will come back next time! Very professional service and cocktails. I am happy that my random choice is right. I arrived very early and not too many people.

reviews.author: Alessandro Joseph Messuti
reviews.text:
The staff is very kind and welcoming.
I find the retro style of the place truly charming. The two girls who served me, Linda and Shakira, were extremely nice, and the bartender was a real gentleman—very skilled at making cocktails; he really knows what he’s doing.
Fair prices! One of my favorite spots in Berlin for my Friday after-work margarita.

reviews.author: Tobias Rud
reviews.text: Can certainly recommend this place for a nice cocktail in Kreuzberg - professional and friendly bartender and delicious cocktails. Can recommend the Kyoto Dream and Golden Cadillac.

reviews.author: Reuben Neeladoo
reviews.text:
Visited Bar Immertreu last night and had one of the worst service experiences I've encountered in Berlin. The bartender was unwelcoming and rude from the moment we walked in. After being seated, we waited 20 minutes just to receive a menu and place an order. Then we waited another 20 minutes only for the bartender to return and tell us he'd completely forgotten about our order. To make matters worse, the bartender appeared to be intoxicated while on duty. At that point, we'd had enough and decided to leave.

The complete lack of basic hospitality and professionalism was shocking. Would not recommend this place to anyone looking for a pleasant evening out. There are plenty of other bars in Berlin where customers are actually valued and staff maintain professional standards.

reviews.author: Caitlin R
reviews.text:
Was visiting Berlin and came across this bar on google. Quick note (bring cash to pay bill) there is an atm nearby.

You have to ring the doorbell to get into the bar. Once we were in we sat at the bar. (Which was completely empty) the seating section with couches was full. It was a Friday night around midnight.

We ordered drinks from the bartender who at first we couldn’t tell if he was happy to have us there or not. The drinks were absolutely delicious. It was my friends birthday and the bartender ended up warming up to us and we had a great night talking to him.

He made us a few other delicious drinks! But definitely had a great night and loved the vibe inside this bar.

reviews.author: Rogelio Vergara
reviews.text: Pretty good bar. They have good drinks that are a bit pricey. Smoking is allowed inside as well.

reviews.author: Fallon Ginot
reviews.text:
Cocktails are great. Smoking inside is allowed so its ok depending on how crowded it gets.

Service is terrible. Bartender/owner either berates you or simply ignores you. We also noticed some gaslighting on his part to some female customers. Not sure we will come back. There's other bars in the area with equally good cocktails and a much better service.

reviews.author: Martin Nobelen
reviews.text: Great drinks mixed by true professionals who will ignite you with their passion for good taste

reviews.author: Christoffer Ahlstrøm
reviews.text: Just amazing. If you don't find a gin you like here, then you don't like gin. They have "every gin from all corners of the world". Selection is amazing and service is excellent. The bartender will happily help you find your perfect gin, while explaining all about each one. Love this place.

reviews.author: Anita Stojanovska
reviews.text: This bar offers an impressive selection of over 400 gins from around the world, along with a variety of other beverages. The bartender is highly knowledgeable and takes the time to explain the drinks and cocktails in detail. We tried several cocktails, each featuring different gins and unique flavors, all beautifully crafted and presented with precision. As a nice touch, we were also offered complimentary peanuts and limoncello. The atmosphere is calm and inviting, making it a great spot for anyone who appreciates well-made cocktails. I highly recommend it!

reviews.author: B - goalkeeper
reviews.text: Lovely bar, cool atmosphere, very kind service and friendly people all around. We will definitely come back an can highly recommend this bar to all Gin Lovers. Cheers!

reviews.author: Florence Mutinta
reviews.text:
Flo was amazing, he took his time and explained the top 5 Gin of his choice. The basil cocktail was 5*, thanks :)

Will definitely be back. Had a great time 🤗. Memories were made

reviews.author: Chris C
reviews.text: Huge gin selection with over 150 options. They have a cocktail menu to match along with gin flights if you want to branch out. A nice selection of snacks too. I would recommend the popcorn. Some very interesting flavours and a light accompaniment for a few drinks. The drinks can be pricy, but the atmosphere and quality justifies the price in my mind. The bartender was very accommodating and provided great suggestions for us. Check it out for a nice night out in a relaxed welcoming atmosphere.

reviews.author: Lirim Scholz
reviews.text: Best cocktails from all over Berlin, I think even from all over Germany, from today on every day I think

reviews.author: Aziiz Ghalleb
reviews.text: Best cocktails in Berlin

reviews.author: Marijn van der Staaij
reviews.text: Great cocktail bar! It's a very nice place to visit! Most importantly, they serve good cocktails. Creative and a frequently changing menu. Additionally, the staff is great and helpful. Also, the interior is really cool and comfortable. Definitely recommend this place

reviews.author: Verena Meßner
reviews.text:
Lovely staff and great atmosphere.
Three different cocktails every night. Every single one lovely. You can smoke indoors.

reviews.author: 성지유
reviews.text: Had a great time here. If I stayed longer in berlin, I'd have definitely come back here. Thanks a lot

reviews.author: Jana Par
reviews.text:
First, I have to say that the atmosphere of the bar is lovely. The low lighting and cozy decor make for a very intimate and comfortable setting, perfect for a night out with friends or a date.

The cocktails were the star of the show, as they should be in any good cocktail bar. ☺️

While the staff were all very friendly and knowledgeable about the drinks, it seemed like they were a bit overwhelmed with explaining the cocktails and their ingredients to every customer. As a result, the service was quite slow. This was particularly frustrating given that the bar was not very busy when we visited.

Overall, I would still recommend it to anyone looking for a unique and interesting night out. But be prepared for slower service and potentially longer wait times.

reviews.author: Jarrod Miller
reviews.text:
I enjoyed the experience here, just sitting at the bar and listening to the cocktails on offer.

They are making these up daily and you can see when they are being made that the measures need a little tweak from time to time to get the taste just right.

Bar is smallish with some kitsch chairs to sit in while soaking up the ambience. Put it on the list if you are in the neighborhood.

reviews.author: Gee Meyer
reviews.text:
Very cute and vibey bar with attentive staff who know’s how to make a mean espresso martini. Prices for drinks were fair.

The (background) music was really good as well! And there are snacks. We love snacks, right?! 😉👌🏼😊

reviews.author: Mika
reviews.text: Stylish and still relaxed place. The stuff is super friendly and knows how to make real good drinks. Prices are more than decent. Definitely worth visiting.

reviews.author: Simone Thomas
reviews.text: We spend NYE here and it was lovely. Delicious cocktails and a really nice and relaxed vibe to see the new year in

reviews.author: Scarlet
reviews.text:
Had a couple of cocktails here before dinner.
Very cool, cosy yet romantic bar and of course amazing tasting cocktails
Would recommend

reviews.author: Ciarán Handley
reviews.text: Great spot for a late evening cocktail. Friendly staff and a great selection. The ambiance could be improved a little to make it more cosy, but this is a minor gripe!

reviews.author: Nai-An Chen
reviews.text:
Artistic, elegant but grounded.

The space, the scent of space, the decoration… it‘s really perfect.
I felt comfortable and welcome like walking in a friends home, but the cocktails were exquisite and fun. And the price was totally fair.
Absolutely an unforgettable journey.
If I would come to Berlin again, this bar is the reason.

reviews.author: Veronica Cragnolini
reviews.text: The menu is a work of art, so are the drinks presented gracefully with fantastic, and suddenly unique and unexpected flavors. Whimsical interiors, talented and friendly personal. Prices absolutely reasonable. Hope to be back soon and absolutely recommended!

reviews.author: Fah K.
reviews.text:
Really charming little cocktail bar with a beautifully done 40s/50s vibe. It’s cozy and stylish without feeling cramped, and we had no trouble getting a seat on a Thursday evening. The staff were absolutely lovely — friendly, attentive, and welcoming from the start. We were immediately brought water (as every good cocktail bar should!) and even got some complimentary olives and mixed nuts, which was a very nice touch.

The presentation of the drinks is next level — creative, playful, and full of thoughtful details that really elevate the whole experience. My girlfriend’s drink (“Breakfast at Tiffany’s”) was served in a jewelry box, and mine (“Rescue Rangers”) arrived inside a giant sculpted hazelnut, with the top half acting as a lid and a tiny squirrel perched on top. It was whimsical and impressive — definitely the kind of thing you remember and tell people about.

That’s why it was a bit confusing when the drinks themselves didn’t quite live up to the promise. My cocktail, with aged rum, several nut liqueurs, and fresh citrus, somehow ended up tasting like a watered-down Mai Tai — and not because it was trying to be one. But to be fair, the flavor profile wasn’t entirely off-base: rum, citrus, and nut elements do overlap with a classic Mai Tai, so the resemblance isn’t totally surprising. Still, in a bar with this much creativity, I was expecting something much more distinctive and layered.

The “Breakfast at Tiffany’s” had a similar issue. On paper, it sounded exceptional — Haku vodka, roasted macadamia, arabica beans, homemade crème de cacao — but in the end, it tasted more or less like a diluted Espresso Martini. We doubt that was the intention, and we genuinely couldn’t figure out how so many interesting ingredients ended up producing such a basic (and flat) flavor profile. Especially when you consider that something like arabica beans should complement, not completely dominate, the drink.

That said, everything else about the experience — from the decor to the staff to the atmosphere — was truly great. The bar clearly cares about crafting something special, and it shows in every detail. We just wish the drinks had matched the same level of care in their flavor. If they had, we probably would have stayed for multiple rounds. As it was, we stopped after one, but would still consider coming back — maybe to try different drinks and see if it was just an off night.

reviews.author: Pan Da
reviews.text:
Love love love this place! Definitely try it if you're looking for that special spot. The cocktails are experiences. You can see, feel, smell and TASTE the creativity and care that goes into each cocktail. Really good ingredients, too.

Reservations recommended.

reviews.author: Uwe Hahn
reviews.text:
Timber Doodle is an exceptional place. Their signature is telling a story with each cocktail.
Have a look at this artistic menu:
https://www.yumpu.com/en/document/read/65644169/timber-doodle-barkarte-2023
But when it comes to the presentation, that is something else. I have never seen anything like it. Each drink is presented in its own special way from glass to decoration and  special stuff that comes with it (eg unusual popcorn, nuts, olives, chocolate with worms - very nice; comes without as well, in case Your not too keen on them).
Most drinks have a non alcoholic counterpart as well.
To top it all of, the atmosphere is just gorgeous. Splendid decor down to the nicely hidden away restroom.
I would like to call it "my cosy living room"!

reviews.author: Sofía Gómez
reviews.text: Great cocktails. They have a big selection and you can also play with a dice to get random ingredients into your drink. The barman was very friendly. The music is a bit low, though.

reviews.author: Paulina Roczniak
reviews.text: We did a cocktail workshop with Olli, it was really good. We learned a lot and had fun along the way

reviews.author: Jessica Gentles
reviews.text: The drinks are amazing! They're a little more expensive than other places in the area but that shows in the size of the drinks and how much alcohol is in them. We had 4 drinks between the 2 of us and they were all amazing. The drink choice is the best I've seen at a bar and the staff are wonderful

reviews.author: D Campman
reviews.text: Great cocktail bar which has been around for years. Huge choice, well made and great tastes. Also the alc. free ones are yum. Quite dark but that is typical Berlin. Fast service and nice staff. Pic is of a yummo White Russian, glowing in the dark! Watermelon Man and Planters Punch also excellent, strong and fruity. Def. recommended.

reviews.author: Mara 01
reviews.text: The best bar in Berlin!!! Coctails Are amazing, the staff is super friendly and the local is beautiful. I recommend for everyone that is looking for extreme good Coctails and a nice atmosphere 11/10 ;)

reviews.author: Maximilian Maqsood
reviews.text: Very good bar. The shisha there is an absolute dream, I and my companion really liked the special. The bar has 3 tables with small games that are a great way to pass the time.

reviews.author: Victor Grosu
reviews.text: Great shisha bar! Great selection, relaxed atmosphere, and friendly staff. Always happy to come back!

reviews.author: Sven Töpfer
reviews.text:
All in all a very nice evening, I felt very comfortable as a customer.

The waitress was there every 20 minutes and asked if everything was OK, and we were able to have nice conversations with the employees.

reviews.author: Laura Siernicki
reviews.text:
Top shisha bar – highly recommended

The atmosphere here is relaxed and stylish, perfect for a cozy evening. The shisha pipes are of the highest quality, with intense flavors and a smooth smoke. I was particularly impressed by the friendly and attentive service – we were thoroughly pampered!

The drinks menu also offers something for every taste. If you're looking for a great shisha experience in a pleasant atmosphere, this is the place to be. I'll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Mr guliav
reviews.text:
Very good shisha bar. The staff are polite and courteous. The price-performance ratio is perfect. I would visit the ShishaBar again at any time to smoke a pipe and drink a cool drink in a pleasant atmosphere.
Thank you for these wonderful hours in Berlin
LG

name: House of Gin - STAY GOLD!
address: Hotel Palace, Budapester Str. 45, 10787 Berlin, Germany

reviews.author: A B
reviews.text:
It’s not the first time I’m visiting this place.
I love gin and I enjoyed being immersed in a gin experience.

I was unsure what to order, I was very well informed and I had very good cocktails with gin! I’d like to visit again, I strongly encourage everyone to do so

reviews.author: Michal Sokolowski
reviews.text:
Fantastic Experience for Gin Lovers & more!

House of Gin is one of Berlin’s true hidden gems. With a stylish interior and a relaxed, intimate vibe, it’s the perfect spot for a special evening. The gin selection is outstanding—over 150 varieties from around the world—and the bartenders are both friendly and incredibly knowledgeable. They’re happy to guide you to something unique based on your preferences. The cocktails are beautifully crafted, balanced, and full of character. Whether you’re a gin expert or just curious, this place delivers an unforgettable experience. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Anouska Bertram
reviews.text: This gin bar is in our hotel. The cocktails are super tasty but on both occasions we went here the bar was virtually empty. On the first evening we sat outside, the bar is on a busy road so the vibe wasn’t great. The people next to us were smoking cigars which stunk so we left quickly. When we ordered one glass of tap water with our cocktails the barman condescendingly replied “we try and sell our bottles of water here” which was really annoying as I obviously didn’t want a bottle of water and I could have just walked back into the lobby and got a glass of water as the staff are super friendly in there and only too happy to be helpful. The barman could do with some customer service training in my opinion. Cocktails tasty though.

reviews.author: Sienna Hill-lamey
reviews.text: Upon arrival we were greeted to our seat with trendy and aesthetic decor. Me and my partner ordered the crystal mojito and came at no hesitation. We were given complimentary nuts that complimented the drink very well. There is a wide selection of carefully crafted cocktails that include gin and other spirits. Only criticism would be that the prices are a little more expensive than we’ve been to, however worth the extra penny!

reviews.author: Khai Nguyen
reviews.text: Great drinks and great DJ music! We visited this venue on a Saturday night. I'm not suprised how busy it was. This bar is just amazing. The staff is very attentive and professional. I highly recommend this bar to anyone looking for a moody and chic place. Of course, according to the name you would only expect gin & tonics, but they can serve any drinks your heart desires, carefully crafted by talented mixologists. The Purple Monarch is a must-try!! I'll definitely come back - many times.

reviews.author: Sergii Starostin
reviews.text: Very cozy and hidden bar you need to go through another bar! I like how they redefined the menu

reviews.author: T. S.
reviews.text: The best cocktails in Berlin! Great atmosphere. Jannick celebrates the preparation, and the results are delicious.

reviews.author: benjamin braun
reviews.text:
Great place
Speakeasy style
Great working crew
Well balanced and delicious cocktails!
Try number three!

Cheers

reviews.author: Yuval Sarel
reviews.text:
Best. Cocktail bar. Ever.
We sat at the bar and got amazing, professional and kind service. The drinks were incredible - tasty, balanced, interesting and beautiful.
Jeff explained everything to us and nailed the balance between hosting and giving us our place to have our conversation.
The space is also super cozy and intimate.
This is how a cocktail bar should look like.

reviews.author: Schiatta Muorto
reviews.text: Entrance is from another bar, they don’t let you enter directly so you drink for a while in the other bar. We sat around 1.30-2 hours in the entrance bar and then we were able to get in. The cocktails weren’t very impressive.

reviews.author: Derya T
reviews.text:
Speakeasy vibe! The cocktails were perfect! The bartender even customized it based on our preferences.

One thing to note : Make sure you get some cash before you get there , as it is cash only

reviews.author: George Lagoudakis
reviews.text:
A hidden gem for true cocktail lovers.

Tucked away behind an unmarked door, Buck & Breck is everything a great bar should be — intimate, refined, and effortlessly cool. The bar itself is beautifully designed, drawing you into a space where every detail feels intentional.

Drinks are expertly crafted, with a strong focus on balance, technique, and originality. The atmosphere is laid-back yet sophisticated, with music that complements the vibe without overpowering it.

A must for cocktail aficionados visiting Berlin — this is where the city’s true bar culture shines.

reviews.author: James Moreno
reviews.text:
DOES NOT ACCEPT CARD!
Last night in Berlin and felt like I needed to punctuate that since every other place during my 3 day accepted card.

Drinks were good and atmosphere was chill. I’m
not a smoker and there was a lot of smoking here, but that seems to be more of the culture here in Berlin vs Texas so not that big of a deal to me.

As we were closing out I placed my card on the handwritten ticket only to be told that they only accept cash. I’m obviously a foreigner so a heads up would have been nice. Maybe it was placed on the door/entrance and I missed it?

Anyways, my partner left the bar to look for an ATM (one of the staff directed him toward one) while I'm waiting at the bar. Lesson learned I guess.

Edit: the conversion rate was stupid and it turns out it was posted in small print, by the door to the left. I obviously didn’t pay much attention to the pictures on the door as well. You would think this caliber of a bar would take card.

reviews.author: Thanida Thongbor
reviews.text: Love this indie bar so much. Try the grapefruit bitter for start, then twisted manhattan (maraschino), then the Don shadow (kinda like oldfashion) soooo good ❤️ anyway drinks name might be incorrect, didn't take the photo of the menu and a bit drunk. But yeah order something like this, the bartender probably gets the idea 😁

reviews.author: Etienne C
reviews.text:
Usually I am very chill and also do not mind if the prices are a bit more expensive (which they definitely are at this place!), but in return I at least expect some kindness and quality service. Definitely not the case. Super rude like I’ve never experienced before.
Drinks were ok, but not worth the price.
Never again.

reviews.author: Fran Bozdech
reviews.text: Very cosy atmosphere, nice music, ambient, and some tasty cocktails with prices from 10-15 eur !

reviews.author: Luca Rider6n
reviews.text:
Cool atmosphere and a friendly barman.
We were not satisfied with the cocktails.
We took a Margarita and a Negroni, and the taste of both was not as it should be.
Probably not a good quality tequila, for the margarita.. and not correct doses for the Negroni.
The bar was also pretty smokey.

reviews.author: Tommy Zěitgeist
reviews.text: Had such a great random time here. More East Berlin type of bar. Can smoke inside. Meet random people. Cocktails were mostly ok, but I'm not really a cocktail guy. The mood is 💯💯💯.

reviews.author: Danielle D'Ambrosio
reviews.text: Love the coziness of this bar. Lovely customers and top customer service!

reviews.author: Kieran Anand
reviews.text: Great vibe and value for drinks! The bar has a super cool ambiance and the bartender was so sweet!

reviews.author: Daniel Rodriguez
reviews.text: This is a great venue for foreigners visiting and mingle with locals; always a great time at this place, plus great service and friendly staff; which speak English and other languages. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Clemens Nickel
reviews.text: Cool Bar, nice drinks. Sarah & Ufuk are awesome barkeepers.

reviews.author: Fariba Fathi
reviews.text: Good service & friendly staffs. Tasty cocktail 👌

reviews.author: Maria Paula Barragan Mendez
reviews.text: Nice environment, drinks and place. 🥰🫶🏼

reviews.author: Dzmitry Hramyka
reviews.text: Cool bar, good beer

reviews.author: Gavin Carmichael
reviews.text: We didn't eat here but stopped for a cocktail. I love a martini, and this was my first vesper martini. It was fabulous. Well presented, stylishly served and the two guys we spoke with couldn't have been more accommodating. I can't wait to go back.

reviews.author: Mark Beyer
reviews.text: “This is one of those rare gems you only find in Berlin—a small bar serving outstanding drinks in the same location for nearly 50 years.”

reviews.author: Laura Mayo
reviews.text: The premise is great and it does feel like stepping back in time, imagine that alcohol was illegal and you stepped into a smoky back room for great drinks. The drinks were fantastic but if, like myself and my husband, you are a non smoker, this may not be the bar for you. The space is small and intimate so when other patrons light up and the staff sell cigars to the rest, the room quickly becomes unbearable. Also note if you want a Zombie, order this first. We had 2 drinks then they refused to serve this drink because it was so strong. I would go back for the drinks but not for the red smoky eyes I’ve had for the remainder of my trip.

reviews.author: Andrei
reviews.text:
Very tasty rum based cocktails. Very big choice of tasty rum. Friendly staff. For non smokers may be not convenient because it is smoking place. No separate table to reserve. The only table they have you will share with others.
Overall experience is very good!

reviews.author: Brian Thivierge
reviews.text: If you are bothered by smoking indoors this is not the bar for your. The staff and patrons were all smoking in about 30 sq m. The smoke was overwhelming. Beyond that, this is a hidden gem. One of the oldest bars in Berlin, amazing staff, good drinks, so much to love but I coughed the entire way home.

reviews.author: Kira Svane Kristensen
reviews.text:
This was great! We went to get some drinks and got some fastastic ones here! You can select your preferred style from their menu card, and then the bartender will try to match to to your flavor profile - and boy did he! It was exactly what I was looking for!
The atmosphere is great and the service is without faults as well!
We tried their tartar as well, and it was delicious.
Really great place, would definitely come back!

reviews.author: Коваль Віра
reviews.text: The sushi was really good. As for oysters, you can try much better ones at Markethalle Neun. The cocktails were disappointing. I asked for a mezcal sour and got an absolutely bland cocktail with a bunch of spicy debris that made it difficult to drink… As a bar, I definitely wouldn’t recommend it.

reviews.author: Anastasiya K
reviews.text: Thank you for the best martini cocktail I’ve ever had. Sophisticated place that offers not just drinks but an entire hospitable experience. We visited on Saturday night so it was quite busy and it reflected on the mixologists: they were always fast and busy, it made me feel somewhat stressed. The music felt a bit cheap for such an elegant place. Nevertheless I’d definitely come again!

reviews.author: Kulsum Altaf Husain
reviews.text: Such a beautiful experience! Absolutely love the vibe of this place . The food and the drinks are so good!!

reviews.author: Antonia Tasina Boehm- Westberg
reviews.text: Amazing, highly recommend ! Much more cosy than the Bellboy Bar and has an incredible vibe: incredible attention to detail, so much hospitality and lovely interactions with so much privacy for a wonderful evening. Especially our barkeeper (who has only been here a week!) has made this evening so memorable, thank you

reviews.author: Cristina Abril
reviews.text:
We have been coming here for years and to this day our favorite cocktail place.

They change the signature cocktail menu from time to time and it is nice to try new combinations.

Even now that we live further we keep coming by.

Service excellent, they accept card.

reviews.author: Charise Longsworth
reviews.text: Non-smoking bar, delightful atmosphere and amazing cocktails! The menu seems small but talk to the bartenders and they’ll recommend and make you a delicious tailored drink - the service is super friendly and they take all cards, would definitely recommend

reviews.author: Tobias Rud
reviews.text: Very nice spot to get a proper cocktail. Good music choices and volume, staff was friendly and helpful. Excellent cocktails.

reviews.author: HY
reviews.text:
Amazing cocktails, lovely service and very knowledgeable bar tender. The complimentary and super tasty popcorn is the cherry on top. So happy about such a bar in my neighborhood. Will definitely come more often from now on.

Cheers!

reviews.author: Matthias Schmidt
reviews.text: Excellent drink spot with a small selection of japanese whiskeys and a lovely service attitude..don't expect to look into their menu, better know what your fav cocktail is. The red lights make a nice ambience for both lovers and good old friends talking about good old times.

reviews.author: Nele Möller
reviews.text: Finally, a company that takes even smaller orders seriously. We weren't put off, but were taken care of right away.

reviews.author: Constantin Simon
reviews.text: The web design changes were not only beautiful but also functional – customers stay on the site longer.

reviews.author: Madita Groß
reviews.text: The Kununu advertising really helped us. Suddenly, we started receiving applications from exactly the people we were looking for.

reviews.author: Justin Lauer
reviews.text: Top-notch advice, quick implementation, and very friendly communication. You feel well looked after.

reviews.author: Fabian Dorn
reviews.text: We were able to gain new customers through targeted review campaigns – and this was noticeable within just a few weeks.

reviews.author: Jitka Staworowska
reviews.text:
Wide selection of great wines and super service!
We had some really tasty food too… amazing focaccia, charcuterie board and homemade whipped butter.
Definitely a great place to have in the neighborhood.

reviews.author: Laura
reviews.text: Such a great wine selection, a lovely and well thought out interior and an impeccable service! I can highly recommend this place as it brings an inviting atmosphere to the area without trying too hard.

reviews.author: Irena Bojarovska
reviews.text:
excellent wine and food, wonderful service - something so hard to find in Berlin. a real gem in our neighbourhood

great selection of alchocol free wines as well

the panna cotta was so lovely, too - looking forward to coming back and trying the tiramisu as well :)

reviews.author: Maria Roldan
reviews.text:
Amazing small place with a super nice owner Salvatore.
The food will transport you directly to Italy (I almost cried when I tried the panacota) and the wine offer is big and great
Even if you do not know about wines, just ask Salvatore and enjoy the experience

reviews.author: Tina P
reviews.text: Beautiful small, cozy kiez wine bar! The service was exceptional, friendly, helpful and the guy who served us definitely knew everything about the wine. We also tried the margarita sbagliata which was delicious! Will definitely make it our new spot!!

name: Blanc de Fuck - NATURAL WINE BAR

reviews.author: Bill Bolloten
reviews.text: Visiting from Spain, this was one of my must visit places in Berlin. A mecca for lovers of minimum intervention wines from small producers. There is a great selection by the glass, and a truly wonderful main wine list, with all the wines carefully described. Great atmosphere and lovely people.

reviews.author: Natalia Zych
reviews.text:
Last Saturday, I had the opportunity to visit this place during a short stay in Berlin. I must admit, my expectations were very high, and I traveled across the entire city just to get there.

I can confidently say that this visit was the best decision of my entire trip! The selection of natural wines is on an incredible level, with a menu featuring the best and most renowned producers from around the world.

The venue itself is truly unique, with a very pleasant atmosphere and a beautiful interior adorned with paintings and graphics inspired by winemakers and their labels—it makes you never want to leave.

However, the most wonderful part of the visit was the service, which was so fantastic that I’m at a loss for words. From the moment we walked in, Jamily was absolutely delightful—she gave us excellent recommendations and shared many fascinating insights. A huge thank you to her, as she is the main reason I will never forget this experience!

reviews.author: Alex Stanculescu
reviews.text: Amazing bar for all natural wine lovers! If you enjoy tropical, fruity wine we definitely recommend the G&M and Non Grata. Great atmosphere, tasty bites and nice ambient. Nice decor as well. Fingers crossed the bar will stay open forever, it’s a gem.

reviews.author: Tony Phan-Nguyen (Cabu)
reviews.text:
Seen them on instagram a lot and walked by on a stroll through the night and decided to check it out.
It was ramped, yet I felt very welcomed. The Team was extremely hospitable and personable. They are super knowledgeable yet they shared the information in such a approachable and digestible way. Not once have I felt like a bother, on my solo trip there.

The Wine selection is out of this world man. I‘ve been into natural wine for a bit but these guys really suprised me with their curation.

Also the top dawg gave me some wine to try, while I was just sipping away. Genuinely took me for a spin, because of how good it was (It was a Vivanterre Melon de Bourgogne, by Patrick Bouju, you HAVE to check it out)

Thanks to the team, good job!

reviews.author: Pom Jacobs
reviews.text: Loved this place! We were in Berlin for a long weekend and came back again the next day because we enjoyed this place so much. The wines and the food are 10/10. The service was also amazing, the people that work there have a really lovely vibe about them. Going to recommend this to anyone going to Berlin!

reviews.author: Isabella Savini Merante
reviews.text: We had an awesome time, the team is lovely and the ambience is great! Calm but fun. Only good wines and snacks too.

reviews.author: FIEL
reviews.text: A very modern, luxurious and cosy wine bar. Had a very great sparkling wine and Vermentino (see pictures), staff was very friendly. Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jaroslav Mida
reviews.text: A cool wine bar in the central Berlin. We enjoyed the ambience, the fingerfood, the wine was alright. Nice outside terrace with heaters as well.

reviews.author: Rhea Che
reviews.text:
After a delightful dinner, my friends and I were feeling a little tipsy and in the mood to keep the good times rolling. That’s when we stumbled upon this charming wine bar. It was buzzing with people, and for a second, we thought about leaving. But then, like a hero in a rom-com, the guy working there—Marco—grabbed my hand and led us through the crowd to an empty table, seemingly waiting just for us. Talk about VIP treatment!

Marco was the true MVP of the night. Not only did he recommend an amazing bottle of wine, but he also made sure the tequila shots kept flowing. It turned out to be one of those nights where the laughter didn’t stop, and the fun was next level.

Pro tip: If you go, make sure to head downstairs toward the bathroom and snap some pics—it’s a vibe down there!

Highly recommend this spot for a night out. Marco and the magical tequila vibes made it unforgettable. 🍷✨

reviews.author: Emma Slater
reviews.text: A perfect spot for a perfect negroni. Service was impeccable and so was the cheese platter

reviews.author: Chulwoo Jung
reviews.text:
One of the best wine bars in Berlin!
The staff were absolutely friendly, and the interior makes the place feel even cozier.
I’ll definitely be coming back

reviews.author: Jelena Goldbach
reviews.text: I did t try the food because I came to buy some organic wine and the girl who served me was super knowledgeable and lively, taking time to explain the wines on offer even though there were customers waiting to be served. I will return to try what’s on offer. The wines by the glass seem really special and my bottles didn’t disappoint either. What a great addition to  Wedding

reviews.author: kira schmitz
reviews.text: absolute gem! nice neighborhood natural wine bar. interesting and exciting selection and super super cozy. will definitely come back!

reviews.author: Azadeh Akbari
reviews.text: Grumpy people with a very limited selection of open wine. Good wine is about the drinking experience not the arrogance.

reviews.author: Lorelai Davie
reviews.text: Lovely little wine bar with a nice selection of wines and a cosy cellar. Will come again!

reviews.author: kieran cormack
reviews.text: Beautiful wine and exceptional cheese and meat selection.  Let them do the choosing just tell them what you don't like.

reviews.author: Amanda Namenek
reviews.text: Amazing! We had such a great time!! We asked for recommendations as we were unfamiliar with several of the wines on the menu and every recommendation was spot on! The service was great and prices were reasonable!!

reviews.author: Aysun Urhan
reviews.text:
On a recent trip to Berlin, we visited Noble Rot for some drinks and bites in the afternoon, mostly because it was on our way. And that visit turned out to be one of the best decisions we made! The owners have a Hungarian background, they've amassed an impressively unique collection of Hungarian and German wines in their cute little winebar. From your more typical cabarnet sauvignons to funky, and weird natural wines made with indigenous grapes.

I met with Sebastian (spelling?) when I was there, being one of the owners not only was he an expert on their wines but he also turned out to be a cheese nerd. As a like-minded cheese nerd, when I "complained" to him about German cheese he suggested that we try one of his cheeseboards made with entirely German cheese. And he was kind enough to let me select the cheese :) I went for a young and slightly aged goat cheese, a haybloom cheese and a more aged cow's milk cheese, and a brie-like soft rind cheese (can't remember the name!). He created a beautiful board with marmalade, a spicy fig mustard, some olives on the side with bread.

I ordered a super fresh 2022 dry Riesling by Frederik Janus for myself and a 2022 cabarnet sauvignon from Szaszi Wine Estate in Balaton. My Riesling started with a highly acidic kick, lending its way to more fruity, citrus aromas. There's a hint of minerality to help balance as well. Overall, a pleasant, everyday wine that you can drink with pretty much anything. The rose was also quite enjoyable, a dry, fruit-forward rose with strong berry aromas. Especially wild strawberries.

I strongly suggest everyone to stop by Noble Rot at least once if you're ever in Berlin, I wish we were staying a bit longer so I could pay a second visit. But I'm so grateful to Sebastian for his hospitality, we truly enjoyed our time there. Can't wait to see you again sometime in the future!

reviews.author: Dave Bracken
reviews.text: Waited and waited for a second glass of wine. We got sick of waiting so went in to pay. Was asked to wait 🫠 ...  perhaps just an off day. Interesting wine list, not extensive but unique as mainly Hungarian wines with some others thrown in. Was a shame we couldn't work through a few more.

reviews.author: Conor Ferris
reviews.text: I came across this bar by chance during a recent trip to Berlin and it was a highlight of my trip. The staff were so friendly and really helpful when I asked for suggestions from the extensive menu. It was a weeknight, I was on my own, and there was a really chill atmosphere. Perfect for enjoying a couple of glasses of wine while reading my book. I loved this place so much, I went back the next day to buy a bottle of wine to bring to a dinner party. Can't wait to visit again during my next trip to Berlin!

reviews.author: Tessa -
reviews.text: We went for the spring wine tasting and had a lovely time. The explanation was a combination of English and German which made it understandable for everyone. The snacks don’t make a full dinner so maybe eat something before. All in all the atmosphere is very gemütlich, accessible and funny.

reviews.author: Anastasiia Nesterkova
reviews.text:
We’ve visited this place 3 times for the wine tasting and every time it was spectacular.
Today for the Valentine’s Day the gallery organized a lovely dinner with 4-course menu with wine paring and lots of candles. Amazing atmosphere.

reviews.author: Seweryn B
reviews.text: Great hidden place where you can sit in quiet area . Enjoy wine and have some tapas . Very good rate quality to price .

reviews.author: Zhanna Lazarieva
reviews.text: A wonderful wine and cheese tasting experience! The pairings were thoughtful and delicious, with a great mix of flavours. The hosts were knowledgeable and friendly, creating a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Perfect for both beginners and wine lovers. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Naomi Seemann
reviews.text: This is honestly the best place to do a winetasting. The stuff is exceptionally and the evening has been the most fun! I gifted this to a friend and can really recommend!

reviews.author: Jessica Preuss
reviews.text: This Place is so cool! Very Cosy (Inside and Outside sitting is possible) - nice, friendly, funny, quick Staff & The Food very original, fresh & tasty also the Drinks and Vine awesome! We hat a good time sharing everything around the table. We‘ll be back! On Weekends make a reservation ;)

reviews.author: Barnaby
reviews.text: We loved the cheese board. Good cocktails and drinks. A wonderful place to soak up the sun on a late spring afternoon.

reviews.author: Gaetano Dentici
reviews.text:
Bad, but very bad wines! Staff does not cares they just want to cash, knowledge is very low.
They just want to show they think they are cool.

reviews.author: afrodite anagno
reviews.text: Amazing location, friendly and warm service and high quality food and drinks. Highly recommended!!! Also, the best espresso martini 🍸 in town 🙌

reviews.author: simone macrì
reviews.text:
I have come here often during the years. Never a let down. Love the place, great location (close to the canals) amazing outside sitting area under vines.
Staff is always polite and professional, always ready to help with a smile and accommodate any request. Food is great (strongly suggest the appetizers boards) and wine is even better. Ask the staff for suggestions! Price is decent. Consider going early on weekends as it's often full!

reviews.author: Ayberk Anıl Atsız
reviews.text: I wanted to bring a bottle of wine as a gift since I was meeting my friends and their group. The gentleman inside was very helpful and recommended many wines to us. I truly appreciate his assistance.

reviews.author: Mikhail Fenchuk
reviews.text: A charming wine spot where you’re sure to find something that suits your taste. The cozy, beautifully designed interior and genuinely welcoming staff make it feel like your new favorite place in the neighborhood.

reviews.author: Abigail
reviews.text:
If you’re looking for the perfect spot to enjoy an incredible selection of natural wines in a warm, welcoming atmosphere, this wine shop/bar is a true gem. From the moment you step in, you’re greeted with a cozy ambiance that feels both sophisticated and inviting, making it an ideal place to unwind, whether alone or with friends.

The wine selection is unparalleled in the area, especially if you’re a fan of natural wines. Each bottle has been thoughtfully curated, and the knowledgeable owner is more than happy to offer insights and recommendations that elevate your tasting experience. It’s clear they have a passion for wine that shines through in every interaction.

The cheese plates are a must-try—beautifully arranged, with high-quality cheeses that pair perfectly with the wines. Each bite feels carefully considered, and it’s these little details that make the experience feel so special.

The owner Theresa is truly one of the highlights of the place. Her warmth and attentiveness make you feel like you’re part of a close-knit community, not just a customer.
