Shes takes the time to get to know your tastes and offer personalized recommendations, creating a welcoming, inclusive atmosphere that keeps you wanting to come back.

In short, Die Wein is a hidden treasure, offering a perfect blend of outstanding wines, delicious food, and genuine hospitality. Highly recommended for anyone who appreciates a great glass of wine in an exceptional setting!

reviews.author: Christian O‘Day
reviews.text: Wonderfully attentive and knowledgeable host. Great wine selection- very accurate description.

reviews.author: Paul R
reviews.text: Best wine bar in Berlin, a great atmosphere. We love it

reviews.author: Nini
reviews.text:
Super nice wine bar with great selection of natural wines but also drinks in general. The interior design is as stunning as their branding, I loved the menu presentation and cover, so stylish.
The staff was very friendly and welcoming, very quick service overall. We came here on a Wednesday, so it wasn’t too packed nor too loud, the background music had a decent level. Can only recommend!

reviews.author: Nazlı Uysal
reviews.text: It is a great wine bar. The quality is very good, their cheese plates are so delicious as on the photos. They have a very good selection of wines and the they are informing very well (Marie was great!). Super friendly staff! I strongly recommend if you are in Berlin!

reviews.author: dog
reviews.text:
Was having dinner around the corner, was so happy we found this wine bar which is hidden in the side street and quiet. Offer good selection orange/ wine and red wine. We had the cheese platter and sour bread, enjoyed that very much too!
The whole place was very relax and lay back, nice deco and friendly service! Will come back again for sure 🫶🏼🫶🏼

reviews.author: Hannah Reichl
reviews.text: Really cute place with a good selection of wine and snacks. Unfortunately the waitress was unfriendly, almost passive aggressive to us. Not sure if we will come again.

reviews.author: Zaur Mustafayev
reviews.text: The place isn't bad and has created a unique ambiance using secondhand furniture. We ordered two different types of wine along with a cheese plate, and all were delicious and tasty. However, when compared to other nice wine bars in Berlin, and taking into account the atmosphere, it didn't quite measure up as one of the best. The inside of the bar was too loud and narrow, making it difficult for standing people to move around comfortably.

reviews.author: Atahan Akbulut
reviews.text:
Atmosphere is pretty nice but the glass options are really limited.

If you label yourself as wine bar, then you should have plenty of options to choose from.

My girlfriend and I prefer different wines so we do not order bottles but when we asked to get a glass, they told us there was only one option for white wine. Really?? In a wine bar??

We also ordered ham and cheese board and it was average.

reviews.author: Jay Jung
reviews.text: The ambience is actually more comfortable than you see on the picture. They charge you only 8 euro for corkage (table fee).  Their side dishes are also very well prepared and personal. The staff is also very attentive and professional to offer recommendation and free tasting offer for some of the wine menus. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: KD
reviews.text: Cozy atmosphere with friendly staff and a great selection of Georgian wines. The Georgian platter was quite large for two people and very tasty. I definitely want to visit again!

reviews.author: Amy Stone
reviews.text: Lovely little find. Knowledgeable waiter who recommended a tasty wine to our liking. We weren’t eating, but had olives and bread sticks. Generous portions. The platters that were coming out looked really good. Great selection and staff were very friendly. Would highly recommend, booking needed for some nights.

reviews.author: Sergey
reviews.text: Brilliant idea to bring together so many Georgian wines. Never realised how many varieties grow over there! The idea of having thematic snacks to accompany wine is also great. All in all wonderful place to have a chat over fine wine.

reviews.author: Vera
reviews.text: A buzzy place with very nice selection of drinks and delicious cold plates. We came here during the week at 6pm, which sounds early, but by 8pm the place was completely full and some people were standing since all the seats were taken, so coming earlier was a good decision. Might be a bit too loud for a romantic date or a serious conversation, but a great choice for any other occasion

reviews.author: Olena Prodchenko
reviews.text:
One of the best bars in the area. One feels really welcome and the vibe is really nice. I was here with my girlfriends and we had the time of our lives. 🤣🤣🤣
The waiter (Antonio) was really kind and helpful and made our experience one of a kind. We’ll definitely come back 😎😎😎
Thank you so much ☺️

reviews.author: Kelly W
reviews.text: Awesome little Italian wine bar in P-berg. Super warm and welcoming service and delicious plates of antipasti and bread for snacking. It’s pretty smokey inside but thankfully there are outdoor tables too.

reviews.author: Yoav Aziz
reviews.text: One of the best places in Berlin, amazing atmosphere, the owner is super nice and cares about his customers, great food, great drinks and amazing price. Highly recommended for anyone that loves good vibes places.

reviews.author: Violet Hamilton
reviews.text: I love it here. It’s a vibe. But just know that you’ll come out smelling like a cigarette because the smoking is heavy indoors. But the drinks and food are top.

reviews.author: Selcan Ö.
reviews.text: This wine Bar was really nice! I recommend to go here. The tapas were top and seasonal offer. the wines very tasty. They have from different countries wines. The staff was very caring, friendly and came to check many times on us. Also they could give us good recommendations for wines. Card payment possible. The place was not too loud, good taste of music in the background. I had a nice date night.

reviews.author: María González Viegas
reviews.text:
Very cozy and romantic wine bar. The food, wine, and service was perfect. Will recommend to everyone.
There are also lots of vegetarian and vegan options.

reviews.author: Gabriella Juillet
reviews.text: Been meaning to visit this bar since moving to Berlin and was not disappointed! Cozy and intimate, varied selection of wines by the glass and plates to share! Great music and staff too, will be back 😊

reviews.author: Karl Lehrer
reviews.text: Nice wine bar. The seating arrangement was a bit tight and service long but overall a good experience. The non alcoholic options were average: negroni and Prosecco but it’s a wine bar after all.

reviews.author: Daniel Lutz
reviews.text: Just excellent. Small menu, everything we had (5 small plates) tasted great. Lots of wines from the glass and fantastic service. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Stacey Wells
reviews.text: Excellent. site cocktails and fab wines, also good beer. Lovely space. A real cocktail bar in a great neighborhood. It’s a smoking bar, although no one was smoking while we were there and outdoor seating is possible. What a gem.

reviews.author: Emanuela Parisi
reviews.text: Great pub, that combines the essence of Berlin and the Italian character of Gianni, the awesome owner of this little gem. Thank you for having us, Gianni. We felt like home. Ajòòò 😄😄

reviews.author: Pavan Chitradurga Thammanna
reviews.text: A great bar with a very nice bartender. It's full on weekends, but go a bit early around 8-9 pm to get a good table. They have really good wines.

reviews.author: João Guilherme Belo Lisboa Trento
reviews.text: Amazing bar, great people, music and atmosphere. Highly recommend and will definitely come back.

reviews.author: Paul Flood
reviews.text: Great bar. I've seen only two people working here and they work hard. Super attentive and polite service.

reviews.author: Hannah
reviews.text: The best!! Auro is so wonderful and made our experience so special. The staff are amazing, the atmosphere is lively and fun. The food portions are very generous and the quality is sooo good. Thank you so much!! ✨✨ thank you to Auro again 🫶

reviews.author: Julie Radzewicz-Pedersen
reviews.text: I ordered for a company event and it was AMAZING! Super fast service, high quality food - very satisfied with the overall experience!

reviews.author: Rachel Chew
reviews.text: A cosy spot to enjoy few bottles of good wines and the cheese and cold cuts platter is the best! The staff was also very nice and took great care of us the whole time. We had their specials today, a slow cooked chicken with so much flavours! Definitely will come back!

reviews.author: laura desirée di paolo
reviews.text: it's fantastic! Not too big, not too fancy, the prices are fair, the wines (even the house wine!) are really pleasant to drink! The focaccia is a jewelry: perfect balance between being crunchy and the juice of the toppings, without being squishy (very important, for an Italian!). The handcut prosciutto melts in the mouth! If you expect fake flattering, this is not the place for you. The people are professional and straight - nice without being overwhelmingly behind your back! Only, particularly on the weekend, one must book in advance! They have (nicely) limited spots and nice space between tables - so one can actually enjoy!

reviews.author: Paolo Beltrami
reviews.text: Great food, great wine and great experience. A full round tour of Italy and Italian culture all in a single place! Auro the owner, and all the staff are nice and prepared, making you feel at home in a second. Truly a recommended place, especially if you fancy a good bottle of wine! 🍷

reviews.author: Tommy Zoom
reviews.text: Me and my girlfriend came in here non German speakers. The bar tender made us feel at home and welcomed us with open arms. Unbelievable vibes from her smiles all around. Even danced with us in a chill way. 10/10 vibes and 10/10 wine. Definitely be back

reviews.author: Ang R
reviews.text: LVQ Wine Bar is a fantastic spot! The wine selection is top-notch, and the laid-back atmosphere makes it the perfect place to unwind. The staff are incredibly friendly and approachable, creating a welcoming vibe while sharing their expert knowledge about the wines. A must-visit for wine lovers looking for a relaxed and enjoyable evening!

reviews.author: James
reviews.text:
I drank wine there. It was quite good and the price is quite decent ~4.5-5 euros per glass. A good variety of wein.

I liked the atmosphere: very cosy and quiet.

Don't remember whether they spoke English, but you can pay with card there

reviews.author: Bea Domingo
reviews.text: Great selection of wine, lovely service and cosy. The only reason I do not give it a 5 is that I missed some tapas to go with the wine. Some olives would be great.

reviews.author: Sahar Sa
reviews.text: Great wine place and the staff is super friendly

reviews.author: Vanessa Lassissi
reviews.text: Underwhelming. Just went for one glass of wine. The prices are very reasonable, but although I ordered the most expensive white wine (the description was interesting) I ended up with a most boring Riesling. Neither good or bad, just ultra standard. They seem to have very little interesting choices by the glass which is a shame. You can probably get much more interesting wines by the bottle.I also had a creme brulee, which was your standard supermarket one. So quite disappointing . But I guess it's a choice to offer more "affordable products, even with sub par quality. Little details make the difference, and the above mentioned details show little effort. Service is pretty neutral, neither good or bad. Ambiance is pretty cosy.

reviews.author: Henry Clay
reviews.text: Cozy spot for some fantastic wines. Really enjoyed sitting on the side patio trying some of their orange, white, and rose options. Good small bites to snack on while you drink.

reviews.author: Ana Correia
reviews.text: My favourite wine bar. Fantastic selection of (only German) wines. Great recommendations by the staff. Kitchen is a bit slow but worth waiting - that Flammkuchen!

reviews.author: Lea _
reviews.text: Really lovely wine bar! Service was really good and wine was delicious! Really cozy and relaxing atmosphere, which was just what we needed after a long day of exploring Berlin! ☺️

reviews.author: Ingar Reinholtsen
reviews.text: Great selection of german wine in a wonderful atmosphere. Tasty Flammkuchen and cheese!

reviews.author: Maryna Balluch
reviews.text:
This restaurant is definitely making it onto my list of the best in Berlin. I loved the atmosphere, and the food was amazing. I even had the chance to take a class on my favorite wines, which is incredibly rare in Berlin (Chablis and Pinot Noir). The service staff were also super sweet.

However, I do want to mention one downside—we waited around 50 minutes for our food. Next time, I would expect a small gesture from the house for such a long wait. That being said, this doesn’t change my 5-star review. I will definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Naomi
reviews.text: Fantastic restaurant with very good food, the entrecôte was absolutely amazing! The staff were even better, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The vibe was super cosy, making it perfect for a date night or an evening out with friends.

reviews.author: Celina Usinger
reviews.text: Truly just such a special place! Whether it is just for a drink at the bar, a little oyster snack or a full dinner this truly is the place for everything! The food is the highest quality, the steak was cooked to perfection and the oyster are the freshest I’ve ever had in the whole of Berlin! But the true star of the show is the service! You just feel welcome and homey and any question you have will be answered both about food or the amazing wine list! Truly if you can stop by and let yourself be immersed into the wonderful world of Seppel

reviews.author: Cristian Todorovic
reviews.text: It started with two Virgin Spritz cocktails; so refreshing, fruity and well made. The grilled chicken with carrots in sauce was my favorite main, but the spicy pumpkin dish and burrata with walnuts and cranberries were equally fantastic. For dessert, both the plum crumble (more crumble please 🍪) and chocolate mousse were spectacular. Impossible to pick a favorite! The staff made us feel right at home. Overall the atmosphere is cozy yet vibrant, and the menu is one of the most exciting I’ve seen in a long time. Can’t wait to come back! ♥️

reviews.author: Jbish01
reviews.text: I came to Bottega Seppel and had a beer in the bar area of the restaurant which was a helles from the selection of the 2 on tap beers they had here also accompanied by the roasted almonds. Whilst being here I took a look at the menu too which had so many incredible options I wanted to try. There was also a very healthily stacked wine list for those looking for a wide selection of great wines as well as their own very underrated cocktail menu. Having eaten prior to coming to Bottega Seppel I only got the pumpkin (Kürbis, Labneh, Erdnuss-Chilli) this time, but this dish was just phenomenal! the mix of the perfectly tender pumpkin with so much flavour and texture and the blend of spice made the dish perfect. Additionally, whilst being alone in the bar, the view they have into the kitchen makes the whole experience so immersive and watching the bar come to life as the kitchen closes is just so enjoyable to watch. I cannot wait to return and be in the restaurant to try their wine and all the other dishes I didn’t get to try this time around.

name: The Rad - Natural Wine Bar & Cafe

reviews.author: Selcan Ö.
reviews.text: Nice wine bar, olives were delicious and good wine card. Prices were good. We had a nice evening with friends and can recommend this place.

reviews.author: Giusy Amoroso
reviews.text: Great wine selection and delicious tapas. I really enjoyed my aperitivo at The Rad. I also had the pleasure of talking with the owner, who was very kind. I’m looking forward to going back and enjoying a new bottle of natural wine :)

reviews.author: Nikola Trajkovic
reviews.text: The first time here. Amazing service. They had a special pop up day combined with amazing wine section. Coffee is also excellent. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Joe O'Brien
reviews.text: Popped in for a bottle of wine with my partner. Was sat straight away at the bar. Staff were lovely, fantastic atmosphere and music, as well as great wine.

reviews.author: Anna Doherty
reviews.text: Lovely, cosy bar serving some great natural wines. Vibe is chilled and welcoming. They also have a snack menu, which I’ll definitely come back to try!

reviews.author: Janina Now
reviews.text:
I’m a tourist from Miami and I come to the Champagne Bar every year — it’s always a highlight of my trip! The champagne is amazing and the vibe is perfect.

Special thanks to Markus, the waiter — truly outstanding service every time. Friendly, professional, and always makes me feel welcome.

Highly recommended! I’ll definitely be back again next year. 🍾✨

reviews.author: Pam Echart
reviews.text: Max our host was magnificent ! His service and knowledge was impeccable!!! These Champagne options were the best we have ever seen by the glass! A must for anyone who loves BUBBLES

reviews.author: K Burke
reviews.text:
Lovely place to have a glass of champagne. Lots of choice and the service was good. Not cheap compared to local bars but worth the treat. They do happy hour on certain days so it's worth asking if any offers.
.

reviews.author: Mathew Banets
reviews.text:
It was a rather unpleasant experience. A tattooed man was very unfriendly and, as a guest of KaDeWe, I was quite disturbed to witness an obviously supervisor—who both looks and behaves like a gang boss—treating the otherwise lively and charming staff so poorly. I will not return if I see this individual again. Truly disappointing.

That said, my compliments to the members of staff who handled his behaviour with such grace and professionalism. Aside from this, the bar remains an exceptional place of outstanding quality.

reviews.author: Steve Brockton
reviews.text: We spent a very pleasant couple of hours at the Champagner Bar, ably assisted by Danilo.  Great service and ambience.

reviews.author: Kelly G
reviews.text: Had a glass of wine here on my first night in Berlin, it was a lovely local white wine. I sat outside and soaked up some of the atmosphere. Staff were lovely!

reviews.author: Xabier Goikoetxea Uriarte
reviews.text: The best wine bar near the Berlin Cathedral; good wines and excellent service, Sophi and Judith were very kind with us.

reviews.author: Aleksandra Majewska
reviews.text: Great place with a variety of wines and a knowledgeable owner. It was possible to taste a wine before choosing one and we got good recommendations. Moreover it's located in a picturesque area. Personally, I would like to hear more jazz/classical music, but it's subjective. Will go back there when I'm in Berlin again.

reviews.author: April James
reviews.text:
Lovely little bar with friendly and knowledgeable staff. We enjoyed trying a variety of German wines, some very local!

We visited on holiday and would definitely come back, the wine list was a good length and had a lot of interesting options.

reviews.author: Niddy Bkk
reviews.text: I didn't  have a chance to try the cheese plate which looked so tempting. The wines were lovely, so does the services from the owner.

reviews.author: Erica
reviews.text: This small bar is nestled in one of Friedrichshain’s residential streets, hardly even visible as you pass by. The inside feels like a living room converted into a bar, with an unusual selection of wines and cocktails. I had a mezcal cocktail, well priced and tasty. The bar was also smoke-free, so a real gem in my book.

reviews.author: Sandra Fernández
reviews.text: I was looking for a cozy and homely atmosphere for Halloween's evening, and I am so happy I found this place. They organized a candlelight event, with fantastic decorations and wonderful cocktails, spooky smoke included! I also enjoyed their Icaro wine, which taste I found very unique. Thanks for a wonderful evening!

reviews.author: Leonie Holly
reviews.text: So glad to have found this place! Great drinks, great service and wonderful owners. Looking forward to visiting again soon!

reviews.author: Kali Hardwick
reviews.text: This was such a fun gem! It’s a bit farther away from other bars and restaurants in the area, but that only adds to its charm. It’s quiet, retro, and very comfortable. The cocktails are amazing! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: 오윤진
reviews.text:
what i can only say is, "the best". nice wine&beer&other things.
they are really friendly and make fast service. also they have a live music often on the weekend. what i love here is they have seperate rooms for smoker&non-smoker. for me as non-smoker, it is really hard ro find a non-smoker bars.

mood, staffs, wines and etc. are perfect!

reviews.author: Amna Malik
reviews.text: Stopped in while visiting the city and was blown away. The grilled swordfish with lemon caper butter was light and flavorful, and the roasted vegetables on the side were perfectly seasoned. Service was attentive without being pushy. Loved the atmosphere — classy but comfortable.

reviews.author: sergio hammes
reviews.text: Excellent wine bar. The food surprised us especially the starter and the tuna dish. I recommend the visit.

reviews.author: Jay KR
reviews.text: A newly opened wine restaurant! Nice ambiance and friendly staff. Dishes are very tasty too

reviews.author: Rheanna Lanning
reviews.text: Such a cool wine bar!! My friend and I had Apo as our server and wow! Such great service and really good food! Love it here ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

reviews.author: Ліда Осташевська
reviews.text: extremely delicious and beautiful place, the staff is wonderful. you will definitely not regret it here very beautiful

reviews.author: aria soroushi
reviews.text: We had some drinks, it was teally good athmosphere, staff were really friendly and smiely, they speak English as well. Only one thing that could effect the athmosphere is music sound comes from other side might be bothering. They have pizza also

reviews.author: HYUNG JUNE DO
reviews.text: It was perfect bar in my life. Mood&Drinks are excellent!! Service is nice too. I wanna come again definitely🙌

reviews.author: Barbora Koláčková
reviews.text: Very nice cosy place. We did not eat there but the wine was delicious and the service very nice. We will definitely come back.

reviews.author: Mira Guha
reviews.text: Linh is amazing she made us feel very welcome and the food atmosphere and experience was amazing! Very beautiful location and lovely food! Would recommend!!

reviews.author: Carmel Chavez
reviews.text:
I went with my husband, we got a great time!
The food is really delicious!
The reservations was missing , and the waitress solve it quite fast, super profesional.
We got a good experience thanks to her!

reviews.author: sofia cicinelli
reviews.text: Beautiful place with an excellent wine selection from all over Europe and really good dishes for shearing. Must visit if you are in Berlin.

reviews.author: Mary
reviews.text: Bit expensive. The wines by the glass weren’t that mindblowing, and only 0,1L. I missed overall lively vibes, the music was barely to hear and no atmosphere. Staff was friendly. They’ve just opened, so let’s see again in a couple of weeks.

reviews.author: Audrey Davis
reviews.text: Had a really nice time here and the wine selection was great. We ordered a few plates as well and everything was so tasty. Perfect for a date night or a hangout with a friend. I will be back!

reviews.author: Leoni Kapell
reviews.text:
The wine bar Prenzlauer Berg has been waiting for! A place that feels like it’s always been there and still has the buzz and excitement of something newly opened.
The food brings such joy and accompanies the great selection of wine and drinks perfectly.
Thank you ❤️‍🔥

reviews.author: Daniel
reviews.text: Absolutely love this spot! It will become my go-to hangout. The cozy vibe, great music, and delicious bar food paired with a solid wine selection make it a standout. They also offer some tasty non-alcoholic options. The staff is so friendly and attentive. If you can, grab a seat at the bar—you'll get to watch the chef in action and soak in the lively atmosphere. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Alexandra Grishechko
reviews.text: Good snacks and super friendly staff, prices are reasonable

reviews.author: Ivan K
reviews.text: Really good selection of aperitifs and very reasonable price tags. Look for special days and special offers — can be quite interesting and fun. Last time I visited on a Friday they had free tapas. Really good finger food and drinks for your evening after work time.

reviews.author: ellee kim
reviews.text: Staffs were friendly, food was good, and wine set the mood right. No wonder why this place had 5 stars!! It took awhile to prepare but that käse platter was sooo good!!

reviews.author: Scott in Berlin
reviews.text: What a wee gem of a place. Lovely seating area on the street . Lovely to see it fully on a Saturday evening. Full of nice people and the staff are all delightful and pleasant. Love the snacks that are offered by amazing selection of wines. Inside it’s also cute and the bathroom is so quaint and really clean even thought it’s unisex. Me and my wife will make this a regular watering hole from today onwards…

reviews.author: Lyndon Meyer
reviews.text: Very friendly staff, spoke English and Italian with them, fantastic wines, delicious cheese plate in a cozy atmosphere.  Highly recommended!

reviews.author: James
reviews.text:
I really enjoyed the wine. I ordered a glass of orange wine (12€).
They have a few options that you can order per glass. All options available as bottles and if you buy 'to go' it's cheaper.

✅ Card payment
✅ English-friendly

reviews.author: Cecy Nielsen
reviews.text: Cosy spot with a nice barmaid. There are some interesting bottles lining the wall, but only one of each colour available by the glass. White & red on tap too

reviews.author: Megan Bedard
reviews.text: The woman who helped us was awesome (I didn’t catch her name but she’s from London). She helped us find a bottle of wine I loved for a reasonable price, and she was really warm and funny. Honestly it turned our night around, we left feeling super happy we had popped in

reviews.author: Filip Lněnička
reviews.text:
great vibes, cute place, helpfull staff and good wine on tap for reasonable price.

cards only, which is great

reviews.author: Shachar Azriel
reviews.text: Took away a bottle of their house wine from the barrel for 16€. Amazing selection of natural wine

reviews.author: Therese Breyer
reviews.text: My favourite Wine shop in Kreuzberg. Great selection of exclusively natural fermented wine through all price ranges (not only above 15€ like in other wine stores). I can spend hours there learning the unique stories behind the bottles.

reviews.author: Diane Sicsic
reviews.text: Great selection and amazing recommendations, will go back!

reviews.author: Guillaume Besson
reviews.text: Great place to find excellent and well-priced natural wine. The staff is knowledgeable and helpful. I definitely recommend it.

reviews.author: Klas Tauberman
reviews.text: Super friendly staff. The red wines we drank was superb 🙌💯 The place and atmosphere is amazing. We had a nice time here.

reviews.author: nk sorelle
reviews.text: Nice place, good food good .🥰🥰🥰.

reviews.author: Ally Shu
reviews.text: Absolutely loved this beautiful spot! Really appreciate that it’s not the typical ‘shabby Berlin’ style but has a fresh, modern, and super cute design. Great selection, relaxed vibe, and the perfect place to catch up with friends — and even buy some unique gifts! ❤️ The service was a bit slow, so there’s definitely room for improvement there.

reviews.author: Dario CapoDiCapi
reviews.text:
A Hidden Gem in Berlin – Absolutely Loved It!

I visited Jane and the Jam with my girlfriend who was visiting from Miami, and we were both genuinely blown away. We’ve seen a lot of great places around the world, but this one really stood out.

The atmosphere is super cute and relaxed—just the kind of place you’d hope to stumble upon in a quiet Berlin street, even on a Saturday night. It felt like a little escape from the city without actually leaving it. We didn’t have a reservation, but the staff went out of their way to make space for us outside, which we really appreciated.

The drinks were excellent, the service was warm and cool in the best way, and overall it just had that perfect balance of charm and chill. Whether you’re heading out for a casual drink after work or looking for a cozy spot to spend time with your partner or friends, this place really delivers.

Highly recommend stopping by—Jane and the Jam has that kind of magic that makes you want to come back.

reviews.author: Solveig
reviews.text:
We had a really nice experience here yesterday! It was a busy evening due to a staff shortage, and I imagine the sudden change in weather didn’t help with people moving inside all at once, then back out again when the rain stopped. Despite all this, we were served with kindness, professionalism, and good humour :) A special shout-out to the waitress handling our section: calm, attentive, composed, and kind, even as things got hectic (and even in the face of rudeness from other customers). Unfortunately, we witnessed a group of customers being unnecessarily rude and confrontational toward her (they’ve also left a review), and I want to offer a counter-narrative/review to this: it was clear this was an extraordinary evening, and from our perspective, the staff handled it as well as anyone could. The only thing we noticed was how rude that other table was! Even if you’re disappointed, basic respect is the minimum..

Unfortunately the bar staff are not in control of the kitchen wait time, the weather or other extraordinary events... All in all, we had a great time! The wine and food were excellent, and despite the pressure, the atmosphere stayed warm and welcoming. We waited a bit to order, but the wine came quickly once we had and the food was worth the wait (especially the charcuterie board, the small one was perfect for two people). Honestly, we were just grateful to enjoy the evening and really don't understand the harsh words! Looking forward to coming back soon :))

reviews.author: Dea Avdulaj
reviews.text: Cozy, stylish vibe with a great selection of wines and snacks. The staff is super friendly and the atmosphere is great for a relaxed night out.

reviews.author: Carolin
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience at this wine bar! The atmosphere was warm and inviting, with beautifully curated interior. They had a solid wine selection, and the staff were helpful — offering great recommendations that paired really well with the food. Everything was thoughtfully prepared and complemented the wine perfectly. Overall, a great spot to relax and enjoy a few glasses. I’d definitely go back.

reviews.author: Cristina S
reviews.text:
I don't actually like wine, I went here to accompany a friend.

The service and ambiance was ok.

Food was excellent, I got the Flammkuchen with duck.

reviews.author: Andrés Suárez
reviews.text: sharing concept lovely food excellent service good wine comfortable place.  it also has a pleasant outdoors area. unfortunately it was raining.  Dies Ente Flammkuchen ist sehr lecker

reviews.author: Robert Peveling-Oberhag
reviews.text: Fantastic food and service. Classic dishes with a twist and the right wines to go with it. Loved the gravy as you can tell by the pictures.

reviews.author: dr. jan onno reiners
reviews.text:
Absolutely great food (I recommend the vegetarian 4-course menu) with even better wines (yes, get the menu with accompanying wines) and fantastic service.
Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Ralph H.
reviews.text: The place was excellent, and the attention of the staff was great. Cosy and relaxed atmosphere with excellent wines and delicious food. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Thomas Neil
reviews.text:
Wonderful service and selection of wines with a vibe you don’t get in Germany every day. I wish the server (we never got her name) and bar nothing but the best for their kindness, flexibility and customer service.

When I asked to order a Tempranillo, she didn’t allow me to just pick one randomly but let my wife try several.

reviews.author: Valentin Paul
reviews.text: With food, I review the wine. We were given three different open choices after a small briefing what we liked and then one of the wines made it into the glass. Charming and authentic service and quite nice options to go with the wines. Reasonable prices. Very bright room, relaxing atmosphere.

reviews.author: Merve Sahin
reviews.text: Amazing wine at affordable prices. Very relaxed low key vibe. Lovely owner taking time with your order. Didn’t try the food but would recommend this place for a drink (or 5)

reviews.author: Mostafa Gado
reviews.text:
Highly recommended! Excellent food and drinks, and very affordable!
Service was great too!

reviews.author: Michela Mastrella
reviews.text: Really unwelcoming…Great first time, so I brought some friends for a second time: at our request for a table, we were met with sighs and then ignored. We tried to find a solution because my friends really wanted to try their wines (which are very good), but at this point, the staff made us feel very unwelcome. We were even rudely asked to move away from the counter. It's a shame because it's near my home, and I would have gladly become a regular!

reviews.author: Eduardo Aspezzi
reviews.text: Lovely little Italian wine spot with warm, friendly service that makes you feel right at home. The food was simple but full of flavor. Great wine, great vibe, and truly kind staff. Can’t wait to go back!

reviews.author: Elena Navarrete (Elebonie)
reviews.text: I absolutely love this place! The food is simply amazing, and the portions are generous – you'll definitely want to try an antipasto and at least one main dish. What makes the experience even better is the warm and welcoming service. The staff had fantastic wine recommendations that added to our enjoyment. I'm already looking forward to my next trip to Berlin so I can visit again! ✨

reviews.author: Ignacio Campana
reviews.text: Amazing place!! The food was amazing and super high quality wine. 10 points for the service also!! I will come back

reviews.author: Kristina Chopa
reviews.text: If you’re reading this review just head over here already! Food is Micheln star quality at reasonable prices matched with wine that will take you back to your favorite memories. Super welcoming hosts, who will happily share their knowledge about natural wines and passion for food.

reviews.author: Justin
reviews.text: Great food & wine, everything was fresh & good quality. The server knows his products very well. The atmosphere is cosy & laid back.

reviews.author: Berlin Gal
reviews.text: If you’re anywhere near Gendarmenmarkt looking for lunch, aperitivo, or dinner, Sagrantino is a great choice. Love their aperitivo! Laid-back atmosphere, friendly service, and solid Italian food done right. The aperitivo bites are a must-eat, and the vongole pasta is simply delicious. Cold drinks, good vibes, and great value - highly recommended!

reviews.author: Steven Eisbjerg
reviews.text:
Had a really good business lunch here.
Food and service was excellent and very good value.

reviews.author: C C
reviews.text: The place has a nice ambiance, and the staff are friendly. However, the pasta lacked flavor, and the portion size was far too small. The bread seemed stale and was hard to bite into. Overall, the quality felt a bit lower compared to other upscale restaurants in the area.

reviews.author: Kaveh DADKHAH
reviews.text:
Walking in the vibrant vicinity of the city's orchestra hall, we found an Italian restaurant. We sampled their pasta and lasagna.

The quality of the food was commendable, with each bite reflecting the authenticity and care put into its preparation. However, the portions left us yearning for more, as the quantity did not quite satisfy our appetites. This was particularly noticeable given the price point.

The staff were kind, respectful, and helpful that resonated well with us.

Speaking of ambiance, the internal design contributed to a dining experience that was aesthetically pleasing.

In conclusion, while the restaurant hits many high notes with its quality, service, and location, a slight adjustment in portion size and pricing could elevate this establishment to a standing ovation.🍝🎶

reviews.author: Markus Riedel
reviews.text: I love coming here for lunch. Every day there is a different lunch menu for €11.90. You can choose between salad or soup of the day and a selection of 3 different pasta dishes. I am always served in a friendly manner. The ambience is very lovingly decorated. Card payment is also possible. I would be happy to return.

reviews.author: Peter Reinholt
reviews.text:
We went here as the final dinner of an extended weekend in Berlin and I could not have wished for a better experience.
We were imediately greeted by the extremely friendly staff and were seated at our table, there is an incredible atmosphere and the theme of the old apothacary realy sets the mood for the evening.
The food was simply amazing, the bbq pork in particular. The House cocktails are also very well made and taste great.

10/10 would recommend and visit again

reviews.author: Milan V
reviews.text: The ambiance is unique as the restaurant is a former Pharmacy shop, and they combined the old shelves and interior design. We went for the tasting menu. All the dishes were delicious but our favorite was the BBQ pork. The negroni is really good

reviews.author: Ania Jeżowska
reviews.text: Food is created as a perfect set of well balanced menu - just go for the full option and you won’t regret it! Wonderful German Chardonnay. Lovely service. But the just after the food (which is obviously super good and the most important) just make sure you pay attention to the interior… with booking a spot inside, to feel the vibe :) great place!

reviews.author: Joachim Roski
reviews.text: After dinner the other night, I came back because of the cocktail program. I was impressed during my first visit by the sophistication of classic cocktails such as dry martini or a Manhattan. On my second visit, I wanted to doublecheck that I wasn’t hallucinating. I had sensed correctly during my first visit, The cocktail program is superior. Erin, a Mixologist from Melbourne Australia, does a remarkable job, paying attention to details such as temperature of the glass,  temperature of the drink, and sourcing superior ingredients. These were probably the best cocktails I had during my stay in Berlin. If you like great cocktails, beautiful surroundings, delicious snacks, and a super competent mixologist, visit ORA. I had a great time. Congratulations to Erin and the team.

reviews.author: Diana Elaine Miller
reviews.text:
Amazing service, food and vibe.
Cocktails were perfect.
Menu very interesting.
Elishka our server was wonderful.
Would 10/10 recommend.
We went early (5:30) to catch a quiet time without a reservation.

reviews.author: Michelangelo Corsaro
reviews.text: This wine bar greeted us with a chilly reception, we thought because of our outfits, and made us feel a bit judged. And as for the olives, they must be made of gold, because we definitely paid a premium for them! Not exactly the vibe we were hoping for!

reviews.author: Nina M
reviews.text: The wine shop of my choice. Great consulting, amazing overall experience. You can feel at ease without being a wine nerd, but also excited if you are one.

reviews.author: Dean Woods
reviews.text: Found this place on google as I wanted a bottle for my hotel room. Great recommendation so went back again today. The guy who advised me was spot on. Glad to know they will ship to the UK. Might pop in for lunch tomorrow! Highly recommended and thank you.

reviews.author: Norbert Harmanus
reviews.text: Friendly wine shop where I had 2 German white wines and a cheese board. I received some explanations on the German wine regions. The Priorat I took home was excellent! Thanks for the enjoyable visit!

reviews.author: Nikita Chernyshov
reviews.text: Massive gratefulness to this place and especially Piero and Poul as they opened the door to wine world for me during lockdown and keep broadening my experience every week! This place is more than a usual wine shop, as you always find friendly atmosphere, experienced people who will guide you through different wines, educate you and help to find the wine that suit you best. Usually passing by Planet Wein I used to take a sit and enjoy several glasses while having a chat with friend or just observing the area. It's one of my favorite spots in the area and I would definitely recommend it to everyone besides your knowledge in wine industry. Be proactive, ask questions and learn the beauty of wine! PS. I've added some pictures of wines i've bought here.

reviews.author: Sabrina Jahnke
reviews.text: Great food, interesting service! We had a company dinner here and the food was fantastic – no complaints there. The location is also lovely. The service, however, was its own kind of memorable. The owner was clearly having a stressful night and wasn't shy about showing it. We were treated a little disrespectfully, but our group decided to just laugh it off as the authentic German customer service experience we've all heard about. I still highly recommend it and would come back cause the quality of the food and drinks are phenomenal.

reviews.author: L C
reviews.text: Excellent food. The service can be a little intimidating but in general attentive. The space is not big so it can be quite loud. Two course menu should be 49.9 euro but I was charged 63 euro. Otherwise I really enjoyed the food.

reviews.author: Vincent Lin
reviews.text: Got the three course meal with no regrets. The food was exceptional, totally understand why it's on the Michelin guide! Scallops and roast beef were on-point, and the lime meringue was the cherry on top! My waitress was very friendly and provided me with great recs and descriptions of dishes. The atmosphere was also very comfortable. Only gripe was that it seemed a bit understaffed with two waiters considering how busy it was. Expect half an hour wait between courses which is understandable given the time it takes to prepare fresh dishes.

reviews.author: Tom Beute
reviews.text:
Really dissapointing, I orderd 5 courses
Menu with wine pairing. We had a red muller which was really dry and we had mushrooms rush that was full of sand. In the end I left very disappointed, the owner was having a nice drink with his friends and Max had to solve everything.

reviews.author: Jamie Gaviola
reviews.text:
I found the food to be decent.. nothing really stood out to me or was really memorable. Compared to most of the wine bars we have in Canada, I found their selection to be quite small but the selection that we had were exceptional.

As tourists who are new to German wine, it would have been a nice touch if the sommelier or waiter had a brief rundown as to why this particular wine made it on their list and what makes this wine special. I would have loved to know more about each glass & I feel like this touch would definitely elevate their wine bar experience.

Out of all the dining experiences we had in Berlin, the service had to have been the best during our stay - although that is to be expected, given their rating on the Michelin guide. However, during our meal, there were a few wasps that came down on our table and tried a few meats from our charcuterie board. We let them be and take what they needed but hopefully they are in the midst of controlling the wasps in their terrace.

In the end, we had a great time and it was a nice place to enjoy German wine 😊🍷

reviews.author: Cem Karabay
reviews.text:
Quite crowded at weekend but you can find sits around the shop.

We ordered limonchello, aperol and aperatif plate, these was pretty good. It took €26. I will come again when i visit this part of city.

reviews.author: Alesia Dizpro
reviews.text:
One of favourite places in neighbourhood. Good variety, fear price, kind service. They always have some new positions of natural wine, I highly recommend to try orange ones. I would say this place is well curated, the owner is definitely making a good choice of bottles to serve.

Interior is just how it supposed to look at the old bar :)
CASH AND CARDS PAYMENT 👌
They also have some food: soup of the day, some snacks(chips, olives, etc.), cakes.

reviews.author: Gal Alperovitch
reviews.text: Lovely bar with great drinks in affordable prices

reviews.author: Xhersi Lula
reviews.text: I have been visiting this place for almost 4.5 years now and I can only recommend it. I love this place not only of its great location but also for the best espresso I have tried in Berlin so far, delicious cheesecake and croissants, good wine and great atmosphere overall, especially in the summer in the outdoor area. The staff is friendly and they speak English very well.

reviews.author: Chiaki
reviews.text:
I fully understand that they are busy, but The person on the register was unfriendly, miss-ordered, and do not return change.

Not recommended.

name: Bom aus Portugal - Weinbar und Restaurant

reviews.author: Christian Breitkreutz
reviews.text: Fantastic little Portuguese restaurant. I always wanted to try this place when I lived in Berlin. I had to move away to finally come. I had a great night with tinned fish, Portuguese wine and some snacks. Great service and lovely vibe. Prices are definitely ok. Looking forward to next year‘s Berlin visit.

reviews.author: Nazlı Uysal
reviews.text: My first time here and totally impressed! We had a nice green wine and bachalau and even Ginjinha! Also: Edna was super nice and helpful! This place is one of my favs right now✌🏼

reviews.author: Jaume Estapé
reviews.text: The dishes were  good and service really friendly and generous.

reviews.author: Ekin Gunsan
reviews.text: This place is just the best! The owners are super lovely, I felt like eating at home. He is such a nice person. Thanks so much for making our day better - Also, food was great 🙏😊🥰

reviews.author: The Voyager
reviews.text: Food is very good. The wine of the house it‘s very good too and everything very tasty as well the dessert. The owner of the restaurant is a very nice, friendly and humble person. I recommend to anyone and I‘ll come for sure again.

reviews.author: Zarema Maillan
reviews.text:
a real discovery for all connoisseurs of natural wine! The space of the store immerses you in the atmosphere of coziness and creativity. The stylish interior with elegant posters on the walls and live plants creates a special mood, as if you are in the heart of a wine paradise.
On the shelves there are various bottles with unique labels, which makes the process of choosing wine especially exciting. The assortment is impressive - it seems that everyone will find something to his taste here. In addition, a special care for the quality of the products is felt, emphasizing attention to detail and respect for customers.
The atmosphere of More Natural Wine inspires new wine discoveries and pleasant pastime with friends. This is a place where you want to come back again and again to discover new flavors and enjoy the unique atmosphere.
I recommend it to all lovers of quality and natural wines!

reviews.author: Dyon Schlebos
reviews.text: As a beginning enthusiast of natural wine, this shop was a great starting point to explore the lovely world of natural wines. Chris loves to help you out and with his outstanding knowledge of wines you will walk out with the best (and not the priciest) choice of your taste.

reviews.author: Sofiia Bovtenko
reviews.text: Loved this place! A really well-curated range of natural wines! Chris helped me find the perfect bottle and made the experience feel personal. It’s inspiring to see someone so passionate about what they do.

reviews.author: Cosmin Butnarasu
reviews.text: The reference point for natural wine in Berlin! The shop is located in the vivid Neukölln and is relatively small. However, you will find a wide selection of natural wine from basically all over Europe. And if you don’t know which one to pick, just ask the owner! He is incredibly knowledgeable and friendly. Absolutely recommended 👍🏻👍🏻

reviews.author: Fer W
reviews.text: Amazing selection of natural wines at great prices. The staff is super friendly, helpful, and always ready to give great recommendations. Whether you’re a wine newbie or a connoisseur, this place is a gem. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Raphael Isaac Landzbaum
reviews.text: French wines of the best quality, great beer, good music, and best of all amazing service. Cezary is the best host! He always makes us feel at home. The Markthalle would never be the same without him. He also makes killer Aperol Spritz! They also have nice snacks like salami and cheese platters, olives and peanuts. One of the best locations in Moabit!

reviews.author: Alexandra Paladi
reviews.text:
Cezary is absolutely fantastic.
His warmth, professionalism, and attentive way of working make every visit to Tastavin a true pleasure. I’ve been a regular guest at Tastavin even before getting to know him personally, and after all these years, I’m still incredibly grateful and happy about his hospitality and presence. I would give 5 stars to Cezary alone.

Unfortunately, I had a disappointing experience with another staff member recently, who initially refused to offer me another drink around 23:00, saying, “Why do you need another one? You still have enough.” Only after basically begging was I served. Later, around 23:30, he even started making faces behind my back to my friend. Because of this specific situation, I’m giving 4 stars instead of 5.

I’ll always go back—thanks to Cezary and his amazing hospitality. Thank you Cezary!

reviews.author: Joshua Maners
reviews.text: Stopped in for some wine (also a beer) and the ambiance/staff of the market at night was very pleasant. A lot of energy with all the different restaurants and establishments in action. We sat at a small table in between the bar and pizza place behind. It was a cozy setting and the wine was great. We had a few French wines and then I took a local beer. Definitely recommend this place because you will definitely find something you like.

reviews.author: Andreia Nascimento D'Alessandro
reviews.text: Very cozy place, great wine and very friendly staff. I was there for my birthday with some friends and they were lovely!

reviews.author: Thilo Michael
reviews.text:
This is the best place to drink wine that I know of. I can especially recommend the red Cotes du Rhone! Also, if you need something to eat, you can order a cheese plate with many different types of cheese for only 6 Euros (there is absolutely no reason to not do that)! And the staff is just the best - always friendly and they can tell you everything about their collection of wines.

I cannot recommend this place enough!

reviews.author: Chi (Chi)
reviews.text: We visited and had a drink in our last night stay in Berlin. loved the vibe and appreciated the nice art pieces in the bar. The wine they reco was amazing. also offer non alcoholic wine. Amazed by them serving with Zalto glasses which is very fine. It was a great experience and wonderful night

reviews.author: Sophie Truong Neumann
reviews.text:
Really enjoyed the selection of wine and the delicious small nibbles—both were well thought out and nicely presented.

However, the service could be just a little better. While everything was handled efficiently, a warmer and friendlier approach would have made the experience even more enjoyable.

Overall, a lovely spot with great flavors, just a slight improvement in hospitality would make it perfect!

reviews.author: Stuart Norgett
reviews.text: Very sophisticated without being snobby. If you want somewhere to go that is chilled but not intense in the evening- this is it. Only drank here.

reviews.author: June E
reviews.text:
Little racist Hansel and Gretel. From the moment you sit at the bar, the hostility is palpable. Gretel kept asking with exasperation if I was ready to order food when I had cutlery already with me, since Hansel took my order. Gretel was also obsessed with taking the menu that I was studying from me. Though they had plenty of other copies available for people. When I said I needed to decide my next drink with it, Gretel says, “Oh, you’re having another drink?”

With wine, if you’re not white, they won’t let you taste before a full pour, even if you say you’ll try it first.

When you bring up the different treatment, Hansel will get defensive before hearing you, tell you it’s a problem with your delivery, and that you should have asked to taste first. Although you did. Twice. Hansel says you only get to taste if you order a bottle. You saw the bar full of people being courteously served a taste before their glass. But not you. Even though you asked. Twice.

Food is terrible as well. A joke. Over-salting is their flavouring of choice. Their inspiration, 90’s Jaime Oliver, bless his soul.

This seems to be a place run by another group of try-hard Berliners, resentful of foreigners, wishing they were Parisian, with no awareness of how stupid and racist they come off to global citizens. You have no style whatsoever.

A business that would never make it outside Berlin, with its likewise try-hard followers. Don’t bother giving them a chance.

reviews.author: Fifo
reviews.text:
Love it! Came for the wines and was blown by the food! Make sure you get a little something together with your bottle!

Love the ambient design of the whole place

reviews.author: Dan Siekman
reviews.text: A wonderful shop. Stopped in to pick up a few bottles of German wine to bring back to my home country and Detlef made some excellent recommendations as well as introducing me to some frequent customers so we could taste some wines together. A very pleasant evening. Thank you for your hospitality. I will be back if in Berlin again 👍

reviews.author: Veronika
reviews.text: Love this shop. You can sit inside too, the owner is the best guy in the Kiez. And some tables outside for when it’s sunny.

reviews.author: Daniel Goertz
reviews.text: Super friendly service and an great collection of Wine. Perfect spot to enjoy your wine or an Aperol Spritz in the front of the shop.

reviews.author: Agathe
reviews.text: This is my go to cave, if I want to take a French bottle or have recommendations from the staff. It has a lot of choice, from different countries, and the prices are diverse, so every budget will be satisfied :)

reviews.author: Florian Kraft
reviews.text: Great selection of wines, always very friendly services and a nice atmosphere - I could not really ask for more.

reviews.author: Mariana Veloso
reviews.text:
I celebrated by birthday at Lobby 030 and I have to say it was the best decision!
We had the most wonderful evening with incredible food and excellent service in the most beautiful atmosphere. The planning was super easy and the team at Lobby did their absolute best to adjust the menu and decorations to my ideas and wishes.
I can only recommend stopping by for a glass of wine or hosting bigger celebrations at this locations.
I am already looking forward to my next visit!

reviews.author: Ngo Thai Son
reviews.text: We are here for the very first time and are impressed by the fresh and yummy seafood.  The space is nice designed and still cosy. The prices are very affordable for what you get. We will be back asap and bring our friends for a big seafood brunch!

reviews.author: Zeynep Sağlam
reviews.text:
A very classy ambient, really nice service and food, I really loved it! It has a very distinct atmosphere that is different from Neukolln’s general vibe, and I found it really nice to have a place like this in the heart of Neukolln.
We had mussel flavored Smokey butter, cheese plate and wine, it was extremely delicious. 🤍 I really recommend it:)

reviews.author: Lea Steffan
reviews.text:
The bar has an amazing design, scandic look is welcoming and has a warm atmosphere. The menu is very distinctly chosen and leaves you to choose between a fine selection of  natural wines and conventional wines. I also ordered their seasonal butter with chives and mussels served with a big bun of brioche, which is a very good portion. I also had the anchovies with kumquats which was excellent, very unique!

The service is very nice. They explained the different wines to me and let me try them first. They put a lot of love into what they do so I would recommend it to everyone.

reviews.author: Alexey Venzhega
reviews.text: they cancelled my reservation just 40min before without any alternatives. not a reliable service

reviews.author: Pixa
reviews.text: I was here for a pop-up concert, which was super cool. The drinks were a bit pricey but delicious. Staff was very nice and helpful.

reviews.author: Liam Boyd
reviews.text: Vibey feel to this cosy bar. Made feel at home straight away, waitress went and got a seat for us immediately. Gave me a small taster of beer to make sure I like it aswell. Definitely recommend for a drink and would be great meeting spot for friends.

reviews.author: Eva M
reviews.text: Very sweet and relaxed bar with super friendly owner. I had a Gin Basil Smash and some snacks and felt very well taken care of. Really like to know that there is a relaxed place like this right next to Friedrichstraße. All the best, I’ll be back.

reviews.author: Ana CV
reviews.text:
Gorgeous, chill place. Bartenders were both women.
Great advice and knowledge, the cocktails are really worth it. I had the Berliner Negroni, it was exceptional.
We will come back!

reviews.author: Daniele Krogertaite
reviews.text: Very friendly and welcoming atmosphere, fun people. The bartenders are incredibly cheerful and charismatic didn't regret leaving a tip. AND THE COCKTAILS WERE IMMACULATE AND WORTH THE PRICE. Thank you Berlin🩷

reviews.author: Gamze Kafar
reviews.text: This winery has been my favorite spot for many years, whether I visit alone for a glass of wine or with friends. Stephan, the owner, is incredibly knowledgeable and creates such a warm, welcoming atmosphere. I recently celebrated my birthday here, and the way they prepared the tables and welcomed us made the experience even more special. I have nothing but appreciation for this place and its wonderful team. I truly enjoy every visit and highly recommend it!

reviews.author: Griffin Hanekamp
reviews.text: Excellent wine and great service. I highly recommend the 8-course wine tasting they recently started hosting, it was a great experience. Looking forward to my next visit

reviews.author: sandra khoury
reviews.text: I really enjoy this place. The wine is good and they have a nice variety of snack plus super friendly staff.

reviews.author: Vikram Prakash
reviews.text: If you are a fan of Italian wines do not miss this place. They have a lot of unique wines that are simply not possible to find anywhere else. Sitting outside on a nice sunny day is also an unbeatable experience

reviews.author: Piero D'Onofrio
reviews.text: Great attention for Italian autoctonous grapes. Manager and staff really competent, will suggest you the best choice for your needs and budget. Cozy place, perfect for a quick or slow glass. Good selection of Italian natural wines.

reviews.author: Leo
reviews.text: Honestly, I was expecting so much more from this place based on the positive reviews and that it’s mentioned on the Michelin guide. The plates they are so extremely tiny, for reference the water glass they have was a similar size to the creme brulee dish and the pork belly. The server recommended 3-4 plates for 2 people, so my girlfriend and I started with 3 plates. We got the pork belly, the mushroom creme brulee, and the ravioli. Please do not get the pork belly, they give such a tiny piece, and more than half of the piece is fat. Having some fat on meat gives the fish flavor, but it is not nice to just eat an extremely thick piece of fat. The mushroom creme brulee was sounded really interesting, but it had a very mellow mushroom flavor and was sweet, it was a weird combination. The ravioli was ok, but the pasta dough itself was not great. After finishing those 3 courses, my girlfriend and I were still very hungry, so we ordered the bread, it was the best decision. I honestly don’t think you will get full here unless you order the bread. Overall, the portions are so tiny and the food is just average, I would save your money and go to another restaurant in Berlin. If you are looking for nice recommendations, night kitchen, jomo, and tsomi are all extremely incredible restaurants that give proper portions.

reviews.author: Julia Deufel
reviews.text:
Genuinely fabulous food. My last visit was two years ago and the quality has actually even increased! I remembered Kink for good food and outstanding cocktails but the food was truly delightful this time. I’ll be back much sooner!

As a busy restaurant in Berlin, there could always be more & friendlier staff — but that’s coming from Brits and Americans who have other standards 🙈 For Germany, the service is pretty good 😉

I liked that seasonal asparagus dishes were available. We had a mix of meat dishes which were great but ordered mostly vegetarian — it was the burrata and ravioli that blew us away most. Even the bread and butter are lovely and the oysters were fantastic.

We also enjoyed the cocktails and Petnat (sparkling natural wine)!

reviews.author: Jean Du
reviews.text:
If you want a night out on the town it’s a great spot for drinks and food. Think upscale bar/lounge with restaurant. There’s a live DJ. Setting is modern and chic.

My group and I had some drinks first in the lounge part while our table was being setup and shout out to the maitre’d with the green jacket. Provided us with excellent service and we felt very taken care of. We ordered a round of drinks and I can recommend the penicillin was fresh and sour just very good.
We moved over to the dining area and we were impressed with the overall meal. Highly recommend the Octopus and the special featured truffle pasta. The broccoli starter was also very good. All in all great meal. We then moved back to the lounge bar and had another round of drinks. I’ll say the lounge bar side has better service than the resto side. Overall, service is very attentive and friendly pretty seamless.

The ambience is vibrant and the design of the space is pretty cool with a huge light installation, very open space, high high ceilings.
Great place for a group outing fun place to people watch and have some drinks.

reviews.author: Akin Elkol
reviews.text: One of Berlin’s most aesthetic bars. Great vibes, solid drinks, beautiful crowd, and stylish interior. Didn’t try the food, but most things were top-notch. Only the service could use slight improvement. Nevertheless, highly recommended!

reviews.author: Oksana Taran
reviews.text:
I visited this place during lunchtime today and overall, the experience was disappointing. I’m giving it three stars mainly because the atmosphere was nice, but everything else fell short.

First, the coffee was really bad — I ordered a filter coffee, but it tasted like a low-quality watered-down Americano. We also ordered three dishes: granola, chilaquiles, and eggs benedict. We waited 40 minutes for our food even though the place was less than half full and two of the dishes (granola and chilaquiles) are normally quick to prepare.

The portions were small for the price. The chilaquiles were especially bad — the nacho chips were completely soft and not crispy at all. The granola was just okay.

Overall, the food and service did not justify the wait or the price. The atmosphere was nice, but that’s the only real positive.

reviews.author: Ignacio Gonzalez
reviews.text: Good wines and okay selection. Service a bit caótic. Small place and gets crowded and noisy. The cheese table was nice. A little bit small but pleasant

reviews.author: Natascha T
reviews.text: Amazingly cool and stylish place with great staff. Cheese plate is the best I’ve tried in Berlin so far… And what a playlist!! I haven’t heard Lacrimosa at any bar.

reviews.author: Sayon
reviews.text: Nice cozy place with a VARIETY of wine options — I let my wife choose whose a connoisseur in this case, and I wasn’t disappointed! The ambience is pretty good with nice music, and the people serving are polite and amicable

reviews.author: דני אלטשול
reviews.text:
Delicious local wines, the cheese platter us fantastic, and the ambiance is a perfect underground college vibe without being pretentious.
A bit hard to find, but well worth the schlep.

reviews.author: Dino
reviews.text: The service was a little weird and impolite when I was there. But the good wine and food made up for it

reviews.author: AaronSz
reviews.text:
Stumbled in here with my husband while waiting for our table at a restaurant. We loved it here! The dim lights and dark woods make for a cozy vibe. The staff was very friendly and attentive. And most importantly- Our espresso martinis where delicious! Coming again when I’m in the area!
Thank you!

reviews.author: Lorenzo L
reviews.text:
Gnocco fritto and Lambrusco were super good! And I am from Modena.

The vibes and the people are really nice. I very recommend this place!

reviews.author: Okan Mülkpınar
reviews.text: Loved the beer and olives ahhhhh. Coming back again. Recommended.

reviews.author: Luise Spengler
reviews.text: From the moment you walk in, it feels like a little escape to somewhere warmer and slower- real Italy vibes. The drinks are amazing, the staff super welcoming, and the whole place has this effortless charm you can’t fake. Such a classic!

reviews.author: Maria Eduarda Souza
reviews.text: Amazing place for a beer. Every night crowded (a bit loud). It could have more starters or even food, but in general great

reviews.author: SEVIL E.
reviews.text: Lovely wine bar!

reviews.author: Lylly
reviews.text: This place is perfect for sipping good wine and, if you wish, pairing it with some tasty snacks. For orange wine lovers, you can find them here.

reviews.author: Lady A
reviews.text:
Super cosy wonderful wine bar. There’s a huge selection of wine on offer with descriptions of the flavors and subtleties in each. A small place, but can fit a fair few and a nice outdoor seating area too in warmer months. Beautiful interior design also. The staff are  friendly and helpful too, lending it this nice ‘local’ feel. A cheese and meat platter is available if you’re peckish.
Do give it a visit, it really is a lovely little gem in this area. :)

reviews.author: Darja A.
reviews.text: Visited recently for the first time and I keep coming back! Great selection of wine and amazing owners.

reviews.author: Vedran Pezer
reviews.text:
It’s a decent enough wine bar, but nothing stands out. Platters are a bit small and not really exciting, and wine is a bit on the pricier side. Huge margin on the glasses so I recommend getting a bottle.

Still, everyone was very pleasant, so you won’t really regret coming, but you likely also won’t be looking to come back.

name: La Cantine d'Augusta Käse Restaurant & Wein Bar

reviews.author: Alexander Reiplinger
reviews.text:
Very cute and very French restaurant and shop.
We had the goat cheese toast with salad, cheese fondue and creme brûlée. Additionally two aperitifs.

The goat cheese toast was good, the salad lacked a bit of dressing.
The fondue was delicious and a good amount.
The creme brûlée was also good but not outstanding as the cream had a bit of a "cheesecake" consistency.

Overall, worth a try but for the price (>80€ for two) I don't think I'd go again for a full meal. More for a drink with a cheese platter as they looked really good.

reviews.author: Nidhi S
reviews.text:
Adorable place! We tried the goat cheese toast with salad, cheese fondue, and crème brûlée, paired with two aperitifs.

The goat cheese toast was quite tasty, though I felt the salad could have benefited from a bit more dressing. The fondue was undeniably delicious and offered a satisfying portion. As for the crème brûlée, while it was good, it wasn’t quite memorable—its cream had a texture somewhat of cheesecake.

Overall, the experience was enjoyable and worth a visit, but considering the price (over €80 for two), I might opt for a drink and some of the enticing cheese platters next time instead of a full meal.

reviews.author: Tatiana Zhegulovich
reviews.text:
My favorite place in Berlin! The food is always delicious, the atmosphere cozy, and the service exceptionally friendly. They also have an amazing selection of wines. The crème brûlée is absolutely incredible!
Thank you so much☺️

reviews.author: Quan
reviews.text:
We wanted to try fundu so we found this French restaurant in Germany.

Food: delicious. We ordered fundu for 2 and it was a lot of food for us. He even gave us an extra round of green salad

Services: our waiter spoke 3 languages: German, French, and English. Feel free to speak to him in any other one and he might know. Very friendly.

Drinks: they have a large selection of wine. Beer is also available.

Cheese: yes they are a cheese restaurant. If you want CHEESE, you come to the right place

Location: 1 block away from the subway station

Definitely would come back

reviews.author: Andres Capurro
reviews.text:
Food Quality: was not happy with the fondue. The charcuterie and cheese boards looked very appealing, but the cheese fondue is not a strength here. Cheese felt like it was watered down too much, and we were given stale bread for it. When we asked, they said that the hard bread was for fondue. Never have i ever had hard bread served with fondue before.

Portions: it was a decent amount of cheese.

Drinks: options of wines to pair with the cheeses and regular softdrinks.

Price: $$-$$$ a bit pricy for what i felt was not a real cheese fondue. Have had much better.

Service: staff was friendly. Always ready to assist. Except when requesting fresh bread. It was given, but with an attitude.

Atmosphere: cozy cute place.

Highlights: im sure the other non fondue plates are very good. They looked amazing.

Things to improve: bread and fondue need work. Chocolate volcano would pair much better with some vanilla ice-cream.

Payment Method: cc, cash

reviews.author: Caroline Whiteley
reviews.text: Cute, cozy place with good lighting, great food and immaculate vibes. Celebrated my birthday with a couple of friends. We ordered almost the entire menu, and it was divine: fresh, seasonal ingredients with a creative twist.

reviews.author: ariel steinfeld
reviews.text: Wine was good, more expensive than other good wine bars I've attended. The basics were great- bread with amazing butter and cheese with a special plum sauce. But pretty much everything else was disappointing. The more expensive dishes were just not worth the hype, and the service was not very good. I had a nice time but will not return.

reviews.author: Mattia
reviews.text: Got there without a reservation, it was full hey we were lucky. The waiter was funny and had a great humor which made it very enjoyable. The menu is interesting, prices are o k. I feel like some portions were a little too small, of course the bread was fantastic. Just not quite sure the dishes are fully made to share, as again some of them are… very tiny. Not to be confused with minimalistic, as all dishes are very creative.

reviews.author: Frederic Dimmers
reviews.text: Positively surprised by the outstanding quality of the food, there was not a single miss (and we ordered almost the entire menu). We especially enjoyed the roastbeef, the hamachi and the celeriac. Would have loved some more options for wines by the glass, but still, the selection was good. Will definitely come back!

reviews.author: Michael Pomarico
reviews.text:
Our second time here. Worth the return trip. I can say we will for sure return again.

Our wine recommendation was wonderful.

We ordered a variety of small plates. The mussels, braised cabbage and pork belly were stand outs, superbly prepared.

Dessert was a wonderful pumpkin seed ice cream on a pastry like base. It totally satisfied my sweet tooth!

Highly recommend, must go.

reviews.author: Kiara Dunarova
reviews.text: We visited this bar over the week and it was a fantastic choice. The atmosphere was cozy, the drink selection was impressive, and the staff was genuinely friendly. Cocktails were expertly mixed, and the music was at a perfect volume—great for chatting and relaxing. We’ll definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Mina Tahaei
reviews.text: Amazing atmosphere, delicious drinks and a super friendly service. Very inclusive with great music and DJ, one of the best gay bars in Berlin to visit. Absolutely recommend;)

reviews.author: Ming Cheng
reviews.text: We traveled Berlin for 3 days and have spent 2 nights here. It’s a perfect bar to date. Wonderfully cozy space. Great drinks, and very decent dancing room with DJ sometimes. The staffs are incredibly kind and friendly. Definitely will visit again when travel to Berlin next time. Recommend to everyone.

reviews.author: Samuel Stresnak
reviews.text: Great bar with a chill vibe. Drinks are tasty, staff are friendly, and the music’s always good. Good spot to relax or hang out with friends.

reviews.author: Jack Wilkin (Jacktassium)
reviews.text: checked out this bar on a Friday night and loved it. The staff were super friendly and welcoming, LOVED the drinks, and the inside feels fancy and inviting. Would love to come back when visiting the city

reviews.author: Erica Vambell
reviews.text: I was staying in the neighborhood and in the mood for a glass of wine and am so glad I found this wine shop! The owner was very kind and helpful and he showed me some different kinds of wine to try. He was also very friendly and I really enjoyed chatting with him. Would definitely recommend this shop to anyone!

reviews.author: Steinar Widding
reviews.text: High quality wineshop with an interesting and wide selection of wines for moderate prices. Accommodating and nice owner(?) who took his time to discuss optional wines as I didn’t search for specific wines but had a more exploring agenda especially for german wines. Well worth a visit for the wine interested audience as for the connoisseurs, I guess. Will definitely revisit this place. Recommended.

reviews.author: Ariane Berthoin Antal
reviews.text: We are delighted to have discovered Weinmoral! The selection of wines is diverse but not overwhelming, so it is fun to explore the range and choose a bottle or two or more. The owners know the vineyards personally and share their knowledge in a natural and helpful way. We enjoyed bringing friends to taste different wines before dinner, then took home a bottle of each kind we liked most. The prices are definitely fair.

reviews.author: David Carasso
reviews.text: Pashionate, Sophisticated and knoledgefull.  Its about enjoying the process

reviews.author: Brayn Stellmacher
reviews.text: Good shop.

reviews.author: Lylly
reviews.text: Wide selection of wines, which can be tasted on-site paired with dishes. I chose the cheese board. Excellent quality. The atmosphere is a bit static, which I didn’t enjoy.

reviews.author: Ondrej
reviews.text: Decent wine bar to grab a bottle. Just pick one off the shelf. Drinking on premise is double the retail price, but 50 EUR max, so you will not break the bank by going with a higher end wine. Salami and cheese plates were ok. I personally have an issue with machine made wine glasses, so hand blown glassware would be a nice touch.

reviews.author: Chlams Alt
reviews.text:
Good wine store/bar. The product selection ranges from easy drinks to more complex flavours, and it has something for every budget. The owner is very knowledgeable about his stock and more than willing to share that knowledge with his customers.

Unlike most wine bars in Berlin, they are able to cool any bottle within 10 minutes, so you can choose to have any wine you like instead of being limited to what’s already in the bar’s fridge. Definitely recommend visiting it.

reviews.author: Marina Dedova
reviews.text: Perfect place to have a glass of good wine or grab a bottle of something very special for home. The owner is very passionate and knowledgeable about wines. Was pleasure to talk with! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: S H
reviews.text: Great selection. I appreciate corkage needs to be paid but a flat rate makes more sense than doubling the price of the bottle. Didn’t appreciate that.

reviews.author: michelle mak
reviews.text: Simon is an amazing host and bartender. He serves us with a smile even when the bar is closing and make us feel welcome, worth all the trip to visit from Asia!

reviews.author: Xander Lim
reviews.text: Super chill wine place! Awesome company by the staffs! After moving to Germany for 2 months this was by far the most comfortable hangout so far! 😛🍷🍾🍶

reviews.author: Nelia Bach
reviews.text:
We had wine tasting with Das. Very charismatic and enthusiastic. Gave us a lot of good pairings for the different wines as well as suggestions for other ones we should try. All in all a very fun evening.
The wine tasting comes with cheese, bread, nuts and fruits.

reviews.author: Luke Robinson
reviews.text:
Fantastic little find last night, great wines at great prices and the staff and customers we all very friendly.

Our sommelier was super helpful, friendly and fun to chat too, knowledgeable and full of recommendations.

Would highly recommend a stop here, away from the hustle and bustle.

reviews.author: Klaara Nieminen
reviews.text: Room no. 5.5 is a pleasant surprise in otherwise busy Manifesto, offering a peaceful environment to enjoy some wine. For a wine bar it is very approachable thanks to the superbly friendly staff and their not-so-fussy attitude. The wine was tasty but a bit on the expensive side considering the small pouring.

reviews.author: Nicole Patane
reviews.text:
A Hidden Gem for Wine Lovers 🍷
Great selection, cozy atmosphere, and super knowledgeable staff. Perfect spot for a relaxing glass or discovering something new. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Rodrigo Sua
reviews.text: Amazing wine, music and tapas. Come see it before it becomes too popular.

reviews.author: Iri P
reviews.text:
Vincent Weinstudio is a gem of a wine bar in Berlin. The ambiance is cozy and inviting. Their wine selection is impressive. The host Emilliano is friendly and knowledgeable, always ready to help you find the perfect wine. He speaks Spanish, English and German.

Overall, Vincent Weinstudio is the perfect spot for a relaxed evening with friends or a romantic date. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Jan
reviews.text:
Amazing wines.
Service was impeccable!

reviews.author: Martin Osman
reviews.text: Very friendly owner, he helped me to choose the right wine! If you want to choose a special one, this is the place! Thank you Emiliano!

reviews.author: Dmitry Polozov
reviews.text: That is my third beer garden in Berlin, and I believe it is the best one. First of all, it is big yet cozy. There are plenty of shaded areas for lunch during the summer.
