Secondly, it is located not in a park but in the city center. The place is really nice, and the beer is extremely good. The service is fast and friendly. You can also enjoy traditional bratwurst along with sauerkraut and chicken with potatoes. The most unexpected delight is the wonderful pretzel. I have never had a better pretzel. I would love to come back here in the evening; I bet the atmosphere is magical.

reviews.author: Kalpana K
reviews.text: Visited this place on Monday afternoon. I knew it will be empty but to my surprise there were few people having the beer in quiet environment, enjoying themselves and having nice conversations. We asked the people working there and they said Mondays are like this. But I really like the beer. Would love to go here over weekend to see the louder ambiance.

reviews.author: Corey Chapman
reviews.text: Prater Beer Garden is a large and expansive beer garden in East Berlin. There are tons of tables and plenty of mature trees for shade. They have several beers available which are all great. Food and Bavarian Pretzels are also available. The food and beer are both great. Prater is good spot to relax and enjoy the city.

reviews.author: Jase Houia
reviews.text: Fantastic venue, great beer, delicious food. Spent a really enjoyable Fri evening here. Would highly recommend to anyone wishing to experience a super relaxed  beer garden

reviews.author: Margot
reviews.text: Excellent beer garden in East Berlin. Huge place with tons of seats and tables, ideal for large groups. Food and drinks are good, pets are welcome. The staff is friendly and welcoming. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Karl Finke
reviews.text: Great beer garden. The food is good and not generic, the meat is often organic or raised humanely, and the staff is nice too, despite their workload. It's a little expensive but so are most beer gardens with worse food. Drinks are a nice selection too.

reviews.author: Asli Baysalli
reviews.text: Lovely beer garden in a central location. We came here with our kids some years ago. I'm glad to have found it again. I had vegetable soup, which was very delicious. I didn't try the desserts but they sure looked yummy.

reviews.author: Peter THORN
reviews.text: This is a German beer garden as we can imagine it. Heaps of people tonight... it was completely full. The food is quickly served and well done. It is typical beer garden food, simple and filling. The beer is excellent... I took the weissbeer. The service is very friendly and open to conversation. The outside atmosphere is outstanding and worth the visit in itself. Enjoy

reviews.author: Edwin Karlsson
reviews.text: Food is fantastic, with really exceptional portions as well. Wide selection of beer and the apfelschorle is excellent! There is a very large assortment of tables, but if you're a larger group definitely send someone to find a table a half hour before your party arrives. Delicious!

reviews.author: tom ber
reviews.text:
I had a Schleusensalad (goat cheese incl.) Food was yummy and the service very polite. Highly recommend for summer lunch (like the one I had).
You're ordering at the kantor window, getting your own drinks at the same time, but tell them your table number so the waiter will serve your food to your chosen spot 😎

reviews.author: Luka Grgurić
reviews.text: A classic biergarten — nice place to hang out with friends, but nothing that really sets it apart from others. The food was pretty basic with a limited selection, and for what you get, the prices felt a bit high.

reviews.author: Leona van Diest
reviews.text:
Great place to visit. The ambiance is fun, the beer tastes good and the bathrooms are clean. Wonderful place to sit with your friends and play some games. It’s self service.

I would say the food looked a bit dry and tasteless, so I didn’t try it myself.

reviews.author: S Hassan
reviews.text: It's a really nice beer garden tucked inside Victoria park. Large enough to just walk in on most days. It has ground floor seating, sofas ans even a couple of swings which is really cool. They have an upper floor too with an additional small bar if you want to take in the sunshine. They serve food and have a indoor eating space as well. Service is quiet slow though, and lacking music to create a bit of an atmosphere. It's great for groups or when you want to chill and talk.

reviews.author: Angelika Schreiner
reviews.text: Nice people, nice food, nice atmosphere. Well it’s more than that. Everything in our lives is nice but this place deserves special credit for the friendly people at the BBQ and the quality of the food. I mean 5€ for this perfectly grilled Dorade with the salad is just more than justified, Frey, tasty food, what else do you want? I’ll be back on my next visit to the city I have been born in!

reviews.author: Farhad Qazi
reviews.text: A great Biergarten with the family. It's location adjacent to the playground is perfect for a family day out. The food is great as are the libation. The staff speaks English and are extremely friendly and professional. Highly recommended for a fun day out in Berlin town.

reviews.author: Laura Sellars
reviews.text: Really enjoyed it here in the far end of the Tiergarten, really relaxed place with lots of outdoor seating by the lake. A few huge cold beers and a pizza to share. Pizza was thin crust, light and full of flavour. Really enjoyed it.

reviews.author: Christina Economidou Pieridou
reviews.text: Absolutely worth a visit while in Berlin! A serene environment, in the middle of the park. The lake was beautiful and the atmosphere was very calming and relaxing. The food options were basic but very tasty and clean. It's great for all the family!

reviews.author: Annemarie Koppenaal
reviews.text:
Highly recommended: what a great beer garden in Tiergarten! Such a relaxed atmosphere, friendly staff and good quality food & drinks 🍽️🥂🍻🍹
We are a family of 6 on summer holidays in Berlin. Thoroughly enjoyed this place with its beautiful setting in the Neuen See. Spend a whole summer evening here: drinks, bites, dinner, playing cards, reading books and enjoyed the vibe!

reviews.author: Linh Nguyễn Diệu
reviews.text:
We visited this venue for our best friend’s wedding. The location itself is truly impressive — set beside a large lake, spacious and airy, with a beautiful view. However, the food was absolutely dreadful. Shockingly overpriced and worse than what you'd get at IKEA.

The tomato soup was watery, bland, and served cold. The salad was just a plate of plain greens with a lonely slice of carrot — no dressing, no flavor whatsoever. My husband ordered the steak, which came stone-cold, sitting sadly on the plate with a few beans and four tiny potato wedges. I had the pan-fried salmon, which was also cold and terribly tasteless. Honestly, it was the worst meal I’ve had since moving to Germany.

For the price they charge, the quality was unacceptable. We will definitely not be returning.

reviews.author: Anouska Bertram
reviews.text: We went for the self service option and not the actual restaurant/cafe. The setting and atmosphere is lovely right by the lake. The food was the worst food I’ve had in Berlin. The bratwurst had clearly been sitting there for days, it was dry and inedible. The half a roast chicken again was massively over cooked and dry. Doesn’t come with any gravy or sauce so just dry over cooked chicken. 2 chickens, and a bratwurst with 3 drinks and a pretzel cake to 60 euros. Will never eat here again, worst food ever.

reviews.author: Juliette Brown
reviews.text:
Big beer garden, perfect for big groups… we were a big group of 22 people and there was more than enough space for all of us. Or tables big enough for the whole group to sit together.

Service was not bad and so was the food. Food is self service.
Overall it’s a nice place to chill.

reviews.author: Deniz Öztürk
reviews.text:
It's a place that always offers fun and unique concepts together.
Prices are around the Berlin average — neither cheap nor expensive.
You can enjoy delicious pizzas here.
The fact that they only accept card payments is, in my opinion, an advantage for customers.
You should be careful not to bring full liquid bottles inside.

You can find their weekly or monthly programs and concepts on their website.
It can be even more fun, especially during the summer days.

reviews.author: Anh Mura
reviews.text:
Great place. Big beet garden which will turn into a night club with different floors, pop, house, techno
If you come early, you don't need to pay entry and no queue.

reviews.author: Onkar Gaikwad
reviews.text: Fantastic spot! Birgit gives you that unique Berlin vibe with a creative theme park twist. The upcycled interiors are super cool—crafted from all sorts of repurposed items, just like you’d find in Berlin’s trendiest bars and clubs. It's always buzzing with people, and the food is both tasty and affordable. We had a great time here as a group—definitely a must-visit!

reviews.author: David E.A. (Pacotilla)
reviews.text: Super nice place and atmosphere. Live music with good singers, open air, was a really nice experience. Delicious Pizza and top friendly people working there

reviews.author: Mighty Manotas
reviews.text:
Habla Manotas,
Huge choice of beers, +-20. The food is really good although more pricey than average. The music is just great. The garden looks more like a modern village with tables and benches and a big screen and some lounge chairs.
Although the service is not great fastest it is friendly.
Because of all that you might spend quite a few nice hours there.
All in all this is definitely my favorite brewery in Berlin. You must see it to get the whole picture.
This place is suitable for all ages and every kind of gatherings.
I might be wrong, but from what I remember it's not suited for people on wheel chairs.

reviews.author: Joe Farley
reviews.text: Lovely place. Amazing scenery. Beautiful Pints. Finger Licking food. What more could you possible want from an outdoor beer and food garden. Would 100% recommened for a trip out to Berlin. Perfect sunset location. 10/10 would recommend.

reviews.author: A. S.
reviews.text: Nice beer garden and great chance to taste local BRLO beer. We tried the “Berliner Weisse with Sirup”, a traditional and refreshing way to enjoy sour beer in Berlin. Cool location in repurposed shipping containers and tasty, creative bar food. Great spot for craft beer lovers.

reviews.author: Kim Norbye
reviews.text: Amazing experience and great service, beer and food. I can highly recommend this place for groups and families. Situated on the middle of a park you have access to both playgrounds and the brewery.

reviews.author: Tim
reviews.text: We had a blast! The staff were the BEST, they treated us like family. The food was excellent, be sure to try the pork ribs. My favorite was there IPA. Thanks for making our visit to your establishment such a memorable event. We will see you again at Christmas. Much love!

reviews.author: Wendy
reviews.text: Lovely biergarten with people of all ages; our family of four felt perfectly comfortable. The service was good and the drinks well-made! We really enjoyed the current food - Venezuelan arepas are this week’s seasonal fare, and they were fresh and really delicious. We have a feeling that no matter the street food on offer in any given week, you’ll enjoy it!

reviews.author: Ondřej Pavlíček
reviews.text: this is one of my favourite places in Berlin. there are usually around three beers on tap, with many more available in bottle.

reviews.author: Rad Dockery
reviews.text: A very cool spot in Berlin. Easy to get to. Easy to find.  And so oh much fun. The beer selection was great.  One of the better beer garden atmospheres you will find. Really liked  the staff.  Will be back

reviews.author: Adam
reviews.text: Tried a freshly pulled blonde ale here, it was really refreshing on a hot summer night. Great atmosphere, loved the bus they'd converted. Lots of young Berliners having fun here.

reviews.author: Wesley Van Bommel
reviews.text:
Really nice atmosphere where you know you'll be allowed to get in, unlike most part of Berlin.
You feel really much included, no matter what you wear, say or think. That's what Berlin should be about.

Lots of love for Republic Berlin!❤️

reviews.author: Diana P. A.
reviews.text: Currywurst mit Pommes was really good! There’s no service though, you have to pick your food at the counter (self-service, buffet style) and the people there are not friendly if you’re a tourist 🥲

reviews.author: Jen Ritter
reviews.text: The restaurant had the most delicious and well prepared food! The atmosphere inside was very relaxed and elegant. The staff was very friendly and welcoming. Will eat here again! The beef dinner was cooked just perfect-as was the lox dinner!

reviews.author: Jon Kernow
reviews.text: Great self-service Beergarden. Reopened in June under new ownership. 2 minutes walk from the ferries and the station.

reviews.author: Ozge Aygul
reviews.text:
I visited this place with two friends and unfortunately had an unpleasant experience with the chicken dish we ordered. We encountered some health issues afterward, which we suspect might be related to the food. It's important for businesses to prioritize food safety, and we hope the management takes this feedback seriously to ensure the well-being of their customers.

Note: I did have to give 5 stars as my comment was deleted.

reviews.author: Dorothy Lei
reviews.text: Good environment, average local German food but pricy, honestly.

reviews.author: Parakrama Jayasinghe
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing food and service. The star of the whole experience is the Fraulein at the front desk. See attached photo. Her service is impeccable. The food is equally amazing. The pork knuckle is to die for. The roast pork in beer sauce is equally fantastic. Well worth the two visits we made here

reviews.author: Dave Khoo
reviews.text:
I was looking for genuine German food around my hotel & was pointed to this place by the tourist office at the main train station.
It was right be the River Spree & consist of not just a restaurant but also a large biergarten, I was not expecting much but the din from the place before I reached it told me that I would not be disappointed. It was rather crowded but the friendly staff was able to offered me a seat high table.
I ordered a beer, a vegetable soup & the pork knuckle. The beer came quickly, the soup a little while later & not outstanding.
The pork knuckle came after quite a while (they already pre-warned me) & it was served with some kind of mashed potato & sauerkraut & they worked wonderfully together.
Benjamin, the owner, roamed around entertaining the guest & spoke to me as well telling me that they also have a basement area which they would used as restaurant space in the winter.

reviews.author: Katja Mahelatova
reviews.text:
Very local and delicious restaurant.
It was pretty close to central station and intercity hotel.
We were lucky to just attend it without booking in advance.
Food and beers were really good, so the atmosphere and service.

reviews.author: Rina Feast (That’s How We Feast)
reviews.text: Zollpackhof is a fantastic spot with a great Bavarian-style atmosphere! 🍻🇩🇪 While they serve traditional Bavarian dishes, they also offer Currywurst, adding a nice touch to the menu. We highly recommend the Schnitzel and the assortment sharing dish—perfect for a fun and delicious meal with friends. The service was friendly, and a big plus is that they welcome dogs! A great place to enjoy good food and a lively ambiance. 🍽️🐶✨

reviews.author: Vicky and Dave Edwards
reviews.text:
Lovely authentic Bavarian / German pub.
We enjoyed dinner and some excellent beers.
The staff were very helpful and I'd recommend.

reviews.author: Emiliya G.
reviews.text: Super chill spot to enjoy craft beer🍺 on the hot day, you can also rent a boat and go for a ride on Spree or enjoy the bio ice cream at their Eisdiele🍦

reviews.author: LL. MG
reviews.text: A really nice place to enjoy warm summer nights. They offer typical drinks for a biergarten and also some food. I really liked the loaded fries!

reviews.author: Jakob W. Plummer
reviews.text:
Go for the vibes!
Huge park.
Such a beautiful snapshot of Berlin.
Highly recommend for tourists too.

reviews.author: Daniel Cole
reviews.text: It’s great there’s something great in the park, and in the summer the drink selection is spot on - but it’s still hit and miss with terrible service. We were served re-fried fries - and when someone else also complained about this they were shouted at. The beer was also flat.

reviews.author: Paulina S
reviews.text:
LNestled in the stunning surroundings of Treptower Park, this beer garden is a true oasis for anyone looking to enjoy a leisurely lunch or dinner in the heart of nature. With plenty of seating and a sprawling space, it’s the perfect spot to relax, soak in the greenery, and enjoy some good food with a side of fresh air.

The classic breaded fish was a highlight – crispy on the outside, tender and flavorful on the inside. It’s a simple dish done right, and it hit the spot perfectly. For those leaning towards a lighter option, the veggie bowl was fresh and light, though it could have used a bit more punch in the flavor department. Still, the ingredients were top-notch, and it made for a refreshing meal.

What really sets this place apart, however, is the atmosphere. The combination of lush nature, live music, and the nearby ice cream shop makes for a perfect day out. Whether you’re here for a casual lunch or an early dinner, the vibe is just right – relaxed, friendly, and full of life.

reviews.author: Arif Karahaliloglu
reviews.text: All is good, atmosphere, food etc but we have to wait like 30min for the beer. If you don’t have the capacity, you shouldn’t advertise so much or increase the beer service. Beer was also not cold enough that we had to put some ice.

reviews.author: Konstantin Durant
reviews.text: Great place, good beer and live music. What else do you want for summer day?

reviews.author: Johannes Koch
reviews.text: A teenage punk rock band, great beer just the right side of cold, a chilled out crowd and some random games for the kiddos, booya. Need I say more? It's a shame this is only temporary but that makes it all the more enjoyable.

reviews.author: Ana S
reviews.text: The place is nice, and the beer is good. But we were waiting for a beer in line of 5 people more than 20 minutes because the girl on a bar was completely drunk and high, so it took her so long to poor beer while she was walking back and forth to find the glasses which was next to her …

reviews.author: Rebecca B
reviews.text: One of my favourite biergartens, super great location, lots of live music, great drinks. Totally recommend.

name: Augustiner auf Bötzow / Wirtshaus und Biergarten

reviews.author: Kyrylo Sledz
reviews.text: Augustiner auf Bötzow is a great new traditional German restaurant with super tasty food and fresh beer on tap. It’s located in the new Bötzow campus, which has a big, open area and a huge terrace – definitely a big plus! The atmosphere is relaxed and way more enjoyable than the crowded, touristy spots in the city. Perfect place to enjoy classic dishes and a cold beer in peace.

reviews.author: edgar andriasyan
reviews.text: The food and beer were very tasty. The girl who served us was very professional, smiley, and spoke great English. There were lots of Germans around us so felt authentic. Recommended!

reviews.author: Andrea Fiori
reviews.text: Beautiful modern beer garten on top of a newly built office space. Great beer and plenty of open air space. We enjoyed the curry wurst too!

reviews.author: Mike Savage
reviews.text:
To look at the photo I uploaded the food looks pretty good. However on consumption it was a different affair. The vegan Currywurst was utterly horrible. The fries limp and pathetic and the Bratwurst we ordered was raw on the inside as it was quickly cooked. We didn't finish either meal. The place is still under construction, infested by wasps and overall an unenjoyable experience despite the staff being friendly and attentive.

Hopefully in time this place will get better as it becomes more established, but my experience wasn't one that makes me want to return.

reviews.author: Carlos Eduardo Rührwiem
reviews.text: Not a bad place. Food was alright and the beer is obviously good. But the service was sometimes kinda rude and mocking the bad German. But what annoyed me the most was charging 3.5€ on a glass of tap water. He asked if we wanted big. I said small. And then he said he only had big. What the hell. Why ask for size if you only have one? So easy to fix and so disappointing.

reviews.author: Jana Par
reviews.text: We were here for the ESC viewing party and had a lot of fun! The drinks were priced reasonably, they had an extensive drinks menu and the atmosphere was great. Definitely would consider coming back next year.

reviews.author: Yvette Wrigley
reviews.text: Great music performance in an amazing venue space with super friendly staff and tasty pizza and spoonful ice cream 🍨

reviews.author: Anna Marrack
reviews.text: Beer tastes good. Love such hidden places with loft touch!

reviews.author: Ellen John
reviews.text: We had a party here and had drinks and pizza at the bar. The pizza was good and they even offered customised options suitable for vegetarisch and meat lovers alike. The place has a nice vibe and foosball table too.

reviews.author: Olga Parsons
reviews.text: Revier Südost used to be my one of fave events’ area in Berlin , and I was excited to visit the biergarten today. We arrived 13:45. I checked the website for opening hours (Sat from 12), as well as the big banner and the door sign confirmed it should be open from 12. It was dead as a dodo. No number to call to check. We waited until ~2pm, and then a sound engineer came out, who  told us that no one is in at the moment and it should e open later (no idea when).. really disappointing, especially after 20km cycling deliberately to get there.

reviews.author: Anand Govindan-Ravi
reviews.text: Nice place to hangout, host parties and chill with friends. Improvement can be made in areas of : reservation, hostess to show the table, better lines for the drinks and cleaner toilet facilities.

reviews.author: Tub McGhee
reviews.text: A real shame. lovely atmosphere. The bald chef is an obnoxious man who gaslighted us into thinking we ordered a different pizza when we ordered a vegetable one. It took 30 mins at least to receive half a pizza when the menu doesn't state it. The front of house girl was amazing, patient and calm. Shame about the man

reviews.author: Stephanie Mihova
reviews.text: Be aware this place deletes negative reviews and threatens legal action for posting them. My boyfriend‘s review was deleted because of this. Be wary of the high rating as this place is not great. They don’t hold table bookings and the staff is rude and unhelpful. The atmosphere is nice but nothing exceptional. Food is just okay. The staff attitude makes this a place to avoid.

reviews.author: Filippo Ragusa
reviews.text: The space is really nice, friendly environment. There is also a really good pizzeria, the pizza was absolutely amazing. You have to definitely try it.

reviews.author: Michelle Dannenberg
reviews.text: Very cosy beergarden, tucked away from the busy street. Nice atmosphere, Sarti Spritz could have been a big bigger. Without the ice it wouldn't have filled a small wine glass for 7.50€...

reviews.author: Shahab Nahrevanian
reviews.text:
Food is average,, 3 stars is already too much for it. Basically boiled potatoes, boiled Spargel, Rührei , and hollandaise sauce for 26€ . No creativity whatsoever.
Service is good and fast. Problem with card payment because their system was too slow. Wi-Fi didn't work either, therefore 4 stars.
The atmosphere looks good. 4 stars for that.
Overall 4 stars

reviews.author: StewartGerard
reviews.text: Great tasty classic German restaurant with a nice interior. All the classics are here and the staff is kind and friendly as well which I’d you know berlin service staff this is a rare treat! Enjoy!

reviews.author: Michael S
reviews.text:
Surprising find. Friendly service. Very down to earth German "Kneipe" but nice tablecloths, super soups and hope to come back for good sounding/looking food and beergarden in summer

Update: came back but food was a bit disappointing. Rindsroulade (a classic) at 28€ had soggy cabbage & potatoes, with hard meat (clue: added knife) but sauce was great. Apple cake looked better than it tasted. Beers were so-so

reviews.author: Monika Csonka
reviews.text: I had dinner at the beer garden section of the Alter Krug and I had a great time. I ordered Schnitzel, nothing special, but it was good. I would recommend to come here for the cosy atmosphere in the summer time. The cuisine of the restaurant is mostly German, but this week's menu had BBQ burgers also, so make sure to check their website before your visit.

reviews.author: Anthony Mac
reviews.text: I ordered the Wiener Schnitzel but apparently the cook lost his hammer because what i got had not been pounded thin but was a thick piece of meat. I was too engaged in conversation to say anything but really you'd think the waitress would have said something.

name: TEMPEL GARTEN
address: Columbiadamm, Tempelhofer Feld, Gebäude 462, 12049 Berlin, Germany

reviews.author: Nikolai Mannsfeld
reviews.text: Great place to hangout. I had a fun time here while talking with some of my friends here. The food, especially the bratwurst, was delicious. However, it took forever to get the food. But the staff, at least, were very apologetic about it, and were nice the entire time we were here. The drinks were refreshing though. Other than that, still a great place to hangout with some people while drinking some fresh beer or soda!

reviews.author: Yannick Solandt
reviews.text: Great location for a slightly more pricey beer. Great spot in templehof.

reviews.author: Selcan Ö.
reviews.text: Very nice beer garden! Prices ok. Card payment possible. Fast Food available like fries and Bratwurst. Toilets near by. Seating with shadow. Lot of green space around. Kids friendly. Nice spot to hang out in an open air bar with friends.

reviews.author: Kosmodiah
reviews.text: we had an amazing company event - the location and my event manager, viola, really went above and beyond - we had a great time, highly recommend tempelgarten!

reviews.author: carolina wilson
reviews.text:
The location is great and has a really nice atmosphere! It’s dog-friendly, with nearby toilets, which makes it convenient and comfortable.

However, the downside was the service time — there was a long queue to order, and the wait for food was even longer. I ordered just a portion of French fries, and it took over 20 minutes to arrive… and I mean, it was just fries.

Overall, a pleasant spot, but be prepared for a bit of a wait and to over pay a little bit as well.

reviews.author: Lorenzo Fundaró
reviews.text: I celebrated my birthday here and reservation experience was perfect, I just did it online and tables were reserved exactly like I asked to. Once there, they give you armbands that you can give to your guests so they can consume without any issues. Setting the budget with the team was easy. Staff was very friendly, food and alcohol was very good.

reviews.author: Ivka
reviews.text: Location ist ok but it's too expensive. We paid 2 drinks coca cola and Aperol 14 Euros. Not even coke in the bottle.

reviews.author: Walk with Jonas
reviews.text:
Great location and atmosphere. Really chilled and sunny. Prices for the fries a little steep IMO.
Now the next point can be a plus or a minus depending on your preferences: no meat option for the Currywurst available, only vegan Currywurst.

reviews.author: camille sanchez
reviews.text:
Very nice Biergarten, with a unique aesthetic style.
a lot of place and a various menu between drinks and food.
the place is kids and dogs friendly.

reviews.author: Amit lehavi
reviews.text:
good atmosphere to meet with friends, have a drink or two and enjoy a nice burger..
the food quality is ok though in my opinion.. not bad but I have much better burgers in my life. the service was through a counter which was also problematic due to fact that if you have some issue you need to wlk there and it is not a small place.
but still as far as it goes, the place is very hospitable for large groups and friends for friendly talks and good beer

reviews.author: Nea Barabea
reviews.text: Beautiful spot in the middle of the markets! Nice place to stop and freshen up with a cold beer and then continue on the markets!

reviews.author: Prachi Kumari
reviews.text:
Too crowded, limited food options, long queue for beer or maybe we went there on a wrong day.
Nice vibe.

reviews.author: Γιώργος Σταματιάδης
reviews.text: I didn't eat food and it was self-service so how bad can it be. But the atmosphere was amazing. And there is a skatepark too so if you like skateboarding you can skate there or just watch. Also there is a  bouldering wall if you like climbing or just want to try but be careful although it's not high there is no equipment. I think is an amazing place for summer evenings

reviews.author: Cor Cater
reviews.text:
It’s not often that I start my reviews from the state or the bathroom backward, but it you visit nothing else about Cassiopeia than the bathroom you’ve already had a noteworthy Berlin experience.

It’s both plastered in stickers outlining sets of progressive politics, while also being surprisingly clean for loos that are also used by the night club.

The terrace itself is great, sunny after 1200 and with a wide beer selection. The added bonus being the outdoor climbing hall, so if you’re board of your company you can just see a set of very brave and very ripped people scale up a bunch of small steps with a rope

Loved the diversity of the crowd and how distinct the entire set up felt to Berlin

reviews.author: BestByBoris (Supertaster)
reviews.text:
Really nice venue, with a cool long bar, to have a drink and watch people.
The service is pretty slow and because you pay a deposit for your glass, you have to get back in line and wait again 😖
( I understand about the safety measures with the glasses, which you respond about below, but you can arrange that better :-) For instance have a separate place to return the glasses quick, if you don't need another drink ;-) )
The mimosa was ok, not a real good one. The apple juice was a regular one (not cloudy).

reviews.author: Sungyu Yun
reviews.text: Nice atmosphere and drinks. You can enjoy music of buskers near the restsurant. I recommend just to drink drinks instead of ordering food together, if you wanna know the reason then try the food.

reviews.author: Daniel Lama
reviews.text:
Very nice corner to be hanging out alone or in company, the tram to Sisyphos goes right beside the Bar so it´s pretty cool to go have a drink before the party.

Went for the expresso martini ($11 euros each) which were extremely delicious.

Didn´t try the food.

reviews.author: aria soroushi
reviews.text: We had great time there and even got back with more people. We had an honor to be served with lovely smiely lady and she took our orders. Usually you do not need any rearvation. Even she was offering us some choices which was really nice. Inside is a huge place for events as well. I really liked that place.

reviews.author: Jonathan Preuss
reviews.text:
Why not have a beer from the oldest brewery in the world? They’ve been brewing since 1040!! 😳
The food portions are outrageous! If you leave hungry, it’s definitely your own fault. Worth a stop if you’re passing by. Hackescher Markt is amazing all on its own.

reviews.author: Jamie Leach
reviews.text:
This place has a great outdoor seating area.
The waiter was polite and fun to talk to.

We had 3 drinks: 2 Pepsi  and a bottle of water.

The reason for my 2 star review was the price.

For 3 soft drinks we were expecting the total to be around €6-€10.
The total was €19!! Which is an insane price for 3 soft drinks.

The waiter also asked do we want to add some Euros on to the bill for tip.

We of course declined as All the waiter did was probably just get 3 bottles out a fridge and put them on the table.

Overall the restaurant itself has is nice, However I won't be coming back due the the insane drink price we paid.

reviews.author: David Warren
reviews.text: This was a cool find. We saw this during our train journey in to Alexanderplatz and when exploring the East Side Gallery it was only a 10 minute walk. Situated by the river this area has lots of different traders from a bar, pizza and those selling coffee and cake to handmade crafts.

reviews.author: zaz o
reviews.text: really cool spot! unfortunately went on a Sunday so a lot of the shops/restaurants were closed but cool to walk around. Especially loved being able to sit next to the river with a beer!

reviews.author: Max Johnson
reviews.text:
Love this place. Holzmarkt 25 is far more than just a gathering spot—it’s an urban wonderland where Berlin’s creative soul flourishes along the Spree River. Once the clandestine site of the legendary Bar25 club, this community-driven village fuses art, music, sustainability, and alternative culture in a way unlike anywhere else in the city.
A perfect spot for chilling by the River Spree.

reviews.author: Mad Mike Guitar
reviews.text: Awesome place. Cool vibe, good beer- also alcohol free. Good place to chill and feel real atmosphere of Berlin. At evening looks magical with all tiny lights on.

reviews.author: faozan rizal. ICS
reviews.text:
If you're in Berlin, you absolutely have to check out Holzmarkt! It's such a hidden gem and really captures the authentic Berlin vibe. The atmosphere there is so laid-back and welcoming.

There are loads of food stalls serving up delicious and affordable meals. Just perfect for any budget. I especially loved the Indian street food stall. I tried their sandwich with fresh tandoori bread, and wow, it was fantastic! Not to mention, it’s vegetarian-friendly, which is always a plus. The samosas were another highlight, crunchy and full of flavor.

If you enjoy a good drink, the wine bar has an amazing selection of natural wines, and there are plenty of spots to grab some beers or refreshing summer drinks like Aperol. We found the perfect spot by the river to kick back, unwind, and watch the sunset over Berlin. It was such a lovely experience.

Overall, Holzmarkt is a great place to hang out, enjoy some good food, and soak in the local vibes! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Thomas Martens
reviews.text:
James Biergarten is essentially a beautiful wooden barn next to a seemingly endless meadow.

Combine the dreamy scenery with reasonable prices for excellent beer (€3.80 for 0.5l of draught  Traunsteiner) and you've found your perfect destination for a bike tour on a sunny afternoon. Just bring some time for the queue which can be pretty long when things get busy.

Definitely worth a visit.

reviews.author: Idan Ilan
reviews.text: Fun surprising place. Great atmosphere, nice people everywhere, good offers. View is amazing. Super chill. Like.

reviews.author: Collins Muriuki Oberhoff
reviews.text:
Very nice distance weekend spot. We went their a few times in that summer and the atmosphere was always very relaxed and children and animal friendly.
Not overcrowded!

Payments: Cash or PayPal
Improvement could be card payment.

We are coming back:))

reviews.author: Artem Portugalskyi
reviews.text: Oasis in the middle of nowhere

reviews.author: TV
reviews.text: Nice beergarden. The Bratwurst was tasty, atmosphere was great.

reviews.author: Go Berlin
reviews.text:
Had high expectations when I had lunch on a public holiday. The area is amazing. Beautiful setting and awesome view on the lake.

Since they were short on staff I’ll excuse them for bringing our food 40 minutes after ordering.

What I can’t excuse is the quality vs price. I ordered the pork schnitzel for around 33 euros. The portion was tiny. And tasted only average. When you offer prices like that you’d expect the sauce hollandaise to be homemade. Sadly, not. Funny also that they don’t show the prices on their online menu. Wonder why….

A friend ordered pasta which arrived cold. Not loop warm. But cold.

Edit: don’t excuse them anymore for bringing our food 40 minutes after ordering after ordering. The other comments just proved my point. For over a year they are understaffed.

reviews.author: Kasia Miko
reviews.text:
Food is quite good. We had Pfifferling soup and beef carpaccio, fired calamari and schnitzel. Soup, calamari and  snitzel were very delicious, carpaccio was so so, bad quality of meat.
Service was soooi slow. There were only 2 waiters for the whole terrace.

reviews.author: Michiel Buitelaar
reviews.text:
Pretty good food, nice atmosphere, great view.

We had some local specialties and wine. Very good. Portions were not small.

The terrace is beautiful. Great views. A wonderful place to spend time. Primarily old, quiet people, the customers.

Staff is somewhat clumsy, and not so fast. Friendly though. But there were at least 50 places empty which they would not make available (?), nor were they able to create shade (many parasols were ready to be employed). Strangely unpragmatic, a bit rigid.

It was very nice. Would like to come again.

reviews.author: Ameer
reviews.text:
Great atmosphere! Classy place and great way to end a summer season! Till next year Berlin!

Truffle pasta, chicken salad and burger were all tasty. Very attentive service and the waiters were available at all times and roaming around our table!

The only issue with this location is finding a decent place to park and there is only a one way round so you have to coordinate the traffic with other drivers.

reviews.author: Tae IL Erdmann
reviews.text: The view is the most striking feature at this place. Combined with good food and friendly service its definitely somthing to consider.

reviews.author: Papu Kaja
reviews.text:
A very off the beaten path location with friendly people good beer coffee and snacks.
It’s the old Berlin type atmosphere, were things were made and found and repaired and not just bought.

I recommend visiting by boat!

reviews.author: Maria Unterschuetz
reviews.text: Great localisation with beautifully view on river. It was great stop on our bike trip. Fully recommend!!

reviews.author: Fülöp Wirth
reviews.text: Best location in Siemensstadt, long life for the owners!

reviews.author: C D
reviews.text: The perfect Berlin place to chill out and relax. You can't get more Berlin flair on the water and yet in the middle of the city. Bars like these make up the soul of the city.

reviews.author: Erkan Göker
reviews.text:
A truly awesome place!!
Friendly service, everything is perfect, you feel at one with nature.
Highly recommended!!!!!

reviews.author: Hivel Aksoy
reviews.text: The atmosphere is fantastic, and our kids love spending time here. It's a great place to visit alone or with a big group of friends. The lake looks beautiful, and many people enjoy swimming in it. You can relax and have a meal under the shade of the trees. The prices are reasonable and worth it.

reviews.author: Gordana Marinković
reviews.text: For the price I expected much more flavour instead of just tons of salt, the fish was dry grilled, the veggies just salty lumps. We also ordered pasta for kids, they were definitely not thrilled about the sauce, and Barilla mini penne. The view is great, though. The service was trying hard, but no soul in it. Lame for the price I paid. Don't think we'll be coming back.

reviews.author: Kathryn Amen
reviews.text: Oktoberfest was a bust. Paid for VIP seats, crammed 10 per table. Had a door handle in my back, had to sit sideways to fit 5 per bench. Husband had a pillar blocking half his seat. Waiter took one drink order and disappeared. Literally couldn’t use knife and fork to cut food due to no space. Got up to go outside, not allowed to order a drink at bar, no drinks outside, host at door gave ZERO interest that it was a miserable experience. Loud, cramped and hot. Not worth it.

reviews.author: nuric
reviews.text: It is actually a really nice restaurant. Despite the negative reviews I've seen, our experience was really good. Yes, the price is a bit higher around 25 euros per person but you are next to the lake with no other restaurant within a 20 minute walk. There is a beer garden right in front with self service food as opposed to the proper restaurant service of this place. The food was tasty with German classics like a currywurst. The staff were friendly and the food arrived on time. I would expect the service to slow down during the weekend for sure as it gets busy. Overall, a perfect location with some good food, I have to give 5 stars based on our experience.

reviews.author: Farhad Qazi
reviews.text:
Excellent location, scrumptious food, better service than most German restaurants but that's not saying much. The juiciest and tastiest tiger prawns in the region I've had so far. The kids did complain about the Currywurst being very spicy.

As is the case with German customer service in general, i give it 3 stars. Very expensive but worth the money for the delicious taste.

reviews.author: William Hardister
reviews.text: This place is great. Small but very appealing I've been here several times and I really enjoy the employees and the atmosphere and the people that were there. Nothing but top ratings for this small but very beautiful beer garden

reviews.author: Lorna Cannon
reviews.text: One of the best places to get together with friends who also have kids in the summer. The kids are free to play in the sand pit while the adults can enjoy some refreshing beer and nice food. Very green and relaxed vibes

reviews.author: Masoud Hosseini
reviews.text: I been in a different places for beer and this is one of the gems of berlin unfortunately the kitchen was closing so early i was a bit disappointed but great ambiance

reviews.author: Michaela Stephan
reviews.text: What a gem in the middle of Moabit - green and calm atmosphere, with really great food (Domberger bread!) and an own small play area for the kids (ssndbox, some cars, seesaw)! Fantastic, family-friendly, dog-friendly - perfect for summer days and evenings.

reviews.author: Evgeniya Volkova
reviews.text: Favorite hidden gem in Moabit 🍻 beautifully done, fun, friendly, great fun spot for kids , very good food 🔥

reviews.author: Chiara Mazzetti
reviews.text:
Lovely biergarten! I organised my birthday there. I reserved place for 20 pax online, and hey made it very nice.
I could open a drink a list where my guests could charge the drinks, and ordered several Pinsa (Pizza from Rome), which were delicious!
The atmosphere is super chilled and not too noisy. In the green, but only 8 mins walk from S-Bahn Südkreuz. Super kind and cool staff. 😎  10 out of 10 ❤❤❤

reviews.author: cheche serrano
reviews.text:
What a stunning place to be in the sun, amazing drinks and a good beer.
the pinsa looks amazing but wasn’t ready, the dough was raw in the middle .
