reviews.author: Vinit kulkarni
reviews.text:
Like another beer garden, but serves decent pizza , if your nearby like i work near sudkruez then its a nice hangout. Otherwise i would not recommend to come to this place specially. I have no complains its nice.
Staff is friendly
Self service
They have two side
One serves salad and drinks with some other stuff to eat
And on other side is pizza ( cheaper side)
Both are same

reviews.author: Oscar R
reviews.text:
The Pinsa is just missing the mark. Atmosphere is good. Drinks are tasty and reasonably priced. Overall well balanced place with a nice environment and a beach vibe.

But, the food, apologies if I’m not an Italian expert. But a Pinza looks quite similar to a Pizza. There’s just one thing that I don’t understand, why does it need to be a bit chewy and oily? Tried more than once to confirm that the recipe is creating an oily dough that slightly sticks to your gums. Specific, I know. But I wonder why and if this is intended.

If they could just do, you know, just normal pizzas that would be great.

reviews.author: Peter Hilbert
reviews.text: Discovered by chance today. Signposted on Chausseestrasse. Hidden and quiet in the courtyard. Very friendly and attentive service, delicious salad, and the currywurst portion consists of two large sausages with fries, more than enough. It was my first time here, but definitely not my last. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Lewis Pretorius
reviews.text: Friendly team, great conference facilities, great connections and a very beautiful chapel.

reviews.author: Axk Kb
reviews.text:
Great lunch (weekdays) – delicious and affordable
11.90 including a drink
Changes daily

reviews.author: Lineu Jorge (Lineo)
reviews.text: Visited Mauersegler Berlin during the Champions League final in 2024, and it was an incredible experience! 🏆⚽️ The place is an open-air venue, which added a unique and enjoyable atmosphere to the event. 🌳🍻 There were plenty of good drinks available, and the space was more than adequate for watching the game comfortably. 🍺📺 The ambience was fantastic, with a vibrant and energetic crowd that really made the night special. 🎉👏 If you're looking for a great spot to enjoy sports events or just have a good time with friends, Mauersegler is definitely worth a visit! 🌟🏟️

reviews.author: Tora Forss
reviews.text: We had to wait 2 hours and when I went to ask they had forgotten our order. I asked for our money back because it took so long and they said that they couldn’t ”guarantee anything” and wouldn’t reimburse anything not even a free drink in the burning heat. Bad service, not worth the wait, don’t go here!

reviews.author: Tyler Wall
reviews.text: Fun rooftop for a Sunday hangout after shopping at the flea market. We just did drinks and they were delicious. You get some money back when you return your glasses.

reviews.author: ada stade
reviews.text: took over an hour to get the food because they lost the order and wouldn’t listen when we asked about it. super rude and not worth the wait, probably the worst place in berlin (the restaurant).

reviews.author: Castor Karkaroff
reviews.text: They might double-charge you for glass pfands, make sure you pay the correct amount

reviews.author: Simge Koç
reviews.text: Used to come here last year, it was already pricey, but now it’s even worse. Fries come with a side of disappointment. They already cost 5€, yet ketchup and mayo are now considered luxury items and charged extra. Charging for condiments? Greedy move. I guess next year they’ll start charging for napkins too. If you’re into paying premium prices for average food, this is the place for you.

reviews.author: kiran proulx
reviews.text: Oh my god. We ordered a Bratwurst Brot, you would think that comes with a Brötchen, however, we were served the most stale, ranchid, disappointing excuse of a piece of bread. Inedible. Rude servers who do not warn you of the sorry meal coming you way. Overly expensive food i wouldnt even eat for free.

reviews.author: Kane Bryant
reviews.text:
I regularly attend the area to go SUPing with my family and we always go here after for a beer and some food. They appear to have a set menu (on chalk boards) but i have only ordered the half chicken and bratwurst, and cake and everything has always been great; the pommes is delicious and has always been fresh. There is also ice cream for for sale as well (pre-packaged). Service can be slow sometimes and the line can be long but it generally moves pretty steadily.

There is ample seating around the service area with additional seating down by the water/playground.

Note: there are two service sides, one that takes cash only and one that takes card/cash (water side) so make sure you wait in the appropriate line.

reviews.author: Zane G
reviews.text: I did not went to w/, but the like is beautiful with a lot of swiming spots

reviews.author: savina bellotto
reviews.text: Good but too expensive for quantity and quality

reviews.author: Karl Finke
reviews.text: Decent food, nicely presented. Service is good too, awesome venue! Tho the spritzed apple juice was a little light on apple juice.

reviews.author: Olha Rymartsova
reviews.text:
The food was really tasty, tender schnitzel. Miss waiter was really helpful and nice.
Calm and cozy atmosphere.
And a beer garden! ;)

reviews.author: Jens Görner
reviews.text: Very nice place. Very engaged people. They have a lot of cultural offers like Jazz Jam Sessions, concerts. The kitchen must be good and kind of typical Berlin style but also international. I didn't check so far but surely will as I will come back. Very friendly people especially the service during concerts. Pricing absolutely ok. They're offering a beer brewed just for this place (so in Berlin). I'll come back for sure.

reviews.author: DESNEY BAILEY
reviews.text: Just love the live music sessions they have during the week..Soul, Rock & Jazz music..with fantastic musicians..

reviews.author: Uta Agbara
reviews.text:
delicious food, very accomodating location, not too expensive and very friendly service.
Loved it!

reviews.author: Marie S
reviews.text: this is my favorite biergarten. amazing backfisch and kartoffelsalat, yummy crisp beers, staff is friendly enough and expects you to do your part. prices fit. sitting here by the water in the sun is so cozy and wonderful, i absolutely love this place.

reviews.author: Oğuzhan
reviews.text: Very nice place in the middle of a wonderful forest. Best view for snacking after a great Sunday hike

reviews.author: Gerrit Sievert
reviews.text: super duper friendly-vibed Biergarten by the water. The lake is your garden, why not have a Wurst & a Beer while looking at it?

reviews.author: Conni Covington
reviews.text: It was a fine place to end a walk in the woods on a Sunday afternoon.

reviews.author: Dirk Scheerer
reviews.text: Biergarten. Fair prices. Bier, Bratwurst, Coffee and Cake

reviews.author: Sally Pfeffi
reviews.text:
We have been here several times over the last several years and have always been a bit shocked by the unfriendly service.
One time we were asked to not only order bread and bear even before giving an order of actually several dishes. Another time we came for Christmas menu which left us with stomach aches. Today was again not a great experience - I wanted alcohol free beer and they said we need to sit down for this and then it was just apparently the regular beers available from big brands. Others ordered some beers which were ok but our waiter was not friendly at all. Watch out a guy is walking around taking pictures trying to sell key picture chains

reviews.author: Daniela Muñiz
reviews.text:
This place is really good, they were really patient even though I don't speak german and the waitress didn't speak any english, she was adorable.
Food was very german and really tasty, big portions.
Beer was delicious.
They have these vending machines that were something really diferent and funny.

reviews.author: Roan
reviews.text:
This review is about the Restaurant alone.

Our employer hosted our Christmas Party here and I was so impressed not just with the food but most especially with the service we received from the staff. Then I decided I have to try the restaurant on a regular day.

Usually, this place is packed, especially at night and on the weekends. We went for lunch and we were basically the first customers. As expected, service was impeccable. They were very accommodating without being overly friendly or trying too hard. We have noticed that the kitchen and the brewery were already busy.

Then came our food and it was oh so scrumptious. It was very well-seasoned and freshly cooked. The Haxe was so juicy on the inside. I had the meat platter which paired really well with the tasty Sauerkraut. My favourite was the ribs. It is like home-cooked meal but better. Moreover, we ordered their signature brews and they were really good. I am not a beer lover myself but I liked it very much especially the dark one.

This was definitely not our last visit.

reviews.author: Yakov S
reviews.text:
Every stay in Berlin I visit this place.
Great beer here, no words to describe.
you have to taste it to understand.

Amazing vibes, ✨
Great service
Quiet and warm place
Highly recommend to visit
You will not regret.

reviews.author: Mighty Manotas
reviews.text:
Habla Manotas,
This place is a traditional German brewery with a nice "Biergarten".
The choice of beers is not huge but the food compensates that.
It's spacious, clean and the service is fast and efficient.
It's suitable for any size of groups but a reservation is recommended.

reviews.author: Luka Grgurić
reviews.text: Great spot to hang out with friends in a natural, relaxed setting. The atmosphere is easygoing and inviting. Food could be a bit better, but overall a nice place to spend time outdoors.

reviews.author: Miriam Bungard
reviews.text: Super fun vibes as well as great Position, it is right next to the river. Very spacious and a big playground for children. Very friendly staff and prices are decent. Great spot for a summer day in the city. However the toilets aren’t the most clean.

reviews.author: Sam Alabiad
reviews.text: Great, big and kid friendly beer garden in a very lively area near the canal. It can be very busy especially on weekends. We managed to find a table and had coffee and drinks there which were nice. Great atmosphere there with a dedicated playground for children. They serve ice cream also and food.  Service can be a bit slow depending on how busy it is.

reviews.author: Giuditta Gandellini
reviews.text: We celebrated here 2 bdays and everyone was beyond helpful and nice. Food is good and abundant. Booking a table was easy and quick. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Ersin Yavuz
reviews.text: 5 stars for atmosphere. Big enough for even groups. Perfect resting place in the middle of nature. Also edge of the river. Highly recommended. Grab a beer and enjoy.

name: Biergarten auf der Insel der Jugend

reviews.author: Jonathan Huber
reviews.text: Love the location, the island, the feeling. The beverage and cakes are good. The food stall is subpar - only fries are okay, has changed for the worse this season.

reviews.author: melis caner
reviews.text:
You can find vegan options
Recommended on a sunny day.

reviews.author: Andi Pata
reviews.text: You expect better food for such a nice place.

reviews.author: Mirajj82 82
reviews.text: The island of youth is probably one of the favorite places. You can swim. Take a break from the noisy city. Have a snack and restart your ego with new strength. Nature is for us and we must appreciate and enjoy it, especially in the summer. Kayaks for rent right here

reviews.author: Katrin S.
reviews.text:
Great place for a beer garden. Relax by the water with delicious food and drinks.
There are also sun loungers and beach chairs. Very well maintained.
Very friendly staff. Self-service, well organized.

reviews.author: Cosmin Butnarasu
reviews.text:
Great local brewery tucked away in a quiet courtyard in Wedding. Eschenbräu has a solid selection of house-brewed beers that change with the seasons, we especially liked the variety and freshness. The Flammkuchen was crispy and tasty, perfect with a cold beer.
One cool thing: you can bring your own food! Whether you’re inside or out in the beer garden, it’s a super relaxed spot to hang out with friends. Definitely worth a visit if you’re into craft beer and chill vibes.

reviews.author: Wendy Chen
reviews.text:
Super!👍
It’s located in a peaceful neighborhood with local people.
The traditional pizza, Flammkuchen Klassisch, was delicious while drinking the beer!
I noticed that the customers brought their own food and enjoyed these beers!🍻

reviews.author: fawaz thazhatheri
reviews.text:
Eschenbräu is a popular craft brewery, beer garden, and student-favorite bar located in the Wedding district of Berlin, Germany. It's well known among locals and beer enthusiasts for its house-brewed beers, relaxed atmosphere, and community feel.
What is Eschenbräu?
Type: Microbrewery & beer garden
Address: Triftstraße 67, 13353 Berlin (in the
courtyard of a student dormitory)
District: Wedding, Berlin
Opened: Early 2000s
Name origin: "Esche" means ash tree in German - the name references the ash tree in the courtyard where the beer garden sits.

reviews.author: Irene St. A.
reviews.text:
Hidden gem where to try out some artisanal beers and whisky straight from their own Keller. The atmosphere is quite welcoming and recalls that of rural taverns in Upper Franconia.
It was really packed on a Tuesday evening.
Unfortunately there's not a broad selection of food - the Flammkuchen vegetarisch we ordered was nice, even if a bit overpriced. I found out later that it's allowed to bring your own meal, which is typical around Southern Germany.
There's a garden outside and I'll be back to check it out as soon as the weather allows it!
Also big up for dogs being welcomed indoor and waitresses speaking in English :)

reviews.author: Harsh Singh
reviews.text:
Eschenbräu used to be one of my favorite spots in Berlin, but unfortunately, the beer selection has lost its charm. The variety seems to have disappeared, with most beers tasting overly hoppy, bitter, and leaning heavily toward an IPA profile – not offering much diversity.

While I still love the cozy atmosphere of the place, some staff members could work on being more welcoming.

I really hope the brewery makes some adjustments, as I’d love to return and enjoy it like I used to. I’ll definitely like to give it another try in the future, hoping for better experiences.

reviews.author: Dmitry Polozov
reviews.text:
Tiergartenquelle leaves a wonderful impression! The interior creates the feel of an old tavern. The service is top-notch — the staff is polite and attentive, ready to assist with choices.

The menu offers a variety of dishes, and everything I tried was very tasty! I was especially pleased with the portion sizes. The beer from Brauerei Lemke always leaves a nice impression.

It's also worth mentioning the excellent location of the establishment — right by the Tiergarten. The restaurant is located under the S-Bahn line.

We come here with colleagues to celebrate the end of the quarter at work. Be sure to reserve a table in advance. On Thursday evenings, it gets so crowded that there's hardly any room left!

reviews.author: Jamie Donovan
reviews.text:
Great vibes in the beer garden, which is across the road from the pub.
All of us enjoyed our meals, ordered the meatballs, the schnitzel and beef goulash.
Very generous portion sizes, tasted fresh.
Veggie and vegan options.

reviews.author: Xia Jin (Tim)
reviews.text: This place is mostly set up in the open-air garden across from the main building, where there are all kinds of flies, bees, and small insects constantly flying around me. If you like bugs, this must be your paradise. Being close to the road, there’s also a lot of dust in the air. Many guests around were smoking, which I found really unpleasant. The pork knuckle had a very hard outer layer, was difficult to chew, and tasted bad.

reviews.author: Sanghamitra Das
reviews.text: Good food, especially their goulash soup and currywurst. My husband says go for their crispy pork knuckle (if you like pork knuckle, because no amount of good cooking can make me like pork knuckle as a dish). Our server spoke English and was very energetic. Really appreciated his service despite the fact that it was a very busy evening. Speaking of busy, I highly recommend you reserve a table because it filled out ENTIRELY in a blink and we had to share a table with another group mere minutes into our dinner, that too on a random Monday at 17:30!

reviews.author: W K
reviews.text:
A charming restaurant and pub, The atmosphere is fantastic, the food is very good and the portions are generous.

We don’t even know how we ended up here, we were just passing by and decided to give it a try, and we’re so glad we did! Highly recommended .

reviews.author: Léa Rolot
reviews.text: Super expensive and got told off in a very unfriendly way by security when drinking water from our personal bottle. We just had spent 30euros on food and drinks (overpriced) "Es gibt  hier Getränke zu kaufen". Yeah ok, it s also 33 degrees today.

reviews.author: Ta Lo
reviews.text: 3€ Very poor Pommes, cold, empty inside, very freezer fries 🍟

reviews.author: Rodica Cioclu
reviews.text:
For the 1st time I was here. Great atmosfere. Delicious Limonade and Kaffee.
Definitely, worth visiting 👌

reviews.author: Stuart Reeve
reviews.text: Traditional sort of beer garden,  benches an beer, food menu is good. Gets impossibly crowded though

reviews.author: Jasenko Havel
reviews.text: Nice biergarten, tucked away, next to the canal with great choice of drinks and amazing personnel.

reviews.author: lu ha
reviews.text: A quite special beer garden right on the Spree and below the former Vattenfall power plant with the walkway along the riverfront going right through the beer garden. Despite its special setting it is very unpretentious and simple and that’s why I give it my 5stars, it doesn’t push to be different. It is what it is and that in itself is very admirable and somewhat rare in Berlin these days. The food is simple but good, Leberkäs (with sweet mustard!) brezn and Quark, Opatzter, Kartoffelsalat. And the prices are very reasonable, also for the drinks. A rare gem and a very nice destination for a walk to and along the Spree in Charlotte B. Keep it up, cup rivi.

reviews.author: Kaylee K
reviews.text: Directly on the water with tables and moveable lounge chairs. When all the chairs are taken, just sit in the grass or on the canal wall. Lovely spot with plenty of drink options and enough food selection to keep you enjoying the space. Pictured is a cheese-filled sausage. We will be back!

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.text: Great place to have a sun downer! Next to the river and with tables and benches and beach chairs✅

reviews.author: Val Mam
reviews.text: Nice place to stop and have a drink next to the river on a sunny day!

reviews.author: Rahul Pandita
reviews.text:
Wow 👏

River side sitting, beers & old friends will add more beauty to this place

reviews.author: Tova Mårtensson
reviews.text:
As a long-time vegan, I was blown away by the truffle ravioli—rich, creamy, and absolutely unforgettable. I almost wanted to order in a second plate! The menu is clearly labeled, staff are helpful with adjustments, and the overall vibe is elegant yet relaxed.

Prices are a bit high (€22 for lunch), but the quality makes it 100% worth it. Don’t forget to bring cash for the restroom attendant. I’ll definitely be back next time I’m in Berlin!

reviews.author: Júlio B
reviews.text: Beautiful location, delicious food, good service and super easy to book a table, couldn't ask for more. Will definitely return!

reviews.author: Scott in Berlin
reviews.text: Great way to spend a Sunday afternoon with your loved ones. I felt like I was at home with the wonderful service and lovely nibbles for the High Tea. Small portions but very unique to have Roast Beef and Salmon sandwiches along with homemade scones with clotted cream n jam. My other half was equally impressed with Spargel Soup and Ceviche fresh ingredients. Really lovely surroundings and the staff were just lovely.

reviews.author: Tilman Benecke
reviews.text: The teahouse undoubtedly scores points with its idyllic atmosphere and picturesque location - a real treat for the eyes. Located right in the Tiergarten, not far from the "Golden Else" and in the neighborhood of the Federal President, you might think that everything here is perfect. But unfortunately this experience is spoiled by the guests present. The national German company was not quite to my taste, which reduced the pleasure. In addition, the food prices seemed a bit overpriced to me.

reviews.author: Emel Aydın
reviews.text: It's a nice, classy place. I like it here. It's in the Tiergarten. It's a good place for snacks, food, coffee...all that. The staff is attentive. The prices are a bit high.

reviews.author: St L
reviews.text: Best, vegan currywurst in Berlin! Service was excellent. I had a mint tea at 10:00 p.m. at the bar. A dream come true

reviews.author: Sasha Zhukovsky
reviews.text: Just a five-star. Charged my phone without asking. I ate my food from another place. I was with a dog. We were watching CL final, and everything was smoove. No one said any word. Great bar and nice friendly staff, nice snacks and great draft beer.bcat's say less or more. Recommend definetely.

reviews.author: Milan
reviews.text: Fries, drinks, music and groups around tables in beergarden. Not necessarily in that order but always good atmosphere. The food is really good too. Staff is happy and customers are happy. I've never had a stressful moment there.

reviews.author: Maximilian Graf
reviews.text:
Nice beer garden. Good food from Nice Fries.
The bartenders from the beer garden are not very friendly and don’t seem happy about their job..
Maybe hire people that bring a better vibe to your business.
The place has a lot of potential

reviews.author: Jason Mercer
reviews.text: Love this place. Chilled vibe. Nice staff. Good prices for drinks. Good food options.

reviews.author: D. Kozyk
reviews.text:
Love this place. There's always so many queer people chilling here. I love the atmosphere, the food is good, the prices for drinks are not too much.
I wish they had more than 2 cashiers, because its gets very crowded after 19:00 and you need to stand in a long line to get served.
Also, huge plus for gender-neutral toilets. Makes me feel very safe.

reviews.author: Tallulah Freeway
reviews.text: Best queer neighbourhood hang out in Kreuzberg! Cheap food and drinks, lovely beer garden and great staff! Patio closes around 23-00h though as to not disturb the neighbours.

reviews.author: Sarah laforteza
reviews.text: Worst customer service I have ever come across. At 4pm on July 13, the guy with the curly black hair at the counter, should not be working there. Talking to us like we are not humans. I asked a simple question and he lost his temper. His behaviour was absolutely disgusting and if you’re gonna make people feel unwelcome and give them hostile poor attitude by simply asking a question, then you will continue to drive customers away. Find a better person for the job or this guy should find a job he actually likes so he can stop projecting his anger and ugliness on others.

reviews.author: Hannah Mullen
reviews.text:
The gluten free beer here was delicious!

Food is not celiac safe.

Staff were amazing and helpful and advised me not to eat as unfortunately they use shared fryers for chips and Bio Currywurst.

reviews.author: Larissa Sivri
reviews.text: The burger was huge, almost too much to handle, but absolutely so delicious. I couldn't quite tell if the staff member taking my order was friendly or not; since I don't speak German, I had to ask for clarification, which made me feel a bit guilty for not knowing the language, although I'm not sure why. Something didn't feel quite right, and it left me feeling uneasy. However, I'm willing to give there another shot for this place and see through these situation. :) The atmosphere inside was great, lively, and colorful. At the very least, it's worth stopping by to check out the place and maybe grab a beer!

reviews.author: Carina Åkerberg
reviews.text: A perfect little biergarten , friendly staff and tasty food. A cosy place!

reviews.author: Robin De Backer
reviews.text: First time trying berlin Kurrywürst as a tourist, our waitress was amazingly hospitable! we had a bit of trouble communicating (language barrier) but she was amazingly kind, and the food and atmosphere was great!

reviews.author: Euge A.
reviews.text: Super nice and cheap place!

reviews.author: Marija Radojkovic
reviews.text:
Very nice atmosphere and also has a spielplatz next to it
Service is excellent
Very friendly

reviews.author: Rafaela Teixeira
reviews.text: Bad service

reviews.author: Joanna Bryson
reviews.text: Wonderful small hidden quiet beer garden. I don't know why there were some 2024 poor reviews, to get the place under 3.9? It's true the food was not the draw, but in 2023 they changed to giant toasted sandwiches – vegan, vegetarian, and chicken options. Contra some of the old reviews, I never had to book to get in, even for big football games. Usually there's plenty of space, TV screen or no.  And the atmosphere is GREAT there under the trees, day or night! There is water for dogs which is shared by local wildlife.

reviews.author: M Hunter
reviews.text: Lovely staff, great prices (2 pints 9 euro) and a very peaceful setting. Had a few beers here on a warm evening before dinner…recommend:)

reviews.author: James Buchanan
reviews.text: Really cool space having some beers under the trees. Don’t know why there’s low reviews, cheap and the people were lovely

reviews.author: Jari Aarniala
reviews.text: Nice atmosphere for a couple of drinks in the shade. Get ice cream for kids from inside the movie theater.

reviews.author: Imya Familiya
reviews.text: Very cute place, one probably can have a lovely meetup with friends after a movie here

reviews.author: Alexej
reviews.text: Funny, non-ordinary place. Good service, generous prices,.. Quiet environment and great beer 🤗

reviews.author: Vahid Shahani
reviews.text:
The snacks were lovely, and the beer was fantastic. What really stood out was the staff, they were super helpful and friendly, making the experience even better. If you’re looking for a chill spot to enjoy good food and drinks, this is the place to go before your rave!

Thank you 😊

reviews.author: Guy Gilad
reviews.text: A local Biergarten with good atmosphere, cool crowd and clubbing music, in the yard of the Berghain & Lab.oratory clubs. Reasonable prices (0.5 L Bier: 4.5 €, Hamburger: 7.5 €, Pommes: 3 €).

reviews.author: Radek Em
reviews.text: Cool summer place for a drink 🍺

reviews.author: MMelom
reviews.text: Nice bar with a rooftop next to Berghain. No card accepted so make sure you have spare change for a beer.

reviews.author: arianna dottarelli
reviews.text:
very nice vegan food and chill atmosphere, just outside KINDL museum.
we had the chilli with soya and the pulled bbq seitan, both super tasty!
the sour cream on top of the chilli was delicious.
friendly and kind staff.
definitely we’ll go back to try the other dishes🩵

reviews.author: May Han
reviews.text: Nice place. The iced latte and banana bread are really good!

reviews.author: Adam Bojanczyk
reviews.text: Cool Place with Drinks and vegan food. Nice on hot days die to the trees :)

reviews.author: Fangqin Chuah
reviews.text:
Fair prices for drinks, cosy adorable open air space with overhanging tree canopies.

Every Wednesday night there is a standup comedy show here and we were lucky to catch it. Definitely give it a go if you’re in for some diverse humour :)

reviews.author: Carsten Beulig
reviews.text: A beer garden in the Rollbergviertel district on the former brewery site. Due to the weather, it wasn't busy on the day I visited, and the snack bar wasn't even open. The atmosphere isn't really my thing; there are better ones. I might try again when the weather is better.

reviews.author: Stuart Graham
reviews.text: This place is superb. The food is proper German, tasty and served with care and love. Really lovely guys. I’d make CS a beeline to come back here next time I’m in Berlin

reviews.author: Suzanne Haynes
reviews.text: We really wanted to try real German cuisine.  We had to wait for a table and our wine.  The red wine was unpleasant.  Our waitress was lovely, she smiled and had a small chat.  The food was overpriced.  The fish, chunky pieces of cod was fried moist and had reasonable taste.  The bolied potatoes were buttery and well cooked.  The pork knuckle was very tender thick slices of meat  like a roast pork but soft. It came with mash. The atmosphere was lively.  A tip was really expected, however we felt the service food and delay did not warrant a tip.

reviews.author: David Warren
reviews.text: Great ambient and food was hearty. Wine and beer were of a high quality and the waitress were friendly and attentive. Catered well to one of our party members who has a lactose intolerance.

reviews.author: Todd Cocks
reviews.text:
Had one of our best meals in Berlin at this restaurant. We didn’t have a reservation so we sat at the outside courtyard, which is very pleasant. My husband had the pork joint which was able to be cut by his fork. I had the schnitzel. Both were very good and we had such a great meal. Would highly recommend.

A tip - it seems like they are often booked well in advance so if you want to eat inside, make reservations.

reviews.author: Adrian R.
reviews.text:
I recently visited this restaurant and overall had a very pleasant experience. The place itself is nice and quiet, creating a relaxed and comfortable atmosphere that’s perfect for enjoying a meal. It felt like a good escape from the usual busy and noisy places, which I really appreciated.

The food was another highlight — everything I tried was tasty and well-prepared. You can tell that they put effort into both the flavor and presentation. It’s always a great feeling when the food not only looks good but also tastes great, and this place definitely delivered on that.

As for the service, I have no complaints at all. The staff were genuinely friendly, polite, and helpful throughout the entire visit. It’s clear they care about their guests and want to make sure everyone feels welcome and taken care of.

The only downside for me was the lack of a designated smoking area. I ended up sitting near people who were smoking, and that part of the experience wasn’t so pleasant. It would really improve the atmosphere if there were a separate space for smokers, so non-smokers could enjoy their meals without the smell of smoke.

That said, this is just one small issue in an otherwise very positive experience. I would still definitely recommend this restaurant to others. With great food, friendly service, and a peaceful setting, it’s worth a visit — especially if they address the smoking situation in the future.

reviews.author: Ruvindu Chandradasa
reviews.text: They have different artists performing and they all sound pretty great. Today (11.05.) there was a one man blues show and it was so great paired with the sun, water and the beverages they serve. You can lounge in the chairs they have on the edge of the river bank. Had a great time

reviews.author: Andrew GottWorth
reviews.text:
Such a wonderful place to visit with friends or family. In warm weather, enjoy lounge chairs, pedal boats, and Aperol. In cold weather, enjoy the early sunset, have a Glühwein, and warm up in the tent.

They also have music, stand up comedy, and more for events. Some vegan food as well!

reviews.author: Hassan Radi
reviews.text: Cute little place for having something to eat/drink. They offer beach chairs to relax and enjoy the marvelous view (especially at night). They shine colors on the trees at night which makes the place super beautiful and romantic.

reviews.author: Darshan Gajara
reviews.text:
This Biergarten is on the tiny little island on the edge of Treptower park. It has wonderful views and also a station to book kayaks & boats.

The atmosphere is great and it gets pretty crowded. They also accept card payments.

reviews.author: Kirstin Wiedow
reviews.text: Walking across the bridge you find this secluded spot. Counter service for drinks and food and nice tables tucked away along the river Spree. Boats for hire and nice clean toilets compared to the free dodgy ones in the park!

reviews.author: Berlin Gal
reviews.text: Super fun spot with total Berlin vibes: grab a drink from the kiosk, chill in the open space, hula-hoop, or catch a silent cinema screening. Love it!

reviews.author: A K
reviews.text: This was a great place with reasonable prices and a good vibe when it first opened years ago. Then they jacked up the prices and the music and clientele went down hill.  Still a nice place to people watch and, hey, it's a public park; you can bring your own Augustiner! I do miss the reasonably priced Aperol Spritz I drank many of though

reviews.author: Chris Campbell-Marshall
reviews.text: Away from the hectic inner-city, in a lovely park. Plus there’s a cute pug sleeping in the bar. Good prices, really brilliant!

reviews.author: Sonja Müller
reviews.text: Bar with plenty outside seating on benches and lounge chairs in the adjacent park. Good for a beer in the park and though the bar closes at 10. You can stay longer.

reviews.author: Arthur Mor
reviews.text:
Great spot for chilling with a beer!🍻
Not a lot of people know that sweet spot, but this is a very relaxed and cool place.
They are often hosting nice events and they have live DJ which is playing on the weekends 💃

On a warm summer day that is the perfect place, especially thanks to his location

reviews.author: Andrei “Navigator”
reviews.text: Hidden gem. Nice cozy beer garden surrounded by nature. Beautiful.

reviews.author: Si
reviews.text: A charming time capsule, rough around the edges, but a piece of living history.

reviews.author: Florian H
reviews.text: It was nice if you want to go back in time.

reviews.author: Christian Grimm
reviews.text: A ride back in time

reviews.author: Marco Wurzbacher
reviews.text: THIS is a real insider tip when it comes to beer gardens in Berlin. Quietly located and with lots of retro charm. Unfortunately the first beer wasn't really cold, but the ones that followed were. By the way, there is Engelhardt - unfortunately it has become a rarity.

reviews.author: Em Bi Traveler
reviews.text:
I like this place, I am coming back.
Sometimes a little smile on stuff would not kill anyone ;)

reviews.author: Papu Kaja
reviews.text:
Very good location! love this place. friendly, clean. Weihenstephaner Helles on tap, thank you very much.

Fries were tasty too! Love how out of the way this place is! Also right next to this you can watch people walk the treeline, like literally.

cheerrs :)

reviews.author: Euge A.
reviews.text: Very nice place for drinks and snacks! Beer 4.70€, wine 4€, half pizza Margherita 6.90€.

reviews.author: Wulf Quester
reviews.text: Certainly the beergarden with the best kept lawn in Berlin, if not the world. Great view of the park due to the elavation, typical food like bratwurst and käsespätzle

reviews.author: Ravi Sid
reviews.text: Wanna get refreshed with lots of adventure and hoping to get good food, then this is the best place for you. Come, play well and eat well. 😉

name: Emma & Paul's Biergarten / Eiskrem Hausgemacht
address: Am Hafen Kladow, Imchenallee 42, 14089 Berlin, Germany

reviews.author: Nadya aghaz
reviews.text:
The owner showed such genuine kindness when I mentioned the cake was a bit dry — not only was the issue handled with grace, but I was brought two slices of cake with a smile. It’s rare to experience such thoughtful, generous service. Thank you for turning a small moment into something special

🤍🌸

reviews.author: mgmpw32
reviews.text:
We stayed a few days at nearby Camping Berlin Kladow and Emma & Paul's became our go-to place. We were there every day. The self-service system is good and works well. The staff were great and are well trained, with quite a bit of English spoken too.
We really enjoyed sitting there and watching the world, the boats on the lake, the ferry coming and going. We hope to visit again some day. Thanks to all at Emma & Paul's.

reviews.author: Verena Aibel
reviews.text: A lovely, easy-access outdoor ice cream & bubble tea establishment, right by the Havel River dock. The friendly server offered us to try any flavor we wanted. I settled on the delicious “Butterkeks” (butter cookies) and got treated to a nice-sized scoop (thank you!). He also gave us a quick history of this Kladow-based business and pointed out that the person who started the business and makes the ice cream still lives close by and continues to create different flavors for this shop. The flavors change often! For a bigger appetite, check out the attached Biergarten with indoor and outdoor setting.

reviews.author: S. A.
reviews.text: Nice atmosphere. We like it very much.

reviews.author: Aman Jain
reviews.text: Nice Biergarten at the Dock of Kladow. I love this place, the pizza served here is really delicious. The Coffee is a bit okay, and they are a little overpriced, but the place is beautiful during the summers, and there is an ice cream truck just beside the Biergarten. You get Beer, Hard Drinks and other items too on the menu. Worth visiting this place.

name: Biergarten Rudower Höhe bei Käse Paul
address: Casino "Zum Frühbeet", Wolfram Huger, Künnekeweg 20, 12355 Berlin, Germany

reviews.author: John Trombly
reviews.text: Nice beer garden close to the wall trail in Rudow. They have typical beer garden food. The grounds are nicely land scaped.

reviews.author: Fü Gobrecht
reviews.text: This was an amazing time. We spend 2 evenings after really hot days on #ILA22, in this nice location. The food perfect, the beer 🍻 local and the sound 🔊 back to 80's and 90's. Simply fantastic. We will come back in two years when #ILA24 will 🛫

reviews.author: Dalton Bishop
reviews.text: Best bar I've been to in germany, maybe the best bar I've ever been to!

reviews.author: TV
reviews.text: A nice terrace in the middle of a Kleingarten. Stuff is very nice and friendly

reviews.author: Ulf Schulte
reviews.text: A typical beer garden in an allotment association. The Strammer Max was delicious and the beer was well tapped.

reviews.author: George Dickie
reviews.text: We only came for a beer but ended up  having a serving of pommefritz and they were delicious! Would love to stay longer!

reviews.author: Lotta Sommer
reviews.text: Great Biergarten with the best chips I've had in a long time, delicious beers and friendly staff. Can be loud depending on how full it is or what's happening on the street right next to it.

reviews.author: Uri Kanonov
reviews.text:
Tasty food (pork knuckle, schnitzel, sausage) and beer. Fast service.
Food comes from the restaurant across the street.

reviews.author: Judith Williams
reviews.text: amaaaaazing beer garden with a playground for kids

reviews.author: Bill Lane
reviews.text: Had a fantastic night there last night .

reviews.author: Arzu Geybulla
reviews.text: There is no food on the menu hence no starts for that but everything else deserves more than just five starts. The atmosphere, the service, the decor, and the exhaustive menu offering a whole selection of cocktails. It was raining outside so we did not get a chance to try the outdoor seating but it looks like THE spot to come and chill on a warmer, less wet evening :)

reviews.author: Carolina Marrucho
reviews.text: Great atmosphere and friendly staff. We went there for the Guinness and were not disappointed

reviews.author: Jose Bonetto
reviews.text:
A beautiful bar on a super special location. The bier and whisky menu is top shelf! Best Guinness I’ve ever had in Berlin !
Cozy & sweet vibe.

reviews.author: Пьер Дунн
reviews.text: The best bar, in my opinion. A very cozy room in the loft style, located in the courtyards, there is a fire burning outside in the evenings, in the bar itself the light is only from candles, which adds atmosphere and comfort, delicious unusual beer, a very pleasant and polite bartender, I liked everything, next time I will bring you here friends

reviews.author: Sascha Auerbach
reviews.text: A hidden gem!  The fantastic decor in this converted workshop is complemented by good cocktails and superb service from very friendly staff. One of the best bars in Neukolln.

reviews.author: Erickson Manzano (the_erickson)
reviews.text: Great location. Great german food. Friendly staff. Reasonable prices.

reviews.author: Kaylee K
reviews.text: Perfect spot to enjoy nature with a beer and baked potato in the summer, or mulled wine and chili in the winter. We have been several times. Cash only.

reviews.author: Elias Nema
reviews.text: Amazing place in the middle of the park. Nice views and relaxing atmosphere.

reviews.author: Bob Jangles
reviews.text: Good food 69 and cheap booze and nice peoples! Lovely place!

reviews.author: Sergey Krutiyenko
reviews.text: We like this place. It's nice to visit and try traditional German food. Extremely nice location.

reviews.author: Tilman Benecke
reviews.text: Here, Berlin currywurst meets international communication failure. You don't order, you simply wait until fate speaks to you in the form of a drink. In front of me were four guests who put the staff into a trance-like state with "une bière, s'il vous plaît." Ten minutes of inactivity, then my beer arrived, cold and well-earned. The seller was friendly, perhaps because he knows that patience is a virtue, rewarded here with liquid gold from the wooden barrel. You have to pay a deposit: two euros for a glass that looks like a relic you wouldn't want to take home anyway. When you return it, you get your money back, along with a brief feeling of efficiency. All around sit pensioners with binoculars, students with sunglasses, and tourists with bad timing. The beer glistens in the sun, the lake sparkles, time dissolves.

reviews.author: Matthew MacLennan
reviews.text: Besides Kubi's point which I haven't tried yet, I don't think there are craft beer options in Tegel, but this is close. The beer garden offers a variety of Störtebeker beers on tap and in bottle form. They also have lots of simple food options available although I didn't try them. It's been pretty busy both times I went but the line moves along slowly and there's a nice picnic table area for the family to chill.

reviews.author: Slava Shestopalov
reviews.text: Amazing location and super-tasty flammkuchens – German-style pizza (traditional – with cottage cheese, cured pork fat with meat, and onion; Mediterranean – with ham, cherry tomatoes, and Parmesan). Besides, they make pretty good Aperol Spritz and Hugo cocktails.

reviews.author: Ben Smith
reviews.text:
Great booth with very nice staff and lots of seating in the sun or shade! They have a bathroom and excellent quality beer (Störtebeker Brauspezialitäten). Great alkoholfrei selections as well!

Did I mention how great the fries were!? Cuz they are also great.

reviews.author: Pradnya Mane
reviews.text: Beautiful... Specially if you have a group of people to go and have a small picnic it's super scenic. You can also take tour via 🚢... It's gorgeous

reviews.author: Fariba Fathi
reviews.text: I was there in a summer sunny day that a dance event . Everything was great. Bear, music, enatmospher 😊

reviews.author: David Powell
reviews.text: Good quiet place for a beer. Some food is available.

reviews.author: Despoina Gkogkou
reviews.text:
The pros: The garden is very beautiful, so is the place in general. Tables are sparse, so this is good for the corona virus rules. The staff is super polite. The cons: Unfortunately, the food was average (at least the burger and the roasted potato that was not so freshly cooked).
Overall, nice for a stop and a drink or coffee in an idyllic environment, but not for dinner.

reviews.author: Ömer Bahadır Orhan
reviews.text: We have just asked for a tap water but he refused it!

reviews.author: Anne Musyoki
reviews.text: Good ambiance and best place for chilling

reviews.author: Hanoosha Nagireddy
reviews.text: Great food and wine! Had a blast! Huge portion sizes and good vegetarian spread (forgot to click pictures of the entrees!). Not sure of the cost as it was a work dinner

reviews.author: Juliette Brown
reviews.text:
I had the fanciest „Currywurst & Pommes“ here. 😊 it was tasty.
We were so hungry and were first told we would have to wait 50 minutes for our food as there was a big group with many oders… after all the discussion with the waiter, he agreed to go ask the kitchen and we ended up waiting less than 25 minutes… which we were happy about.
It’s a really nice and big restaurant/hall with a lovely beergarden.
The staff were generally friendly.

reviews.author: Kristi S.
reviews.text: At first I was a little bit mad, because my drink was a joke for that price point. Saddest limoncello spritz ever. And it felt a bit like a tourist trap. But the Berliner plate for 2 was amazing. Die Buletten, köstlich! Cucumber salad, yes mama. Everything was just tasty.

reviews.author: Md. Mehedi Hassan Showrav
reviews.text: Great atmosphere. I was there with one of my friend and we really enjoyed their Beer & Tiramisu. Service was welcoming & humble. Thanks.

reviews.author: Onweni Princess Ashinze
reviews.text:
Awesome food, location and service.

The meals are quite surplus, you do not need a starter. You could also share a mean of you're not incredibly hungry.

Service is attentive and fast plus card payment is possible. Good price but not cheap :)

It's a good venue for events; birthday, office parties or even a wedding.

Minus one star for the hover flies, they were A LOT! (Was there during the summer)

name: Karibik Berlin Köpenick - Strandbar und Biergarten

reviews.author: Eve Schu
reviews.text: Such a hidden gem for a high quality snack on a lovely hike. The owner from Naples is such a lovely guy and makes probably the best focaccia in town (home made)! His choice of music also fits the chill ambience perfectly. The views on the lake are phenomenal

reviews.author: Brad Webb
reviews.text: Great sandwich on my walk yesterday. The owner told me all about the Italian produce and was very passionate. Olive tapanade was delightful.

reviews.author: Antonio Della Volpe
reviews.text: Suggestive spot on the lake with great selection of natural wines, beers and home made focaccias and snacks. Also great chilly vibes music selection! Totally recommended if you wanna relax and have a good time out of the city.

reviews.author: Chiara Faggionato
reviews.text: Super nice bar overlooking the lake. The location is beautiful and super relaxing. In addition, Peppe prepares delicious Italian taglieri and focacce to enjoy by the lake :)

reviews.author: Tyson Peveto
reviews.text: Great little bar along the lake! Good selection of natural wines from Italy and beers from Germany. The cheese and charcuterie board was perfect too!

reviews.author: YH Lee
reviews.text:
WORST experience of my life. got robbed 40 euros, and got yelled at and kicked out by the owner.

I dine here on 2024/8/20. I first order about 54 euro worth of food (3 drinks, 1 Flammkuchen, 1 Hirschbratwurst), then i order a second round of food (1 drink, 2 Hirschbratwurst), which add up to about 80 euros.
But i was only served 4 drinks, 1 Flammkuchen and 1 Hirschbratwurst. When I asked about the rest of my food, I was kicked out of the restaurant by the rude owner.

The owner insisted that he served me all my meals(ignoring there’s only 4 glasses and 2 plates on my table, and ignoring i have a 80 euros transaction history). He threaten to call the police if I didn’t return the pager (the pager I have in my hand because they never page me to go get my food. I have got up to ask the staff when my food will be served, but they just keep repeating that “you’d get paged if your food is ready”. It turns out my food is never ready) . I went ahead and told the owner to call the police because any REASONABLE person will agree that the food on my table can never add up to 80 euros. The owner got so flustered that he told me to get out of his restaurant.

Other kind-hearted customers tries to reason with the owner for us but he is too prideful and rude to admit he’s wrong. While he’s being loud and obnoxious, I still remain polite and calm to make my claim.

At the end the owner tried to pay us off with 10 euros which we politely declined. He never apologize and remain rude till the end.

Never step foot in the restaurant if you’d like your dignity intact. Record every thing if you plan on visit this abomination of a business.

reviews.author: Monica WN
reviews.text: Nice place, but terrible slow service. We waited 1 hour for classic Flammkuchen in which turned out to be wrong order. Instead of replacing it, our order apparently moved back to the end of the queue as we need to wait for another 20+ mins for the correct order to arrive, and it was bad (see pic). Our second order of beer had never arrived. Never again.

reviews.author: Sage Moon
reviews.text: the tall blonde waiter took our order wrong so we never got our food and he keeps lying about it so we pay money then got nothing at the end.  the owner did nothing about it  bad place bad service never come here

reviews.author: Mike Savage
reviews.text: Just don‘t bother - the staff don’t! We waited 20 minutes and despite being welcomed with a “Guten tag“ no one bothered to come take our order - the friendly waves or calls of “Entschuldigung“ were ignored. Perhaps a blessing in disguise as I had a long time to look through the menu and observe the ridiculous prices.

reviews.author: Jody Druce
reviews.text: Very peaceful

reviews.author: Arash Payandeh
reviews.text: Nice place but too many sits were placed inside and people are too close to each othet

reviews.author: Mahdiyeh Cheraghi
reviews.text:
Great place to chill!
We went to this café for some hookah and had a great time. The vibe was really cool, with a beautiful setup and amazing outdoor atmosphere. Everything was relaxing, and the staff were friendly too. Definitely a place I’d love to come back to!

reviews.author: Lennart Gutsche
reviews.text:
Fantastic place! The prices are absolutely fair for the premium you are getting. The food and drinks were fantastic and service was top notch. The staff was friendly and took their time to be helpful with our questions and requests. Just overall a fantastic experience, would come here again any time.

Only note for potential visitors: The cocktails offered are all non-alcoholic, which might be relevant for some.

reviews.author: Sriparna Tah
reviews.text:
The place is wonderful with the perfect vibes, perfect drinks and perfect hookah. The food is also really good, though the quantities are a little less.

Not a 5 stars for the service as the waiter was pretty rude and we had to wait for pretty long for almost everything.

Would recommend the chilli cheese nuggets, nachos, and among the hookah, do try out the Love 66.

reviews.author: Gursimran Singh
reviews.text: Very nice shisha. Perfect place to hangout. Must try cappuccino + biscuit.

reviews.author: Marcus Milen
reviews.text: Best bar in berlin,  the owners took good care of us and treated us well. They have an amazing happy hour on Thursday with shisha

reviews.author: Paolo Longo
reviews.text: Amazing atmosphere with good prices and nice drinks. Shoutout to my waiter from Kosovo👐🏼

reviews.author: N
reviews.text: Friendly bar maid and very reasonable prices for beer and pizza! The chips and pizza were surprisingly good! Recommend the nuggets and chips! Plus they have an interactive game board which was great fun!

reviews.author: Prince Yadav
reviews.text:
The ambiance is quite good with supportive staff. Although i haven't tried food but Beer tastes good.
The most important thing Shisha, you would love to be here, it's not expensive with some cool crowd.

One thing which i don't find suitable is, the sitting arrangements. They have different lobby. Music is clearly audible in inner lobby.

And please book your table on time.

reviews.author: Iker Lleida
reviews.text: horrible service. extremely slow and unfriendly. Shisha took way too long and we were offered shots because of how long it was taking, afterwards we were charged for the shots, which the waitress also took.

reviews.author: Kamil
reviews.text: A very nice business lounge with great views of landing planes. The drink selection was good, and the staff were friendly and welcoming. It wasn’t too crowded, which made the experience even more enjoyable. I’ll definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Ali Hassan
reviews.text:
I recently visited **Lounge Tempelhof at Berlin Airport**, and I was genuinely impressed by the experience. The atmosphere was calm and welcoming — a perfect escape from the usual airport hustle. The staff were professional, attentive, and made me feel comfortable right away.

The lounge was clean, well-organized, and offered a great selection of drinks and snacks. I especially appreciated the thoughtful layout and the availability of quiet spaces to relax or catch up on work. Wi-Fi was fast and reliable, and there were plenty of charging stations for devices.

This lounge truly elevated my airport experience. I would absolutely recommend Lounge Tempelhof to anyone passing through Berlin — it’s well worth a visit!

reviews.author: Basak Kecker-Zerman
reviews.text: The lounge is spacious; however, it has very limited food options, similar to the Tegel Lounge. There are no healthy breakfast choices like low-fat yogurt, and no sugar-free or gluten-free snacks. Unfortunately, this was one of the worst Star Alliance lounges I have ever visited.

reviews.author: Haitham Ahmed
reviews.text: The BER Lounge Tempelhof at Berlin Brandenburg Airport provides a modern space with panoramic runway views, areas for relaxation, work, and dining, as well as a conference room. It is praised for its serene atmosphere and drink selection but has received criticism for cleanliness, food quality, and shower issues. A good option for comfort and views, though experiences vary.

reviews.author: Golucci
reviews.text:
In the Lounge at the new Berlin airport, I was captivated by its outstanding design. This brand-new resting area not only offers a fantastic view for passengers to enjoy the takeoffs and landings on the runway but also provides a remarkably clean and spacious environment.

The thoughtful design of the space creates a sense of comfort and relaxation. However, it's worth noting that despite the overall satisfying atmosphere, the selection of beverages is relatively limited, and the variety of food options is even more scarce. This could be an area for improvement for the Lounge, and we look forward to seeing more diverse choices in the future to enhance the overall resting experience for travelers.

reviews.author: Alex N
reviews.text:
I visited this lounge on a Saturday afternoon and I was surprised to get a seat. It wasn't crowded at all.

Train stations can be hectic, but this lounge does allow you to avoid it. Among others you can choose from hot chocolate, coffee and water. When it comes to "food" I only soup. More free food is - as far as I know - available to those who can access the Premium Lounge of DB. If you need to work or just charge your devices it's possible as well.

Both, the lounge and sanitary rooms made a clean impression.

So, all in all, is it worth it? It depends. If you have access due to your Bahnstatus I recommend it. Same if you are a fan of calm areas while travelling and don't care about the money. However, if your budget is tight and you primarily care about the service in the first class carriage in the train, just go with the cheaper tickets.

reviews.author: Brett B
reviews.text:
Very unfriendly reception.
Scowled at just for asking one question.
Berliners need to be more friendly to tourists or we won’t come back or recommend Berlin.

Maybe that’s what they want.

reviews.author: Jan
reviews.text:
DEUTSCHLANDTICKET IS TOURIST TRAP!

I only cancelled the ticket at the beginning of May this year, so I have to pay the amount of 58€ unnecessarily.

As a tourist, I was not familiar with the conditions in advance. They were not in English.

In a civilized world, I consider it sick to buy a ticket for a month in advance and then have to cancel it immediately on the 10th of the given month.

Never again.

reviews.author: Sonia Nali
reviews.text: DB sells 1st class tickets for overnight trains depending at 12pm and the Lounge access is one of the selling points however the Lounge only works till 10pm. Well… I must say we very left disappointed.

reviews.author: cool 1
reviews.text:
Quite, with nice views of the train station and Reichstag building across the street.  Unfortunately did it go bad no drink service, of any kind.

They have a very nice coffee / Expresso machine, and tap (Voss) beer, and normaly water.

reviews.author: K C
reviews.text: Very cool place for a private party or event - fantastic views of the Zoo area in Berlin. Staff were very friendly and accommodating

reviews.author: Sonja
reviews.text: Very nice 70s style place, ex headquarters of Pan Am.. With great rooftop view and very kind service.

reviews.author: Leitha Matz
reviews.text: Time travel to the 1960s on the top floor of an improbable building. Friendly staff. Amazing views. Antiques you want to steal, but know deep down wouldn’t look right in any other environment. A unique experience.

reviews.author: Eynat Tauber
reviews.text:
Like walking into a movie set of the 60's, this is one of the most unique places I have been to. We were invited to a cocktail get together and the city view from the balconies offered the best scenery for the light conversations and opportunity for getting to know others.
All the decor of the lounge (and the appartment just below it - where you can book a night to stay) - is highly authentic and well kept while the music in the background and the food and drinks being offered complete the gorgeous 60's atmospheres.
I highly recommend booking this venue for your special occasions. It's like no other.

reviews.author: Alexandru Zegrea
reviews.text: Great atmosphere, nice vintage look, great view and exceptionally friendly service.

reviews.author: shay yakobi
reviews.text: The Tegel Lounge at Berlin Brandenburg Airport offers a quiet and clean environment to relax before your flight. However, the food selection was just okay and somewhat limited, which could be disappointing if you're expecting a substantial meal. Soft drinks were served from large bottles rather than individual servings, which might not be ideal for everyone. Overall, if you're looking for a peaceful and tidy place to unwind, this lounge fits the bill, but don't expect too much from the food and beverage offerings.

reviews.author: Paul Prime
reviews.text:
Toilets are clean.

Showers are available.

Drink selection is decent and always nicely chilled. Good quality tomato juice, draft beer.

Chill and smoking area available.

The biggest let down is the lighting of the  lounge.   The spots in the ceiling are blinding annoyingly that it's not possible to relax.

reviews.author: George Forgan-Smith
reviews.text:
Lounge was clear and not crowded on my 9am flight.
The breakfast options included toast, cold cuts and some cereal.
The machine coffee was average.
There are multiple areas which allow you to relax and enjoy quite if you wish. There is also a smoking area, quite rare in an airport lounge.
Staff were friendly and efficient.
Great for a coffee or drink but I would not expect too much.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.text:
EDIT: Since writing this review, the management have responded to our emailed complaint with an apology, a refund, and information about how they are addressing our concerns. I have updated my rating to reflect the fact that they take on board feedback and want to improve their service.

1.30pm on a Thursday, the lounge was hotter and more crowded than anywhere else we were in the airport.

The food selection was poor, and didn't include any vegan options despite saying it had them on the website. There wasn't even a vegan spread for the bread. Just a few bits of salad. No allergen information was provided for any of the breads.

There were a lot of dirty glasses and dishes around and tables were not properly cleaned. Cleaning staff were definitely there and working hard, but maybe the lunchtime rush was too much for them. Every 'clean' glass I checked by the drinks was stained.

The charge points on the large high chair tables (the only places that had a space most of the time) were unsuitable for most laptop plugs - only accommodating the slim plugs and USB plugs.

We asked for a refund and all they gave us was a QR code to contact customer service via our phone. Will update this review to confirm whether a refund was given or not.

reviews.author: Ilona
reviews.text: Not too crowded when I visited, food selection good enough, there’s a quiet place with a desk to work. Fine overall

reviews.author: Kateryna Gundrova
reviews.text: Nice place, where you can enjoy comedy shows for 10-12 euro and cheap drinks starting from 4-6 euro. Great view from the terrace to the river. Smoke area is outside on the terrace, so it’s good for no smokers inside. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: D O M
reviews.text: Great location! One of Berlin's best. A lounge and terrace on a ship by the Berlin wall. Amazing spot for watching the sunset with a nice beer.

reviews.author: Safiera Kho
reviews.text: Second time here now for the comedy show. Great host and also very funny comedians, good atmosphere. They include the audience but in a respectful yet very fun way! Definitely come here again ☺️😁😎

reviews.author: Ryan Norris
reviews.text:
It's a comedy show on a boat.
The host was on door duty, he's super polite, has an awesome range of jokes and deals with hecklers or loud talkers with finesse.

Drinks are reasonably priced, they have variety.
It's a small space so get there early or reserve seats!

In summer take mosquito spray, you are on the water

reviews.author: J W
reviews.text: Went to the comedy show here and I couldn't rate it enough, everyone was super friendly and the organisers were amazing. Drinks cheap too :)

reviews.author: Cla Cla
reviews.text: Great hotel bar. It's also open to the public. The folks at the bar are fun and make the best cocktails ;)

reviews.author: giovanni campa
reviews.text: Cozy and relaxed atmosphere, perfect for a coffee or a drink. The cocktails are amazing and the staff is stellar!

reviews.author: Kate
reviews.text: Nice place to have some drinks.  It's on the 3rd floor in the motel

reviews.author: Tscharlie01
reviews.text:
Style meets tranquility – the One Lounge as a haven of peace in Berlin

Those looking to escape the hustle and bustle of the city for a moment will find a stylish oasis of relaxation in the One Lounge Berlin. The tastefully furnished location impresses with its modern, yet homely atmosphere – ideal for a quiet break or a relaxed evening with friends.

Particularly pleasant: the subtle background music, which never seems intrusive but harmoniously accompanies the mood. Even at full capacity, the noise level remains pleasantly subdued – a real plus in the midst of the vibrant capital.

The drinks menu offers variety and quality: From classic drinks to creative cocktails to high-quality non-alcoholic alternatives, there's something for everyone. The service is attentive, friendly, and never rushed – which also contributes to the positive overall impression.

In conclusion: The One Lounge is more than just a hotel bar concept – it's a real insider tip for anyone who appreciates atmosphere, tranquility, and good drinks. A place to return to.

reviews.author: Mr Big
reviews.text:
Great location in the middle of Berlin directly at the Mall of Berlin.
Ideal if you need a break from shopping. Very attentive service, top value for money. Tastes great. Highly recommended. Definitely again.

name: Lufthansa Business Lounge
address: Willy-Brandt-Platz 1 Terminal 1, Schengen Departures, Level E2, Main Pier North Opposite, Gate B20, 12529 Schönefeld, Germany

reviews.author: Benjamin Wenisch
reviews.text:
After several visits to the Lufthansa Lounge in Berlin, I feel it’s time to update my initial impression. While the lounge still stands out with its fresh, modern, and welcoming design—including the well-thought-out separation between Business and Senator areas—there’s a noticeable inconsistency in service.

The staff inside the lounge continues to be friendly, attentive, and professional, creating a comfortable atmosphere. However, the front desk experience has unfortunately declined. The level of professionalism and friendliness at the entrance has varied significantly, and a clear negative pattern is beginning to show.

Given the importance of first impressions - this is an area that needs attention. Until then, the overall experience is slightly tarnished, despite the otherwise strong setup.

Still a solid lounge, but service consistency, especially at the front, would make all the difference.

reviews.author: Thomas Dafinger
reviews.text: This is a nicely designed frequent flyer lounge in my opinion and with that different to lounges in Munich or Frankfurt. But during my visit on a Monday evening food options are very limited and of low quality, which you could see and taste for sure. I took cold non-alcoholic beverages only and they came out of a soda fountain. Only water was bottled. There’s still room for improvement!

reviews.author: N.
reviews.text: Entire lounge smells like smoke because of the ridiculous and unnecessary smoking area in the middle of it. Only the area near the buffet is „smoke free“ but obviously loud. Great that Lufthansa worries so much about the needs of a minority that everybody else has to suffer. Staff did not offer any solution other than „I can’t smell anything“.

reviews.author: Terence Lee
reviews.text: Went by Lufthansa Senator Lounge with star alliance gold. Good food, huge, quiet, clean and comfy. Most seats also come with wireless charging

reviews.author: Klaus G.
reviews.text: Lufthansa Senator Lounge. Great food, friendly staff and a relaxing and comfortable stay. Most seats include a wireless charger for easy phone charging

reviews.author: Cătălin Goraș
reviews.text: It's ok

reviews.author: Muhammad Faizan
reviews.text: N okay place for fun

reviews.author: Ali Deeeb
reviews.text: Chillig

reviews.author: Sven K.
reviews.text: We visited the Kiss Lounge for the first time yesterday and were thrilled. Super tasty cocktails at a very good price. The service was great 😅 best regards this way. I just say Gin, Jack, Kirsch and Kahlua. We would love to come back next time.

reviews.author: Patte Kliche
reviews.text: When I arrived the shop was empty. When we were seated, the waitress came. I asked for a card. Then the lady said “I hope it’s not that demanding!” When someone wanted to order cocktails, they said she couldn't get any and had no idea about it. We are supposed to wait until midnight when the night shift comes. We were there at 9:30 p.m. I then ordered a Cuba Libre, which in the end was just a long drink. There was an animal in my drink. When I told the waitress the answer was "yes, they fly around here." There was no new one and I had to pay the full price. The toilets have no light and the sink is completely dirty.

reviews.author: Joe
reviews.text: This is a clean and modern lounge with very friendly, hardworking staff and great food and drink options for Business Flex customers. My only complaint is how utterly tiny the lounge is! When we got there (Friday lunchtime) the small room was packed with people standing around because there were only seats for about 50% of the people there -- the room is completely unfit for purpose. This meant that my colleagues and I had to stand for a good 15 minutes before we were able to find somewhere to sit together. I really think they need to move the lounge to somewhere two or three times the size.

reviews.author: Mi Bome
reviews.text: This is a very nice lounge in all aspects: friendly service, selection of food and drinks and even ice-cream, quiet atmosphere, comfortable chairs that allow privacy, location and view.

reviews.author: Disha
reviews.text: The lounge staff were very helpful, overall was a good experience.

reviews.author: Daniel Suranyi
reviews.text: Very friendly service and everything there: drinks, food, Internet and a powerbank to charge my phone. Excellent!

reviews.author: J Berger
reviews.text: Unfortunately at the moment it is too crowded and understaffed. Otherwise generally a nice place to relax and wait for your train (connection)

reviews.author: Eduard Zaynullin
reviews.text: Very good tobacco and hookas, music and overall atmosphere. Always nice people as well =)

reviews.author: Hunadah Alhariri
reviews.text: Very nice and clean shish lounge… the shisha is very tasty.. the atmosphere is great! The bathrooms are also kept clean and tidy. The staff weren’t accessible at all times, but they were always nice and accommodating.

reviews.author: Eugene Perov
reviews.text: Not the first time here. Best hookah in Berlin, way ahead of all others hookah. Friendly stuff. Although I don’t like that it’s a fully open space without any more or less private spaces

reviews.author: Karina M
reviews.text: Wow, what a fantastic place in Berlin! Finally a really really good shisha, nice vibe, music, very friendly staff :) possible to work with a laptop. I’m really surprised and I come again😍

reviews.author: Eugene Khimenko
reviews.text:
I was waiting for a sandwich for an hour and got ignored by waiters.

1. I've ordered a simple sandwich and was still waiting for it while my friends already finished their food.
2. In about half an hour I politely asked a waiter whether the staff forgot about my order. She replied that no, they have a lot of orders, while half of the tables were empty. Her attitude at that moment I'd best describe as conveying "what a stupid question to ask".
3. In another half hour I still didn't get my sandwich and asked to cancel my order, while ordering Wolt instead.
4. When I got my delivery, the waiter told me that they do not allow eating food from other places. And other people eating Wolt there was before this rule took place, apparently. After my friend asked her to make an exception just this time, the waiter went to "ask the manager" and didn't return for 10+ minutes until we left.

It was not the first time I struggled getting waiters' attention there. But never was it this unpleasant.
Was it because I'm not VIP and didn't come there in a sports car? Idk.

reviews.author: Mahmood Al-Sagheer
reviews.text: Nice service , great atmosphere and Best Shisha in berlin

reviews.author: Faina Iasen
reviews.text: We went here in a group of three for hookah and couple of drinks. The staff members weren't overly friendly, but bearable. The hookah we ordered (fruit bomb) was below decent and quite strange (in unpleasant way) to taste, it also wasn't properly set and fell two times without anyone touching it, falling on my friend and the couch second time (luckily, she didn't get burned). We also ordered several alcoholic cocktails (both of mine included gin) and I'm sad to say that we didn't find any alcohol in them. We were quite disappointed and had to leave after several unsuccessful attempts to have a normal cocktail. I have to admit though that extra cheese nachos were bomb, but it's the only good point that comes to my mind.

reviews.author: Hey Berlin
reviews.text:
Review for Balcone Fusion Kitchen

Balcone Fusion Kitchen delivered an outstanding dining experience! The food was super delicious, with the chicken perfectly soft and paired with incredibly yummy sauces. Despite being delivered, the presentation was impressive, and the food arrived still hot, which was a big plus.

The only slight downside was the one-hour delivery time, but considering it was a busy Saturday evening, it’s understandable.

Overall, a fantastic meal—10/10 points! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Antonia Grüner
reviews.text: Amazing bar! Food is amazing, the atmosphere is very nice, they have shisha and amazing alcoholfree cocktails. Recommend 100%!!!

reviews.author: M A

Excellent shisha cafe!
The best I’ve been to in berlin so far.
Waiters are extremely polite, shisha tastes very good.
If you have any complains they will change your shisha right away.
Very ambient as well and decoration is on spot.

reviews.author: Rue Alwais
reviews.text: I was hesitant at first to go because of some of the bad reviews , but i did go anyways because I believe everyone has a different experience. But what i can definitely say about this place is how beautiful it was and they had such great service, the workers were so nice and sweet and the drinks were amazing too. So I really think they deserve the five stars and would definitely go again 🩷

reviews.author: Christian Robert Adzic
reviews.text:
This was a special story. We just asked the waiter in front of the hotel for some info and he asked to enter the hotel. When we saw where we were it was like in a dream or a really good movie. We just looked around and were waiting for something to happen. A voice asked do we wish for a table? Oh, yes but we are not dressed as we should for such a bar, I say. But that was not a problem. So from there I realized the staff care about people and not only the luxury and dressing code. I can say we were treated as little queen and king until we left the hotel. That feeling what we got from that gorgeous ambiance, staff and the service, that was something unbelievable.
Thanks to the staff who served us and made our life that night so special and important to us. Good bless you all and see you soon.
A great greeting from Vesna and Chris from Serbia.
We will never forget you.

reviews.text:
I go there every day and drink my coffee, water and in the afternoon I go back to drink Red Bull and so on, really every day up until today everything has been great, I always love going there, there were two really friendly ladies and the man too. But on April 6th, 2023, at around 1 p.m. there was a new young lady there who was like 👱‍♀️ that was no longer normal, did she really force me to do it? It's arguable, I have no idea what was wrong with her, she served me for the first time and she had a small shisha in her hand and I did too, she started smoking straight away and then she told me I'm not allowed to. It's really not a problem, but I understand how she spoke to me so disrespectfully, it really hurt me. And I don't even smoke normal cigarettes, they were iQos hot cigarettes, you can smoke them on top of anything, nothing comes out. None of that was a problem, but the fact that she was so disrespectful is really not okay. There are plenty of cafes and bars in Berlin, but I always liked going to that one, and now I'll never go back, and I think it's a shame. I'm not a disrespectful person, and I was always nice until it was too late. But maybe my skin color just doesn't suit her, or my German isn't that good, which is a problem for her. That's not normal. I hope my review gets to my boss, he reads it, and at some point he'll realize that I was right about this young lady. They really do get a lot of customer service.
Best regards,
Basel

name: GRAND BAR - Restaurant | Bar | Lounge | Event-Lokation in Berlin-Mitte

reviews.author: becky aspray
reviews.text:
I tried their vegan curry wurst (I’m not actually vegan but I don’t like pork so fancied giving it a go). It wasn’t actually that bad - got 3 wurst’s,plenty of fries and a side salad. May be a little over priced but never mind!

What let the restaurant down was the service from the staff. I went there by myself just be chance. The waiter allowed me to sit where I wanted which was nice and came over promptly to take my order. I found their waitress a bit rude and after telling her what I wanted to have, she told me it was cash only. I did ask if they took card and was told they preferred cash ( luckily I had enough cash on me to cover my food/drink).

Neither the waiter or waitress asked how the meal was and at the end of me finishing, I could see the, chatting to each other within just a few feet for me and twice they looked and stared at me and didn’t bother coming over to see if I was done. It wasn’t until the 3rd time they stared at me, when I made the point of getting up did and started to ask about paying, did they actually start to make notice. Again nothing about offering card payment so handed over the cash and left.

Overall, nice food, just don’t expect a high level of customer service from the staff.

reviews.author: Yan Nick
reviews.text:
I organised a meal for 2 very large groups on different occasions. Both times, communication beforehand was easy and the restaurant was very flexible to accommodate the needs of my groups. Once there, the staff was incredibly friendly and hardworking, they are used to handling large groups and even enjoy it, which makes a huge difference.
Lastly, the setting is really nice and , of course, the food very nice.

reviews.author: Tena-Matea Toth
reviews.text:
Terrible experience — avoid this place.
After sitting for 15 minutes without anyone even taking our order, a waiter finally came over — only to rudely tell us we had to leave because the table was “reserved.” There was no reserved sign, no warning, and the bar was almost completely empty.
Clearly, the waiter (skinny guy, black hair, glasses) had made a mistake when a group of six boys showed up, but instead of owning it or apologizing, he treated us with complete disrespect, speaking to us with zero politeness and acting like we were a problem.
Absolutely unacceptable service.

For children there is a children's menu and a sandbox in the shade of trees.
We will be happy to come back!
Important: the entrance to the restaurant is a bit ambiguous, you need to go through a wooden gate to the left of the tennis court.

reviews.text:
I celebrated my birthday here.
The atmosphere in this restaurant is wonderful. (The music, food, and service were excellent.)
The hostess, Inna, is very friendly and even bakes cakes herself. You can order a cake made to your liking if you wish.

The decorations were so beautiful and modern that you wouldn't even notice them.

P.S.
It's so special to enjoy the lakeside setting.
This restaurant is also great to visit with children, as there's a children's corner with toys.
