reviews.author: B R
reviews.text:
I highly, highly recommend this shop for kink tools - I like top quality, artist aesthetic - this place has it for decent pricing.  There are tier graded pieces in the space for those wanting cheaper pieces.

The costume space on the second floor was excellent for sizing me to a one piece full body leather holster.  * the only issue for tourists, is the items on hand are what they have and no inquiries for other sizes/shapes if not available at the time.*

Truly not an issue - where I thought the holster would not be my size, the staff attending to me fixed me right up optimally & was such a dear to work with.

I could not find high quality shibari rope from the berlin scene to purchase asap, even with attending an intensive workshop.  This is from responses of the shibari instructors and the shibari venues.  This place has lots of different ropes for what you are actively looking for, right now.  *This shop was not offered to me by the shibari scene.*  The staff were even quick to explain which rope is suspension worthy and what was only tie use.

Fetish done right. 🌹 my new favourite shop to visit when in Berlin.

reviews.text: I’ve been here with a couple of friends for some drinks. The place is very chill, cozy, and vintage. The vintage furniture such as old lamps, televisions, and cinema chairs will be the first thing you will notice. In the basement you can play pool (2 euro/game) or fussball. Drinks are good and the staff was very kind. Here you can pay by card (a big plus in Berlin). Absolutely recommended!

reviews.author: Simge Uludoğan
reviews.text: It's a sweet bar I've been enjoying going to lately. The outside feels like being in the garden of my house, and the inside is vintage and nice. The staff are very friendly and our cocktails were prepared quickly. It is very nice to have table football and billiards, but the table football is a bit broken, I hope it will be fixed 😢 I will continue to go anyway 🙃

reviews.author: Melanie Golub
reviews.text: Found the bar randomly and came for a drink and stayed for 5 😅 amazing cozy outside-area, feels like being in a garden and the waiter we had was super nice and fun. So 5 stars for him, 5 for the delicious cocktails and shot he recommend and 5 for the outside area! Will definitely come back. Had a great Friday evening there 🍹💃🏻✨ Danke 🤗

reviews.author: Sabine
reviews.text:
Great bar! We started outside surrounded by plants in the little seating nooks they’ve made. My friends got fancy cocktails with fresh fruit / veggie garnishes. I just got a limoncello shot which was a fair price and tasty. Then we went to the basement to play a game of pool, 2€, it was quiet downstairs so we turned on our own music and a man was like no no we will turn on music for you. He also got me some change out of the foosball machine to use. Then he asked to make us shots and came back down with three delicious concoctions, which he bruleed an orange slice on top of each in front of us. Turns out that was Zaher! He was just hanging out, he made us another round of shots after this that were more like a creamy baileys drink.

So kind and made us feel very special to be there. The servers upstairs were very kind too, and pretty, I took another shot with one of them after we got chatting about Texas. Will definitely return next time I’m in Berlin

reviews.author: Julija Kravcova
reviews.text:
Ordered our drinks (a beer and simple coctail), every 5-10 minutes waiters passed by asking if we have ordered, checked their system - order was there. Every 10 minutes we asked, if our drinks are ready - waitress confirmed, that they are being made right now. Yet we never got the drinks, waited for 50 minutes. We decided to leave, on the way out we let them know, that they can go ahead and cancel the order - the waitress gave us an grumpy grim and mumbled something rude.
They were not full, and we could see one of the bartenders just drinking his own drink while the other was having a discussion with him while slowly making drinks. Awfull service and attiture, terrible waiting times of 50+ minutes for simple drinks, without ever getting them, and in the and getting rude treatment because we are not willing to wait any longer for nothing. Left alone any consideration to apologise to costumers for wasted time.

reviews.author: Osman Arda Ertugrul
reviews.text:
This place was introduced me by a friend about 3 years ago and I don't know why I haven't reviewed it before even if I'm a frequent visitor.

Qum offers one of the best sisha in Berlin. Their Hamburg and Lemon chill flavours are two of my most favourites.

It can get crowded on Fridays and Saturdays due to its proximity to clubs in Kulturbrauerie. Also as it streams football matches and some other sport events, occasionally it can get crowded too.

On the back, in the lounge area, they put actual sand on the floor.

They make fairly decent cocktails and have a large enough options for beer and soft drinks. They also make killer "Nachos mit käse".

All in all my experience with Qum is always pleasant.

name: The Sterling Tavern
address: 119 N Main St, Berlin, MD 21811, USA

reviews.author: John Mattingly
reviews.text:
Very mixed bag. Atmosphere was relaxed. Food was quite good. Service left quite a bit to be desired but then again it's only one person. Waited for EVERYTHING. She seemed to have something really important going on in the back the whole time. And it wasn't just our table.

I ordered a burger, wife and oldest ordered smash burgers. All three patties were completely identical. No smash at all. Wasn't asked what temperature I wanted. My youngest got chicken tenders and was thrilled. I tried them and they were awesome.

reviews.author: Bill s
reviews.text: My spinach salad was delicious and loaded with all of the toppings listed on the menu (goat cheese, cranberries, red onion). They definitely didn't skimp there...and a LOT of places do! Our server was super friendly; prices were totally reasonable. I so recommend this restaurant.

reviews.author: Randy Carter
reviews.text: Had some steamed oysters, blackened mahi tacos and crab cakes. Food was excellent. Price was fair. Great happy hour prices. Would definitely eat here again.

reviews.author: Doug
reviews.text: The atmosphere was great and the staff were friendly, but unfortunately, the burgers were absolute trash. We came specifically because of the positive reviews about the burgers, so we were surprised and disappointed by the quality. I don’t enjoy leaving negative feedback, but based on this visit, I wouldn’t recommend this restaurant.

reviews.author: Carl Cooper
reviews.text: 1st. Time at Sterling Tavern. Beautiful setting right on Main St. Dine in or outside seating is available. If you're looking for an old fashioned Hamburger, this is the place. Cooked to perfection with great taste.  Add some fries or chips & pickles equal some great dining. Coconut Crush is highly recommended. Just a great lunch time experience!! See you again real soon!😎😎

reviews.author: Cisca
reviews.text: What an amazing place to stumble upon. The food is great and service is nice & friendly. Staff greeted us at the door and asked if we wanted an English menu. The Umami Burger was delicious as was the Peanut Curry. Must also try the Basil Lemonade which was surprisingly nice and refreshing. Would definitely go back and recommend!

reviews.author: Ross Davidson
reviews.text: This was one of the best burgers I've eaten. The pattys are great and the portion is generous. The sweet potato fries were perfect. The staff are also fantastically friendly, feels like a family kitchen! Loved the medley of foods they have going on, well worth a visit!

reviews.author: Liran Doron
reviews.text: I liked the burger - Asian combination. My wife and I tried the veggie burger and a veggie adorn dish and both were really good. Fries were also pretty good. The prices are very affordable, service is fast and friendly. Location was great. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Diana Lynovytska
reviews.text:
Affordable, good taste 👍🏻
Food: we ordered Pho & Mango curry (or something like that) - the portions are big enough (especially Pho). The taste is good - Pho was not just a water but a real soup, mango curry sauce was really delicious. Of course it’s not a Michelin restaurant but you get what you pay for :)
Prices are affordable.
Atmosphere needs some improvements - probably add mood light, put some figures / pictures on the walls, etc. Menu book looks time-worn, requires an exchange.

reviews.author: Tomas P.
reviews.text:
I liked the food, it was really tasty (soup, burger) as well as honey tea with ginger. The the service was nice but a bit chaotic -  they brought us 2x something that was not ours and then after 1 hour our original order, and then asked again if we already ate :) The experience was pleasant anyway. The prices are friendly.
I personally will most probably go there again.

reviews.author: Peter Pimblett
reviews.text: Stopped in for a beer as was staying nearby. Great vibe, lots of locals and sublime beer selection. The staff very kindly accepted my beginner German but I notice the menu has English explainers in too.

reviews.author: Prasad Gone
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of visiting Hops and Barley, a remarkable beer brew bar in Berlin. The atmosphere was elevated by the perfect selection of music, creating an enjoyable vibe. The bartender at Hops and Barley went above and beyond to assist us in choosing the right beers, offering us a delightful tasting experience with three different brews. The quality of the beer was exceptional, a testament to the skillful brewing process they employ. For all beer enthusiasts out there, I enthusiastically recommend adding Hops and Barley to your list of must-visit places in Berlin. You'll be treated to a memorable and satisfying beer journey.

In addition to the fantastic beer and impeccable service, Hops and Barley also exudes an authentic and charming ambiance reminiscent of old German-style bars. The atmosphere transports you to a different era, offering a nostalgic experience for those seeking a traditional pub setting. The attention to detail in recreating that old-world vibe adds another layer of enjoyment to your visit. At Hops and Barley, not only will you savor exceptional beers, but you'll also relish the feeling of stepping into a classic German tavern. It's a unique combination that makes this establishment truly special.

reviews.author: kelly zehe
reviews.text: I do not drink any alcohol BUT hear me out: my little niece (5) accidentally smashed her head at the construction site right outside of "Hops & Barley." The staff has been extremely helpful and kind. They provided us with icecubes, towels, and comforting lemonade. Full points to these amazing people!

reviews.author: Nicola Heaton
reviews.text: Easily accessible location, definitely worth a visit if you’re a beer enthusiast. Great selection, and ever better service! Mo was an absolute delight to chat with, really knowledgable and had great recommendations

reviews.author: Jinkuk Nahidi
reviews.text: So this was my second brewery I visited in Berlin and by far this was really nice service. It had just tell snacks which was enough for me but if your looking for bar food choices this isn't why you would come here. The service was great the beer was tasty and the choices were enough. A variety for any beer lover with greasy service. Very happy coming here over the first brewery.

reviews.author: Anders Folke Westlund
reviews.text: Schalander was a fun and great find. A small homebrewery in Berlin with a couple of different styles to try with a cozy Biergarten and bar with fitting decor and lamps. The place was nice, and music and atmosphere as great, but the beers they brew were not that great sadly, however, fun of them to serve their own!

reviews.author: Bull Dogg
reviews.text: Great small brewery with standard German pils, Kellerbier, and Hefeweizen. The beer is good and the location is nice. Plenty of seating indoor and in the summer there is a nice outdoor seating area with sand. We enjoy many different kinds of beer so after a few beers it is time to move to a brewery with a bigger selection. That said, if you are happy with traditional German beer you may find this place good enough to stay longer. We found the staff uninterested and, seemingly, bored so we didn’t like how we were treated by the staff. There are many great breweries in Friedrichshain so Privatbrauerei Schalander should think about improving their service in our opinion.

reviews.author: George H
reviews.text: It's a nice place and the staff are friendly. I only like the dunkle beer offered. The helles and pils are a bit too sour for my taste.

reviews.author: Sebastiaan Naafs-van Dijk
reviews.text: Nice and simple place to take a homegrown beer, outside seating on a warm day. Great ambiance, lots of people coming and going, focus on great beer and talking and eachothers company.

reviews.author: Mike Tyson
reviews.text: Beer is tasty (brewed in-house), and both the inside and the Garten are super nice. One of our favorite spots to grab a pint after bouldering and watch the sun set.

reviews.author: Marcelo Moreira
reviews.text: A nice tiny brewery with good beer. They claim to be the smallest brewery in Germany, I didn't fact-check but seems accurate. The prices are not very different from any other brewery you find in Berlin. Overall a nice place for a stop and a drink at the end of the day.

reviews.author: Tiphaine Carrere
reviews.text:
Big big thank you to the bar’s staff who is super welcoming, pro, attentive and good vibes.
On another note if you go there be prepared for very efficient pickpockets. Can happen everywhere you’d say; yes, except that it doesn’t. In this case no big surprise as the bar policy appears to take little to no responsibility in fostering a sense of accountability among its crowd. The atmosphere tends to attract a rather entitled and careless crowd.
Thanks anyway to the staff team who is doing the best they can to counterpart that.

reviews.text: Great spot for a quick beer. The house brew is solid and well-priced, and the craft options are worth a try. Would’ve loved a bit more variety, but no complaints on ambiance or service. Definitely coming back.

reviews.author: Pierre

Great beer place! 🍺 Everything was excellent — the atmosphere, the service, and of course the beer. I really enjoyed my time here.

Just a heads-up for future visitors: they only accept cash, no credit or debit cards. So make sure to bring some cash with you!

Highly recommend this spot if you're a beer lover.

reviews.author: Kostiantyn Prudnikov

reviews.author: Jose Hernandez
reviews.text: No food available other than some peanuts and Ukrainian breadsticks. However, staff are quite happy for you to bring your takeaway to eat whilst sampling their beer.

reviews.author: Benjamin Maingot
reviews.text: Very nice bar with great selection of beers. They also regularly change it and brew some of their own. Highly recommend!

reviews.text: One of the best and unique craft beer places in Berlin with a lot of specialty beers for a great price. Also, the staff is  super friendly and knowledgeable. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Dragan Stanić
reviews.text: Relaxed atmosphere and friendly staff. Excellent beer! I really enjoyed a couple of beers after 10 p.m. You can find several craft beers, fresh and tasteful. Such a Berlin vibe! Music also!

reviews.author: Recep Yasin BALCI
reviews.text: The atmosphere was quite nice, and I liked it. The staff was friendly and welcoming. The drink menu was quite extensive, and they had their own homemade drinks. The music volume wasn't too loud, so we were able to chat and have conversations with our friends. The prices were a bit high.  wouldn't call it cheap but considering it's a quality venue in Berlin, paying these prices for socializing isn't really surprising anymore. In short, I was satisfied, and we had an enjoyable Thursday evening.

reviews.author: Christina Panoriou
reviews.text: Good selection of beers their own production! Each one has different characteristics and we actually tried them all! The service is perfect, they were coming to ask if we liked our order 😄

reviews.text:
Best beer in Berlin for a good price!
They don't have food themselves, but they have menus from the local restaurants that you can order from!

reviews.author: hello idk
reviews.text: Fantastic selection of worldy beers. Best craft beer bar in Berlin without doubt. Great service and variety of styles to choose from. Access to drinks from some of the best craft breweries across the globe is not always easy to find, even in capital cities, so Biererei Bar is a must if visiting Berlin.

reviews.author: Arvid Sanglert
reviews.text:
Best bar in Berlin for craft beers? Probably!
A must visit for the beer lover.
Wide selection of beers both on tap and in can/bottles for take-away.
Friendly staff and great atmosphere.

reviews.author: Hannah
reviews.text:
Great craft beer place. Lodes of options on draft. The cellar is a chilled room with a very large variety of beers to purchase. The prices of these do range and can get quite high so keep an eye out.
The staff were friendly the bar tender at the time recommended us places we had to try out for dinner as it was the first time in that area

reviews.author: Lara Isak
reviews.text: Biererei, the best craft beer bar in Berlin… And beyond!

reviews.author: Theresa Näsman
reviews.text: If you are inuti beer, this is a must! A wide range of different types, and superfriendly and helpful staff! I highly recommend this place!

reviews.author: Jess Blum
reviews.text: The tour was exactly what I was looking for. Great Beers to taste and a great guide knowledgeable about the neighborhood and how beer is made. It was so much fun tasting beer and learning about the evolution of the craft beer movement in Berlin. Added bonus were all of the interesting anecdotes about beer in history and German culture. I highly recommend this experience. Definitely a lot of fun and definitely not a pub crawl vibe.

reviews.author: Corey Chapman
reviews.text: Cliff was a great tour guide and was very knowledgeable about the craft beer scene in Berlin and how it developed. He does a great job with storytelling and does not overload you with unnecessary information. He truly knows beer and the scene in Berlin. I would definitely recommend the tour.

reviews.author: Patrycja R
reviews.text:
One of the most interesting tours around Berlin, accompanied by an interesting guide and accompanied by tasty beers.
The trip was organized for 25 people (or more!) and I think that I can say on behalf of most of them that the evening was successful and interesting. The beers offered during the tour surprised with their variety of flavors, and Cliff brilliantly created the atmosphere by telling interesting facts about beer crafts.
What to expect from the trip? Lovely atmosphere, lots of interesting facts about Berlin and beer brewing, and above all, the opportunity to try great beers!

reviews.author: Aubrey Maxwell
reviews.text: What a fun experience. Cliff was so friendly and shared so much information not only about the craft beer scene but also a good bit of Berlin history as well. I have done several brewery/beer tours but this one by far was the best! All the beer we tried was incredible and the venues we visited were unique. Highly recommend if you are in Berlin and love beer!

reviews.author: Hayley Watson
reviews.text: Cliff knows his stuff! It was a fun evening, great beers, some good insights into the Berlin Craft Beer culture and the beer making process. Would 10/10 recommend

reviews.author: Tub McGhee
reviews.text: Very cosy and welcoming establishment. Interesting and wholesome German food small tapas dishes perfect for sharing for a big group. Delicious beer and great service. Can't thank the staff enough.

reviews.author: Katrina Sharonin
reviews.text: Amazing hole-in-the-wall spot (so cozy) with delicious dishes and perfect service. It was our first meal in Berlin and the perfect choice! Bonus: lovely mojito

reviews.author: Marcelo Lima Filho
reviews.text: We had a great experience there. Very good food, beer and service. Cozy place e nice place. I really recommend it !

reviews.author: Agnese Paolucci
reviews.text: I had dinner here with my family Friday evening and the place was full but they let’s us sit at the counter. The place is really small so I suggested to book a table specially in Weekends. The food is really good, well presented and made with good quality ingredients. Also the service was friendly and efficient.

reviews.author: Geoffrey Holtsclaw
reviews.text: Wonderful restaurant tucked away in Prenzlauer Berg. A little on the upscale side (read: pricier), it's a German-themed tapas bar, meaning you can try various German delicacies in smaller portions! It's great for those who like to share or just try a bite of everything on the table. It's in a very inviting "underground" Keller with a cozy atmosphere. The service was super friendly and found a place for us at the bar despite being fully reserved. Book a table in advance! Everything we had was delicious, including the beer and dessert. Be sure to try everything!

reviews.author: Bull Dogg
reviews.text: Nice offshoot bar of the brewery. Limited selection of draft beers in the bar, but a very friendly bartender. We tried the lagers and the pale ale and they tasted fine. The interior is spartan but sufficient for a beer or two. Probably not the cleanest toilet, but this is pretty much standard in Berlin.

reviews.author: Pablo Holmes
reviews.text: Excellent beer. Made by the establishment. Already a Berliner tradition.

reviews.author: Steve Morrison
reviews.text:
Great beers in a really nice bar, but....
You can smoke anywhere in the bar and that's a big Red Flag for me.  Separate areas are fine but secondhand smoke is deadly and very unpleasant.
That's a shame, because otherwise, I'd really recommend the bar.

reviews.author: Richard Göpel
reviews.text: Really cool place, went there eatly to chill, drink and draw. So I got a comfy spot and good beer. Some blues musicians popped in and played a few songs had good talks with cool people and it was really affordable. Good stuff!

reviews.author: Liam Harrison
reviews.text: My absolute favourite drinking spot in kreuzberg, berlin even. Some of the tastiest beers I’ve had, for good prices. Patrons and the bar staff are also wonderful. Only problem is that my liver hasn’t really recovered since discovering it 😉😉😉 keep it up guys!

reviews.author: Darshan Gajara
reviews.text:
The whole vibe feels pretty exclusive. From the outside, I wouldn't have guessed that the bar would be so fancy.

The cocktails are excellent, the staff will also recommend or customise the cocktails based on your taste. They're quite pricey though with 12-15 euros for a cocktail.

The service was a bit underwhelming. We had to ask for the water a few times and wait even longer.

reviews.author: James Mims
reviews.text: What a surprise! I absolutely loved this place. It's not a large venue, but they really focus on quality vs quantity here. There were 5 beer options available on tap when I visited, and none of them were short of amazing. I feel like they typically have around 9, but I did visit right after New Years Eve.

reviews.author: D. Ebber
reviews.text: Amazing beer! I really loved all their types/styles so far. Great mix of traditional and experimental varieties and flavors. It's also a very cool place and bottle pick-up service.

reviews.author: Kjetil Reppe
reviews.text: Welcoming staff from the second I arrived. Had a flight (1, 3 and 6 in the menu), and really liked all of them. Both outside and inside seating, and they offer alcohol-free options. Would love to come back!

reviews.author: Tobi Gritschacher
reviews.text: One of the top craft beer places in Berlin. Friendly, well-versed service. Great beer selection, cans for takeaway.

reviews.author: R. Roy
reviews.text: What a place to be for beer tasting! Thorsten is an amazing guy and really passionate about what he does. Personally, it was a humbling experience. Highly recommend if you're in Berlin! Please be respectful about the story related to the attached pic. Ask Thorsten about it :) If you like stouts, definitely go for Katerfruhstock (made from real freaking vanilla beans)! A lot of effort went into making that beer. Have fun!

reviews.author: Andrew Coleman
reviews.text: Away from the main strip. Some good beers inc a poky IPA, a dark lager and a cherry weiss beer. Also blonde lagers. Very friendly and helpful barman. Tables outside on a quiet tree-lined street.

reviews.author: Tormod Gjersvold
reviews.text:
Great in house beers. Brewmaster behind the bar. Great stuff.
Except the smoke.
Come on Berlin, stop this smoking indoors.

reviews.author: Taushif MD
reviews.text:
Very chilled and nice place with really amazing beers (If you are in the right time you can find the happy hours). The bartenders are very kind and helpful. I forgot my laptop before leaving there and realized later when the bar was closed. They woke up from there sleep just to give me my laptop instead of asking me to come next day. Grateful for their kindness. Will definitely go there again.

Thank you guys for helping me out last night.

reviews.author: Cardio Salus
reviews.text:
My partner and I visited this place during our visit to Berlin. From all the bars we found, this was defintly the most authentic.

Not only the quality of the craft beer they offer was pretty high, but the treatment by its bartender was top level. Lisardo, a spanish young man, was taking care of everyone needs. He was very kind and nice with us and the rest of the clients.

Highly recommended bar in the hearth of Kreuzberg!

reviews.author: Karl Finke
reviews.text:
There's lots I don't like about this place. But the food is fantastic. Really delicious, well executed, very pretty and decently creative. And given that, the prices are okay. A little high maybe but if you choose a few things to share you can land at 20 euros per person for two people including a beer each, which is a great price for good dinner! Four dishes are a nice and filling amount for two, owing to the very fine dining like richness of the food.
That being said - the music is bad and too loud; some of the staff is undertrained and unrecognizable because they just look like regular customers, no distinction at all; and the beer can be hit or miss.
But the food warrants five stars and I'd still recommend the place and will come back.

reviews.author: Lou Hayton
reviews.text:
I finally made it to this taproom during a public transport (BVG) strike in Berlin on 20th March. Solidarity and the S-bahn afe run by someone ekse.
They have a great section of beers brewed by Vagabund and the Session IPA was particularly excellent  an explosion of subtle flavours.
Staff really friendly and welcoming. Happy Hour (5-6) is half  price so I got 4 x 0.3l different beers for 9.4 euros.
An absolute must if you are in Berlin and you like good interesting beer

reviews.author: Ma
reviews.text: The staff is friendly and the atmosphere is great! Very chill and welcoming. It is different from most of Berlin bars, so it is nice to give it a try! The music is always good and the beers are amazing, it is worth the price! During summer I highly recomend the raspberry sour! The session is also one of my favorites. There is a lot of craft beer options and some cocktails too. It is specially cool when there is food and dj pop ups. This is one of my favorites places in Berlin, just go and enjoy!

reviews.author: Ekaterina Kadykova
reviews.text: A perfect way to spend a Sunday afternoon: we went beer tasting and were pleasantly surprised by the variety of flavors! 🍻

reviews.author: Dmitry Polozov
reviews.text: The bar located in a former boiler house. I must say it was a delightful experience. The atmosphere is very cozy and unique, with the taps listing beer varieties written on the back of the door. We arrived at 6 pm and were lucky enough to catch happy hour, where we enjoyed a 50% discount on our beers which was a pleasant surprise. The selection of beers on tap was excellent and we were impressed with the variety available. Overall, I would highly recommend this bar to anyone looking for a laid-back spot to enjoy a good beer in a charming setting. I will definitely be returning in the future.

reviews.author: Rixard “Rixard201” Rueda
reviews.text:
This was our second visit to BrewDog, and while I was hoping for a better experience, I left disappointed. The biggest issue was the price it’s simply too expensive for what you get. I ordered the fried chicken, expecting a classic American-style dish, but it was so overwhelmingly spicy that we couldn’t eat it. There was no warning about the spice level, which made it even more frustrating.

That being said, the service was excellent. The staff was very friendly and attentive, which was the highlight of the evening. If only the food matched their warmth! Unfortunately, for the high prices and the lack of balance in the flavors, I don’t think I’ll be returning.

reviews.author: Lev Wasiak
reviews.text: Our waitress, Tianna (so sorry if I misspelt it!!), made our meal here an absolute delight - not only was she incredibly kind and treated us to a complimentary beer, but the food itself was also amazing. Highly recommend for both burgers and beer!!

reviews.author: M K. Gertrude
reviews.text:
This is my to-go beer place if I want to hang out and spend time with my husband and friends. I like crafted beer, even though it's a bit expensive, but I am seeking for the good beer.

Service can be very slow because of the number of visitors come here. Hopefully the management can add the team, so the waiters are not overwhelming. I could understand how hectic it is when the visitors are really crowded, but it's better to take care of the workers as well. I know it's stressful to handle so many people 😅

Location is really strategic. It's next to U Frankfurter Tor and also tram.

I go here quite frequent. I like the chicken wings. That adds with the atmosphere which really makes me stay longer to chit chat.

reviews.author: A. N.
reviews.text: first pub in the whole world, where a tap beer taste worst than a canned/ bottled beer. Tried 4 types of beer, all watery taste, no flavor. and costs 3 times the one in a supermarket. thank you for the understanding to the employees for returning some.

reviews.author: Arti
reviews.text:
🍺 BrewDog Friedrichshain – Craft Beer, Cool Crowd, Berlin Attitude 🔥

BrewDog Friedrichshain blends industrial style with indie soul in one of Berlin’s liveliest districts. Expect world-class craft beers, next-level burgers, and a vibe that’s laid-back but always buzzing.

🍻 More than a bar – it’s a beer experience

From hoppy IPAs to small-batch exclusives, BrewDog is where flavor meets freedom. Add friendly staff, a huge tap list, and an edgy urban crowd, and you’ve got the perfect setup for after-work chills or weekend hangouts.

🔥 Why BrewDog Friedrichshain draws a crowd:

🍔 Craft beer & killer food – no compromise

🎸 Alt-punk aesthetic, Berlin edge

🌍 Eco-aware, community-driven

🎯 Great music, real conversations, no BS

---

📸 #BrewDogBerlin #CraftCultureFriedrichshain #BeerWithBackbone
👉 Insider tip: Go for the beer flights + loaded fries. Stay for the energy.

reviews.author: Philipp Wiesner
reviews.text: Nice 😁

reviews.author: Königin Bier (moechen)
reviews.text: There's no bar here. Someone posted a photo of the food, but that's wrong. There's only one lager of Straßenbräu. The bar is at Ostkreuz.

reviews.author: Sabine Busse
reviews.text: Very great service and very good food.  Top would love to come back

reviews.author: Nataliya G
reviews.text: We truly enjoyed the homemade red beer—it was delightful! The pork knuckle was quite good, and the sausage was satisfying as well. However, I found the goulash a bit too chewy and lacking the rich, savory flavor that goulash should have.

reviews.author: David James
reviews.text: We had a slight heads up with Marcus's Brewery, my brother who lived in Berlin for a few years said if you want well priced traditional German food (and beer) then Marcus's is a must! It didn't disappoint. Food was great, Pils was also great, service was prompt and friendly (to two non German speakers). When in Berlin make a point of going to Marcus's, one of our many great experiences! May thanks

reviews.author: Artigian Studio
reviews.text: In a world saturated with sterile industrial products and over-the-top marketing, I more and more appreciate places like this. They have a big soul. The beer is truly unique — it couldn’t be more “house-made” than this. It’s so artisanal that, at certain times of the year, its taste changes completely. It’s never boring. I also love the Flammkuchen!

reviews.author: jennifer surjanto
reviews.text:
I could recommend you to order the pork knuckle here! The meat was not dry at all and  the skin was so crispy. Unfortunately it came without any brown sauce.

The schnitzel was just ok, not the thin type of schnitzel. Another tip: try their beer mustard on the table, it taste so good 👍🏻

reviews.author: Dmitry Polozov
reviews.text: The pub with it is own brewery. The pizza was simple. The beer was good and fresh. The interior is nice but the place wasn’t absolutely clean. I can’t say that I recommend the place for everyone. But if you are a beer geek you are looking for the opportunity to visit every micro brewery in the city.

reviews.author: J Lemcke
reviews.text: Visiting from Canada and had to come to the Lemke Brewery as we are Canadian Lemcke’s. Very kind service, delicious schnitzel, sausages and ribs. Tasted a variety of beers and Helles was the favourite. Bringing our family back home souvenir glasses. Cheers from Canada!

reviews.author: Melanie Zammit
reviews.text:
This is our favorite local restaurant in Berlin! We love the location, the atmosphere, the staff, and the quality German food. It feels like home. Prices are reasonable and the service is excellent! We also love that although they serve alcohol, there is no smoking inside the restaurant.

Note: If you have kids, you can bring them along! There is a wonderful play area in the back, out of the way.

reviews.author: Dmitry Polozov
reviews.text: Very interesting interior. Great service. Decent beer. The only downside was the schnitzel. We made a reservation 4 days in advance. The place was packed. So plan your visit ahead of time. On Friday evening, there was no room to drop an apple. We were warned that we had 20 minutes to place our food order; after that, we would wait a long time for the food. The schnitzel was a bit dry. For the sake of the beer and the interior, I would come back again.

reviews.author: E J
reviews.text: My favourite brewery. Tasty food with attentive friendly staffs

reviews.author: Sien Van der Zee
reviews.text:
Nice man greeted us upon entering, but the beers we got served (we ordered a tasting) were ridiculously flat. There was a mechanic busy with the taps while we were there, clearly pointing to errors with the taps, yet the server kept telling us there was nothing flat about the beers and it was just the glasses they were served in.

All in all ridiculous.

name: Gaffel Haus Berlin - Das Kölsche Konsulat in der Hauptstadt
address: Direkt neben dem Maritim proArte Hotel, Dorotheenstraße 65, 10117 Berlin, Germany

reviews.author: M&L
reviews.text:
Absolutely perfect experience — top notch all around!
I just visited this amazing spot and it exceeded all expectations. Michelle welcomed me with genuine warmth and professionalism, ensuring everything was seamless from the very start. Her knowledge of the menu and her suggestions made the visit even more memorable.

The atmosphere is vibrant yet relaxed, with great music and a lively crowd that adds to the overall charm. Drinks were beautifully crafted—every sip felt premium. The service throughout was consistently attentive, ensuring I felt looked after at all times.

We had the boiled gammon and the bratwurst and it was delicious

Michelle’s personal touch elevated the whole experience—her friendly demeanor and genuine care stood out. It’s rare to find such personalized attention these days.

reviews.author: Christakis Psyllides
reviews.text:
A brilliant recommendation from my wife!

Near enough to the main train station at Friedrichstraße to be a useful spot when you are catching a train and also a good spot to go and get some authentic German food on your way to the multitude of tourist spots that are scattered around that area.

Nicely designed interior that obviously is trying to make the place feel as authentic German as possible. That's probably why it it seems constantly full of local German clientele (always a good thing when you see locals in a restaurant in Berlin).

A very German menu (with English translation) that will appease most tastes.

Huge selection of  German beer options that might well be very tempting if you are so inclined.

To top it off, the service is very good.

As a result of all this positivity, the place is extremely popular. We went on a random Thursday after afternoon without a booking and struggled to get a seat. In the end, they managed to get us in and this also speaks volumes to the staffs fantastic attitude (not always the case in Berlin, I am afraid).

Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Linda Paz
reviews.text:
Delicious food and great service! 🇩🇪🍽️
Everything we ordered was full of flavor and perfectly cooked. The staff was very friendly and attentive, and the whole place was super clean and well-kept. A lovely experience 😋💯

reviews.author: JINHOON BAE
reviews.text: Nice location, nice interior and nice house beer. However, no idea why the server was too rude to enjoy foods. It was so uncomfortable that I almost got indigestion while eating. He even didn't take care of my ordering and served a different dish 😂. At the same time, Haxen was too dry and hard. No intention of revisiting

reviews.author: Adela Iturregui
reviews.text: Food and service are great!  Only reason it’s not perfect ten is because the food is not the best we’ve had in Germany!  However, it is still fantastic!  And the staff is extremely friendly. And the atmosphere is perfect.  Loud, and typical European. A mix of locals and lots of tourists.

reviews.author: sean byrne
reviews.text: Cool as smoking bar with brilliant beers on tap. Top man serving too 👊🏻

reviews.author: Dmitry Polozov
reviews.text: Very cute bar. It wasn't very crowded here on Thursday evening. The beer selection is diverse - something for everyone. The staff is very friendly. Service is fast. The atmosphere is cool. Liked the music. We will definitely come here again.

reviews.author: Jovan Vidić
reviews.text: Mauerwerk is a great local bar in Moabit if you like craft beer. They have a good selection with typical Berlin prices—not cheap, but not too expensive either. The atmosphere is relaxed, and it’s a nice spot to hang out with friends. Be careful on Saturday nights—it gets really crowded, so it’s better to come early if you want a table.

reviews.author: Elizaveta Fotina
reviews.text:
Nice local pub in Moabit, I didn’t expect to have such a nice place in the neighborhood. Selection of beers is great, I had a very tasty Pale Ale and bar mentors were helpful with their recommendations!
On Saturday it was really full, but I still managed to find a spot to sit at the bar. Happy about that discovery and will return here with great pleasure!

reviews.author: Hunadah Alhariri
reviews.text: Very nice place, good for a chill and calm time with friends. Reasonable prices and amazingly kind staff! The women toilet was also very clean! I definitely recommend this place for good time!

reviews.author: Yana Ilmovska
reviews.text: Not a bad restaurant, nothing special, ordinary food but made from quality products, which is important. I must say that this was a really fresh and very tasty pretzel and for sure excellent beer brewed by this brewery. If you are hungry, then this is a good choice.

reviews.author: Frederico Schmaltz
reviews.text: Simply an amazing place for typical German food. Great portion sizes and delicious taste. The staff was extremely friendly and prompt. Couldn’t have chosen a better place to take my parents who were visiting.

reviews.author: Wook Chung
reviews.text:
Even with a tourist's excitement to try out great German beer and sausages, it is difficult to rate Lindenbrau more than 3 stars. The 3-story joint is located at the fancy Sony Center where you get this awesome indoor/outdoor open-space atmosphere. And you sit in the patio / beer garden outside on a cool breezy summer day - anything should be amazing frankly.

There is no complaints about the beer. Plenty of great selection, and more interestingly, there were "beer cocktails". For example, it seems like mixing beer and coke is a thing. We just went for the default Beliner Pilsner which was slight bitter but refreshing.

The pretzel was nice and fresh, and really non-American-styled. Which was great. Until you realize the size was tiny. I guess this is the original pretzel, much healthier than the American counterparts, but it's tough to enjoy it without butter (which they charge you more for).

The disappointment came with the sausages. Quelling my excitement, they just tasted "normal". I got the platter to taste a variety and quite frankly none of them blew my mind. As a matter of fact, most German breweries in America probably provide tastier bratwursts. Also, nothing special about the potatoes nor the pickled onions.

The dessert was pretty good but again, not mind-blowing levels. I guess perhaps a 3-star is a bit too harsh but given the halo effect of the environment and the country, I think it is fair. Probably won't return if I'm back.

reviews.author: Lenoi Belzer
reviews.text:
Great schnitzel and alpen schnitzel (with a tasty and savoury mushroom sauce).
I didn’t appreciate the siders, it was a potato and cucumber salad and overcooked pasta spatzle. I forgot to ask if it’s possible to replace it. But we came for the schnitzel, and it was very good.
Nice to sit upstairs by the window, to enjoy the view on this interesting building.

reviews.author: Julia Barrow
reviews.text: Great German bar. Great sausages, great place to try traditional German fare. Splendid interior, great service to from our waiter. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Suhas Thakral
reviews.text: This bar is a minimalist design with a lot of personality! I really enjoyed having Belgian beer here and it is my favourite beer. The bartender is friendly and happy to serve! The selection of beers is quite good and the menu design is really nice . coming back for some more drinks!

reviews.author: Roman Zacharia
reviews.text: A great choice of Belgian beers in bottles at the best price I've seen in Germany. Very nice staff and friendly atmosphere. Also 4 taps with mass market beers.

reviews.author: Heran Bago
reviews.text: These guys know how to beer. Great bartender. Bathrooms are ok but not wheelchair accessible. Prices shot up pre-pandemic but stayed constant to the point where it's actually very reasonable. Would choose HERMAN over most craft and foreign beer bars in Berlin. Selection and menus are or if this world. Sports on projector if you like, outdoor seating if you don't. A pleasure to be there every time. A++ will drink again.

reviews.author: eloisebattey
reviews.text: Fab Belgium beer and the guy behind the bar is a laugh. Great projector to watch the football and nice area outside to drink too.

reviews.author: Daniel Tracy
reviews.text: Quite impressed with the vast variety of selection in this unique Belgian brew spot in Berlin. The vibe is great and Barr behind the counter makes for an adventure each time we returned during our vacation. We had beers recently released which are very rare to find and had many laughs while enjoying the atmosphere of this cozy place. Drafts variety also impeccable. Highly recommend for the beer adventurist*

reviews.author: tianyun zhang
reviews.text: The beer is good but the oldest waiter is so rude, she is a racist, I was locked in, she asked me where I was from and why I didn't know how to use a lock??? Yes I come from China, as a tourist I like Berlin, but I don’t know why she is so rude and biased! When she expressed inappropriate language, the young waiter next to her dissuaded her. She was still smiling and said, "Maybe I come from a place where people don't need to use non-smart locks?" That is so weird!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: sandee woodside
reviews.text:
The owner & this place are fantastic! They successfully prescribed a beer for me; I usually say, 'I don't drink beer' but the gurkenkaiser I had was wonderful—I'm truly amazed that I was able to enjoy a beer so much (it didn't even bother my stomach like beers usually do).

My dad was introduced to his first German beers; he had some smoked rotbiers that he really enjoyed while we snacked on peanuts and chatted all together. Our conversations with the owner were effortless and for us, surely memorable as well.

The prices are good, and the environment is cozy and decorated in an enticing way.

Plus, the vinyls we heard there were spot on.

reviews.author: Gustav Foseid
reviews.text: A gem if you are looking for good Berliner weisse, but also some other good beers. Good service.

reviews.author: Milosz Hajduk
reviews.text: A 'must see' for sour beer lovers. The owner is super nice and can tell you everything about the history and production of Weisse beer. And the beer produced by her is really tasty! She has a passion for her job.

reviews.author: Karl Finke
reviews.text: Incredibly well curated selection of beers and all of their own are unbelievably delicious and creative. What you're getting here is a great atmosphere, super chill and knowledgeable staff and a revived Berlin beer tradition. Cannot recommend this place enough, will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Rupesh Barbade
reviews.text:
They had 16 beers on tap, which is rare. I am a big fan of craft beers and I must say, they have one of the best collection of beers on the menu along with cheese cubes and sandwiches.
Definitely recommend to visit this place if you're a beer lover. 10 minutes walk from S Bahn station Prenzlauer Berg.

I tried the following the 3 beers:
- Red Lager
- West coast IPA
- Straßenbrau

Beer: 9/10
Atmosphere: 9/10
Service: 9/10

Must visit!!!!

reviews.author: Dmitry Polozov
reviews.text: This is a small Italian pub with 10 types of beer on tap. Here you can try the rare smoked stout, rye beer, or raspberry beer without syrup, which are hard to find in Berlin. In addition to Italian beer, you can also enjoy German and French varieties. The staff is very welcoming. Seats fill up within the first 10 minutes after the bar opens, so make sure to arrive right at 6 PM. The prices are affordable. We will definitely come back here again.

reviews.author: Er Mus
reviews.text:
Definitely a place I'll visit again! The beers aren't exactly Italian, but it's a very good selection. You can be sure there is a suitable taste for everyone, even for a beer critic like me. There are tables outside which is great for smokers. However, inside is a non-smoking bar, which isn't necessarily a bad thing (sayin that as a smoker). It's a self service bar and the orders are often delayed, most probably because of lack of man power, but it could be because it was a Champions League  🏆 that night, when I was visiting. YES, they are streaming Champions League 💪🏻
It was my first time there, but definitely won't be the last!
Cheers 🍻.

reviews.author: Teppo Lindell
reviews.text:
Excellent selection of beers and a really nice atmosphere in this cozy little bar. Especially the darker beers were good.
Seems to get a little bit crowded if there's some italian football match on.
The snack plate with meats and cheeses was also good but we didn't try any of the tapas.

reviews.author: Imke Sandra
reviews.text: Really great spot - lots of interesting and tasty beers on tap and a staff that is helpful, personable and fun. Definitely recommended. ✌🏾

reviews.author: Stuart Reeve
reviews.text: Very welcoming bar, quality of music depends on who dropped a euro into the jukebox,  I like the folk here, good people and warm. Met a lady who took blood for living and a postman.  Friendliest introverts in Berlin!!

reviews.author: Charles Vestal
reviews.text: What on earth was this pint of Guinness supposed to be?

reviews.author: Simon Puleo
reviews.text: I went on a Tuesday night to check out the local Gypsy Jazz / Django scene.  A group of talented musicians were playing  standards at top speed.  The almost prolific bass player told me he learned playing "on the streets", almost internal sense of music.  Good inexpensive drinks and straight forward bar keep treated all customers to shots that tasted like bloody marys on the house.   Look up at the doorway for the Django posters and other Jazz memorabilia.  Play a round of foose ball.   Friendly place.

reviews.author: Niklas Wittkowski
reviews.text: Best Bier Haus in Berlin. If you want a solid night out in Berlin Kreuzberg Bierhaus Urban is your place. Pilsener and Helles drafted and a wonderful and fantastic Berlin crowd.

reviews.author: Steve Morrison
reviews.text:
A decent bar at anytime of day.
It's open 24 hours and was really pleasant when I visited late in the evening. I was staying nearby and there always seemed to be folk inside. There were a range of ages and it was welcoming, rather than being either rowdy or miserable. Not seedy in my experience or attracting a dodgy crowd. I'd be happy to visit again.

reviews.author: Eva Yeend
reviews.text: 10/10. Great beer and great atmosphere. Cash only though!! But worth the atm fee ;) Recommend for those looking for something different than classic lager.

reviews.author: Kira Svane Kristensen
reviews.text:
Great place to get some craft beers. They have 27 taps to select from and also some cans and bottles in the fridge.
They don't take card, so remember to bring cash.

reviews.author: Zoe McArthur
reviews.text:
The staff are lovely and so helpful with deciding what to drink. A great spot to chill in the sun. The tuna melt is the best I have had in Berlin.

They have games in the back which anyone in the bar can use - a lot of fun.

reviews.author: Lucia Rodriguez
reviews.text:
Amazing sandwiches and large selection of beers.
We had the chicken and brisket ones. The chicken was kind of pasty, the brisket one was just great.
Cauliflower side was quite good as well, Mac and cheese not too much.
Service was kind and fast.

reviews.author: Nicha B
reviews.text:
Excellent selection of craft beer 🍺
The staff was lovely and very helpful in recommending the beer. The atmosphere is cozy and perfect for hanging out. Too bad I didn’t get to try their food cause it looked (and smelt) amazing. Next time I’ll definitely try that! 🤤

Edited: I visited Manifest again and try their food and it was AMAZING. The highlight was the sandwich (that I devoured immediately). Highly recommended.

name: Das Haus der 100 Biere -Deutsches Restaurant und Bar

reviews.author: Xenia Kovalski
reviews.text:
🥩 I didn't expect the Schnitzel «hunter style» to be soo gooood, not like the usual one. I highly recommend it to try!
🍺 Dju Dju Mango beer took my heart, but the Floris chocolat did the opposite.

I will definitely come back here.
The interior is classic German wooden, but pleasant.

reviews.author: Diana von S.
reviews.text: This restaurant was recommended to us and I must say, I wished I had discovered it long ago! The food was very good and well presented and of course, it certainly lives up to its name offering so many different beers. Our very friendly waitress Güzin was an absolute highlight and exceptionally helpful when it came to advising our guests from abroad. We’ll be returning soon!

reviews.author: Alexandra Birtar
reviews.text: We made a reservation before coming but there are plenty of tables. The atmosphere is nice, not at all pub style but neither sophisticated restaurant. The food is delicious and with big portions. The variety of beers is a big plus. I recommend.

reviews.author: pronins
reviews.text: Great place to sit outside and have a beer. Food was excellent, especially their schnitzel. While they do have 100 different types of beer to choose from, I certainly prefer their draft options - they don’t have too many, but just enough to create a good variety. Prices are ok, nothing too crazily expensive, especially given their location. Service was quite good - fast and friendly. This place would be suitable for lunch, dinner or simply drinks and snacks in the evening - very casual and laid back.

reviews.author: Zuu san
reviews.text: The food was delicious, the service was pleasant and the atmosphere was cozy, thank you!

reviews.author: Christine Wilkinson
reviews.text: Spent a fabulous early evening here enjoying the delicious cocktails. Great ambiance and lovely decor with twinkling  lights and comfy sofas. Great service from friendly, professional staff. Highly recommend for relaxed visit.

reviews.author: Daria Korneva
reviews.text: Very stylish bar with interesting decor and lively atmosphere. Have to deduct one star for the absence of wine glasses and quite average quality of red wine. Tried cocktails of my friends, they appeared to be very tasty. I think the owner needs to expand the wine list.

reviews.author: Felipe Vincensi
reviews.text:
Edit: what I mean is: I just ordered X euros worth of beer and was charged X+Y by the barmen working Thursday night April 24th. Cash. I don’t care about a refund, I just wanted to pay the right price without having to worry about it and have a good night.

They charge more to get ungiven tips. Poor service when this happens.

reviews.author: T T
reviews.text: Good beer selection and they have a fun comedy show on Tuesday evenings (in English). It's free (with option to give donation - no pressure). Most of the comedians - especially the host - were great and more importantly, awesome opportunity to meet locals - residents, visitors and transplants! The only reason I didn't give them 5 stars is because the bartender is as rude as he could possibly be but don't let miserable misfits ruin your good night!!

reviews.author: Daithi Kelly
reviews.text: Brilliant bar with the best hosts and beer was fantastic... highly recommended 👌

reviews.author: Mircea-Bogdan Tănăsescu
reviews.text: Great selection of German craft beers, plus a few classics. Place is small, can acomidat max. 20 people at the same time, thats including the terasse. 5-6 average beers in tap. Nice folks around.

reviews.author: Harshita Tiwari
reviews.text: So cool! There are 100's of variety of craft beers and the owner is super friendly. He will help you pick up the kind of taste or experience you are looking for. Location is great and beach chairs make is very laid-back.

reviews.author: Antonio J
reviews.text: You'll need to come here a lot of times to try all the beers. I feel here like a child in a toy's store. Price like a bar but you can choose beer like a späti. I'll come back every time I can. Wonderful and amazing place.

reviews.author: Samuel Gustafsson
reviews.text:
This is all about beer!

Great location in Kreuzberg and a good selection of beer, which literally changes every week. Been here about 10 times in total and always able to find new beers I have not discovered before.

Strong focus on German beers from smaller micro or nano breweries, but also many international options. You find a lot of IPAs, some good sours and many other kinds of beer here. Not so much into very extreme and rare beers though as for example Biererei Store is, but still able to bring great options.

Service is overall very good, staff is super nice and can give good choices if ask. A strong plus is that most beers are sold cold - so you can just enjoy them directly if you want.

reviews.author: Ali Lloyd
reviews.text: Great selection of craft and local beers. They stocked BRLO which is made very close by. Staff were fantastic and the atmosphere calm and relaxing.

reviews.author: Luca Kalid
reviews.text: Great little local bar/pub. Prices are very reasonable and with plenty of options to choose from when it comes to drinks. The service is great and joyful. The atmosphere is fun and they have some board games too. For all you smokers out there they allow smoking inside, which is hard to find these days. Overall lovely place and will be coming back when I return to Berlin.

reviews.author: KlankMan
reviews.text:
A typical Berliner Kneipe to fall in love with, nice staff that make you feel at home, i'm not a smoker but i enjoyed the smell of tabaco in my clothes after visiting this place...
Nice drinks, space, this Kneipe has an amount of Cult- status to be become a touristic hotspot, but they shouldn't!

reviews.author: Marijn Pals
reviews.text:
This a real one.

This Cafe is all you need on a late evening.

After a way to long walk we came across this Cafe and we thought: Why not?
The serving lady was really good she was waiting at your table for you to take the last sip of your drink to make sure you got a new drink when you needed one.

This is a real German Cafe where smoking inside is still okay so for all you smokers and vapers out there go there because you will love it. I do not smoke but even i enjoyed the cafe so there is no excuse to not stop by at this Cafe.

reviews.author: Ivan Cinoz
reviews.text:
I think we encountered one of the rudest behaviors ever. A middle aged (and maybe older) woman came rudely and strongly towards us when we opened the door and entered the bar telling us (in German) that the bar is reserved for some birthday or sth. With a miserable tone and rude
movements, she did not stop showing us the exit door, telling us to leave immediately. As if we didn't know how to leave on our own. Horrible behavior, completely unwelcoming.

reviews.author: Neil McRae
reviews.text: Good old-school neighbourhood bar with seating in or out and views of a small square and greenery. Perfect place for a chat with locals or for reading a book. Relaxed cheerful vibe. Excellent cold draught beer. Hardworking staff. Tranquil surroundings. Clean toilets.

reviews.author: Lorenz Blumenthaler
reviews.text: One of my favorite bars in Berlin. Klaus always feels like home, from the run down glasses, the amazing interrior, the unbelievable cheap prices and the funky crowd. Always a good mix of regulars and hipster expats. Chill vibe in the front party in the second room where you also can play darts and/or kicker. Pro-Tip: it you are here early enough you even can be your own DJ.

reviews.author: Juancho Barbero
reviews.text: one of my favourite bars in Berlin. The owner, Klaus, makes you feel at home and the vibe is spectacular, highly recommended if you are into local-runned bars.

reviews.author: Justyna Komuda
reviews.text: Very old school, cool place. It's not fake a old school (place just designed to look like) it's a real old school. Everything smells here like cigaretes and beer is very cheap and in speakers goes good, old rock. Unfortunately they don't have a lot of customers or at least they didn't had that day. An owner (I think) welcomed us very warm, like guests in his house. I liked it a lot because since very long time nobody treated me like this in any restaurant, bar or whatever. I would like to see such behavior in more places. It's not on my way but I think I would like to come back.

reviews.author: Victoria Weber
reviews.text: I love the energy of the place, like being at home - but in the 70s or 80s! The beer is very cheap, there are lots of games to play: dart shooting, pool and even old Arcade games.

reviews.author: Beto LaCalle
reviews.text: A travel back in time, to the happy times when beer was cheap and you could have a cigarette without leaving your glass alone. Klaus is a great bartender!

reviews.author: Alexander Dzerakh
reviews.text:
Such a cozy place! Extensive choice of wines and beers! Their sour’es are so good and crunchy!
Staff is extremely polite, handful and can really give you an advice!
Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Giavu
reviews.text: Charming wine shop in Prenzlauer Berg with a well-curated selection of natural wines, spirits, and craft beers. While the stock is somewhat limited, making it easy to explore the entire range over time, it’s still the go-to spot for anyone in the neighborhood.

reviews.author: Türkiz Demiralay
reviews.text: I went to a wine tasting day and enjoyed it very much. very knowledgeable, friendly people, amazing snacks that go with the wine and a good selection of natural wines. A bit pricey compared to the store wine but totally worth it.

reviews.author: Renee Nielsen
reviews.text: Great selection of wine and also craft beer! The owner Jason is a bundle of joy, he's really the life of the store. They also do wine tastings which some friends and I have attended. It was a lot of fun and very informative :) Plus we got a little drunk

reviews.author: Sam A
reviews.text: Lovely place with a great vibe. Been a couple of times. They've often got events and weekly specials (check their Instagram). It is a bit pricey - 8 euros for a spritz (their lemoncello spritz is a lot better than the Aperol). But you'll definitely appreciate the ambiance and how friendly the staff is. They speak both English and German. Bonus points for the super clean restroom.

reviews.author: Güneş Evrim Yılmaz
reviews.text: Very cute, friendly place. We loved the food and enjoyed our time a lot!

reviews.author: 谭英俊
reviews.text: enjoyable experience! From the variety of beer to the service, everything is world class, and as an alt beir fan, I found everything I was looking for.

reviews.author: That Dude
reviews.text: Awesome beer selection, friendly owner who is helpful to guide you through the wide menu. Good vibe, as well as outdoor seating. Must go for beer lovers.

reviews.author: Kane Bryant
reviews.text: Great little bar. They have an awesome selection of beers and everytime I go I try to have one of each on their tap menu. The atmosphere is great, it has a small outdoor and indoor area so I try to go a little earlier so I can get a table outside. The staff are very pleasant and helpful.

reviews.author: Lauren Papot
reviews.text: Extensive German beer selection with brews of every shade and characteristic. Cozy but modern interior, pleasant garden area in front, brotzeit and wurst available.

reviews.author: Nadia (nds_slm)
reviews.text:
Reading the reviews here I should say that Das Gift is no longer a Scottish bar as the owners have changed just in case people were wondering.

I had a really negative experience here.

Booked the venue for 40ppl at roughly 22:00 for my wedding post dinner party.

It was really hard to get anyone to answer on Instagram and eventually I got an answer but this behaviour continued through the whole process of booking the venue.

I paid 150e for a private room on the night. When we arrived (at 22:45) the barman had no idea we were coming. The place was not privatised and the sound system only operated with an old school jack and no other cables were provided.

When I reported the bad service to the owner, he said he would discuss with his partner and work on getting me the money back as he had 'dropped the ball' and forgot we were coming.

Cut to a month later with no answer and no refund. I sent regular messages to follow up and finally got through.

Their answer was that I would only get half the money back as I arrived at midnight so they had cancelled all their shows for that night and therefore I lost them money but yet they accepted responsibility etc. even though they had no idea we were coming and services were not rendered on their part etc.

Might I add that the bar was empty when I arrived apart from a few people from my own party who had arrived earlier and we closed the bar out at 05:00 so I think we drank more than our fair share.

I wanted to close this chapter so accepted the money but really disappointed at this type of behaviour as I find placing the blame on a customer when admitting fault and then not accepting the responsibility and gaslighting them into thinking it was their fault.

I find them to be pleasant enough to speak to and I'm sure they're nice people but zero head for business.

reviews.author: Charly corbie
reviews.text: It was really nice! I went there for a stand up show and laughed a lot ! I would recommend to go there for stand up show with friends but you can also go there alone (what I did). I liked the way people were there, really open! I would recommend if you want to laugh after a difficult or a tiring day 👏🏼

reviews.author: Ron R
reviews.text: Das Gift hosts open mic night for comedians on Wednesday's.  Well worth the visit for good drinks we enjoyed the house wine and beer! There was a great line up of comedians either starting their craft or honing it to a fine laughter.  Easy to get too we used the  Ubahn and walked from Rathaus Neukolin.

reviews.author: Freyda Lenihan-Geels
reviews.text: I recently had a birthday party here and it was the best experience. The hire of a private room is very reasonably priced and they let you set up the room with decorations and you can play your own music. The staff were so friendly and helpful and we all had the best time. They also serve nice drinks. Would definitely recommend for a drink or a party!

reviews.author: Tanja Renee
reviews.text: Hello, I enjoyed my experience at the bar. The bartender gave me a great recommendation for an espresso martini. She also had her own coffee liquor and she was so sweet in her service.

name: East - Korean Chicken Craft Beer Bar & Restaurant

reviews.author: Anastassia Koppel
reviews.text: Just simply amazing! Food was tasty, beer was good and service was really friendly! Thank you Nicole for kind and friendly service! You made our evening special! We’ll be back for sure! I can recommend this restaurant!

reviews.author: joppie
reviews.text: Spiciest Korean chicken ever. The waiter told us it was going to be spicy. I can usually handle the spice because of buldak and habanero but the liquid pain is actual LIQUID PAIN! When you are in need get the milk!!!

reviews.author: A Rai
reviews.text: The food was absolutely incredible, and the service was top-notch! A special shout-out to Thong, who was wonderfully kind. Every dish had an authentic Korean taste, and the bibimbap was, without a doubt, the best I've ever tasted.

reviews.author: Frank Amanor
reviews.text:
For a taste of tasty Korean food and at a good location,do visit.
Don't be held back to request for hot or spicy flavors.
You would be blown.

reviews.author: Erfan Tavoosi
reviews.text: Very tasty and delicious food as well as wonderful dessert as finish. Highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Vedanti Joshi
reviews.text: Definitely a hidden gem. Super friendly staff, live music on Saturdays. Lovely neighbourhood locals and some great food ❤️

reviews.author: Ilya Sakharov
reviews.text:
This is a gem! We came for live music this place offers every Saturday and got so much more! Very good selection of drinks, variaty of food options from snacks to full dishes (something that bars don’t usually offer). Multilingual interaction, card payment, laughter and humor. The public is so very heterogeneous and lovely.

Moving to the neighborhood last year, 5 minutes walk from where I live, I think I finally found my favorite local pub/bar 😍

reviews.author: Code Man
reviews.text:
Amazing place

Love ur atmosphere and party ambience with friends

reviews.author: Nikifor Blog
reviews.text: Live music was really good. Every saturday you can enjoy live music and a drink here.

reviews.author: Emre Ebeturk
reviews.text: Located in a quiet neighborhood close to Poststadion sport complex, this bar is a great choice for small groups of friends. It has a super nice bartender, fair prices, and also Störtebeker on tap, which is by itself a sufficient reason to pick this place. Music is nice and does by no means hinders conversation. They also have outdoor seating. Perhaps the inside can benefit some sort of de-odorizing. I don't know about the food but they sell small bag of chips for 1.5.

reviews.author: Oli Allen
reviews.text:
Great Sports bar tons of TVs. Smoking bar so be prepared for everyone smoking and the smell. However tons of tv for sports. No food. But we got a kebab from next door and the staff are happy for you to bring in and eat which is nice.
Good experience. Would come again.

reviews.author: Danilo G
reviews.text: I’d never come back again. There’s obviously a different treatment between customers. At the same time  the waitress demanded that we should pay in advance in cash and we need to get our drinks at the bar, not at the table, she  didn’t make the same to others customers who were able could order food/drink on their tables and pay the bill in the end… if you want to have a unpleseant experience in Berlin, with regular beer, you must go. At all, I think this place should ashame itself and think about this kind of “service”they apply to customers. Terrible…

reviews.author: paul hoskins
reviews.text: I enjoyed my evening here. The patio is really nice, the beer was great. Barman was friendly. A great neighborhood, there are lots of places to eat close by. Hope to come back soon. Thanks.

reviews.author: Mihai Diaconu
reviews.text: I really liked this place, very nice decorated and friendly bartender. Lots of TV's.

reviews.author: Mehran MxM
reviews.text: This is a GREAT local bar to hang out and watch sports and drink beer. The only downside is that they don't accept credit card. Most places in Europe use credit cards. Even when you enter Berlin Airport, you get a warning from the Airport that NO cash transaction is accepted at the Airport. So I don't carry cash with me. I had to scramble to fine the money to pay for my beer. But the atmosphere is fantastic for a local bar.

reviews.author: Nicole Gundlach
reviews.text: What a great little sports bar!! Nice service,  good beer.. great atmosphere to watch a game! Will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Nirav Desai
reviews.text: An amazing place to watch a game. We saw the 2024 Olympics US/DE Women's Group level match and it was perfect. Engaged crowd, helpful servers, and so many TVs that you never got a bad angle to see the action.

reviews.author: Seccad Zeynali
reviews.text: I was there last night and watched football. The atmosphere was great, and the staff were very lovely and helpful. The drinks are also reasonably priced. I love this place and will go here again.

reviews.author: Ross Beech
reviews.text: Great bar to watch a Celtic game or any football game, staff were very helpful and fast service. Beers are very reasonably priced. Cash only though but there is a cash machine 2 mins walk away.

reviews.author: Karl Hansen
reviews.text: Perfect sports bar with incredible Pilsner from the tank, super friendly staff and good vibes!

reviews.author: Luke Elkins
reviews.text: Nice little bar showing sky sports . Man behind bar spoke english polite and helpful told me where nearest ATM was ( 15 euro limit for card transactions) . Nice little dog walking about

reviews.author: James Tonks
reviews.text: Great service nice. The guy at the bar was very friendly. Great place to watch the sports even the golf ;)

reviews.author: Bart
reviews.text: Brilliant service, the lady behind the bar was really friendly and welcoming regardless of us not speaking any German. The beer was absolutely great as well!

reviews.author: isu
reviews.text: Such a lovely local bar. The gentleman that works here is possible the most welcoming staff ever!! Could enjoy various types of beer on tap. Thank you for providing us with another pleasant memory while spending some time in Berlin.

reviews.author: Sarah Ottewell
reviews.text: Lovely pub, very friendly and great service. Sky Sports and lots of locals too. We were made to feel very welcome.

reviews.author: Gareth Cartledge
reviews.text: Food this bar randomly after trying to find somewhere to watch Europa League final between Manchester United and Tottenham. The whole experience was amazing. Host was amazing. Got speaking to a Stuttgart fan who was an absolute gentleman. Glad we stumbled on this bar. 5 stars from the Manchester United fan.

reviews.author: Ashley Loftus
reviews.text: Went for a beer to watch the football finals. We had an amazing time and the locals and the barman were incredibly friendly and made us feel very welcome. We will certainly be back!

reviews.author: Alane Hogan
reviews.text: Do you have a NFL game to watch but it’s on late? This is your place then. Salamas Bar is just simply the best. Cool vibe like you’re in your uncle’s living room. Highly recommend for a good time! Go Bills! Cheap easy beers pulled.

reviews.author: Felix Haltermann
reviews.text: Traditionell German/Berlin „Kneipe“ Bar, very nice Location to watch football.

reviews.author: Kristy
reviews.text: Dive sports bar with excellent beer selection. They don't serve food but they allow you to bring in take out from near by restaurants. Affordable and the only bar in Berlin with the NFL gamepass.

reviews.author: Lineu Jorge (Lineo)
reviews.text:
I visited a cozy bar in Friedrichshain, Berlin, during Euro 2024 ⚽️, and it was a fantastic experience 🌟. This small yet welcoming place is run by two incredibly friendly ladies 😊 who go above and beyond to make you feel at home 🏠. Their unique method of keeping track of your beer consumption 🍺 with a simple paper and pen 📝 adds a charming personal touch to the experience.

The ambience is warm and inviting 🌿, making it a perfect spot to relax and enjoy the game 🎉. Despite its size, the bar feels spacious and comfortable 🛋️. The service was impeccable 👌, and the atmosphere was vibrant and lively, ideal for catching up with friends over a few drinks 🥂.

I highly recommend this bar for its exceptional service 💯, cozy environment 🕯️, and unique character ✨. It’s a gem 💎 in Friedrichshain, and I’ll definitely be returning on my next visit to Berlin ✈️.

reviews.author: Ibad Bayramov
reviews.text: Reserved a place in advance. Didn’t book a table for us and was rude and tried to kick us out. Disgraceful place. Never again.

reviews.author: Jana Par
reviews.text: Best place to watch football as they have several screens. During summer you can watch the games from their outdoor seating. Super attentive waitresses, great atmosphere every time there’s a match on and the drinks are priced reasonably.

reviews.author: Lucas
reviews.text: Horrible experience at this bar. The server (Who I suppose was also the owner/manager) told my two friends and I who had purchased rounds of drinks throughout the entirety of a football match to leave because we’d stopped ordering and paid, after the match entered the last 10 minutes. Keep in mind it’s not as though there were other people looking for seats or a table. This type of behavior really felt like discrimination as we weren’t being loud or anything and we’d bought enough drinks throughout the course of the match that we were satisfied. Keep in mind that nobody else was made to get up and it just happened that neither me nor my friends were German. I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone.

reviews.author: Tamara Menéndez
reviews.text:
I ended up by chance having a drink on a Friday night at Sports bar Lilly-Pub and I can only recommend it as it was not too crowded (and therefore not too noisy!!) and we found a big table to enjoy our conversation. Prices are really okay (big Berliner 4'90 and Aperol for 5'10)
Staff do only speak German, but should not be a big deal as they have all menu in paper.

reviews.author: Daniel Demant
reviews.text: Great little place for a beer. Very friendly staff. Note that this is a smoking bar, making it difficult to be inside but the beer garden is nice.

reviews.author: Natalie Makarkina
reviews.text:
People smoke inside and 1€ for toilet (good luck if u don’t have cash)
U lost ur client :)

reviews.author: dougie penrice
reviews.text: Had the Premier league on .Cheap beer and the locals were good banter for the football.

reviews.author: Freddy Terstall
reviews.text: A place for all types, spacious, good view of the street, good for night owls

reviews.author: Тарас Сенчук
reviews.text: Very atmospheric bar.  Joshi is an interesting interlocutor)))

reviews.author: Reza Majidi
reviews.text:
Went to watch Der Klassiker and some beer.
The staff were very friendly.
But the smoking literally killed us due to no ventilation. There is Kicker(Fussball table) and Dart

Also the bar is open to +18

reviews.author: Gaurav
reviews.text: Iconic bar in the neighborhood! Never a dull day at Schmitz, I've always had a pleasant time ever since the days it hosted legendary ping pong battles

reviews.author: Michael Hessen
reviews.text: Nice atmosphere, cheap drinks and some games to play. There was no toilet however from what we saw.

reviews.author: Philippe Zollinger
reviews.text: Cheap drinks, bouncer is a jerk. Confronts you about being drunk because you walk a little off

reviews.author: Gonçalo Soares
reviews.text: Was only once there on a Thursday night in mid February but was very pleasant. Lots of people quite a mix of ages. Love to see bars with counters

reviews.author: Christopher Danz
reviews.text: Such a welcoming place! Even in front of the bar the people got in contact with me and my friends, starting a conversation and inviting us inside. The owner then proceeded to be very friendly and welcoming as well. The prices for beer are comparatively cheap and me and my friends had a wonderful time here. I'll keep it in mind, will come back again for the next opportunity and can recommend this place for some fun, laughter, nice people and decent drinks. 😊

reviews.author: Christian Brearley
reviews.text:
Very welcoming place! Owner accommodated me and allowed me to watch the English football separately despite there being German football on for everyone else. The place is very friendly. I will be coming back!

Ps: As an English person, going to this bar for the first time, I can say that the negative reviews are purely from people looking for something to complain about.

reviews.author: Adnan Moiz
reviews.text: It’s a nice friendly bar. I went to see a match

reviews.author: Cody
reviews.text:
It's a nice pub. Not very crowded as long there is no soccer game on TV.

They used to smoke inside but now it's forbidden. The owner might change it back again.

The beer is affordable...

The waitresses are friendly and helpful. Sometimes you gotta wait a little bit till you get your order. It happens.

Fridays and Saturdays are the best days to be there. Sometimes even Thursdays.

The restrooms are in a bad shape. Mostly the male restroom is smelly.

reviews.author: Maxence Goussot
reviews.text: They kicked us out of the bar because we weren't consumming but didnt even asked us if we needed the menu. The employee was angry with everyone. Do not come here.

reviews.author: stan tonkin
