reviews.author: Geht dich Gar nix an
reviews.text:
Sorry, but one star is actually too much for the store. I've already been to a few pubs and bars, but this place really goes beyond the scope. I've been there three times now at different times and nothing has changed in the store. Hence my review.

The furniture is run down, especially the back benches in the billiards room.
Cracked seats, dirty sticky carpet and the tables and bar tables are also very worn out. The stools are very wobbly, so when you sit on them you think you're going to fall over, so it's better not to.

The left dartboard doesn't count as well as it should and the pool table is also getting old. You then have to share a cue because there doesn't seem to be another one. The darts could also be replaced.

Then there are some long curtains, which doesn't make the store look any better, and junk is stored behind them.

The toilets are at the back. The hallway is anything but clean and it hasn't been painted in a while. Old cigarette machine is still hanging there and doesn't work.

The women's toilet: Extremely disgusting. You really lose your mind when you go to the toilet. There were still pieces hanging on the walls or I have no idea what they were. I don't think there's anything else to say about it.

Men's toilet: Broken faucet, hanging at half past seven. Very dirty.

Both toilets should definitely be renovated and, in general, they should be cleaned regularly and, on the other hand, the cleanliness of a pub that is open 24 hours must be regularly checked and restored.
It cannot be the case that as a guest you start to maintain a certain level of cleanliness in the toilet and have to ask for cleaning utensils in order to even be able to use the tap. It doesn't work at all. The same applies to refilling utensils (toilet paper).

In general, the store should be completely renovated. Because he is getting old.

When it comes to the service, I have to say that there is definitely still room for improvement. Friendliness is apparently a foreign word and smiling is not a thing either. You felt quite unwelcome as a guest. Apparently it's because the waitresses are not satisfied with their work and probably with the store itself. I think if you get involved, things can get better.
Cocktail training for the ladies would also be recommended. There is no white sugar in a Caipi.
What was also extremely annoying with the drinks was that there was either too much alcohol in the glasses or too little. And unfortunately the ladies didn't seem trustworthy when they wrote down the drinks either. We think we paid too much too. They didn't want to go into clarification because they were afraid that it might get out of hand. But it was also due to the audience, which was there from midnight onwards. That was also the reason why we left. A very bad mood arose. With one girl I also asked myself whether she was even 18 yet. I don't think it's controlled.

We definitely won't be coming back, which is a shame because the shop actually has potential and the guests before midnight were very pleasant.

I hope the owner takes care of this and wish you all the best for the future.

reviews.author: chimichurri
reviews.text:
We really wanted to find a fun arcade in Berlin, not one of those typical gambling spots, but a place where you can actually enjoy games and hang out with friends. This arcade was one of the few we found, and the experience was genuinely great. We loved it!

The staff was super friendly and helped us figure out which ticket package to go for. Once you enter, it’s all pretty straightforward, you head to the kiosk, choose a card with a certain amount of points, and you’re good to go. We’d recommend getting the €30 card. For two people, that was more than enough, we played most of the games at least once, and it felt like the best value.

The games were a lot of fun, and what made it even better was the ticket system. A lot of arcades in Germany don’t have that, so it was nice to actually win tickets and redeem them for a small prize at the end.

There were even a few games we’d never seen before, which made it even more exciting to try new things and just have fun. We’ll definitely be going back!

There’s also a restaurant area with a bar. We didn’t try it since we weren’t hungry, but it looked like a nice place to grab food or drinks. The whole space would actually be perfect for a birthday party or special event, you could eat, celebrate, and play games all in one place.

They also have bowling and billiards, but you’ll have to pay separately for those.

All in all, a really solid experience, we’ll for sure be visiting again! :)

I had moderate expectations about the food since this place is more focused on fun, video games, and entertainment in general. However, I was pleasantly surprised! reviews.text: I gave 3 stars only because the evening was saved by a guy from the staff because for the experience with a girl on the staff I would have given 0. I would like to point out that I understand the waiter's job so I do not accept rude behavior. When we got to the restaurant part we we sat down and ordered, after I asked to remove a dish from the order but I was told no because they were already preparing it (a bit strange after two minutes from the order). We eat, good food, fair prices, the time comes to pay. We couldn't understand each other with the girl (because of the music and of our english ) we had asked to split the bill, first she says no, then yes and in the meantime he showed signs of annoyance (rolling his eyes, hitting his face while leaning on the table, huffing, etc.). In the end we didn't even play and told the experience to another boy who instead is loving and offers us a card to play and some sweets. There is enough choice of games and a good atmosphere for the rest. I hope the girl learns from her mistakes with all my heart because the work is tiring but you have to be patient.

reviews.author: Khizar Malik
reviews.text: Went there for a standup comdey/poem show and it was amazing!

reviews.author: C (C)
reviews.text: You always feel at home at Holzwurm. There are games, darts, and billiards, the bar staff are friendly, and the atmosphere is great! There are large tables for large groups and even outdoor seating. Unfortunately, it's a smoking bar, and you can only pay by cash (no big deal, just FYI). We always enjoy coming here!

reviews.author: Gordon Sumner
reviews.text: I've known the store for 10 years. For the first of May there was delicious grilli and the highlight: at 28 degrees outside there was a sprinkler system on the awning. Everyone was allowed to dance through it. Caring service and nice people in the middle of Moabit. Holy Earth!!!

reviews.author: Pablo Knappe Rodriguez
reviews.text: It was very nice at the Holzwurm. We were always greeted warmly, and the atmosphere was always great. However, it should be noted that it's a smoking bar, with no ventilation system. Anyone who treats themselves to a drink here won't be disappointed, although you'll smell like an ashtray afterward.

reviews.author: Ralf Hänschen
reviews.text: Always very nice, we like to come by every now and then for a few drinks and some local stories.

reviews.author: j p
reviews.text:
Very Reasonably priced beer. Cheapest bar we came  across.
Sebastian is a wonderful mine host, very friendly. Great atmosphere.

Can't wait to return
Eisern Union

reviews.author: duke tog
reviews.text: Being a fan of pinball my good lady looks up wherever we are if any are near us. While having a afternoon tram ride she says as we stop "medieval madness" of we get and a few beers and way to many games we left.  Cheap basic old school pub, what's not to love.

reviews.author: Francesco Maltoni
reviews.text: The owner was listening to Black Sabbath regardless of fashon, suggested a beer I did not know and was very good, the atmosphere was friendly love that place

reviews.author: K St
reviews.text: Really nice, authentic bar. Good prices.

reviews.author: Christian Friske
reviews.text: Nice place.if you want to go to a traditional bar in berlin

reviews.author: David Allan
reviews.text: We were disappointed. The place was more run down than expected and the food disappointing. The pizza was OK but the pasta was bland and very greasy. I ordered what appeared to be (on the German menu) potato skins. The Cheese Skins turned out to be baked potatoes... I will take the hit for that. We left about half the meal on the plate.. paid and left. Won't return and would not really recommend it.

reviews.author: Erin Mason
reviews.text: Went here for dinner on our first night in Berlin, was a great place and the food was amazing!! Staff were so kind and made it a great experience! Definitely recommend going if you go to Berlin☺️

reviews.author: Eva Vlieger
reviews.text: DO NOT ORDER THE ENCHILADAS, there was something terribly wrong with them, I wasn’t expecting authentic tex mex but it was literally plain chicken in a tortilla with some plain tomato sauce on top, just something in it tasted chemically or expired, I had to spit it out after one bite. Luckily after explaining that I didn’t just dislike it there was something wrong with it I was allowed to choose a different dish instead. The vibes and decorations are fun. Burger was good milkshake was good and fries were ok tho very greasy and lacked salt. It’s fun to visit for the vibes and aesthetic but some dishes definitely need improvement in quality.

reviews.author: Cristina RG
reviews.text: We had lunch here and the food is nice. There’s a curious happy hour with dishes for 9,50€ each. Prices of drinks are Berlin normal ones. The thing is we ordered two Coca Colas and we received two glasses with “cola”, but obviously it wasn’t original Coca Cola. So…soft drinks should be cheaper for sure…The service is very nice but the local needs to be refurbished a lot. Manu sofas are broken, the local and glasses weren’t that clean…I guess they need more hands.Good idea if you want to have lunch with cheap prices!

reviews.author: Vlada Liashchenko
reviews.text: Ordered a burger which was undercooked, asked the waitress about it and she said its medium, but she never asked me how I would like this patty to be cooked. Do not recommend.

reviews.author: bruce packard
reviews.text: Great place for watching football.  3x screen so that even if there's a Bundesliga game showing, still possible to watch Premier League.  Helps if you smile and ask nicely though .

reviews.author: mike
reviews.text: fun spot, looks like very local bar, so you can get authentic experience there with cracking wooden floor and other things

reviews.author: WILL. I. AM.
reviews.text: The staff were very nice. Unfortunately in the day I have been there, the alive music was a closed event and I was not able to join. The food was good and the beer too. The price was fare!

reviews.author: Marta Vega
reviews.text: We were upstairs for drinks late in the evening. There was cozy atmosphere to talk for hours with friends. Good prices, amazing cocktails and our waiter was so professional, funny and friendly. We got nachos with dips for free. It was literally the best service I have gotten in years, absolute perfection.

reviews.author: Sawako Ogo
reviews.text: Very nice, welcoming staff/bartender person and calm atmosphere where you can enjoy conversations with your company.

reviews.author: Eldar B
reviews.text: Absolutely love this place! Route 66 American Diner in Berlin hits all the right notes — juicy, made-to-order burgers, incredibly crispy homemade fries, and genuinely friendly service. The staff checked in more than once to make sure we were happy, which was a great touch. The retro Americana décor adds a fun vibe, and the background music sets the perfect mood without being overwhelming. The spacious beer garden is a big plus, especially on sunny days, and everything from the seating area to the bathrooms is spotless. I came here years ago and was thrilled to see that the quality is just as high now. Highly recommend for anyone craving great food in a relaxed, classic diner setting!

reviews.author: Louis Frömmrich
reviews.text:
The place has this vintage American style. Its cosy, especially on the outside Terrasse during the warm seasons. Calm place next to Ludwigkirchplatz, the streets are calm, a lot of green, which gives it a peaceful atmosphere.
The food and service are ok in my experience, though could be better. Anyhow a pleasant experience for me.

reviews.author: Micky Friedmann
reviews.text: Great juicy burgers, great crispy French fries & the service was very friendly. I know this place for many years & it’s so good to know that Route 66 American Diner in Berlin kept the food and service quality. 👏👏👏👏👏

reviews.author: Aneta Horáková
reviews.text: Very nice service. I appreciate, that we've been asked at least twice if everything is fine. The food was delicious. Especially the home made french fries. Stylish interior. Fitting music, not too loud. Huge beer garden. Clean and nice bathroom. The place is huge, so I don't think you have to make a reservation. I visited this place also 10 years ago and the quality level is still great.

reviews.author: Abi K
reviews.text: This was one for my daughter so I didn't hold out much hope but I loved it.  Was the best burger I've ever had. The atmosphere was great and all of the pictures and music was exactly what I wanted to see and hear. So happy she picked it.

reviews.author: Caitlin Broadhurst
reviews.text: Good fun if you love a game of shuffleboard. If you book a shuffleboard table you can make use of the drinks offers. 3L for 19,50€ you can't go wrong.

reviews.author: Sonia Galega!!!
reviews.text: I celebrated my bday there and we had a lot for fun playing with the giant Jenga and shuffleboard. We also use the karaoke. Great place where you can spend quality and fun times with your friends and family!

reviews.author: Florian Heiwig
reviews.text: A great spot for a fun, relaxed night! The bartenders were super friendly and explained shuffleboard to us as first-timers. The young crowd was chill, adding to the laid-back vibe of this hostel bar. Perfect place to enjoy a game and a drink—highly recommended!

reviews.author: Ulf Althinsson
reviews.text: A very nice place with amazing staff.. the only thing worth mentioning was that me and my friends doubled the average age

reviews.author: Berkay Biçer
reviews.text: Staff is intentionally ignoring customers as they like. We’ve been here twice to play beerpong and shuffleboard. Both times, the staff said that they already closed the games although there were others playing even one hour after we arrived. Overall the place is full of underage youngsters having a hostel experience in Berlin so better to avoid.

name: Gallery Rooftop Bar am Mercedes Platz

reviews.author: ammar
reviews.text: Very nice Bar, will visit again, waitresses were super friendly and nice. They have so many alcohol free options too

reviews.author: Nicole Pesidze
reviews.text: We spend whole evening here with a big company and received amazing service! Waiter was very friendly, knew 3 languages and was serving us extremely fast. Music was very good too, it’s something that you expect to hear in the lounge.

reviews.author: Sofya
reviews.text: Service was not too good. There were so many tables and that didn’t allow us to sit inside even though we had a reservation. Furthermore, they didn’t have any snacks which pretty disappointed us. So better come to any other bar. I give one star only for the view

reviews.author: Gabriel
reviews.text: Ver good bar with nice views over the spree, it has a nice selection of not conventional cocktails ( tried a tequila, wasabi mix 👍🏻) . A very good point is that it has both an outside and inside area so on cold and rainy days you can still enjoy it. The music selection can somehow be improved.

reviews.author: Huzefa
reviews.text:
Reservation was made for Birthday celebration.

Pros:
+ fancy rooftop, clean and modern
+ nice view of river with Oberbaum Bridge
+ service was good

Cons:
- ice tea wasn’t nice, i was expecting more

Verdict:
Good place to hangout.

reviews.author: Ñusta Nina
reviews.text: Disappointing offering, uncomfortable seating, sparse decor. We were ready for some luxurious atmosphere and exclusive cocktails, but were disappointed. Shown to uncomfortable chairs facing a wall, the cocktails on offer were generic (aperol spritz etc) I don’t mind paying extra for a good cocktail, but here you are treated to the same cocktails they have everywhere for about 1,5 times more. The final disappointment were the toilets, out of soap (??) and not clean. Never again.

reviews.author: Jochen Fromm
reviews.text: The Serenity Rooftop Bar at the Waldorf-Astoria is directly across the street from the Rooftop One Bar at the Motel One Berlin-Upper West. Prices are high, as expected for a 5-star hotel. However, the view is good, and all guests are warmly welcomed, whether movie stars or ordinary Berliners. You can't go wrong with the Moët Chandon Garden Spritz (pictured).

reviews.author: Hakon Schalk
reviews.text:
A very chic rooftop bar in the Waldorf Astoria Hotel with a very pleasant atmosphere and a view of the Gedächtniskirche (Memorial Church).

The service is excellent, cheerful, and very friendly and attentive.

Definitely worth a visit!

reviews.author: Gabriele Suelzen
reviews.text: Two years ago, you could still enjoy a glass of wine and a bite to eat while enjoying a great view (I was really looking forward to that). Unfortunately, that's no longer the case; instead, there's just a small drinks menu and a very specific clientele (looking for the perfect Instagram spot).

reviews.author: Marie Mellin
reviews.text: Cool location. Unfortunately no cloakroom

reviews.author: Mike Barry
reviews.text: It was a good experience and it was definitely worth going, however this was only due to the fact that a friend of mine was behind the DJ. I have gone here multiple times and usually I am not greeted with kindness and respect but when you’re behind the DJ, apparently service suddenly improves. It is also quite expensive and packed - the crowd is also rather hostile and odd. I wouldn’t say this is a typical Berlin club, but this is likely meant for people who are not into the usual Berlin scene. The pictures added, are from a previous visit.

reviews.author: Nathan Rieck
reviews.text:
Absolutely not recommended — if I could give 0 stars, I would.

We arrived there with a group of 5 appropriately dressed guys and the bouncer said: “not possible.”
Then a few couples walked up and were let in without hesitation.

reviews.author: Azzedine BELLOUT
reviews.text:
Unwelcoming and disappointing experience.
We were refused entry without any explanation, despite being well-dressed, respectful, and completely sober. There was no visible reason for the rejection. It felt arbitrary and dismissive. If you're looking for a place with a positive vibe and fair treatment, I strongly recommend going elsewhere. Berlin has much better venues where guests are treated with respect.

reviews.author: Mirosław Czerliński
reviews.text: Great event location with fantastic view on Berlin! You have here space to sit, stand ;), bars and club dancefloor. Place has 2 levels and great roof lighting on first stage. It is located on top of one of the highest buildings in the city. 🌆🌇 Perfect for sunset!

reviews.author: Nicola Hibbert
reviews.text:
Had fun last night in Berlin
They had a salsa night

reviews.author: Alexander Reiplinger
reviews.text: Nice view. Our drink was ok, nothing special but not bad. I'd come again mainly for the nice view. Drinks are around 12€ so more or less what one can expect for the location

reviews.author: Oleksii Ivashchenko
reviews.text: Cocktails are just ok, View is nice, however we were waiting more than 15 minutes for our order

reviews.author: Chen K
reviews.text:
Nice cocktails, but the rooftop is just ok. The view is not unique or special.
I didn’t see any food menu..

reviews.author: Jana F
reviews.text: I expected more from the rooftop bar. The view was nice, the furniture and decoration were stylish. However, the place seemed rather mismanaged. We had to step over some crumpeled covers or something at the entrance to the rooftop. Many tables had empty glasses but no guests. The two people at the bar were nice but seemed untrained. They removed the glasses from our table, but a quick wipe of the drink stains from the previous guests would have been nice.  Cocktails were not available anymore, so we chose long drinks. My basil spritz was red and tasted only of lemon juice. The music was nice. Maybe nice for hotel guests, but I wouldn't travel across town to get there.

reviews.author: Noheir El Adly
reviews.text: I visited the place twice. Once with a friend, and the second time organized the office Christmas drinks for a group of 16. It is a cost small place, so for the group, we gathered in the corner, which is as about right for the size. Bartender is professional. We got several recommendations for drinks. I recommend the Negroni. Prices are around 10€ and more and the glasses are small 😊. They do not serve nuts or snacks, as it is a smoker bar. If you want snacks of finger-food for a small party, one will need to rent the place.

reviews.author: Yusuf Hadi
reviews.text: Amano Bar is one of fantastic rooftop spots in Berlin! The view is amazing, offering a great panorama of the city, especially in the afternoon. The bartenders are super friendly. It’s the perfect place to unwind and enjoy the atmosphere. Definitely a must-visit for a chill night out in Berlin!

reviews.author: Valeriia
reviews.text: Great location with a beautiful view of Berlin and the sunset 😍 Very tasty cocktails and a friendly bartender. Definitely recommend ☺️

reviews.author: htwrepublica17 hoang
reviews.text: Nice rooftop bar. A little small, but the view is great, bartenders and service staffs are nice. Drinks are okay-ish

reviews.author: Henry Estevez
reviews.text: They canceled my reservation twice.  One because they booked an event and the other because "there was bad weather" even though it was completely sunny. I asked why they didn't notify me and their answer was "we can't notify people that their booking was canceled"

reviews.author: Erika Rosen
reviews.text:
Great bar with a bit of a night club vibe in the late evenings with a DJ getting the crowd on their feet. Great cocktails and friendly and attentive bartenders.

The only downside for me personally is that smoking is allowed inside so your clothes and hair will smell the next day. There is also a non-smoking lounge area for those more sensitive to smoke, however, the smoking section has a more festive vibe.

Show up before 21 on Saturdays if you want to find a seat!

name: Secret Champagne Garden
address: The Ritz-Carlton, Berlin, Potsdamer Platz 3, 10785 Berlin, Germany

reviews.author: JMC
reviews.text:
If you're going out of your way to visit you might want to call ahead first. The listed hours might be correct but they will close at anytime without notice if they're quiet. Reception was also unaware that they'd closed and gave us a key anyway. A waste of time.

From the marketing and signage it seems more like a Hendrick's Gin bar than a true champagne bar.

I'd suggest you try your luck elsewhere. This is a very weak offering from The Ritz-Carlton.

reviews.author: Stephanie Hoang
reviews.text:
Pricey, but aesthetic rooftop cocktail bar in the Ritz Carlton.

The drinks were nice. I didn't particularly like the truffle cocktail, because it was way too strong, but I can appreciate someone else may like it.

There's plenty of seating. There isn't much of a view from most of the bar, but it is nicely decorated.

I probably wouldn't go out of my way for this rooftop, but it was nice as we were on the way.

reviews.author: ELENI EFAPLOMATA
reviews.text: highly recommended, will definitely be back. Kudos to the cocktails and staff !!

reviews.author: Marta K
reviews.text: Amazing atmosphere and great staff! For sure I will be back there soon!

reviews.author: STYLIANI SARRI
reviews.text: A perfect place to be, I strongly recommend it.

reviews.author: Isabella Ranieri
reviews.text: I celebrated my birthday party on this terrace, and had an unforgettable time!! I immediately fell in love with the space and the atmosphere the team has created up there, and it felt too good to be true when they agreed to let me rent it out for my birthday celebration. My friends loved it and keep asking me when we are going back ;)

reviews.author: Jade Manning
reviews.text: Super nice location and lovely team! We'd be happy to come back anytime.

reviews.author: alexander held
reviews.text: Best place to view the skyline of Berlin!! Very clean only few gambling machines and vegan drinks

reviews.author: kamal josan
reviews.text: It's awesome place . I like it

reviews.author: Yuri Leontyev
reviews.text: Gambling place, expensive beer but ordinary, a lot of screen to watch sports

reviews.author: Dady Dady
reviews.text: Nice

reviews.author: Delia Grösch
reviews.text: The menu was fantastic and for my birthday they even got a piece of cake with candles on it :) The decor and the view are also impressive.

reviews.author: Mahsa “Akbarzadehjavan”
reviews.text: The place is nice with a very beautiful view, but the drinks are not really good. The drinks taste more like syrup than fresh ingredients. Also, we have ordered the snacks plate which had 4 items but thery brought us just 4 items on. Overall, its a nice view but not worth the money.

reviews.author: Ha Phuong “Rosa” Nguyen
reviews.text: The atmosphere was nice. Came here for the first time with my boyfriend when we were on the first date and we just visited here again for the second time. Nice to sit both outside or inside. Service was also nice

reviews.author: Iuri Matsuura
reviews.text: Lovely rooftop bar in Mercedes Benz arena. You get a nice view of the Spree and east side gallery. The cocktails are pricey but well prepared. It’s worth the price tag. Indoor have AC which is a life saver during summer. I haven’t tried the food, but should be as good.

reviews.author: Andres Capurro
reviews.text:
Food Quality: did not order, but there is only an option for bar snacks which seemed a bit overpriced for olives and biscuits.

Portions: normal drink sizes. Some very original glassware.

Drinks: quite a few options, being a bar and all that. As a former bartender, I was quite disappointed that a margarita was served without a salt rim.

Price: $$ mid range price

Service: very friendly staff. Always made sure we had drinks.

Atmosphere: very nice location. The decor in general is nice and welcoming.
It was unfortunate for us that the elevator was broken this week and had to go all the way up the stairs to the rooftop bar 😅

Highlights: nice location and decent drinks.

reviews.author: Daniel Chong
reviews.text: One of my favorite cocktail bars in the city. Love the vibe for a date night or just drinks with a friend in a fun but not insanely loud setting at afternoon. The view is AMAZING. They also have an extensive cocktail menu of well-made drinks and friendly service that will have you coming back again and again.

reviews.author: pratik kusumanchi
reviews.text: They have really good decor and atmosphere, also nice seating but not enough for a big group. Not enough choices to select, although it was small bar it has pool and some games which can be fun 😁.  It is worth visiting during evenings 🫡

reviews.author: James C
reviews.text: A really great place to spend your evenings for a chilled & fun one. Pool & electronic darts at really decent prices (€2 - 3 plays). Great cocktails (€7.50) with happy hours running all week (Mon - Fri/16:00 - 22:00), staff will also make excellent off menu cocktails at request. Lastly great shisha (€12), play your own music/mixes & kind attentive staff, always going the extra mile with their customer service. Big shout out to Daria and Bahar for making our evenings something to remember in Berlin.

reviews.author: Natalie Hardy
reviews.text: We went to play billiards. €1 a game, €10 deposit. Nice space in the back to play. Good choice of drinks and beers. Clean and Relaxing environment mid week. The Barman was friendly and helpful in English.

reviews.author: Sharna Polley
reviews.text:
By far the best bar in Berlin in my opinion, great atmosphere and an incredibly lovely bar lady - Lovely Daria ❤️ - who looked after us and made us feel so comfortable. Shishas, pool and cocktails (I personally recommend the swimming pool), absolutely can't go wrong! The decor is beautiful too

Daria, you made our visit perfect! Thank you

reviews.author: Levi JC
reviews.text: Very friendly place. Staff are lovely especially Daria we played darts together. I was having a bad day and she calmed me down.

reviews.author: Jacqueline Kraft
reviews.text:
Pros: great location and great view on the skyline, Variations of drinks and food on the menu

Cons: not dog friendly

Overall a great place and i would recommend people to come and enjoy the view. The food and drink are more on the expensive side but it is in a reasonable way as the location is top such as the view. I would come with great appetite. Great to come with friends.

reviews.author: Volker Schmidt
reviews.text: Great place to watch the sunset over Berlin. Usually not too crowded for dinner and drinks. Prices are high compared to value but nonetheless tasty. Expect 100€ for two with food and drinks. Service is usually slow, especially on outside

reviews.author: MAURICIO REYGADAS
reviews.text: The views make this place 1,000% worth it, and that’s before even ordering drinks or food. I do recommend getting a reservation because it can get very packed and if you want a nice seat outside you should book the terrace online. The drinks were good and the service was good. One little detail that I liked which made them stand out where the glass straws they use.

reviews.author: Alessandro Stefan
reviews.text: The place is nice with a great view, customer service is really nice as well, the food is very good but the prices should be revised, they are a bit expensive, although i understand you're paying for the view and mostly they sell drinks. Overall the place is very nice.

reviews.author: Brintha M
reviews.text: Baret is an amazing rooftop restaurant with a wonderful view from top. It's one of the best place in Berlin to catch the sun go down with some special cocktails and best foood! We had some drinks , starters and cake 👌🏽

reviews.author: Leah Pompey
reviews.text: Decent spot for food and drinks. Good location  Service can be a little slow but was very busy both times we went. Good range of options. Would return if back in the city

reviews.author: John Lieberman
reviews.text: Everything about this place is excellent. The view reminds me of my hometown (NY). Top notch bartenders and staff, friendly and unpretentious crowd. When we went here a few months back they had a DJ playing vinyl which was so cool! Where is he now? He played some pretty great music in an eclectic set, I recognised a few like Dave Lee or Louie Vega, but also great old school House tracks. We were actually really surprised. Easily one of my favourite places in Berlin so far!!

reviews.author: rosie wood
reviews.text: Amazing view from the rooftop bar. Came here 3 nights in a row from our hotel about a 5 minute walk away. Cocktail selection is not huge, but all we had seemed nice. I think unless you know it’s there, it seems hard to find (from a tourist’s perspective), we sort of stumbled upon it by accident really. Recommend for brilliant views towards the Waldorf Astoria.

reviews.author: Taylor McMullen
reviews.text: The Lillet Wild Berry cocktail is amazing!!  Service was great, and this place has an amazing view of the Kaiser Memorial Church both during the day and at night!

reviews.author: Sergio Chrysikopoulos
reviews.text: Great food,great view right at the center of Berlin.Cozy vibes,relaxed atmosphere...

reviews.author: Enmanuel Ortega
reviews.text: Nice environment, beautiful view.

reviews.author: Paul Hopkins (Paul)
reviews.text:
Nice lounge bar with roof top terrace.  Ideal place for a sundowner with 360 views of Berlin.

Great to come with friends for a nice evening.

Nice and chilled music in the bar.

reviews.author: Z O L U
reviews.text:
One of the few venues in Berlin where you can party with a view over the City!

It’s a broadcast studio, a restaurant, a bar and an event location, all in one. Open most days from 17:00 to midnight, this is a cool spot to watch the sun set over the roofs of Berlin. Cool inside and outside seating with a close to 360 degree view.

reviews.author: Simon Eldin
reviews.text: Totally relaxed nice ambience good comfy place to go I loved it plus theres views over Berlin to see good place to dine drink relax will be back again soon :))))))))))

reviews.author: Sabine Kadgien
reviews.text:
Extraordinary rooftop bar with restaurant.Stunning view all over Berlin.
Interesting interior design.
Very friendly  and inviting staff.
Food is also good .

reviews.author: Dani Nik
reviews.text: Once you get through the door a world of pleasure awaits you. It’s hard to find the entrance so make sure you don’t walk past it. This place is so nice I’m almost tempted to gatekeep.

reviews.author: Talal Arida
reviews.text: Best cocktails in town!! A must visit. Chilled and watched the sunset.

reviews.author: Matthias Lindenthal
reviews.text: And what a blast we had. Agree, finding the place is a challenge, getting past the bouncers (Hey Jim!) can be as well… but hey once you’re in, this place is heaven on earth. They played all the tunes you can wish for - hiphop straight from the 90‘s. Drinks were great. Can recommend literally anything from page 2 onwards. Ask for Mimi!

reviews.author: S. F.
reviews.text: This place is incredible. It's tricky to get in, but once inside the vibe is just perfect. Watching the swallows dive about in the air above listening to great tunes amongst the garden. Best drinks in town. Amazing.

reviews.author: Claudio Paganini
reviews.text: What a fantastic location. Great drinks. But getting in is incredibly hard. Gotta jump many hoops for that but once you make  it, it is entirely worth it. 10/10 would recommend.

reviews.author: Xenia Ershova
reviews.text:
Such a jem!
Stunning views and great service

reviews.author: Ludmila Sucha
reviews.text: This hidden gem is a must visit in Berlin! True atmosphere of the past of the East! On the picturesque Karl Marx Allee, away from eyes of masses, great friendly stuff and for me the most beautiful sunsets in Berlin❤️❤️❤️Oh and good prices👌🏼

reviews.author: Wayne
reviews.text: Amazing place tucked away. The bartender was really friendly / helpful, and the place had a great chilled vibe. Terrace had nice views of the city and a nice place to have a beer.

reviews.author: Hailee Xiang
reviews.text: It’s a hidden gem of berlin. When you arrive you have to “ring” at the panorama bar, which will automatically open the door for you. Once inside take the first elevator on the right to the top floor. The view is breathtaking, and our bartender was rly fremdelt and showed us the stunning outside area

reviews.author: yu
reviews.text: I want to give a full score to the service of a girl with short ash blonde hair. Not only she mix very delicious cocktail , but she also had a very good attitude! The balcony sightseeing of this restaurant is also very attractive!

reviews.author: Noyan Yalçın
reviews.text: Berlin needs more rooftop places like this! Very nice views of the city with amazing cocktails. Nicki minaj cocktail tasted and looked so good. I will definitely come again for watching the sunset

reviews.author: A. S.
reviews.text: This bar is very stylish … I’m getting strong ’80s vibes. The bartenders are doing a fantastic job serving creative drinks, some of which are inspired by the current museum exhibitions. The view is also lovely, the sunset must be incredible.

reviews.author: Dora
reviews.text:
Beautiful bar and great cocktail menu. But service left a bit bitter experience.

Very commercial approach: if you don’t order a lot and regularly you are asked to leave the bar. Not a place to casually grab a drink with friends. You feel a bit rushed to order more

reviews.author: Uliana Driannykh
reviews.text:
Nice place, beautiful view. Perfect and attentive service.
The cocktails were 4/5.

reviews.author: Yusuf Hadi
reviews.text:
Bar Clara in Berlin is a fantastic spot, especially if you’re looking for a cozy, intimate night out. The decor is gorgeous—stylish and inviting with warm lighting and chic furniture that make the whole place feel upscale yet comfortable. The view over the city is amazing, adding a really special vibe.

The service is excellent; the staff is friendly and really knows their stuff, making sure you’re taken care of from the start. The cocktails are top quality—creative, well-balanced, and you can tell they’re made with premium ingredients. They’re a bit pricey, but the quality totally makes it worth it. People need to understand that quality comes with high price :)

Whether it’s for a date night or just a chill evening with friends, Bar Clara nails the experience. I’ll definitely be back—it’s perfect for a memorable evening out.

reviews.author: Patrick Nadoll
reviews.text: We just dropped in for early NYE drinks and were pleasantly surprised. Nice drinks and a great setting with a cosy couch corner including fireplace and fantastic urban landscape views. The service was very friendly. We’ll have to try their rooftop bar in summer.

reviews.author: Yuan Joyce
reviews.text: Great atmosphere. Friendly service

reviews.author: Marni Abigail
reviews.text:
This bar is pretty hidden in the back of the hotel. You can either enter the hotel front entrance and walk toward the back or take the side entrance. There is a side entrance that has red lighting and just says “bar.” In the summer they close out the bar area and move everything to the roof top and offer summer cocktails. The roof top area is about 1/3 of the bar size.

The bar is very welcoming with an old library feel with bookcases lining one side of the room and artwork with sofas lining the other side. The bar menu is large and offers some interesting cocktails. Unfortunately we came on the last night they were open before moving to the rooftop bar, meaning a lot of fresh ingredients were not available. There is no beer on tap, if you are coming here for beer.

The cocktails here are a concoction of mainly alcohol with very little or no juice/sodas as a mixer, unless you order a gin tonic. The drinks are quite strong, but a bit small. In my opinion, if I am going to pay the same price as a cocktail as what I do in Zurich, but in Berlin, I should be blown away about how amazing this drink will be. I honestly did not find anything on the menu that I wanted, especially since everything was not available. I asked the bartender to make me a drink. It was ok.

FYI: There is only one bartender working here, so if it is full or you are a huge group, then don’t be surprised if you have to wait a while to get your drink.

All in all, the bar has a nice ambience and the bartender is competent, but for the price, I would rather spend my 15€+ for a cocktail somewhere else.

reviews.author: Dmitry Kisler
reviews.text: The rooftop bar is a genuine oasis at the centre of Berlin where you can gather your thoughts over a beverage with cigar. I’ll definitely return.

reviews.author: Maria Chistiakova
reviews.text: great place, nice view, drinks taste good and the price is affordable. i would definitely come back

reviews.author: Minia Merino
reviews.text: The place has nice view outside and nice decoration inside. Waiters are fine… but you can smoke inside !!! And it is full of ashtrays, the smell is disgusting and the offer of drinks is really poor. I am quite disappointed.. also, no music at all !! I would not recommend it.

reviews.author: María Camila Acosta
reviews.text: Great drinks and atmosphere. Bar staff is very kind and welcoming. The view from the bar is wonderful. Would definitely come back for more drinks. Loved it!!!

reviews.author: Océane
reviews.text:
I went there to party at the 5th floor. Entrance was 15€ + 2€ for the coat room. It is a bit expensive as the place was quite small. The DJ was pretty good, played from RnB, rap, hip-hop, afrobeats…
I didn’t order to drink so I am not sure if the price are worth it tbh.

reviews.author: Alexandre S (Alex S.)
reviews.text: The place is nice, the view is cool but is it really a bar?  We ordered 2 beers,  my friend asked for a San Miguel and she got one without alcohol... She didn't really mind so it was ok but then we ordered 2 Cuba libre and it took the bartender 20 minutes to do them ( there was maybe 10 people in the bar) and the best thing was that there was no alcohol!!!  and finally they charged us more than what was on the menu...

reviews.author: Johnny Dance
reviews.text: Lovely set up, awesome location, nice staff and depending the event also the right people. Middle price range on drinks. Great for summertime. Absolut recommendation.

reviews.author: Angie Castner
reviews.text: After arriving in Berlin, I checked into the Leonardo Royal Hotel and found this excellent hotel bar. The staff are super nice; there is a great range of food, snacks and drinks at very reasonable prices. My baba ghanoush was generous and amazingly fresh. With one small glass of tempranillo, this sneaky afternoon snack cost only 8 Euro! I highly recommend this hotel bar.

reviews.author: James Gilleran
reviews.text: Nice and friendly staff very clean and nice background music Very spacious and not expensive Part off the hotel

reviews.author: Enrica Finotto
reviews.text: Good vodka sour! Pretty environment

reviews.author: Sil Salirrosas
reviews.text:
The hotel bar has a very relaxed atmosphere, and the bartenders were always very friendly.
I really enjoyed the Spanish house red wine, especially the classic Margarita. I give it a 9/10.
There's a great selection of snacks at the bar (the fries were delicious), and the cocktails generally tasted as expected.

reviews.author: Morten Schwend
reviews.text:
Bar was okay. Service was very nice, music and food were also good.
The cocktails are tasty, but unfortunately, as in so many bars, the Moscow Mule is not served in a copper mug, but in a normal glass, hence the deduction of one star

reviews.author: Marwan Ragheb
reviews.text: Grace Restaurant & Bar offers an exceptional dining experience, combining a sophisticated, trendy design with impeccable service. The interiors exude elegance, creating a refined yet welcoming ambiance. The menu showcases top-quality ingredients, expertly crafted into exquisite dishes that impress in both presentation and taste. Service is highly professional and efficient, ensuring a seamless experience. For those who enjoy fine beverages, the extensive wine and champagne selection adds another layer of excellence. A top-tier destination for both business and leisure dining.

reviews.author: Ayup Grace
reviews.text:
I didn’t try the food yet that’s why I’m not rating it, but everything else is superb ♥️ .

And it has my name🤭. Great for cozy,classy hangout and it has amazing music too.

reviews.author: Sivani Kallingal
reviews.text:
The ambiance at GRACE is both elegant and vibrant. The interior green chairs, lighting, and a lively atmosphere created a great experience for us.
During our visit, we were particularly impressed by the  service provided by waiter, Yasar. His attentive and friendly service ensured we felt well taken care of throughout the evening. The combination of exquisite food and  hospitality made our dining experience truly memorable.

reviews.author: Yulia N
reviews.text: Thanks for the great birthday celebration! The place is very beautiful, the food is delicious — the tartare was simply amazing. They also have a great selection of cocktails. I had an unforgettable time and will definitely come back!

reviews.author: Vanessa Pohl
reviews.text:
This restaurant completely exceeded my expectations in every way—location, food, and service were absolutely outstanding. From the moment we arrived, everything felt effortlessly elegant yet welcoming.

The Grace Dessert Platter for Two is an absolute must-try! It’s worth every bite and perfect for sharing. Special mention goes to the cheesecake, which was simply out of this world—creamy, flavorful, and truly unforgettable.

The location itself is stunning, set within the elegant Hotel Zoo Berlin. The sophisticated atmosphere perfectly complements the dining experience. Just in front of the restaurant is a chic bar with great music, making it an ideal spot to grab a drink either before or after your meal. Definitely don’t miss it—it’s a wonderful addition to the evening.

Every detail, from the ambiance to the impeccable service, was executed flawlessly. I can’t wait to dine here again—it’s a place I would recommend without hesitation. Grace truly delivers a five-star experience!

reviews.author: Michael Schilling
reviews.text:
I've been to The Cloud multiple times now, and every visit is a little different — but always a blast.

What makes The Cloud stand out is its ever-changing vibe. The crowd and music shift depending on the night and the event, which keeps things fresh. One weekend you might be dancing to deep house with a stylish, international crowd — the next, it's techno or R&B with a more local scene. The DJs are consistently solid, and the sound system seriously delivers.

Drinks are reasonably priced for Berlin (especially for a club in such a central location), and the bartenders are quick and friendly. The staff at the door have always been professional — not overly strict but keeping the vibe right inside.

Tip: Check their socials or website to see what event is on before you go — the experience changes depending on the night, but that’s part of the charm.

reviews.author: Beril
reviews.text: nice environment friendly staff! def recommend

reviews.author: Kimberley N
reviews.text: Such a nice club!! Friendly staff and really good music at tokyo drifts parties 🔥

reviews.author: tudor uanikehi
reviews.text: Very nice Atmosphere and Dj. The place was spacious and the staffs were nice and respectful

reviews.author: Serhii Polishchuk
reviews.text: Super place, nice atmosphere and music

reviews.author: Patrik Glavan
reviews.text: It was nice to come with my family here for some great "würste". It is not overpriced and has a good location.

reviews.author: Nevkell Nevkell
reviews.text: Disgusting food. The schnitzel was not made on place. Maybe from lidl. The atmosphere is not good. Turist trapp

reviews.author: Hezlet Fernandes
reviews.text: Had a lovely evening here. The ambiance is good, great music. The service personnel were all very friendly. They have a good collection of cocktails and drinks which is the highlight of this place. Overall very good experience, will gladly return. Highly recommend

reviews.author: lisa heeney
reviews.text: Food and cocktails are gorgeous. Beautiful restaurant with lovely staff.

reviews.author: Alice C
reviews.text:
To all the tourists who wants visit here, you might be overcharged lots by some staffs there. Be careful don’t get rip off by them.

I went there on Christmas Eve and had a no sugar coke, sparking water, a aperil spirits, a pasta, I be charged 59 euro, they didn’t offer any bill and I didn’t realize it was a trick. We also paid another few dollars for their tips. I asked a receipt after I paid but I didn’t check at the time.

After i back to hotel I checked the receipt It’s only 39 euro we should pay. And it wasn’t a real receipt it’s more like a bill. it doesn’t shows any information of how much and the way I paid, only shows how much i have to pay.

It was awful experience to me because it’s first time I visited Berlin from Australia.

I wouldn’t recommend tourist to come here as they might rip off your money while you are relaxing on your holiday.

They did it on a Christmas Eve just make feelings awful wasted time to have awful memory at this restaurant!

Update 25/12/2023
I went to talk with their manager.
He was nice and after understand what happened last night. He apologised for it and returned the amount from overcharge.

reviews.author: J L
reviews.text: Service is friendly and drinks were good.  I think the price is fair for a great view.

reviews.author: Armin Urban
reviews.text: Berlin is a big metropol. No way to see it all when you only have a few days. This allows a great view on this amazing city. Day or night an amazing experience. Afternoon and evening there might be line. So, plan some time but it is worth the wait. The elevator to the 203 meter viewing level is already an experience. Nothing for people who afraid of heights. Enjoy

reviews.author: niall collins
reviews.text:
Bar staff very rude but the views are a must! You will not be disappointed or let down by the awesome views available here.

The fastest smoothest lift I ever travelled in. The other staff were great and friendly.

Straight off the train station and you access this gem in Berlin.

You can eat here too.

The views are accompanied with information for each view and you won’t be disappointed.

reviews.author: Deirdre Bartley
reviews.text:
Excellent views from the observation deck.
Booked a reservation time so had an hour to wait, a little bit pricey. Didn't stay for drinks as only a few seats along the bar.

reviews.author: Bass Wyndu
reviews.text:
The TV tower was one of the best tourist attractions I visited during my holiday in Berlin. The views were astounding, and due to the fact I went in December you got a brilliant view of the surrounding Christmas markets too. The one downside was how expensive the bar was (our 2 drinks cost €11) but it's to be expected in a tourist attraction like this.

I would recommend going up if you're in Berlin, and it's well worth booking a Fast Track ticket in advance to skip the queues.

reviews.author: Ronny Wydra
reviews.text: Actually I just wanted to go to the toilet... Super great evening, lovely, very nice service. Was immediately entertained and very tasty Cuba Libre! See you next time!

reviews.author: Ahmet
reviews.text: Thanks and a big shout out to bartender “Jerry” who has been rocking the night shift for 3 months!!!

reviews.author: Daniel Oswald
reviews.text: Friendly staff. Okay, it's a smoking bar, but everyone can live with that. Quaint "residents" who like to tell a joke. A dartboard and radio music. It deserves its place among us.

reviews.author: Georg Zielke
reviews.text:
Wonderfully welcoming! Great staff, including the manager!
It was fun! The prices are unbeatable!

reviews.author: Jean-Philippe
reviews.text:
Jay Jay sets the dancefloor on fire!
Efficient boss, 6 gintos in 1 minute!
Crazy bar

name: Spreegold Bikini Berlin
address: Budapester Straße 50 Im Bikini, 10787 Berlin, Germany

reviews.author: Ecem'in Seyahat Defteri
reviews.text: Today we had the most delicious BBQ burger and Lasagna here. I am usually too lazy to write a review but this place really deserves a nice review and score. ♡ I just ordered Lasagna but It was incredibly delicious I didn't expect it!!! There were different flavors in the burger and both were really perfect. You should definitely try the Lasagna especially, every bite leaves a great pleasure in your mouth. The staff is also very attentive and smiling. We would like to thanks all the crew for this very enjoyable dinner... (Try the lasagna) :)

reviews.author: Kevin Steve Lopez
reviews.text:
I had high hopes for Royal Benny (Benedict eggs), given the luxurious combination of ingredients. The brioche was soft, the torched salmon was well-prepared, and the truffle touch was a nice addition. The service was great, and the place had a pleasant atmosphere.

However, the most important aspect failed: the eggs, which were supposed to be poached, were completely cooked.

Not just one, but both eggs were hard-boiled, with no trace of runny yolk. For a dish centered around poached eggs, this is a serious and unforgivable mistake, especially considering the price. The contrast between a runny yolk and hollandaise is what makes Eggs Benny come alive, and here, it was completely missing.

A dish with so much potential and such good presentation just can't miss the basics.

reviews.author: Jo Patterson
reviews.text: Loved this place - great vibe, the food was 'fast' but not too fast all made in full view. Food and fresh blueberry milkshake was absolutely delicious. Great place to pick up some healthy fast food and watch the world go by. Staff were friendly too!

reviews.author: Mike Barry
reviews.text: The view from their terrace looks over Europa Center and also boasts a good view on two tall buildings which gives the restaurant a good atmosphere, especially during sunset. The service is incredibly kind and I definitely recommend going here for a glass of wine or a quick snack in the afternoon. I also recommend ordering a table if it is summer and you want to sit outside at sunset.

reviews.author: Tima zebardast
reviews.text: We were there early morning; the upstairs was not open to customers, so I am talking about my experience in the ground floor of the cafe.  We, six people, barely fitted; the dishes looked pretty but were not tasty at all. The coffee was also just mid-quality. They brought one order wrong. The location is great; the view is wonderful.

reviews.author: TH3 TR/\V1R
reviews.text: Posh, upmarket bar offering a variety of high quality cocktails. Staff was very friendly, knowledgeable, service quick. On weekends it can get busy and they invite DJs or live music to play. Of you want to get a table, better reserve ahead of your visit. Interior is a mix of modern and traditional bar elements, all clean, cosy and tidy.

reviews.author: Chris J.
reviews.text: Don’t be misled by the location—this bar is not operated by the Waldorf Astoria, and the difference in service is immediately noticeable. It’s run independently by someone who appears more interested in catering to his friends than offering any semblance of hospitality. If you’re expecting the signature Waldorf Astoria experience, you’ll be sorely disappointed. The atmosphere is unwelcoming, and the owner comes off as rude and dismissive. I strongly do not recommend visiting this bar.

reviews.author: kath K
reviews.text: I think everyone has their own idea of what constitutes a classic cocktail bar - for me, this is it. I still recall the first time i walked in & felt like i'd landed in an Art Deco period movie... It's certainly a luxe setting; velvet lounges, restful lighting and staff that like you to be at ease. We first visited Berlin in 2016 & while staying nearby, celebrated our anniversary with some cocktails at The Lang.I was introduced to my favourite rum (a 15yr El Dorado) by the wonderful barman on that occasion. We've returned to the city 4 times since & it's become a wee treat to visit the Lang & enjoy a cocktail or two (or 3!) for more anniversaries & birthdays. Their newest menu (Oct23) had some quite innovative options which did not disappoint. An indulgence and thoroughly treasured.

reviews.author: kristina popova
reviews.text: Nice interior, friendly stuff and delicious cocktails.

reviews.author: Julia Cristiane Aenne Denker
reviews.text:
I was there about 9pm by chance. It is a luxurious and very comfortable Bar for a Date with a Man you cherish. Not too busy, dimmed Lights, Club Music like in my Youth and a lot of Spirits and tasty Cocktails to choose from.
:We: have arranged for :Rehab Escorts: to pay a visit and meet well-behaved Single Men to show their skills to Novices ;-)
So, maybe you get a Glimpse :-D

name: Park Inn by Radisson Berlin Alexanderplatz

reviews.author: Mehmet Onur
reviews.text: The staff at this hotel are truly outstanding — from housekeeping to reception, security, and management, every single person was warm, respectful, and genuinely dedicated to guest comfort. I would especially like to thank Ms. Stein and Ms. Schneider for their exceptional kindness, professionalism, and sincere care. They went far beyond expectations to assist me, always with a smile and positive attitude. I also want to acknowledge the hotel’s management team for leading by example and creating such a welcoming and service-focused atmosphere. Their leadership clearly inspires the entire team to deliver top-class hospitality. Combined with the hotel’s perfect central location and spotless, well-maintained rooms, my stay was truly unforgettable. Wholeheartedly recommended!

reviews.author: Isabel Fernández Tomás
reviews.text: Nice hotel conveniently located close to Museum Island, U and S stations and with many bus and tram stops in the vicinity. My room was in the 18th floor, with a nice view from the window, clean and modern. I got new clean towels everyday. Breakfast is abundant and served from six to eleven each morning and dinner in the hotel restaurant is good price and good quality. If I would come back to Berlin I would stay here.

reviews.author: David Warren
reviews.text: Perfect location to explore most of the iconic landmarks that Berlin has to offer and easily accessible from the airport by train. Directly outside the hotel you have the underground station which can get you around the city quickly. We stayed on the 13th floor and the views were incredible but you can also take the lift to the top where there are deck chairs and a small bar to soak in more of the views. Pillows in our bedroom were thin and there was issues with the shower and toilet draining. When drinking or eating in the restaurant/bar in the lobby there is only a toilet which you have to pay for by coin otherwise you have to take the lift to the second floor.

reviews.author: Kim Kuro
reviews.text:
Horrible Experience – Do Not Recommend

This is easily the worst Radisson I have ever stayed in, and as a VIP member who has visited many locations across countries.

The room was outdated: the bathtub was full of scratches, the side table was falling apart, and—most importantly—there was no AC or fan. The so-called “climate control ceiling” did not work at all. When it was 35°C outside, it felt just as hot (if not hotter) inside, and when the temperature outside dropped to 24°C in the evening, the room still felt like 35°C—stuffy and suffocating. The window couldn’t be opened, making it even worse. Sleeping was impossible.

The hotel’s response was unacceptable. They said there was nothing they could do except have someone check it the next morning. There was no ice machine, and when we asked for ice to help cool the room, they suggested we go to the bar. They offered to switch rooms but couldn’t guarantee it would be cooler. Only after reading other reviews did we realize that some guests at least had been given table fans, something they never offered us.

We booked for three nights as a birthday trip for my partner. It was so unbearable that we had to leave in the middle of the night on his birthday.

As loyal Radisson guests, this was beyond disappointing. We will not be returning and cannot recommend this hotel to anyone.

reviews.author: Joanne Lancaster
reviews.text: Just back from an excellent trip. I found all the staff very welcoming and friendly, any questions I had they were willing and able to help with. The hotel overall and the room was very clean and well maintained. I had breakfast and 1 dinner in the restaurant, service and food both great. Location of the hotel was perfect and central with good transport links to the airport and other parts of the city. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend this hotel to others!

reviews.author: Keewen Lee
reviews.text: Shout out to Michelle and marsya! Best cocktail team in Europe! Great hospitality, skills, service and kindness. Definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Rozus Suchsuch
reviews.text: Very nice staff, beautiful and delicious drinks

reviews.author: Aria Silver
reviews.text: Fantastic cocktails in a lovely, cosy atmosphere.   Bar staff are friendly and make a fabulous Rum Sour! :)

reviews.author: Marijn Van bekkum
reviews.text: We had a super warm welcome by the bartender. They have a huge selection of cocktails and the ones we had were perfect Would definitely recommend this bar for anyone who likes to have a good cocktail in a fun bar

reviews.author: Josh Mahon
reviews.text: Very nice staff and we’re happy to help us choose a cocktail which were reasonably priced.

name: Sky Cocktail Bar Steglitz
address: Steglitz Kreisel Turm, Albrechtstr. 2, 12165 Berlin, Germany

reviews.author: Steven Saikinson
reviews.text: The bar is really great. If you could still have a drink upstairs as a Steglitzer like you used to, that would be great. The people at the hotel reception like to make your life difficult and briefly feel like powerful bouncers and say that it is only for guests. But that's not how management thinks. But if you can get past the busybodies the bar is really great and the staff really know their stuff.

reviews.author: Monika Anhaeuser
reviews.text: Great atmosphere, friendly service, and a large selection. We really enjoyed it 😊😊😊😊

reviews.author: joel valomet
reviews.text: The setting ok, the bartender a little less...

reviews.author: T “N0x” N0x
reviews.text:
Not reliable on the sky cocktail bar.
Sometimes it's open, sometimes it's just closed.

reviews.author: Andreas Müller
reviews.text: Cozy like in the 80s

reviews.author: Ueda Etona
reviews.text: this bar is located in the hotel and welcomes any guests including solo travellers and family guests. actually I went with my twelve years old son and I asked them to have a non-alcohol original cocktail. thanks to their service oriented mind, my son really enjoyed his drinks seems like the same as the adult people drink. that was an awesome one with the inspiration and good consideration. you can enjoy food as well if you sit at the wall side table.

reviews.author: Fah Chana
reviews.text: I followed the other review for the drinks and indeed experienced the best martini in my life ( the staff also recommended this pornstar one, thank you x) plus I nibbled the tasty crackers nonstop. Very nice, elegant while friendly atmosphere (went alone and was ok x).

reviews.author: BlakeElChulo
reviews.text: If you’re just coming here for drinks it’s great. If you’re looking for a place to eat go somewhere else. Food was pretty subpar, limited selection with not a lot of flavour and overpriced. Cheeseburger was dry, had no sauce and probably the worst I’ve ever had. The tuna was so overcooked you could barely tell it was tuna. I’m not usually one to comment on service but the servers were nowhere to be seen. Waited 20 minutes after we finished to get the bill, and not a single staff person was in sight. In the end we just walked out and tried to find someone.

reviews.author: Alister Kyle
reviews.text: Great service, friendly staff, and a good selection of drinks. Highly recommend. Hagen and Anjana looked after us very well during our evening in the bar. 👌🍻

reviews.author: Adi Yehoshua
reviews.text:
Amazing cocktails, classy, calm
Tanni's service was attentive, professional and super nice!

reviews.author: Debbie Foster
reviews.text:
We had a bad experience of really poor service at a Vietnamese restaurant not far from here, so stopped for a water and coke and to give our feet a rest. It was a lovely spot with big umbrellas for shade. Today was particularly hot so it was nice to get out of the sun for a while.
The staff were so friendly too which gave us more reason to stay a little longer.
Well done on creating a good, happy atmosphere in your space by the river.

reviews.author: Patricia Repol
reviews.text: The pizza surprised me, very good. The highlight there is the atmosphere, great for a sunny day in Berlin

reviews.author: Ceyhun Şahin
reviews.text: very cool place, affordable prices, amazing location with cool people. amazing for summer day drinks

reviews.author: victoria vervat
reviews.text: We went there with a group of 35 people for pizza’s and they were so helpful and super chill. The two people who were making the pizza made all 35 pizza within 20 min!! Also the guy behind the bar was so so nice and friendly. It was overall an amazing experience and would def go there again!!

reviews.author: The Lives Of Concepts
reviews.text: I've loved coming to the bar for about 20 years now, but the service has sharply declined now. On a Friday night, it was not even 9 pm, the bar man had closed the taps - despite us having our arrival previously announced and agreed that we could stay till 10 pm. So a group of 30 people not only didn't get beer from the tap, the bar man then also suggested that he would close rather soon. Very disappointing!

reviews.author: Alice V.
reviews.text: Service is fine but the food quality is very poor. Burned nachos on one side, overcooked egg, cold fries… well, a tourist trap.

reviews.author: Loz H
reviews.text:
Amazing place we accidentally stumbled upon.
Food: amazing.
Drinks: amazing.
Service: 10 stars!!!
Capo is an incredible man with an amazing story and the best service I have come across.
He knows exactly what he is doing, and has an amazing team.
Could not recommend this place any more!
Wow ☺️

reviews.author: Yvonne F
reviews.text: We ate here twice on our recent visit to Berlin. It's located below the TV Tower. Quite a large restaurant with seats inside and out. We all enjoyed what we ate there the only thing that let it down a little is both times the food cooled quite quickly after arrival. Not sure if it had been sitting in the kitchen for a bit before coming out. However, the food was nice and they have lots of choice. Also a nice place to watch the world go by with a beer or coffee. I'd recommend the pizzas and the toasties.

reviews.author: Zuzanna Kłodowska
reviews.text: Terrible service, had to wait over an hour for the food. The waiters kept forgetting when we asked for a straw or another drink. There’s plenty of waiters but no one paid attention to our table. Do not recommend. Prices are alright and food as well but the service made it way worse. There are better places in that range which actually take care of their customers :)

reviews.author: Margo Luchko
reviews.text:
The Central Café near the TV Tower in Berlin is a great place with an incredible atmosphere.
I didn’t try the food, but the cocktails are absolutely amazing! 💫⭐️
Huge glasses, juicy fruits, and impressive presentation. The taste is top!! 10+
If you want to enjoy not only the taste but also the atmosphere, this place is definitely worth a visit!

name: Mokka Mitte
address: James Simon Park, Stadtbahnbogen 159/160, 10178 Berlin, Germany

reviews.author: anne putri
reviews.text: Mokka Mitte in Berlin is a cozy bar nestled in the Mitte district, known for its prime location in James Simon Park, just steps away from Museum Island and the Spree River. With its relaxed atmosphere, it’s a great spot to unwind after a day of exploring Berlin’s cultural sites. They serve a variety of dishes, from German classics to tasty pizzas, and offer comfortable seating inside or out on their terrace—perfect for enjoying sunny days. The food is good, the vibe is chill, and the people-watching is spot on! ￼

reviews.author: Hendrik Beenker
reviews.text:
I just had some drinks here on a warm evening, but walked past it on earlier occasions, snd it seems to be a good hangout based on the amount of people.

They have a good drinks selection, with some variety in beers that are decent. The views are excellent and the location is very Berlin.

reviews.author: SZO 360
reviews.text: Very nice bar in one of the nicest spots on the banks of the Spree river in Berlin. Zip your cocktail in a deckchair, enjoy the relaxed atmosphere and watch the people strolling in the park.

reviews.author: Andy Chaplin
reviews.text: The name wouldn't lead you to think this, but the pizza here is about as authentic Italian as you can get.  The service is excellent and in the Summer you can sit on the terrace and watch Berlin strolling along the banks of the Spree.  They offer a good selection of wine and the prices are more than fair.  One thing you should note is that it's located under a railway, so you will hear (and feel) the occasional train rolling by.  But that certainly doesn't spoil the experience.  Well worth a visit!

reviews.author: L LC
reviews.text: Excellent prices and really tasty Italian food. Don't let the branding fool you! It's a great place for food and drink, especially when the sun is shining and you can sit outside.

name: The Unique Bar Berlin
address: Sheraton Berlin Grand Hotel Esplanade, Lützowufer 15, 10785 Berlin, Germany

reviews.author: Visay Saycocie
reviews.text: Great bar with live music at weekend. Bar staff very professional and you get cool drinks there. Want more? Don't order from the drink menu. Just tell the barkeeper what you like. You will be surprised!

reviews.author: Dr Arthur Kurt Eilers
reviews.text: A place were always you find a minute of relax,  joy, friends and super cocktails. Unique whiskey, and other world famous or not none Rum or.. As well a super team that serves in a professional way that biggest nurt cannot complain.  Your desire there whish served with a humble and integrity. Also such a large card of non and alcohol cocktails. World best musicians play live.  A place to be every time you visit Berlin.  With pleasure Dr. Arthur.

reviews.author: Conor Sweeney
reviews.text: Was expecting a far more interesting place. It's just an ordinary hotel cocktail bar. Not worth going out of your way for. Attitude of one staff member in particular was very off-putting.

reviews.author: RMA
reviews.text: Spent a wonderful night there. Great life music, danced, sang and lots of fun. Service excellent, super friendly and attentive. A must go!

reviews.author: Vidhya Vijayakumar
reviews.text: Awesome cocktails with great setup. They had live music after 10 pm had a great time.
